reviews.comment: I think she's still trying to get her footing in terms of her teaching style. She's very intelligent and could tell you a lot about the subject but she'd have students do presentations each class and I did not find it a really effective way to retain info. She was also really particular in her grading and was somewhat harsh.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Extremely dry lectures

Class lectures were very dry, and grading was unclear. Two essay tests were 65% of the grade, making it a high stakes class. If you take a class from her, read the material, show up to class, and study hard. She will make you work for your grade, but overall is a knowledgeable teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Cottiero is incredibly intelligent and knows her material very well, but severely lacks confidence and teaching skills. Her lectures are extremely boring and difficult to sit through. The class material is pretty straightforward and not difficult, but the lectures made me nearly drop the class. Tests are easy if you study course concepts.
Boring lectures, but if you pay attention and do the readings, you'll do well.

i loved prof crowley's class, one of my favorite classes ive taken! as long as you participate in class and bring new ideas to discussions he will enjoy you as a student. most of the tests are essays but he gives designated time to write them. there are a lot of readings that you have to do which you talk about in class but he makes it interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He has easily been one of the best professors I've had so far. He can be strict but it never comes off as unnecessary or excessive. He did have a lot of personal hardships and excessive work burdens during our 2025 Fall Semester, but he did a great job communicating to us about how it impacted his duties as a professor. He still put in his best.
Prof Crowley has been my favorite professor in college so far.
Very personable guy, really enjoyed my class with him. Really knows the material and wants you to do well.

Prof Crowley was a fantastic professor. It is clear he cares about his students and makes his lectures super entertaining. He grades tough for sure, but if you put effort and are a talented writer, you will succeed. He drops a lot of quiz scores and gives you many opportunities to do well. Can not recommend more.

He didn't grade any of our essays until the day grades were due, so we had no clue what was expected of the essays based on previous feedback. Grades very harsh for a 1000 level gen-ed and doesn't fully explain what is expected and what to improve on the essays.

Professor Crowley is a very fun and engaging professor. You get 4 main essays and a final essay, graded extremely hard. We got feedback on the first essay, and not a single other essay was graded till after finals were over, leaving over 400 points to just go "randomly" into the gradebook, not knowing what to expect of my grade.
Professor Crowley is incredible. He cares so much about the topic he's teaching. Attendance isn't mandatory but you learn so much if you go to class. Highly recommend!!!

This is combined for 1050 and 3900. He was easy in 1050 and overall good my huge issue with him comes in 3900 he did not release any of the essay grades before December third. This includes one in October. Gives students no time to improve if grades aren't released. Attendance is mandatory if you want to do well. Great lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: *I took him for MGT 3900* He does live up to his reviews about being great however I was disappointed in the class. It just became a history class instead of showcasing the power of women in capitalism. He also didn't release grades/feedback about the papers so I didn't know what to improve on for the next ones.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mr. Crowley might be one of the best if not the BEST professor/teacher I've ever had my entire life. His lectures are fun and simple to follow, and he lives by the philosophy "show up to my class and you will succeed". Take home quizzes based on the readings, and 5 writing assignments which are relatively easy. Do yourself a favor- TAKE HIS CLASS!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing, hilarious guy. He cracks me up.
I love Mark Crowley

Crowley is awesome.  Even though this was online, his lecture videos were really well done.  We knew exactly what we had to do to get a good grade.  His rubrics were super clear.  I spoke with him several times in the semester and he always had great feedback and encouragement.  Do yourself a favor and take this man for 1050.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Crowley, British wit, very caring about his classes and students. Tough grader when it comes to the essays. Lectures are mandatory, but very insightful. 10/10 professor. Given the fact the school took away his Ta's in the middle of the semester, he was determined to make sure everyone got good grades if you tried.

Extremely knowledgeable in his material, making him a well-versed teacher. He lost half of his funding throughout this semester, and it showed. I did not receive feedback on my midterm, and he was quite petty in the verbiage he used when replying to my email. I understand that these things were not in his control, but I honestly expected more.

Professor Crowley is an excellent professor who cares about his students. He had no problem meeting with me and helping me prepare for my mid term. Great job of using first world examples in his content as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: This is a great class taught by probably one of the best professors in the Business School.  He teaches so many courses in one semester, but still has time for all his students.  Even though this was a Zoom class, he worked so hard to make it interactive.  I learned so much, and I can't wait to do Crowley's upper division class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Crowley is amazing! You can tell he really cares about his students and wants what is best for them. He is the best. There is a lot of reading, but not many other assignments, so it's not too bad. Quizzes every week.

He is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is a super good guy, and he cares about his students. He is also very knowledgeable and is very good at teaching the material using his research insights in his class.

One of the best professors that I have had! Super caring and understanding of students and real life problems. He makes all feel included within the class and the lectures are interesting. Allows for in class discussions that really help everyone understand what is going on.

Professor Crowley is an amazing lecturer; concise, funny, and knowledgeable. You will learn if you pay attention. He is accommodating and will offer extensions on the midterm and final essay if you communicate with him. You will have reading before class but overall you can float through this course. Shouldn't be too hard.

Professor Crowley was awesome. You are required to read the textbook a lot each week but the quizzes about them are really easy. He only has 2 essay midterms and is honeslty so understanding. He will teach you a lot and I would recommend taking him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Crowley! He has been the best experience I have had so far, and probably will be for my whole stay here at the U. He is down to earth, super funny, and very relatable. His class is engaging and as long as you show up, usually an A.

Mark Crowley is probably one of the best professors that I have taken so far. The readings we had to do were sometimes hard to understand, but Cowley did everything he could to ensure we all understood the readings. He truly cares for his students' well-being and will do anything he can to help. I 100% would recommend!

Mark Crowley is hands down the best professor at the U. Super genuine nice guy, entertaining, makes the content interesting and relevant. I told him I got broken up with and he excused me from attending class for the week! Still had to do the participation homework for missing class but that was only offered for excused absences like being sick.
I'm not a business major and still loved this class since I took it for the humanities credit. If you have the opportunity to take a class from Crowley, jump on it.
Amazing person, he always made class enjoyable and work was very light.

Crowley is an amazing professor. He cares about his students and clearly loves what he does. He is super understanding, as long as you communicate with him you can get an extension on basically any assignment. There is reading that has to be done before each class, but you can get away with not doing it all every so often.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Best Teacher you'll ever have!
THE only professor you should take if you have the chance. Does an amazing job explaining material, grading is not too tough, and makes class a fun time.
Really nice guy and great professor. Only bad thing is that attendance is mandatory and there is a bit of reading required for every class.

Professor Crowley clearly cares so much about his job as a professor and each individual students well being and mental health as well as their retention of the material. I absolutely loved the layout of this class and he clearly understands the importance of communicating with classmates and working together to come to conclusions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment:
Professor Crowley is by far the best professor I have had at the U. He is so incredibly genuine and helpful. He truly has been a blessing in my college education. Outside of class, he is a phenomenal and supportive mentor. He only wants the best for you and wants you to succeed!

Minimal courseload, weekly quiz, two essays (hard to fail!)
He deeply cares for his student and is one of the best professor in busses school. It was amazing being taught by him, his class are exciting to attend!

An incredibly sharp individual, Dr. Crowley cares deeply about the success of his students. It has been a privilege to learn from him. Highly recommend his class. He turns an otherwise banal subject matter into important and exciting discussion. I wish he taught every course I take. Challenge yourself to expand your horizons, he casts a wide net.

Dr. Crowley is a very sweet and caring professor who wants his students to succeed. The class isn't too hard, just readings and lectures; only tests are essays. Quizzes each week. Super understanding and approachable, he really cares about what he's teaching and is willing to give extensions if you ask. Pick Crowley; you won't regret it.

Very funny professor, provides everything needed to get an A in the class. Very flexible on time and will help you if you are struggling. Quizzes every week but are very easy and answers are in his slideshows.

Crowley is great. There is reading before class then a discussion each class. Weekly quizzes that are easy if you review the videos or powerpoint before. Two essays that aren't very long. 100% would take again. Best professor.
Professor Crowley is hilarious! It was genuinely an enjoyable class that I looked forward to going to.

Professor Crowley's class is fantastic, he is a great lecturer and cares about his students. There is clear grading criteria and most of it is weighted on participation and quizzes that you can get a good grade on as long as you pay attention in class.
Such a nice guy with a lot of interesting things to say.
Such a great class. The readings were interesting and Professor Crowley is one of the nicest and most genuine professors/teachers I've ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Crowley was just amazing! Truly loved being in his class. He is very understanding and is very open-minded to whatever you discuss in class. The homework load isn't bad at all just 2-3 readings each class is due and he provided videos if you don't completely understand. Overall, great class and great guy.

Prof Crowley is one of the best professors at the U. He knows his stuff and actually cares about the students. He has a light-hearted personality and isn't afraid to crack a joke hear and there. Overall a very good class and actually learned a lot. You won't be disappointed if you pick Mr. Crowley, and you will probably enjoy the class.

Mark Crowley is amazing. He is a great professor and he loves what he does. I took 1051 and it was very easy because every week you come to the meeting prepared with notes on 2-3 readings each class and it/'s 2 days a week. 10/10 would take him again, he is the sweetest and most understanding person.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Mark is an amazing lecturer - the readings in the course are not too difficult and if they are, he'll make sure to let you know. He is a caring professor who genuinely has the interest of the student at heart. He embraces all types of ideas and creates a great environment for exploration.

Prof. Crowley is one of my favorite professors that I've had. Attendance is a huge must for his class since 40% of your grade comes from participation. Every class is structured the same. It's a lengthy 80 min lecture twice a week, but to quote him, "what you put into it is what you'll get out of it".
Mark is a legend. All you need to do is show up to class and take decent notes and you'll get an A for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Crowley is the best teacher in the whole business school.  I really looked forward to his class and the discussions.  He is easy to reach, and he is always willing to help.  He's very caring and not pretentious in the slightest.  Take his class if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: He is so far the best business professor I've had at the business school. There are a lot of required readings, however, I didn't do any of them and I ended up with an A. As long as you show up and contribute to the discussion it's a pretty straightforward class.

Great guy who cares about his students. He has a lot of stories and loves to get to know his students. Very passionate about what he teaches. You get out what you put in. Not a lot of assignments unless you don't attend class. Overall great professor who loves teaching.

Professor is extremely caring of all his students in his classroom. The homework is manageable. In class discussions of difficult topics are not often enlightening. It feels like broad topics are extracted from readings then discuss surface level implications. Essay prompt questions are very elementary and not very thought provoking.

I am not one for History but Crowley makes it super fun. His lectures, even though online, were super interactive and engaging. He really makes you think about the real world not just the reading itself. He gives you a chance to speak your mind and helps you with your thought process. The class is graded by attendance weekly quizzes, and 2 essays.

Professor Crowley was the nicest professor I had this semester. Each week you do a couple readings and hop on a couple zoom calls and that's all the homework you will have. There's 2 writing finals but they are reasonable. If you pay attention the content is actually pretty interesting!

Passionate and concise. Professor Crowley is great at explaining relatively complex topics in simple, concise ways that really help when digesting the readings. On top of that, hes very kind, accommodating, and entertaining. Definitely worth taking his class. Reading is fairly light, and grading criteria is very clear.

An amazing professor that really cared about all of his students. Always had a story to tell to the class, making it easier to connect with him. As long as you do the readings and show up to class you'll do just fine.
Homie is awesome, he loves to teach and it makes his lectures so much more enjoyable. The class content isn't too hard and the quizzes are pulled straight from the slides.
Professor Crowley is the best professor you will ever have! Loves to teach and is super understanding.

Professor Crowley is one of my favorite professors so far. You get points just for showing up to the class and saying something in the discussion or you can participate on canvas instead. This class was hard enough that its not boring but if you try then you will do well. He is very easy to work with and will make accommodations if needed.

This class is a very heavy on group discussions, so be prepared to share with your fellow students. Crowley is very open and truly cares about his students. If you care about his class, he will take care of you. He is also very straight forward and easy to work with. Would highly recommend to anyone.

Hands down one of my most favorite professors! He is such a stud and makes our discussions in class so enjoyable. He really cares about student success and is so good at phrasing questions to expand your thinking process. Wish he taught more courses because he would do so well in any course taught!
I took his class this spring semester and it was so good! You should be fine if you are in class, take notes, and do all works.
The most genuine, caring and nicest professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hes a really good professor and if you go to class and do the work you will learn a lot. Also worth it to go to class because there will be a lot of funny things that happen. Tests are all open book/note and you have plenty of time to do the other assignments. Good class to take.

He is one of my favorite professors I have ever had and genuinely cares about his students. He will extend deadlines if you talk to him in advance. The material covered is adequately interesting, but he makes it so much more engaging. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Truly cares for students, and understanding, always willing to push deadlines if needed. Philosophy is hard for me but he really did a good job explaining each passage. Best professor I've had, and I actually looked forward to the class.

He is the best professor I have ever had. He genuinely cares about his students and is passionate about teaching. He is funny and is extremely understanding. He is willing to give extensions and extra credit just to help out his students. The class material was ok but he made it 1000x better. He is such a caring person and is a great professor.
He really is a top-of-the-line professor, and I would recommend him to any of my friends. A really nice, funny guy who will push you. The U should give this man a raise!
Best professor I've had to date. He cares for his students and cares about his job. The best professors are the ones who care. Oh, and he's British so that's fun

She's an amazing professor for a student who is not very great at chemistry, like me. I thought I didn't like chemistry until I took it, and now I'm finding myself interested in it. A lot of homework, though, tests are straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: professor Carr is a great, she explains concepts really well, the course is nicely structured, and the final exam is not cumulative. However, the class is test heavy and they can be difficult, she grades harshly on the tests. Other than that she was great.

Gretchen was kind however such a difficult class. When grading on tests she only gave credit for right or wrong and nothing else. When asked how I could help my grade she took weeks to respond and finally gave 2 EC points on an 80-point exam. Comparatively to the Chemistry I am taking now, it was unnecessarily difficult.

Gretchen was an amazing professor! I took Chem 1210 with her, but that wasn't an option to pick. Lectures were a little dull to me but the examples and everything else really helped me understand. Sometimes I didn't attend lecture which was difficult to catch up, but I still managed. The course had homework that was necessary and super helpful!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Gretchen for chem 1 and she was great. Its a tough class but she really wants you to learn and succeed. I am now in chem 2 with a different professor and have had more help from her than my own teacher. She has taken the time to hop on zooms with me to help me through difficult concepts and sent me videos that pertain to what I'm learning.

Gretchen was the reason I changed my major to Chemistry. She really made sure we understood everything and would check our work in class to make sure everything was comprehended. She cared a lot about everyone  in class and always gave us resources to do well. The homework is heavy, but if you do it, you'll do well on tests. The HW was necessary.
There are daily quizzes and lots of homework in this class. If you are working and trying to take her class I advise you to not do so. Her lecture style was not for me and it is very test heavy
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I never thought I could be taught chemistry, but I stand corrected. What we need to know was clear, exams were straightforward. Carr was kind and understanding and willing to stay after to help you understand. If you can, take her chemistry courses.

It's a tough class due to the material, but professor Charles is awesome. Super sweet soul of you get to know her and always wants the best for her students. She's not a tough grader, but coming to class and solidifying the material on your own time is essential. Not an easy A class but 10/10 would recommend professor Charles

Shannon Charles is an excellent teacher. She makes complex concepts very simple, and spoon feeds it in a way that makes you confident about the material. She is also very caring and helpful to her students for office hours. Can't recommend her enough!!! Make sure to give your best to every class and you'll do fine.

Shannon is a good teacher, but her teaching doesn't prepare students well for exams. The exams are harder than the practice exams, often including twists or steps not practiced in class. You need to know the accounting theory/logic and formulas very well. She also teaches really fast, which can make it hard to follow, ask questions, and take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Shannon was very intentional about having frequent office hours. USE HER OFFICE HOURS!! She is a forgiving grader and rewards effort. That being said, the grading is VERY test heavy and the tests are not easy if you aren't in class every day. She will do good pretest review days which should prepare you well for your PERSONAL review/study.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Extremely hard exams but she's available to meet outside of class for extra help.

Professor Charles truly wants students to succeed and often offers extra help outside office hours. However, her exams are tough, with most points coming from short-answer questions that build on earlier calculations, making small mistakes costly. Projects will pull your grade up, as well as exam reviews and homework. Use her help & the TA's.
Moves too fast
DONT TAKE!!!!!! one month in and she's the worst
Show up to class and do the in-class session sheets that are handed out. Shannon is also super willing to help with all assignments and is incredibly fair with test grading.
Great Teacher, accounting is hard but her lectures are thorough and she is very easy to understand. Great teacher and would take again. JUST BE SURE TO DO THE READINGS

As someone who isn't an accounting major this class was one of the harder classes i've taken. Although, Professor Charles was always helpful in explaining topics if I was confused on it. Study the materials like crazy and make sure you fully understand it and you'll be okay and pass the class.

Professor Charles is very kind and she is super passionate about accounting, she's not as great when it comes to connecting with students during her lectures. But she gives you all the materials and resources needed to help pass the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Shannon is just so boring, I stopped going to class even though you had to get attendance, she was awful at keeping people engaged but she's decent at teaching. Don't recommend but if you like just strait material for an hour and half of accounting shes probably your teacher.

does absolutely nothing to be engaging and if you don't lock in you're just screwed. everyone cheated on all the exams (which is going to ruin it for future semesters). talks like a robot and has no human connection to her students at all. i dont get why she has high reviews, i get this class is hard but she did not make it any better

Professor Charles was amazing! Her lectures were always helpful. Exams reflected everything we had learned and she gave study guides before every exam. As long as you do the homework and study guides you will do great in her class.

I don't understand how she has good reviews. Shannon talked too fast, and I learned more from the TAs than her. Her lectures and slides are messy and wordy. She also picks the hardest questions for the Accounting exams and does not care about her students. It felt like every opportunity she had to help us, she failed us instead.

Professor Charles is a wonderful individual who greatly cares about the success of all her students. I'm a Business Admin major and this course is mostly targeted at Accounting majors. This course is extremely difficult, but very informative. Study hard and make friends and you will do alright. Don't let your first exam score discourage you.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Shannon knows her stuff. She is so well versed in accounting and passionate about the subject. She is clear on grading and the materials and tells you exactlly what you need to know. If you have to use AI to pass this accounting class, you are lazy and incompetent, because she spells out everything you need to know and also requires attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Charles is a great person! Lectures teach you what you need to know but aren't very engaging, I fall asleep almost every class. I like that you can retake an exam if you get below an 80, she tries her best to help all her students get a good grade. However, I failed this past exam.

Prof Charles is great at explaining tough topics and is always available to help. She prepares you very well for exams, but the material is still very challenging. You can do well in this class you just have to really dedicate time and effort.

Absolutely love this woman. Explain things well and provide example problems that help solidify concepts. Had weekly quizzes but was frankly nice because it kept me on top of the content. Bummer she only taught for the first half of the semester.
This is a challenging class, especially the tests. But she is an amazing professor! Don't hesitate to go get help from her. Befriend others in the class to compare homeworks and study guides also.

Professor Charles is one of the best professors I have had throughout college. I had previously hated accounting after taking another class at a different university, but Professors Charles completely changed my mind on the subject. That being said it is super important you show up for class and participate. This class is not an easy A.

She was a very tough but fair professor. She definitely didn't give you any gimmies, you had to work really hard to do well in her class.

The group project she assigned was really difficult and if you are going to do well you need a good group.

Make sure to ask plenty of questions and visit her office hours, do this and you'll do very well.

Professor Charles was a great teacher. The curriculum was HARD for me! definitely not an easy class, but I think she did the best she could to teach us. She was always sweet with questions, never rude or condescending, tried to keep things lighthearted, and so on. I recommend taking her if you think you'll struggle with accounting!

Such a good professor. She teaches the class very well and will make extra time for you if you are struggling with a topic. Her exams are very difficult and often take the entire class to finish with no time to spare. Would highly recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Literally spoon feeds you the entire class. If you show up you'll do great, AWSOME teacher!

Yes she's very nice. But her teaching style is so aggravating, as in she needs someone to respond to her every query each waking second. It makes class drag and be so painful to sit through. Like, please just teach and be okay going 5 minutes without class participation. I can't stand teachers like that. She also doesn't really care about cheating.

I was shocked to see Professor Charles had such a high rating on here, but I do believe those are all outdated. Maybe she was a good professor 8 years ago, but not now. She is rude when you ask her for help outside of class, her exam review assignments were nothing like the exams, and she makes her class difficult for her own ego. Horrible class.

DONT TAKE HER!!! For some reason her microphone was messed up for every single recorded lecture so all you heard was static and she didnt care to fix it even after the whole class brought it up. Her TAs left our group in the dust for our project. If you take this class be ready to teach the entire thing to yourself.
Prof Charles is a solid choice. She is a caring professor who takes time to help students. My only issue with this course was the terrible group project. It will take 80+ hours to complete for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: This ACCTG class consisted of 3 midterms, a final, and the group project. She gives many worksheets and posts the PowerPoint and class notes on Canvas which is exactly what you need to study for the midterms and final . START EARLY ON THE GROUP PROJECT & GO TO OFFICE + TA HOURS TRUST ME!!! The project is not too hard but it's very tedious.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 2Opt out of Cengage, you won't need it. She lays out evrtg that will be on the quizzes and exams so if you study from her worksheets and know how to do each calculation this class won't be hard. Class will be time consuming though, project takes 20-40 hrs,studying for quizzes 3-5 hrs each, and final 8-10 hrs. Accounting is more tedious than anythg

1Her material and quizzes prepare you well for the dept. final. The class has clear grading criteria and you will be fine if you put some effort into the class. Beware of the group project, meeting with the TAs is a must if you want to pass. Overall an effective class although she seemed annoyed at me anytime I asked her something so there's that
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is part of the business degree. I really recommend her if you can find a seat. She is, in my opinion, one of the best accounting teachers. She doesn't just teach the how but also the why. She is super nice and super helpful and loves students. Take her if you can, she's the best teacher for this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I would definitely recommend her for Acctg 3600. She gives you problems to practice in class that will be on the quiz. The project is not easy however find reliable people as soon as possible to do the project with, don't procrastinate the project. Shannon is very helpful and so are her TA's. Graded by 3 quizzes, 1 final and 1 project. Take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Shannon is an excellent teacher! She really cares and teaches each concept multiple ways, but doesn't care how you solve the problems, as long as you get the right answer. The tests and quizzes are EXACTLY like the problems she does in class, so it's an easy A if you practice. The project is easy if you don't procrastinate. She is available for Q's
Super great teacher. She knows all of the problems without reference. She's great at explaining and wants you to do well.

Probably one of the best Accounting professors! Really helps you learn and is very caring of her students. She's very available for office hours and although her quizzes suck, they help out for the final. Wish I was an Accounting major so I could take more classes from her!
Professor Charles is the best. Nothing more to say. Take her for Accounting 3600.

Okay Shannon is HANDS down the BEST lady. She made me love Accounting & I was actually so sad when her class ended. Her teaching style is clear & concise and she prepares you for the quizzes and final. Group project is always terrible but pick a good group, utilize the TA's and you'll be fine! HIGHLY RECOMMEND SHANNON!

Shannon is an amazing professor who cares about the success of her students. She will go out of her way to help you and gives great practice problems to help you learn. The quizzes are tough but if you study and use the problems she gives you you'll do fine. Also start working on the project ASAP and make sure you get a good group! She's 10/10!

Mrs. Charles has been one of my favorite professors. She cares about her students and will work with you outside of class if you do not understand the material. She does not have homework but gives you problems to work on. I highly suggest working on those problems. The group project is pretty brutal- pick wisely!

Shannon is THE BEST professor! Not only do her lectures actually make sense, she prepares you EXTREMELY well for the final (literally just like her review packet). Not a difficult class as long as you put in the work. I'm actually sad I'm not an accounting major because I will definitely miss Shannon's friendly and caring personality!

Shannon is amazing. This class is extremely hard, but you can't expect anything else from an upper division accounting class. She is so sweet, and always willing to help. She responds very quickly to all emails, and I explains the content well in class. I will be taking every accounting class in the future from Shannon.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Very hard class but one of the best prof's at the U. You will learn a ton. Take notes and start the review assignment the day she gives it out. Loved this class.

One of the the best professors for accounting at the U. She is known for her tough exams, but she provides you with all the material before you take them. You will known exactly what you need to do on the exams and in the class to do well. She gives you loads of help and always answers your questions. You do have to go to class but its interesting.
Taking another class with here next semester. Great lectures. Very helpful to pass tests.

Probably one of the most liked Professors I know. Class is hard but you learn a lot, difficult for any Professor to pull off a hard class while being liked. She is very smart, teaches well, and cares about students. Beware took her for Management Accounting, know your stuff before walking into an exam.
By far the best accounting teacher I've had! Not the easiest class, but she makes accounting easy to understand!

One of the best teachers I've had at the U.  She was very organized and really knows her stuff.  Attendance is mandatory, but only tests on stuff she goes over in class and hands out examples to help you learn the material.  I highly recommend her!   I wish she was teaching ACCTG 5120...
Professor might of made test easier as they seemed manageable and final exam was easier than expected. Very oranized, knowledgeable, and structured. Overall a good experience.

I had this professor for 5110 and 5210 and in both cases the exams were very difficult. It was very difficult to complete the exam in the time given and I would recommend starting at the end of the exam because these problems were long hand problems and worth more points, then do the fill in the blank in the middle then do the multiple choice.

This is a difficult class, and Prof. Charles' class is no exception. She does a great job of explaining things clearly and succinctly and is very fair with grading (final replaces lowest midterm). I enjoyed this class and became interested in managerial accounting as a result.
Very good teacher.  I think she is new to the University, but is very clear in teaching, has good powerpoints you can look at after class.  Uses clicker which is fun.

He didn't place heavy weight on tests; instead, he valued homework. He posts notes on the website in his syllabus, but it's hard to tell what matches each lecture day, making it difficult to miss class. Personally found his notes unorganized, but he does seem to work with students to pass the class.

You can tell he really cares about his students and is insanely knowledgeable about what he teaches. He honestly does what is in the best interest of the student, and his lectures are fun (and funny). Highly recommend taking a class from him. 10/10.

Took the class in Fall of 2023. Should note I wasn't nearly as good of a student as I am now so if I took a class now, rating likely would change. Difficult class due to being the first real proofs exposure and working with abstract concepts. Thus a lot of the concepts didn't stick very well. Concepts difficult and office hours highly recommended.

Amazing Professor, specifically for linear algebra, being a CS and applied math major, working with AI and machine learning on day to day life, I dont think there is any better way to teach linear algebra than how he taught it.

This class is really hard. He treats it like everyone is a math major, and already has a good background in math. The homework is ridiculously hard and time-consuming. Not even the math center knows how to do the homework.  Do not take this class unless you are a math major.
This guy is just awesome, you will get absolutely 100/100 only if u finish the hw and go to the class

If you're at all interested in mathematics, I'd highly recommend a class from Jack. He's brilliant and passionate about what he teaches. The lectures, exams, and assignments are extremely difficult, but there are lots of extra credit chances to get a good grade. Content is 5/5 difficult, but getting an A does not have to be if you put in the work.

Jack is easily the best professor I've had in college. His class is very hard, and you must give 100% effort. He makes up for the difficult content and assignments with lots of extra credit, giving you many opportunities to succeed in the class. Jack really cares about his students and is always there to help. OFFICE HOURS ARE YOUR BEST RESOURCE!

Jack is genuinely the only reason I've made it this far. He's incredibly lenient and transparent about his expectations/policies, so if you put in the work (i.e. go to office hours, participate, do the homework) this class is an easy A. If you don't, this course will be akin to passing a meatball sized kidney stone. Do with that what you will. ONG

If you are a math major or want to master the subject I recommend taking the course from Jack. He expects a lot from you, but is an excellent instructor. Homework is very challenging, but he is always available in office hours. Expect to work hard, but you will get a lot out of the class. I would take every math class form Jack if I could.

HANDS DOWN the best teacher I have ever had. One of the only professors in here that have lectures that are actually engaging. Plus he's hilarious and not an out of touch boomer. Class is easy to pass if you put effort in but he doesn't just hand it to you, I still learned so much. Jackson for new U mascot. GET HIM FOR CALC 2!!! Way less stress.

I actually took 2210, but it only allows me to select 1321 for some reason.

Jack definitely caters his lectures to students who love math and are paying attention --- but he gives plenty of extra credit opportunities so if you're taking his class because you have to, it shouldn't be hard to pass as long as you do all of the available extra credit!
Very friendly and patient. Always ready to help you solving problems in Math 2210.(Dont know why only math1321 available)

One of the hardest classes I've taken in terms of content, but Jack gives plenty of extra credit, so do not worry. Tests and quizzes align well with lecture material, and homework assignments are actually useful. Jack writes his own questions for the most part, so don't expect answers online. Go to his office hours :)

The other reviews are true. I didn't understand anything that we were supposed to learn, because I used all my energy spending over 20 hours a week figuring out outdated instructions to incredibly complex software platforms that would crash. I've never left a review for a class before, but I wouldn't wish this torture on anyone.

reviews.comment: This week she's assigned us a semester's worth of lectures and material on fluid mechanics to "absorb and understand". I am getting nothing out of this other than raised cortisol levels. I can tell she's a genius but she thinks we all are too, and that we sit around all day with 12 hours a day to spend on homework.

DO NOT TAKE THIS! I am leaving this review on 03/25/26, and only one of our assignments has been graded from the entire semester. This class is so convoluted and time-intensive. The infamous CT unit took 22 hours, and even this week, we were assigned 7.5 hours of lecture videos to watch with 6 packets to fill out. Worst class I've taken in 4 years
At this point have spent a total of 21 hours on CT scan assignment and I want to end it all. Do with that what you will.

I took 5665. 5665 was an absolute blast. 3665 maybe not lol.

Either way, if you are here to see if you want to take 5665, don't let the negative reviews for 3665 deter you. There is one large project on a dinosaur of your choice that was quite difficult; however, almost all the information is in the readings. Don't skim them. It is quite fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Some weeks, the weekly assignments will take less than five minutes. Other weeks, I've spent 35 hours on projects. The pacing in this class is incredibly confusing. There are so many weeks where I had to skip personal events, other classes, and even my job to be able to work on the ridiculous amount of homework in this class.

Incredibly variable workload. There'd be a 20 hr assignment one week, then a 3 hr one the next. Her lab instructions & lectures were confusingly organized and barely comprehensible. The unit on CT scans was a waking nightmare, while the rest of the class was just the normal kind of frustrating. I don't recommend taking a class from Farmer.

If I could give her a 0 I would!! She didn't even post the exams to canvas until the minute before it was set to start, had us looking everything on canvas for it till the minute it was posted. Same with homework, never posted the turn in spot till we emailed her. Beware, make up exams are oral. Exams are 150+ questions in 90 min or less!!

She is the worst professor I have ever had. All exams were made up of questions posted by students from the weekly chapters we were assigned but they were so long that no one read them. Just memorized the test answers and took the test. She didn't lecture but when she did it was non related physics. EXTREMELY disappointed.

In short, Davar's lectures were boring and confusing. You would be better off not going to lectures and reading the online textbook instead. Every test was online and he clearly didn't care about students cheating.
lectures are so bad I just ended up not going and having to teach it to myself which worked way better and he cant even explain it to him self he just pauses

reviews.comment: I found the lectures to be confusing and boring so most of my learning was on my own. He truly does want everyone to pass and gives resources to do so. I especially appreciated that we were able to have a page of notes for the exams, that really saved me.

Professor Khoshnevisan is a really good guy. He cares about his students and is well informed on statistics. I just personally did not learn well from his class. Lectures can get confusing and a bit boring, I learned most clearly from the textbook. Homework isn't bad. Not a bad class, just hard for me personally.

Homework once a week with very few problems. Lectures feel long and it felt that most people didn't understand/follow his lectures. He cares about what he teaches, but his teaching style didn't work for me personally. I got very frustrated with many things during this class. He is chill and a kind person, but I struggled to learn the concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tries to make things as clear as possible. Gave plenty opportunity for students to ask questions. Funny here and there. Very grounded and realistic.
He makes things as easy to understand as possible. Very funny here and there. Down to earth, very grounded and realistic.

Professor Khoshnevisan is a very kind man. His lectures are quite clear, but if you get distracted you might get pretty lost. If you come to class prepared and keep up with the material and assignments each week, you'll do great. Some extra credit on tests. I personally never went to office hours but he is very easy to reach if needed.

He's a really kind guy, but his teaching style is difficult to understand. You need to read the textbook or you will be completely lost. The lectures are often hard to follow and the notes he posts are sometimes illegible. He is a good guy, I just cannot learn from his style of learning.

I really liked this professor as a person but his teaching style was difficult and it was harder to understand the material. Compared to the other professors for the same course his teaching and homework assignments were much harder. Attendance is not mandatory but is highly encouraged to help understand. Homework assignments aren't too time taking

Professor Khoshnevisan is a really kind man do not get me wrong but I feel that his lectures assume you already know certain terms and formulas, that is if you read the chapters before the lectures or else it is just a brief summary on the chapter with an abundance of information that is not necessary relevant to the topic.

reviews.comment: Decent class just not my learning style. Mostly just reading over his notes

reviews.comment: I did not do super well but I passed. I am leaving this message because it was no fault of Davar. He is an an amazing professor. Any student in an UD math class crying about how "the tests where not like the homework", is being a poor sport. Probability 5010 and any other class he teaches are not easy classes, don't blame the teacher.

Davar is a great professor. His tests were extremely hard but he was reasonable with the grading and the curve at the end of the semester. He gives you the opportunity to do well and his lectures were useful for the assignments and tests. Used the textbook all the time, and going to his office hours really helped me improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The tests were very similar to the homework given and his lectures were very clear and helpful but I definitely needed the book for support.
bad test
Brilliant professor with quite engaging lectures.
Horrible professor, not at all helpful. Exams were horrible, not at all related to the homework problems or the problems in book. One of the worst professor i ever had at U of U

Davar is a great teacher. My particular class involved computer programming which he never approached at all in any lectures. The pre req courses which were supposed to develop MatLab skills were very weak. Other than that A+

This class was awesome, and Davar is definitely one of the best upper division math teachers at the U. He's very willing to help during office hours, and he tells bad math jokes during class. He also kind of sounds like Kermit the Frog =D. Tests are clearly based on the homework, so if you do the homework you'll ace the tests.
Interesting and knows what he's doing. One of the best classes I've had at the University.
No Comments
No Comments
This dude's voice puts me to sleep in the lectures!! Not very clear on tests, but a lot of help on homeworks in the discussion class (seperate from lecture).  Overall not a bad course

By far the worst exams I have even seen. They are beyond ambiguous and not really based off the facts from the course material rather are based on his personal interpretation of what he thinks is important. You can read the material like the gospel and still end up wondering what they are smoking when making the questions.

The grade split in this class was very fair, 25% midterm 1, 25% midterm 2, 25% take home (open note/book) quizzes, 10% project, 15% the rest. Overall the content isn't super exciting but he keeps the lectures interesting. It is easy to get a decent grade in the class as long as you study for the exams. Don't be scared he wants you to do well
Great professor and if you really put effort into the essays/final/midterm you will have a great grade
Don't trust the good reviews. Just run!
He is a great guy and his class is incredibly easy and all you have to do to get a good grade is show up and do the online quizzes on time.
Great guy. Engaging discussions and cares about his students. An entertaining and interesting guy, as well as very knowledgeable.

He's a really nice guy but all the classes are the exact same and so it's gets really boring and hard to sit through. He is also an extremely tough grader and makes the class much harder than it is with other professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very easy class but oh so boring and did not feel like I had room for free thought. Every day was the exact same structure. The weekly quizzes are extremely easy and open note/open book. The 2 midterm (essays) were graded harshly and had a long turnaround before we saw our scores. He's very slow at inputting grades and does not respond to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He can be very intimating at first but once the semester went on he can be a very kind person. He is very passionate about the material and the lectures are discussion based so It doesn't require a lot of mental thought. I found the midterms to be unclear about expectations and he can be a harsh grader but overall I would take it again.

Great professor who seems intimidating, but is one of the kindest people ever. Can be a bit of a tough grader on the two papers, but a great teacher overall. I highly recommend taking a course from him.

Professor Dominguez is a really fun Professor if you take the time to get to know him. He's really passionate about teaching and is willing to help you succeed if you show him you're willing to put in the work.

Professor Dominguez cares about his students and makes lectures interesting and engaging. In his class you very much get out what you put in, if you give effort and come to class getting a good grade will be very easy. Essays are graded harshly but with clearly defined expectations, and plenty of assistance is provided if needed.

This was by far the easiest class I took this semester. All the quizzes are at-home, open-note and all the answers are in the posted lecture slides. There are no tests, like the other 1050 professors, rather two mid-term papers. The only thing you have to do to get an A is show up to lectures and do the quizzes on time.

Before taking Professor Dominguez's class I read his rate my professor rating and was a bit skeptical. After taking his class it is clear that all of the low rating are due to people not trying at all in his class. If you show up to lectures t
Incredibly rude and confrontational.

When confronted about a possible gradeing mistake made by a TA on a midterm rather than looking into it he just talked about how the rubric was created and that there world be no regradeing. Im disappointed to say the least as I hope this does not reflect the rest of the eccles school of buissness.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He posted our final grade in CIS but did not give us the score we get for midterm 2, even is literally until now I still don't know what my score is and why I got that grade?

Mandatory Zoom attendance with almost no flexibility for absences. He's nice, but he is a very harsh grader. The weekly quizzes can be done with the posted slides, but he makes the questions really vague, so sometimes it's difficult to get full points. The workload isn't awful, but if you want an A, your work has to be basically perfect.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He was the only professor available this sem, but if you have a choice, take someone else! No clear expectations or rubrics for essays. Weekly quizzes have horrible answer choices. Attendance is mandatory and graded, but doesn't allow for absences whatsoever. Every class is the same, and I hated every second.

I loved him as a professor, very passionate about his job! It's not hard to earn an A in the class, you have to not skip the class , because attendance is graded and do the class readings . He dropped 6 our quizzes because we filled out the survey in the end. Such a great guy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: It was a pleasure to have Professer Dominguez as my mgt-1050 teacher. I always looked forward to his clases, He always would have students engaged by having them share there opinion to the discussion questions. It was always clear what we would do every week and he would sometimes have the class do a debate.

Dr. Dominguez is such an understanding and caring teacher. You can tell that he is highly passionate about what he teaches, and he loves his students who share the same level of effort that he does. I appreciate the enthusiasm he brings into every class, and what he teaches is clear, concise, and applicable in daily life. 10/10

I really enjoyed my time in this class. The classroom environment was professional, but he still allowed us to have fun and be interactive. He was incredibly accommodating and understanding, but was also very firm in his rules. I would definitely recommend!
Super solid professor. Would definitely recommend taking. He cares deeply about his students, while still respecting others opinions.
Great professor who cares about his students and teaching important concepts. There are online quizzes every week and two papers (1200 words) total. No exams

This professor has very unclear expectations for the midterm essays and then grades based on expectations that he does not explain effectively, without using a rubric. The weekly quizzes have poorly written answers. Every week, it's a game of trying to choose the least wrong answer, because none of the multiple-choice answers provided actually fit.

Professor Dominguez's class is more about authority than learning. His confrontational style, political bias, and selective participation make it hard to engage. He misquotes students, uses unreliable sources, and discourages independent thought. His heavy workload/harsh policies add stress, and his lack of focus on practical skills is concerning.

Amazing Professor. Asigns reading for every class but goes through the topics of each passage with the entire class and gives his breakdown. Weekly tests all from the assigned reading. Deadlines and expectations are thoroughly laid out and explained. Overall amazing professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: weekly quizzes and really like chicago style writing lectures and reading go hand in hand so make sure to read the textbook and you'll be chilling
He clearly outlines deadlines way in advance. He will give you feedback directly if you ask for it in person.

He is passionate about what he teaches. He has amazing lectures that allow for class participation and group discussion. The class can get a little repetitive but they are still tolerable. You have readings before every class but they aren't too hard. Overall, I would recommend taking his class if you can.

He's a good professor. He care about his students and tries to make it clear and doable. There's a lot of reading involved and he can be a bit strict and by the book but it's clear he wants his students to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this professor. He is so funny, cares about getting to know his students, loves his field, and great at explaining. You couldn't ask for a better professor.

Dr. Sanbonmatsu is a great professor. He takes the time to get to know students who are engaged and asks questions during the lectures to make them more interesting. You can tell he is passionate about the subject. The tests are easy as long as you study, and the only other things you are graded on are brief discussions and some reading questions.

Funny, clear, really good at explaining. Fairly easy class, was only graded on a few discussions in class, 3 assignments, and 3 exams. Lectures prepare you fairly well for exams, and there are questions directly from the study sheet. Good class, would take again.

Professor Sanbonmatsu was one of my favorites, he was really kind and funny. His class is mostly lectures but he makes them super fun and entertaining. Grade was composed of tests which were not hard as long as you study, a question set and a group discussion for each test. Overall I would love to take another class of his again.

Dr. Sanbonmatsu is a great professor. He's both very knowledgable about the subject matter and makes the lectures easy to understand. Class is organized with clearly defined expectations and deadlines. The tests are closed note, but a comprehensive study guide is given. Nearly every class session had a lecture, which were engaging and interesting.
A good teacher. Definitely attend class, most of the tests and assignments come from his lectures.

3 group work days, 3 assignments, 3 tests (non cumulative). Fun teacher, I did not attend class most days but got 92+ on the exams. Some exam answers weren't on the lecture but stated in class. The exam guide is super helpful and I learned a ton. Go to class! He tries to make class fun :)
This class was lecture heavy and had very few assignments. The tests were manageable and were easy if completed the study guide and paid attention during class.

My favorite class of the semester! Prof. Sanbonmatsu is a very engaging lecturer. There are only 3 question sets, 3 group discussions, and 3 exams throughout the semester, so there isn't a ton of wiggle room for grading, but the assignments and exams aren't hard as long as you pay attention to the lectures. Would take the class again if I could!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While attendance is not mandatory, PowerPoints do not explain well so lectures are very important to attend. Professor is very caring and considerate of students. His lecture style includes jokes and lots of examples. Only 3 group work days, 3 question sets to complete, and 3 tests. Few assignments but workload can be extremely heavy, so plan ahead

Hes a sweet professor, he gave me points for a discussion I missed when I was sick, however there are 9 things you are graded for the whole semester so there is little wiggle room for mess ups. Great class if you like the subject but definitely not an easy a class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class has 3 assignments, 3 discussions, and 3 tests per semester. David Sanbonmatsu is an excellent professor who makes the class entertaining and wants his students to succeed. This would be a great option for DV and BF credit. I recommend attending class for test review because he will answer questions that will be on the test.

David Sanbonmatsu is an incredible lecturer and person. While attending the class is not mandatory, the lectures are important to attend so that you can hear the ideas clearly laid out and many of the slides have questions that he will have the class answer. The study guides mirror exactly what is expected on the exams! Great professor!

I really enjoyed this Professor. He was very engaging and knew his material very well. If you studied the notes the tests were very easy and straight forward. Only 3 assignments the entire semester which could be completed in 15 minutes if you focused. There were a couple comments made during the semester that were uncalled for which is unfortunate

I took his class in the Spring of 2021. I wasn't a huge fan of his teaching style, always lectures and maybe an occasional video. The class itself wasn't anything like what I thought it would be. He is a very strict grader. I also found the tests to be extremely difficult, studying almost felt useless. Explanations from the lectures were vague.

Took his 2500 course which started in person & ended up online (Covid-19 Pandemic). He makes lectures interesting & there were a couple of group discussions when we were in class. Yes textbook is used, as well as a couple other assigned readings, however these are provided through Canvas. Workload is fair & the 3 exams are easy, if you study!

Professor Sanbonmatsu is a phenomenal professor. He is extraordinarily caring and compassionate to his students. His lectures are simultaneously engaging and easy to follow. The pace he moves through material is great, and the assignments/tests help you learn but aren't going to be terrible. Highly, highly recommend.

Sanbonmatsu is the best person. He is engaging, but not demanding with his class. He is kind, funny, and laid-back. You are graded on 3 in-class group discussions (which he informs you of before), 3 assignment sets (which are simple and quick to do), and 3 tests. If you show up to class and listen, its an easy a and an informative class.

Dr. Sanbonmatsu is a drop of happiness upon the earth. He is hilarious when lecturing in a way that makes the material much more memorable. His assignments are few and far between but take a good amount of work to complete. I found them fantastic in supplementing the stuff I had learned about in class. Finally, he really cares about the students!!
Sanbonmatsu is one of the best professors I've had at the U. Extremely engaging, great lectures, and hilarious. Would easily take any class from him again.

great professor with a funny personality. There are 3 assignments and 3 tests for the semester, with the option of extra credit at the end. The test's aren't hard if you use the study guides. I recommend!

I selected attendance non-mandatory because there is no credit for it and you could pass without attending however attending the lectures will be a great help. Professor Sanbonmatsu was very descriptive and fun in class. Sometimes there would end up being class discussions and he will entertain them before moving on. I enjoyed his class a lot!

His lectures are long but hilarious. He encourages student participation and engages the class into the lecture. Reading the textbook is a must if you want to do well on the exams and the study guide is super helpful.
The class has a total of three assignments, and three tests. His lectures are long and boring, but no information is ever left out. Take good notes on his lectures, and you will pass easily.

Dr. Sanbonmatsu and his class are amazing! I learned so much about social psychology. If you need to take that class, take it with him. He knows what he's talking about, and he can be really funny. You HAVE to go to test reviews; all questions from the tests come from the review. There are only 3 tests, but they're hard if you don't study a lot.

He is the reason I am sticking with Psychology. He is personable and knowledgeable as well.  In class discussion is encouraged during his lectures and makes his class very interesting and fun as well. If you need to take Social Psych, make sure you have him as your professor. There was a lot of memorization required of psych terms for tests.
Professor Sanbonmatsu  is funny, intelligent and an all around amazing guy. It is a lecture class so it's expected to have long power points, but all in all it was interesting and I learned a lot.
Great teacher and a pretty cool guy, just don't get offended if he asks you to redo something in a patronizing tone. He means well.
David is a great instructor and the clas was extremely interesting! He truly wants everyone to do well.
I loved Social Psych. I loved the Problem sets assigned. The exams are based off of the Study guide he provides. The lectures are entertaining because Sanbonmatsu is hilarious.
He is hilarious, and gets you interested in the subject. One of the better teachers I have ever had.

David is awesome. He is really easy going. His class is extremely easy as long as you get the notes. He gives you a study guide for the tests and even tells you certain ones that will for sure be on the test. Only 3 tests,3 assignments, and the final isn't comprehensive.  Great for DV and BF requirement.

Easiest class I ever took. Three assignments and three exams and that's it. If you actually go to class it would be hard not to get an A. Even though it is extremely boring. Sanbonmatsu is a really cool guy.
He is a fantastic guy, very knowledgable. If you attend classes you can easily get an A
Professor Sanbonmatsu's a great guy.
No Comments
he is such a nice, intelligent guy.  this class is just so boring!
David is a very funny and intelligent teacher.  If you don't show up to class, you won't pass.
She is heavy on mini-essay assignments which requires research and time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She will make your online experience amazing. She alerts you every week of what is expected. Doesn't overwhelm you and her TAs    were great too. You can tell she's passionate about what she teaches. Really cares about her students, and will give good feedback. Honestly if you take 4-5 classes you will not feel too overwhelmed!

She is a great professor who is obviously very knowledgable in the field, but not boring to listen too. I enjoyed her class. It was tougher because we only had 2 assignments, a midterm, and a final. Her tests are worded a bit hard, but they were taken online outside of class. Overall, I think she is a great professor and would recommend her class!

This class was fine, but as a 1010 class it was harder than my upper devision classes. The tests were kind of worded to trick you. The professor was nice but I was frustrated because there were so few points in the class that losing a single point on my essay (a 20 point essay) was the difference between and A and A-, or even a B+.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was the worst class I've ever taken. And the professor was the worst teacher I've had since kindergarten. I would not recommend this class to anyone. There was no support from the professor for homework and she was very condescending. The work load was insane, there were hundreds of pages of reading. Don't take this class from this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Professor Durante's class. She made it enjoyable but very informational. She knows a lot about the topic of Criminology, her lectures and slides are content heavy but its easy to understand. Overall she's a very personable professor and her two assignments besides the random attendance checks are straight forward. I definitely recommend!

Engaging lectures and clear connecting to assigned readings. Office hours are helpful for confusion about course content, professor fosters supportive environment. Prof really cares about student feedback and learning.

Best professor I've ever had by far. There are so many drops, exam replacements and extra credit opportunities that you really have to try to get a bad grade in this class. On top of that his lecture style makes going to class extremely interesting. Exams can be tough but he gives the scenarios that will be on each one and the final.

Amazing engaged lectures. Passionate about the subject and applies concepts to explain systems in real life. Great grade policies (no minus grades, final replaces, drop low homework grades, etc). Releases scenarios about what's on exams (just the diagrams you predict questions he'll ask) which help test prep. Easy to talk to. Chill homework.

Dr. Davenport made coming to class a joy. He was very good at showing his enthusiasm for physics and engaging the audience. He is the most motivated teacher I've ever had when it comes to taking feedback and improving the course. Physics is a hard subject, but he made sure there were a lot of resources you can use to learn the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Davenport really wants to help you learn and it shows. He is easily approachable and happy to help clear things up. He is definitely more focused on understanding and applying concepts as opposed to memorizing equations. The grading scale is really generous at the trade-off of not accepting late work. I would take classes with him again.

Professor Davenport is amazing, lectures often have demonstrations in them that are very helpful for understanding what is going on. He also will reiterate the same things in multiple lectures to help connect the ideas to one another. Tests are difficult but not impossible, overall would definitely recommend.
Tests were quite tough, but he made the content very engaging and did a few demos in lecture which was cool. You could tell that he wanted to get to know the students and wanted us to succeed.

Prof. Davenport was just a fun person to listen. He does really aim to teach this class conceptually more than remembering how to use equations. The homework would usually be easy with 1 or 2 challenging questions, he shows what the exam problems will look like (not what it will ask) which was weird at first but you get a grip on what he will ask

PHYS 2210
Easy class, and he gives the scenarios for the tests and midterms. There is some extra credit and he also drops a lot of assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Davenport is very passionate about physics. His lectures, while not always directly applicable to the HW, helped build the conceptual understanding for an unintuitive class. Exams were hard but graded generously. The Help Lab hours were very clutch with helpful TAs and Professor Davenport himself often present.

This guy is awesome. He really cares about you as a student and as a person. Sent me a 7 paragraph study plan email in middle of semester when I was struggling. This class is hard because the material is confusing. If you go to lecture, you will laugh and you will learn. Read the book and engage in discussion. I'd take Davenport again for sure.
Lectures are very interesting and informative. He posts all the notes to canvas as well.

Kevin clearly loves physics and was an all-around awesome guy. I will say there tended to be a disconnect between the difficulty of tests compared to examples and homework problems. I really liked him, but the lectures were very long, making them hard to sit through despite his excellent lecture skills.

I always went to office hours/help lab for homework help and he always helped me understand it. He would also explain physics concepts and relate them to real world examples. Lectures aren't bad to sit through either.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Davenport was an excellent lecturer and I always enjoyed going to lecture. But the homework's, discussions, and tests felt very disconnected from each other. I never felt prepared for tests despite studying and understanding the content. He also doesn't curve, so tests were incredibly stressful.

He's a great professor, you can tell he really likes and understands physics. i had him for physics 2. There was a lack of cohesiveness from class lectures to homework's to exams. I don't think the homework's adequately prepped you for the difficulty jump of the exams. So I always felt a little underprepared for them. But very interesting class

This course was by far the worst course I've ever had to take out of the 80+ credits I've completed at the U. The lecture portion (physics 2020) was fine and actually useful, but the lab portion went in a completely opposite direction. The material was poorly taught n required extensive understanding of computer literacy and excel. Terrible course.

He is one of the best lecturers I have ever had. He knows the material super well and is very good at providing multiple ways to understand complicated topics. It's very clear that he cares deeply about the success and learning of his students and he goes above and beyond to provide extra resources outside of class.
Great professor! He explains everything clearly, and the examples he goes over in class are almost identical to the exam questions.

When I took the class, we have weekly evaluations instead of midterms and a final project instead of an exam. Kevin has a very honest and personable approach to physics which I greatly admire. I am a physics major myself, so I found the content was very engaging, but your mileage may vary.

The lectures could be interesting but were often inefficient and mostly rambling. Lots of homework, and quizzes. Tests were long and difficult, but the scenarios were posted beforehand. Overall not the best not the worst.

The lectures are bad, he can't teach. I went for the first half of the semester, and got fed up and stopped going. I started doing better in the class after that. For his exams he has the scenarios posted beforehand, and then you have to guess what questions he will ask from those scenarios. People said that it helped, but I don't understand how.
Professor Davenport cares about his students and listens to feedback. He also is helpful in office hours.

Kevin is an incredibly passionate lecturer where every class is mostly enjoyable to go to. The homework is very relevant to what you learn in class and the discussions help massively. The three midterms weren't the easiest, but still definitely manageable. The topics themselves are difficult, but he does a great job of making them easier to grasp.
This was the biggest time waste and the most ridiculous lab I've ever taken. There is no practical use for anything learned in this lab, and it was a horrible class. Would not recommend taking this.

He had no exams throughout the class, but he did have a quiz every Thursday that replaced the exams. The quizzes were based on the previous homeworks and you could bring a help sheet to them. If you went to TA hours for the homework and wrote everything that was hard in the homework on your help sheet, you were set on the quizzes.

He cares about student feedback and actually listens to it! His course setup was well organized and he provided several materials to help students succeed. Discussions had required attendance. Study hall hours were super helpful.

Davenport's lectures are some of the best I've ever attended. You can tell he puts a significant amount of effort into the quality of the lectures. He interacts with the students and creates a friendly environment which makes the class much less stressful.

Professor Davenport is entertaining during lectures. He explains concepts well. The grading seemed fair. There was a final project instead of a final exam which made the end of the class enjoyable rather than stressful.
Great Professor. He cares about the students, and his passion for physics is infectious. He is a really fun lecturer and just an overall great guy. Highly, highly recommend.
Pretty good Professor!
Davenport is a good guy and was very easy to reach outside of class if I had questions. I would recommend him as a teacher.

Bro, its a 1 credit lab! But the class is run like its a 4 credit lecture course. Kevin is nice and some of the TAs are cool but the class is just trying way too hard. I would never take this lab again, by far the worst lab at the U.

He assigns one homework assignment per week that is very difficult and makes up most of your grade. The exams were very easy in comparison and he does test corrections. He makes it very easy to get the grade you want and tries to keep his class relatively stress free (short exams, no final, helps answer questions and emails fast, etc).
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was by far one of the most interesting classes I've taken here. The material is a little daunting, but Professor Davenport does an amazing job of breaking it down into clear and engaging lectures. The homework is long at times, but the grading criteria is laid out clearly and there are ample resources to get help on the course material.

Professor Davenport gave the best lectures I have experienced. He used a lot of visuals and demonstrations during lectures and often made class topics relevant to real-life. The class was difficult but fair and included four shorter tests and a final project. One online homework assignment was assigned per week along with two discussion sections.
