This class was definitely one of the most work-heavy courses I had this semester. There's a lot to learn in CS2420 and a lot of it really isn't easy. Prof. Parker prepares you well if you go to lectures because her provided slides don't really cut it in the midterm and final exams. The homework given weekly can easily take 6-10 hours per week.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Hands down the hardest class I have ever taken. If you are taking 2420 with Erin Parker, be ready to work hard and feel stressed/overwhelmed most of the time. In the end its all worth it because you learn a lot. Don't be afraid to go to office hours if you are struggling since she is caring in a 1 to 1 setting. Solid teacher and class experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Parker is an amazing professor, probably one of the best ones I have ever had. She's organized, professional, well respected, and great at teaching complex subjects. She doesn't take any crap and if you don't put in the work she's not gonna carry you.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Parker is overall a nice and highly knowledgeable professor. Specific and clear on how she grades tests and homework and honors fair regrade requests. Biggest flaw is that she comes off as very patronizing, like she's intellectually above us and that some people's ideas are not valid. However I think she's improved slightly throughout the semester.

In lecture, she commands respect, and sometimes I (including my peers) feel scared to ask questions. The inverse is true 1 on 1. In office hours, I could tell she really cares about how her students do. Abuse her office hours, get to know her, and you'll do good in the class. HW is LONG; so don't be afraid of cutting back on your other class load.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Flipped classroom that really worked for a lot of people. This class covers a lot of material so the tests were difficult but fair. She gives you the grading tests for each assignment so you know what grade you will get. Plenty of time for each assignment 6 x 2 weeks. She was kind and did a good job. Assignments usually took <10 except for one.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The course is difficult, but Dr. Parker teaches it very well. Theres homework due about every two weeks and a midterm the week after its due. She does a flipped class which I didnt love because I usually didnt understand the videos until she retaught it in class anyway. Exams are really similar to homework and I learned a ton!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Tough class but she did a good job. There are a lot of resources to help you outside of class if you struggle, including good lecture videos and a really good textbook. Lectures mainly consist of working on practice problems while you learn the topics on your own. Difficult but manageable tests. DO NOT PROCRASTINATE!!!

Pretty good all around professor. Never felt particularly amazing or eccentric, but taught the material with few to no problems. Tests were pretty difficult and required study, but didn't feel unreasonable. My only complaint is that we were forced to use pair programming which just felt boring for the person not at the keyboard.

CS 2420 is the make-or-break class for getting accepted into the major and should be your priority class for the semester. Prof Parker is no nonsense but is not over the top "mean" like some of these ratings have stated, she is a good professor for a tough class. An A is very attainable. You will be doing pair programming, GET A GOOD PARTNER EARLY.

I definitely see how many people don't like this professor. She almost discourages participation in class by blatantly calling out and correcting any incorrect comments made by a student. However she is very knowledgable and her assignments and tests really make sure you understand the material. I learned a lot and would take another class from her

I think the dramatic split in opinions about Prof. Parker is interesting. She is definitely not warm and cuddly, and will not suffer any foolishness or nonsense whatsoever. But she is eminently competent and has probably forgotten more about CS than I know. Leave your ego at the door and learn everything you can from this brilliant woman!
Unclear assignment expectations; Word-play tests; No extra credit/dropped assignments; Very tough grading; Incompatible to those new to CS. Ridiculously smart professor though

Dr. Parker is a great professor who knows how to craft assignments and exams in order to thoroughly test if you know every concept to the bone. If you really want to learn about Data Structures and Algorithms and become a better programmer overall, take Dr. Parker. Each assignment easily takes 12+ hours/week if you're aiming for an A.

Professor Parker is a great professor overall. She is really good about explaining the material thoroughly, very easy to talk to, and seems to understand how to teach for different types of students and their learning styles. Having said this, she is a tough grader and you'll really need to study for her exams.

One of the worst experiences I have had. Her lectures are terrible, and she tends to use a condescending tone during them. The rubrics for assignments were generally vague and unhelpful. If you can help it, avoid this professor!

Her lectures are a joke. Grading rubric is hidden. Pair programming is mandatory. Assignment pages are unclear, as they are graded harshly and specifically on a rubric you are not hinted at or provided. Example tests have answers hidden to make your life harder. Avoid this professor at all costs. Possibly the worst professor in the CS department.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Parker is a fantastic lecturer. Her teaching style and content is direct and relevant. You will learn a lot in this class, and it is possible to get an A if you study for it. Almost all of your grade comes from 6 separate tests, including the final. The exams are hard enough to make you work, but easy enough to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: 2100 is tough class no matter the professor. There is a ton of content and the class has 5 quizzes (which are essentially midterms) and a comprehensive final at the end. Very easy to fall behind it if you don't attend lectures and read the textbook. With that said, Dr. Parker does an excellent job! She is always willing to help!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Surprised she's poorly rated from my classmates this semester. She was a great lecturer. Difficult class for sure but an A is obtainable if you're willing to put in the work for it. You could get away with not attending lecture as long as you read the book thoroughly. Study hard for the quizzes. They make or break your grade for this class.

Easy class to pass with an A. However, not a big fan of the professor. She is extremely rude, and while the material is very easy to follow, her lectures are a joke. Seriously, dont even bother attending them as youll learn way more from the labs and the TAs who actually know how to give you a helpful answer.

I never seen this kind of person entire of my college life. What a disrespect and rude person. I do not even want to call her "professor" since her lectures are terrible. If you have to take this class, just take another professor unless you wanna get a ton of stress.
just do not take

Professor Parker's preparedness and knowledge of the content was obvious, and her high standards helped to encourage me to succeed. She was always willing to answer questions after class and to explain concepts further. I admire her willingness to invest in students, advising them one on one and heading up the mentoring program at the U of U.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: do not take this class if you want to survive from stress.

Parker is the best teacher. She really cares about her students and does not take any bs. She can answer anyone's question and is really knowledgable about the subject. If you attend class you will learn a lot.

This is one of the toughest classes I've ever taken! I easily spent about 10 hours per week on the assignments. But I learned so much and have become such a better programmer because of it. I would recommend taking an easy load when you take this class. Most of the projects are with partners.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Erin Parker is ridiculously smart. I don't think I have asked her a single question that she did not know the answer to. She has very high expectations of her students, and if you take a class from her, get ready to bring your A game. You will need it. If you work hard and succeed, things will go very well for you in this major.
Long rambling lectures, but decent content. Be sure not to mess up any assignments, as she will not help you out at all. TAs are what make this class, not the professor.
Good prof overall. You definitely have to work for it, but in the end the requirements are clear and achievable.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Lectures are jam-packed with information, be ready to take some notes. Erin will be intimidating; if you show her you're willing to put in work, she will respect you greatly and you can learn much from her. Stick with your TAs and make them your friends. Erin has very high expectations of her students, and presents how tough this major can be.

She is knowledgeable in the subject but I feel like I was having information shoved down my throat during class which makes me wish that class periods were extended. The out of class material wasn't manageable for me with other classes/work. I found lecture's hard to pay attention to because they were mostly reading Powerpoints.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Expect a rigorous class, and the tests count for a lot. That being said, her expectations are beautifully clear and she's very accessible outside of class if you're struggling with something. Don't expect to be coddled, but this woman is brilliant and knows her stuff

This is a hard class! No matter who you take it with it will time intensive and challenging. I'm actually surprised by the negative feedback Prof. Parker has received. Personally, I find her lectures to be clear and articulate, as well as her answers to questions. I've taken two classes with her and definitely recommend her!

Absolutely useless professor. Told us during one of the first lectures that she's, "a computer science professor that hates computers." Learned nothing from the lectures, all the useful information coming in the first 5 minutes of class during the review. Her homework is cryptic, hard to understand. Insane grader, you miss part, all points gone!
Sets a realistic work load for the major
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Parker does somewhat teach the concepts at a decent level.  However, when asking for clarification in class, she seems quite paranoid and condescending.  She was okay when it comes to visiting her office hours but when going to her class, I felt like it would be better to study the material on my own outside of class.  Quite a horrible experience

Tests were too long and difficult to fit in the class time. Lectures were very poorly organized. Parker used powerpoint presentations to explain math and only rarely wrote on the chalkboard which is too small to read unless you sit up close to the front. This class was my worst experience at the U. Should have used a tablet/projector to write.

Treat's students like they're in elementary school during lectures. Very disrespectful to students who don't understand or want extra explanation. Quizzes were frequent, and quite difficult, class averages ranged from 55-65 with no curve. Grade breakdowns at end of class showed 47% of students failed, 30% with C and a mere 6% with an A.
Dr. Parker is amazing!

Avoid if she is teaching 2100. Simple as that. In jeopardy of retaking.  Red flags: 1) Math + powerpoint  why...  2) Either I'm really sensitive or she is condescending in class and in office hours.  3) Very test heavy. 5 tests, 60% of your grade. Throws awful questions. If you do bad in one or two tests... No A for you. This is a weed out class.

One of the worst experiences I've had at the U. Honestly, seems very condescending and annoyed to answer questions in class. Intentionally throws trick questions on exams. 6 big exams each 2 1/2 hours long. This was a very difficult math class, but taught from PowerPoint. Who teaches math from PP? Helpful in office hours, but in class, watch-out.

Amazing professor. She is very time-efficient, gives you everything you need to succeed. Must attend class and labs. Inspired me as a woman in CS. Don't ask dumb questions or give dumb answers, you will be ignored lol
Great at teaching the stuff, knows it like the back of the hand, and just thorough and helpful.

This class was difficult especially if I missed class however all her lecture notes are online and there are lots of TA hours and office hours to get help. So if you utilize all the resources give you can pass. She has a high standard that which makes her a tough grader. You can also find a PDF of this book online. I have only looked at it 2 times.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is an excellent teacher and her lectures were great! I would not recommend her CS1410-030 class if you have already completed an intro to programming else where. This class compresses all fundamentals of programming with object oriented programming. If you have taken an intro to programming class previous, take the regular CS1410 class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Great lecturer and if you have any questions she is happy to answer them as long as you don't interrupt lecture to ask. The TAs in my class were great too.  Class is hard and you will spend a lot of time working on the projects outside of class. If you wanted an easy major you shouldn't have chosen computer science.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Excellent professor. She is good at distilling a lot of information into bite-sized pieces while making it understandable. She runs a tough class, but she provides everything you need to be successful. Take the time to see her in office hours, as it will be beneficial to your understanding, but do your due diligence prior to asking questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I've taken CS 2420 & 3810 from Parker, I have liked her quite a bit. She's not a pushover and makes you work for a good grade, 2420 is a great class, assignments were fun.  CS 3810 is a tough class no matter who is teaching it. Parker's first time teaching, she did a good job given that. Assignment grading is unpredictable and she tests fairly.

Good lectures, but the workload is ridiculous. If you are taking the class simply to learn programming and aren't there for a degree, do not take this class.  There is too much work and the speed is too fast for thorough understanding of the material. The exams are weighted too high so you need to focus more on them than learning deeply.

Lots of time put in, but learned a ton though. Solid lectures even if I usually wasn't paying attention. She responds to posts on the class forum and is very helpful when you approach her. Good assignments. TA's take turns grading so standards vary a ton. When they were too radical though Erin took care of it.

Professor Parker follows the syllabus closely.  The department's specified curriculum will largely dictate the experience you have with her classes. Parker herself is professional, helpful, and generally reasonable. She doesn't, in my opinion, inspire or provide insight in the way you might expect from a truly top-tier instructor.  Expect average.

A fantastic educator.  Her lectures are a work of art, efficiently presented and packed full of content.  The assignments are difficult, forcing you to take the lead in learning Java, but also structured enough to help guide you in the process. Taking a course from a professor like this really is the best way to step into CSprogramming.

The worst experience I have ever had with a professor in my life. Very rude and pretentious, does not like to explain things in an understandable way, and does not like answering student questions. If you take a class from her, utilize the TA's. At least the TA's care to help.

Very challenging, but probably bit easier than Peter Jensen's class(I took both). Erin truly cares about students and THE STAFF SUPPORTS ARE FANTASTIC. She replies to questions very quickly and it actually helps too. Do keep in mind that 1410 isn't an easy class. Go to every lecture and do well on the assignments & quizzes alsostudy hard for tests.

Erin loves to help students succeed. She comes off as blunt & to the point, but if you visit her office hours & get to know her she is a great person. Her tests are difficult but manageable if you attend class <90% of the time. Don't slack on your assignments/labs and you'll get a good grade. Not easy but if you love CS you'll enjoy the challenge!

Great teacher for great class. Very organized and covers material very quickly. Don't be looking for an easy class  with her. She is very very understanding and helpful during class but, On tests if you get the answer wrong well.. its wrong.
Great Teacher. By far one of the most difficult classes I've ever taken, but She was very helpful for those who wanted to learn with Office hours and asking questions.
She's tough, but not entirely unreasonable. Every little bit counts in this class, do everything you can to get more points!

You can tell Dr. Parker is fairly knowledgeable. However, she is very condescending, and it can be very demotivating. She is not very forgiving or understanding. The amount of work required to do well in her class is substantial, so be prepared. A side note - she  likes to memorize as many student names as possible in her classes of 100-200.
She is an absolutely amazing professor, if she sees that you are trying, she will go out of her way to help you.

She is always friendly if you ask her questions at the relevant time (do NOT ask her about homework in class or lab, but afterwards). She was very accommodating for meetings, and was very helpful when she saw you making an effort. She is a bit blunt and can be rough around the edges, but she was overall nice. She also remembers everyone's names.

Hands down without a doubt the worst educator I have ever had to suffer through.  She has no real world experience and it is obvious.  She has zero people skills, is rude, and clearly does not care at all if students learn the material.  Thank god the book in the course is fantastic or I would have been screwed!

Great teacher. She is blunt and direct, but it's never unwarranted. Her teaching is clear and understandable. Don't expect much flexibility because the class has too many students for her to make exceptions. Tests aren't too hard as long as you really study and make an effort to master the concepts (which you need to do).

She is the rudest professor I have ever had, and has a serious overconfidence issue.  While it is obvious that she is rather intelligent and knows her stuff, she cannot convey that information to others.

Parker is a good teacher. She has kind of a harsh demeanor. Certainly doesn't take any BS. Good teacher, clear, easy, lectures were interesting. Assignments are easy if you don't fall behind. Tests aren't too bad.

Great Teacher! She is blunt and to the point, she doesn't give pity, and ignores dumb questions. Far too many students give up too early, and she knows when they do. Don't expect your hand to be held, don't cut corners, and she will show you great respect. Some say the tests are hard, I don't see how since they are the exact topics from class!
She was incredibly rude whenever I had questions!

Tough but fair, and I respect her a LOT for it. Best prof I have ever had. I have stopped in her office for help and received more than I had had needed. She is extremely smart and knows her subject thoroughly. She teaches very clearly and at the level of understanding of the students. I highly recommend taking classes from her!

Provides little to no constructive criticism on assignments, weighs tests too heavily, and doesn't seem interested in practical applications of knowledge, only theoretical ones. Way too much focus on timing

she is the most awesome prof! loved her intro class. she is really clear during lecture, and i like that she doesn't take BS from people. she is really fair and very helpful. she also is unique because she remembers every student she has ever had by name. she is amazing.
Doesn't provide help to students when they ask for it, provides no time for material to sink in, gives explanation of week's assignment the day its due, and assignments are aseninely long
Great
Great professor, very clear teacher and very helpful, wants her students to understand the subject and will do her part so that you do.
Dr. Parker understands the C language and therefore she can help the students understand the semantics of C.  She was always ready to help through email or in person.
Very clear instructor. Always very helpful during office hours, even staying past her scheduled hours to help me.

Dr. Enioutina's medical microbio is one of the best I classes I have taken at the U. She wants students to succeed and the course is structured for everyone to do well. Attendance isn't mandatory but some days are graded, so attend when you can. Use the TA review videos before each exam, and do the extra credit you'll almost certainly earn an A.

One of the easiest classes I have taken. All you have to do is memorize the highlighted content on review slides for exams, attend class, and take easy quizzes for an attendance grade. The few projects/assignments, other than exams and attendance quizzes, were also not very difficult

Very interesting class! Exam reviews were fantastic for exams and everything on the exams was covered in modules. Very sweet and intelligent professor but I personally struggled with her accent so I used closed captions.
great professor, I enjoyed the class heavily!

Elena was nice and clear with the grading criteria. Exams were multiple choice and short answer (2 exams) and each student presented 3-4 times on different diseases, in a flipped classroom. Attendance is required and class is hybrid. Exams are online, lectures recorded, and presentations in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Easy class, memorize the highlighted parts in the exam reviews along with the gram bacteria practice quiz and you're guarantied an A.

She is a good professor, knowledgeable in what she teaches. The only thing that made it difficult with this professor is the thick accent. It is hard to understand sometimes and watch the lectures. Overtime you do get used to the accent and it can be a good class if you put in the work.

Professor Elena Enioutina teaches a great class and this was my favorite class this year. We had other professors that helped teach throughout the semester that were also very great! We had in class activities on canvas some days, 4 exams, and one paper. She also offers extra credit at the end of the semester that helps your grade 5%.

Dr. Enioutina has been the best professor I've had my entire college career. Her lectures are extremely clear, you know exactly what will be on exams. She is super responsive and will help you with any questions you have. She offers extra credit quizzes because she genuinely wants you to get a good grade.

Professor Enioutina was great! 1-2 weekly assignments, 2-3 bigger projects, and 4 non-cumulative exams. The expectations were clear, and she was very flexible about letting students join over Zoom if they weren't comfortable coming into class. Lectures move FAST, so take notes and go to class!

This class was all online. All we did was watch 2 lectures /wk and take case studies afterwards. After every module there was a test. It's not a bad class although the videos can feel lengthy. Our prof did have an accent, but it is not hard to understand her and If you need help just ask the professors and TA's they are always willing to help you!

I took a chance on this Microbiology class, with it being online and me taking anatomy, physiology, and other courses at the same time while working 30 hours a week, I thought why not. There are up to 2 cases studies a week with 5 questions, there are 4 tests in total including the final, and TAs and instructors in the class will help, just ask!

I really enjoyed this class, a great teacher with a great set of TA's! They really helped me out! I may have not had the best grade but I was working 50 hours a week so I did the best I could! Really though, this class is so interesting and is quite fun! It is so possible to get a great grade! Very caring professor & TA's! Strongly recommend!

Really poorly executed and incredibly dry course. Reads slides provided by previous deceased professor completely verbatim, in a stilted accent, adding no additional information of use and providing no ad lib. Must listen to lectures to get a code to unlock hw. Bored to tears with this class. Should be fascinating material. Best to take elsewhere.

I thought Emily was a pretty good stats instructor. She clearly understands the concepts and she is decent at explaining them. She used material from Dr. Bowen, so there were flipped lectures to watch most weeks. She did well explaining things on the board, quizzing us casually to ensure understanding, providing opportunities for review, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor seemed to have no interest in the class, as they never connected with students, used other professors' lecture material, and had TAs/AI grading every assignment. Beware, if you meet every requirement on an assignment, you will be docked for "grammatical errors" with no explanation in an attempt not to allow a perfect score.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor does not seem to care about the class or the students. The lecture videos are recycled from multiple other professors. The material you are tested on is not indicative of actually understanding the course material. You have to write an essay weekly, and I suspect she has AI grade them. Unresponsive to email, overall bad experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Absolutely would not recommend this instructor.

Class is structured super poorly, grade is composed of basically just exams, posts online lectures and makes you watch them beforehand just to repeat everything again in lecture, teaches things in his “own way.” Only negative things to say, but Dave is a little funny though. I wouldn't recommend, take it somewhere else
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst class ever would not recommend
David is a super nice teacher and has a great sense of humor but the class material and the way it is taught is super hard and not easy to understand. Make sure to go to class, it is worth it.

do not take. It's probably the worst class I've taken and I've never had much of a problem in college. 6 hours of online lecture + 4 hours in person where he just belittles everyone. concepts are very very hard to understand the way he teaches them and he wants very specific things for his exams when he claims to only care if you "understand".
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT. SAVE YOURSELF.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If I could give him a 0, I would. The way he talks is hard to follow and he sometimes uses his own terms, not the scientific terms. Also he often says everyone in the class won't understand anything, we should all drop the class, and pretty much insults the class. Also his canvas is unorganized. worst prof ever. I hated this class. he was an awful prof. makes you watch hour videos before classes.

Professor Temme really wants his students to succeed but you have to apply yourself. It's really important to stay on top of the videos. It helps to hear the information once before class and then have him explain it again during class. It is also really helpful to use your own life/experiences to help study since you are studying about yourself!

He teaches things in complicated ways. He spends time on unimportant subjects. It is more important to him that we figure out how to word things in the way he wants us to and understand things the way that he does than actually understanding the concepts.

I really liked this professor. Honestly if you don't give the class your all, you won't pass. I gave this class my 85% and still got a B. In any course, you have to figure out the professor's thinking style and apply it to exams. In Temme's case, his course is purely conceptual. Find the concept in exam questions and apply it. Go to one library study session a week and I promise you will do well. It's a fantastic class; Temme is a fantastic lecturer. He makes physiology intuitive. Very little memorization. If you learn the few, key concepts each unit that he tells you will be on the test, you'll ace the class.

While this professor is known to be extremely difficult he is an incredible professor. TAKE HIS CLASS! Though some don't like him cause he stresses understanding rather than rote memorization, I can't thank him enough for how he has helped me learn to think. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The TA sessions were essential to passing the class and core quizzes. Temme's test were insanely hard and confusing because he wants his students to "think". Therefore, there is nothing you can do to properly prepare yourself for the exams. The lectures were great, but Temme didn't always explain everything which made it difficult to connect things
Dave was a great professor, but in class, it was hard to grasp every concept that he gave us. It was like class was a huge cram session every day.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Decent teacher. He gives good lectures, on subjects he's very passionate about, so he makes them interesting. However, his philosophy is that he wants to make his students "think." So his tests are unnecessarily confusing because of that. Tough class, especially when the TA's don't know all that much. But he gives a curve at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This was my 2nd class with Dave, and just like the first feels like a giant game of "guess what I'm thinking!". Dave's teaching style (which consists of arrogance, yelling and failed attempts at fostering "critical thinking") mainly helps you learn how to guess his answers than learn the material. Test questions will look nothing like lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dave teaches biology conceptually. He teaches concepts, then expects you to be able to apply those concepts to a scenario or story given on the test. The TA sessions are very helpful, but if you aren't wanting to put in extra time outside of the lecture, don't take the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Temme obviously thinks very highly of himself. He's very narrow-minded on how things should be learned, and it's his way or the highway. Tests don't reflect class, and TA's do all of the teaching. Also very demeaning and disrespectful to students as well as other faculty. As an entry level biology course it should have been more straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dave is a very tough tester. His questions will come out of left field and totally blind side you.  He will ask questions about things that were breezed passed in class. His TA's are hit and miss.  Some of them are very helpful and others have no idea what is going on.  Make sure you find a good study group.

Temme is interesting in class but the material that he covers will not be on the test. He may say one sentence, such as "the gall bladder is important," and test you all about it. It is ABSOLUTELY  MANDATORY that you see the TAs because they teach the material that will be on the test. Tests/quizzes will determine your grade, nothing else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Temme's class is very unique. Your entire grade comes from vocab quizzes, memorization-based core quizzes, and application-based tests. It can be very hard to figure out the exact phrasing he wants. I relied very heavily on the TA sessions before every test and quiz, and I honestly learned much more from them than I did from Temme himself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: First, this class is going to be hard no matter what professor you take it from. Second, those who disliked this class expected to do little work and still receive an A. Temme wants to challenge you to think in ways you never have before. At first I hated it, but now I use this thinking in every day life. Temme is amazing and I highly recommend him

Dave Temme and Dave Carrier joint teach this class.  It is straight forward and really interesting.  The class purpose is to force you to rethink nutrition and medicine, which it does effectively.  Dave Temme is just a really good man.  I have a lot of respect for him as a person.

Temme believes in what education should be. He isn't going to just give you an A for not learning anything. He teaches in such a way that you will actually learn concepts and not forget them. He is a solid teacher, not perfect, but definitely what other professors should be like.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This was the most AMAZING class!!! One of the best professors I've ever had.

Temme took so much time telling us he wasn't going to waste our time and how good a professor he is that he frequently wasted our time. He didn't want us to memorize things, just think it through but you have to memorize how to think like Temme because he doesn't make it easy to get the base info needed to analyze or make a critical assesments
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Read the textbook throughout the class and dont wait untill 2 days before the exam. LOTS of information and very detailed. dont take this class if youre not a science major. TA sessions are helpfull, you wont pass the class if you dont go to them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Temme is probably your stereotypical college professor. He seems really unapproachable and talks way over everyone's head. That being said he has helped me to understand concepts in the sciences (not just biology) that had stumped me for years, and his lectures are amazing. If you take his class it will be extremely hard, but extremely rewarding.
Couldn't ask for a more inspiring professor.  If you love biology take his class

Take his class only if you really want to learn! I had zero biology background and I thought biology was boring. But his class totally changes my mind. I love biology now. His lecture is SO fun and challenging. It pushes me to think a lot. I study hard and go to TAs for his class, and it totally worth it!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Take his class only if you really want to learn! I had zero biology background and I thought biology was boring. But his class totally changed my mind. I love biology now. His lecture is SO fun and challenging. It pushes me to think a lot. I study hard and go to TAs  for his class, and it totally worth it!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is a 'tough love' kind of professor. This class is not an easy A, and he makes that very clear. His material gets pretty difficult after a few weeks, and he goes fast. My suggestion for studying for quizzes is to first struggle and learn it on your own, then go see the TAs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I loved prof. Temme's class. It is a difficult class so if you're looking for an easy A, you won't find it here. Temme is focused on making sure every student understands the material and is staying on track. He can be harsh at times but he wants his students to succeed. No memorization in this class, all theory-based, so pay attention in lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is unwilling to work with his students. If you can't get the "words" he wants you to use on the quizzes, you won't pass. He teaches in an idealistic way so if you like people putting ideas into your head he would be great but if you like facts to make your own ideas then this isn't the professor for you. He is very disrespectful and will yell.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is tough, however if you read the text book, come to lectures, and go to TA help session you can pass this class vary easily. He teaches very different because he teaches so you understand the material and can visualize what is going on. Not as much memorizing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dave Temme and Dave Carrier co-teach this course. I loved it. It was challenging but helped me think outside the box. So interesting for pre-health students. Learned a ton about modern and and evolutionary health. I highly recommend it. There are low-stakes quizzes every week and a couple "journals" due, which are simple. Take this course.

TA sessions are a must! He teaches in a way that was hard for me to learn. His class is so eye opening. He teaches in a way that each thing builds on each other. If that makes sense. Lectures aren't boring, he is very lively and humorous throughout the  lecture. He has study guides you can fill in during class, you can print or do in on a computer.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This class was honestly way too anal for me. You have to put in so much effort and time in order to get a decent grade. He rants during lecture, you have to go TA's to pass quizzes. Tests don't reflect the materials learned in class. Disliked this class. I don't recommend it unless you really enjoy torturing yourself to some extent.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Temme is an interesting lecturer, but bases most of it on his book. Few times he says things that aren't in the book, but just go to a TA session you'll be fine. If you go to class regularly you won't need a book, but TAs help you understand material better and are basically the backbone of your knowledge for this class.
This class was quite a challenge for me. Very different teaching style. Got a few laughs in the class. Go to the TA sessions always or you are fudged.

I truly would not recommend this class. It was ridiculously harder than it needed to be and you learn cool things but they truly do not seem necessary for a biology course. He basically has this whole idea in his head of what he wants, and if your answer is even a word off from what he thinks, you're docked.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I loved professor Temme! He was absolutely wonderful. I didn't do well in the class, and that's completely on me because I didn't want to put in the effort. It is A LOT of work, but so worth it. TA sessions are a must, but they are extremely helpful. They will go over literally every question that will be on the quiz/test.

The people that say that Temme's course is bad, did not get the grade they expected because they didn't work hard enough.  Temme has not only taught me different ways to view the science of life, but he also taught me a lot about what education should be.  This class is hard. You cannot just memorize things to get by, but the TAs are very helpful!

Temme makes the biology less science and philosophical. He has quizzes and tests, no hw. Did well on quizzes which were based on bio concepts. But did not do well on the tests which were more analytical thinking (similar to standardized testing) which was hard for me. I would say that you need to study to think like him and what he thinks to get A

Temme is great as a person. He knows he does his class differently, so he has TAs to help you.  But let me just tell you, that it's just a Roll of the Dice. I went to almost EVERY TA sessions, and I heard WRONG information Many times. Which I had to correct, and got scoffed at.  The tests are hard, English intensive, and my second language.

Dave Temme is a different type of teacher. However, I loved him! He actually taught us the material in an attention-grabbing way, and I actually LEARNED the material. This isn't a memorization class, its a concept based class, and this helped me, despite the fact that my greatest strength is my short term memory. Be prepared to show up everyday!

Dave's classes are unlike most other classes in the sense that he is there for you to LEARN. If you want a class to just show up, memorize a bunch of stuff and regurgitate it on the exams, DO NOT take this class. Dave makes you think through everything he teaching. TA sessions are crucial for passing. TA's will save your life. My FAVORITE professor

This class was hard. Temme can be really confusing and has high arbitrary requirements of his students. He rants a lot in class and feels unapproachable . Basically you have to study with the TAs before every quiz and exam to even do ok. His exams are brutal and require at least 10 hours of study each to get a decent grade. Don't take him.

The only reason people think Temme is a hard/terrible teacher is because he expects students to put in outside work by reading his book and going to TA sessions. Yes, his tests are hard but you can still get an A by doing well on core quizzes and vocab quizzes. Temme has taught me more than any other professor I've ever had. Take his class.

He wants you to think simple and that one event will lead to another then another, just like the Direct TV commercials. He also wants you to know the basic ideas and not memorize the little details. Going to the TA sessions is a must, since they grade the quizzes. Overall, he is a unique professor and hilarious. DO NOT FALL BEHIND ON THE READINGS!

If you are looking for an easy class do not take it with Temme. If you are looking to learn and think about things in a whole new way, Temme is definitely the teacher for you! You will not be able to memorize your way through tests, you'll have to understand it; more importantly, you have to understand it Temme's way. Very interesting class though!

I wouldn't say I disliked him he was a nice guy, however this class was extremely difficult for me. The way he teaches is very confusing, its not your typical biology course, I personally would not recommend taking his bio class, it is possible to pass if you have a good biology background and study hard and meet w/ T.A.'s. Prioritize this class.

I wish I liked him. He is super passionate about biology which is great. Only problem, his tests are not based on his lectures. And his quizzes are basically memorizing exactly what the TA's say or they will mark you down. I attended every lecture, did not read the book. I never found a good way to study for this class. Tests are crazy hard.

He teaches in a different way but after a few weeks I got used to it and now I love how he teaches, you can tell he really has passion for the subject! TA sessions are essential to truly understanding. This class was tough but it is worth it to take.

I've read many reviews of Professor Temme implying that he does not teach biology.  I found Temme's method of teaching to be wonderful. He taught me the core ideas of biology. If you are willing to learn the concepts then apply them, you will excel. If you just want to memorize a biology book and pretend you know biology, don't take this class.

I wanted to give Temme the benefit of the doubt since he is such a well liked professor, however I found him to be pretentious and quite frankly, a huge male genetalia.  He's passionate about his field, yet that doesn't translate to being a good teacher, instead he just seems unapproachable.

Temme has a very different style of teaching. There is little memorizing in this class. His hard tests are all based off of understanding ideas. GO TO THE TA SESSIONS, that is the only way I'm understanding anything. No homework, just pure studying and understanding. I occasionally read the book, only when I didn't understand something from lecture

Temme is a good teacher, but he's just really annoying. He spends a lot of class time yelling at you to leave his class if you're not prepared to learn in the way that he wants you to learn.  I had my phone out in class once, and he yelled at me, saying there was no way I was going to pass his class. I've gotten high scores on all his tests lol RIP

I hate this teacher he does nothing to help his students and gives you a f if you dont think like he does, not only that he tells you that you shouldn't be in the class if you dont get this and that. like what in the hell Im paying a ton of money to take this class to be told   I don't have time for you and your not good enough i hate this teacher.

He tries way too hard to try and make us "think" I do not want to think about little processors and dung beetles eating you know what. I want to learn about real biology please. I've asked many friends that have taken biology elsewhere (and passed with good grades)  and they think his teaching is pointless and I'm not learning what I should be.
He will make you work for your grade, however, if you're interested in biology this is one of the best teachers to learn from.

It's definitely a tougher class, but the material is interesting and engaging. To get a good grade, you need to put in quite a bit of time and effort. A lot of my time is spent trying to understand what Temme wants on a quiz or test rather than actually reviewing material. It takes some time to adapt to him and the way he teaches and grades.

Arguably the best professor I've ever had!  It's because he teaches you how to THINK, not how to memorize.  It's a tough class, no doubt; not like normal classes or teaching styles.  You either love it or hate it.  I loved it, and learned LOADS.  He cares passionately about the subject and about your success.  Tons of TAs to make sure you pass.

DO NOT TAKE PHYSIOLOGY FROM TEMME! He expects you to already understand everything HE knows about phys. He expects a lot and teaches very little. Class time is looking at pictures he created and believes makes sense to everyone and skips real material. He also will blame students for their lack of understanding and not consider his poor teaching.

Temme gets a bad rap for holding students accountable for really understanding content instead of memorizing useless information. Tests always have new material, but the concepts are the same so you just use what you know and you get an A. I've never had a better teacher in college.

The best teacher at the U. He will help you learn how to learn, and really think about physiology. It helped so much for the bio section of the mcat. His tests are conceptual like the mcat you will learn how to apply concepts about physiology to things you have never seen before. He is a great lecturer and make difficult material understandable.
His lecture are extremely confusing and when you ask questions he just tells you to look back at the book. Not helpful.

He's not necessarily bad, just has a controversial teaching style.  He's more interested in getting you to think like him than to teach. Considering he writes his own book, you're stuck with his style.  Many try to write off his odd teaching by saying he has a great T.A. system, but if meeting with T.A.s is a must, what does that say about him?

It's not as tough as some people say. It's not just about spending a lot of time with the TAs. I found that it was necessary to spend some time on my own to really do well on his exams, because big groups can be pretty inefficient at times.

I've never worked so hard and struggled so much in a class. Dave can be pretty confusing, but the TA's are extremely helpful. I would have had no idea on some of the quizzes if it weren't for going to TA sessions. Definitely not a class that you can breeze through...

This class was really hard for me, but I learned a lot from it. The T.A.s are incredible, take advantage of the library sessions and the quizzes will be a breeze! Tests are hard, but if you work hard it definitely pays off. He challenges you to think in different ways which can be frustrating but once you finish the class you feel so accomplished!

he thinks his ideas are more corrrect than anyone else, to prove it he wrote his own book. So for tests you need to read the book and listen to lectures and then still not have any idea how to answer test questions because that is just the way he teaches.  He also rants a lot during lecture wich got old. Used to love bio till this class :(
I've taken biology before and understood and enjoyed it. Temme makes up his own stuff and he wrote his own book which is not helpful because it is the same way he talks, ununderstandable.
I loved this professor he definitely made you earn your grade.

He was really hard. Doesn't explain much of the quiz material in class and you have to go to additional discussion sections to get any help. He uses his own textbook and the ideas he teaches are based in science but his own conclusions and his way of teaching isn't very instructive.
He really makes you learn the material. If you try to just coast through his class you will fail..

he wrote his own book, so you better like reading and listening to lectures because on test he wants HIS definition from HIS book. You can have a perfect understanding but if you forget one word that he thinks is important he will dock you. Good luck. I wouldnt take another class from him ever.

Phisio was amazing. You don't need to buy a text book but you will end up making your own. Use the pages he provides and understand them. He is a conceptual teacher, not someone to just check off a box. If you do not NEED this class don't take it. He always had time for questions and was always willing to give extra help. DO NOT SKIP LECTURES!!!

this class was interesting. However, it should NOT be taken as your introductory biology class if you're serious about it. Because this class is almost entirely conceptual you're not getting down to the nitty gritty of biology & learning the facts. Tests are graded off if you think the way HE does, not if you really understand.

This class was horrible. I am so enthusiastic about biology; it's my passion. I went to every TA session possible, studied hard, and completely understood all of the material. Then I went and took the exams. I cried. Almost nothing he teaches are on the exams, and I would never, EVER take this class again.  This class nearly ruined biology for me.
In hindsight, I think that this is one of the most important classes that I've taken in college.

He understands he's teaching a bunch of lazy freshmen, so he spends a lot of lecture time ranting about putting work in. If you're a student that reads his textbook (which you need to get!!) you'll do fine as long as you put in a a good amount of studying. Also, TA's are lifesavers if you're confused.

His way of teaching is VERY different and abstract. Doesn't have time to explain things if you need extra help. He only cares about how much you learn, not grades. Which is good, but honestly in college grades DO matter. Be careful if you need an A because this is not an easy class.
Temme was confusing, tests did not match what was taught, and he would not work with or listen to students but instead told them to find a TA as he was too busy. I regret taking this class from him.

Fantastic teacher - distills complicated concepts into their essence, always with an eye on the system. Frustration: his jerkiness when students aren't "getting it" - inevitably attributed to lack of effort & lazy learning habits (ok, more than a little true), but he forgets we're struggling with HUGE concepts for the 1st time that he's taught 30x.

Dave's physiology class was one of the most challenging classes I took at the U. He has a unique approach to teaching, the way I study and answer questions for all other biology classes has completely changed because of this course. Take anatomy before taking this class, it helps a lot! Lecture attendance is essential, & earning an "A" is doable.

I took this class as a freshman and admired Dave's care for the students. He TRULY wants you to learn. Some people don't give him nearly enough credit. Being an "A" student means almost nothing, and if you think you're a good student and hated the class, you likely learn based on pure short-term memorization, which won't do you any good in the end.

Dave is so amazing. People who give him a poor rating probably do it because of one of more of the following 1) they don't work hard enough, 2) they don't like his teaching style, 3) they want a class that just gives them an easy A. If you don't take this class, you're missing out on one of the best opportunities.

If you are a biology major, this class is for you. If you are NOT a biology major, like myself, DO NOT take him! This is way too intense to be a required class. I am the kind of person who cares about getting good grades, but it is hard to want to get a good grade in a class that is very uninteresting and way too much to stress out about.

Extremely difficult class, because he wants you to answer the exams the way he wants it and if you don't he marks you off. You have quizzes in class. The exams are ridiculous. He goes on rants and gets off subject constantly.

Temme is the worst professor I have had so far.  He goes on 20-30 minute rants each lecture about how passionate he is about teaching and how he is the greatest professor instead of teaching biology.  He is not detail oriented so if you have to take more biology classes after this class don't take Temme's class.
The class was hard and I felt it was unnecessary.

Incredible, incredible teacher that knows his subject and is dedicated to sharing his passion. He cares about teaching concepts rather than minute details. For tests, an overall understanding is required rather than memorization of details. The book is extremely useful, as it contains Temme's mind! The dozens of TAs are also invaluable.

Prof. Temme is an enthusiastic and dedicated teacher. He provides ample opportunity to learn however he teaches in a very particular way which may not be easy for many students. He uses a book that he wrote which does not give an alternative perspective. He teaches the way he sees the world and not necessarily the common terms or explanations.

Dave is a Great professor; that being said you have to put work into his class if you want to succeed & do well. Here's the thing; Dave can only teach, the student is the one that has to learn. Dave has TA sessions setup for a reason.people who complain: there probably hundreds of hours or more of total possible library times you could have gone to

To be honest I don't understand why people think this class is so hard. Maybe it's cause ppl say it's hard, BS! It just takes a lot of work but it's not hard.  Dave's class is not based on memorization.  The class is based on knowing the material so that you actually understand it.  But PLEASE ATTEND TA SESSIONS!! Thats the only way you'll pass.

He tells the students that he does not care about details, but then tests you on those same details. The class can be interesting at times. However, Professor Temme is not accomodating at all and I would not recommend taking this class from him.  Not worth the aggravation and pain that he puts you through.

Dave is a very good professor. He has set up the best T.A. session that is very helpful. This class would be impossible without the help of the ta's. Overall the class is difficult but Dave knows what he is doing and is a very knowledgeable professor. If you enjoy biology and want to learn how to study, take this class.

Temme is a good professor, but the class is very hard and nearly impossible to pass without going to see the TAs.  It is good to learn with other students, but I had to work at my job a lot this semester, and it made life really hard trying to get to the TA sessions.  Once again, if you don't attend them then you will NOT do well in the class.
Awesome professor who has set up the best T.A. program I have ever come in contact with. He definitely requires you to work. But you know what you need to study and you will learn in his class.

I absolutely loved his class. He does teach in a very unique style that makes you actually learn the material and not just memorize for an exam. He doesn't care about specifics, he wants you to know the processes and apply it to everyday life. Once you get that it's easy. If you want an easy A or GE don't take bio anyway. Favorite professor.
Temme's teaching methods are unorthodox, but effective. This class is not as hard as people say it is and as long as you go to the TA study sessions, you will do fine.

Doesn't teach what will be on the tests. He uses very obscure references and his handouts are basically worthless unless he tells you to memorize a specific part. I didn't like how if the whole class did poorly on a test he'd blame it on the classes lack of preparation instead of his teaching methods. The only useful stuff was the Review Sessions.

I have had Dave for both principles and physiology and I really enjoy his teaching style. He teaches for comprehension rather than memorization, so If you just want to memorize a bunch of enzymes don't take his class. That being said his classes aren't easy but if you put in the effort and are smart, an A  is very doable.

Temme doesn't teach at the same conceptual level that he tests. The resources he gives are sparse. I'm a good student, just not very good at taking notes, so I only got a B. He seems to like fear mongering and insulting the class based on test performance.
One of the most amazing professors I have ever had. He teaches for understanding. His class is difficult if you are a lazy sack, so work hard. Great class.

I had almost no interest in the subject of Biology before I took Professor Temme's class. He was very hard on his students, and the tests were quite hard as well, but I feel like I learned a lot in his class. He had a great passion for biology, and it was a joy learning the subject from him.

Temme was one of my favorite professors last semester and his course was great. I already had prior knowledge of the subject, but he introduced the material in a nontraditional perspective. He is very energetic and is passionate about biology. However, I relied heavily on his TAs to perform well on exams.

If I could go back and have him again I wouldn't. He makes this way harder than it has to be. Quizzes are easy, but the tests use a bunch of material we didn't and try to confuse you. He wants you to be so familiar with biology that you can use it in any situation he presents you with. Only have him if you genuinely love biology.

He is very passionate about what he teaches. He presents the material in a way that forces students to spend additional time on their own to learn the material. You will need help from the TA's at some point. His tests were hard, but not impossible.
He is the most passionate person I have ever met. He isn't just teaching so he can do research. He loves biology and loves to share his love for biology.

Temme's lectures are interesting, but very conceptual and vague, while the tests and quizzes are really specific. You'd think it would help to use the textbook but he wrote it, so it's just as unhelpful. He's also kind of mean. If you're just taking this class for GenEd, take it from someone else with a more traditional teaching style.
Dave is so fun to listen to and he is always willing to help his students.  There is a lot of material covered in the class, but I recommend taking this course.  Incredibly knowledgable teacher!

This class was difficult, but not impossible. Even for those who are good with science, expect to spend a TON of time in TA study sessions. Most of his information presented in class so prepare to do a lot of work outside the class

Dr Temme was awesome.  Its true his style of teaching is different but if you attend class and study what is gone over in class you'll do great, because that is what is on the test.  Besides that he makes class fun and entertaining, he wants you to understand the material and do well.  I enjoyed his class.
HARD to understand sometimes, and it was painful, but I actually learn somethings, but if you really want to enjoy your biology class DON'T TAKE IT WITH HIM.

Hard and didn't really make sense. I took this class from him and then from someone else. The material that was gone over in the classes weren't the same at all. Temme kind of just did his own thing. If you want to be ready for consecutive biology courses I'd say, take it from someone else.

He's a nice guy and a lot of people loved this class. I hated it just because i didn't like the way he presented Biology.  His weird conceptual way of teaching really teaches most kids to think but I was not a fan.  Become really familiar with the TA's.  They are the best.  Especially Catherine, they are always at the library so find their hours.
This teacher presents the material in such a way that the class is incredibly difficult! However, if you do take this class, you WILL learn an awful lot.
Worst class I've EVER taken! Take this from someone else if you want to understand biology!

He is the best teacher I have ever had. I loved his class; I always learned something new. Some kids disliked him but that's probably because they were too lazy to think and actually learn. He didn't focused on memorization which was nice instead he just wanted you to understand the consents. The TAs help a lot and so does reading the book.
Awesome teacher. His lectures are so much fun. The principles he teaches are applicable to so many other things than biology. I wouldn't take this class from anyone else.

Dave Temme is without a doubt the most intelligent person I have ever had the fortune of coming across in my life. Even as a computer engineering major, I fully believe that I did myself a favor by taking a class from him. Highly recommended!

The best teacher I've ever had, he really knows his stuff. Dave teaches in a fun and simple way but you have to make sure you understand the simple concepts very well or you will never be able to apply it to the tests. His lectures are fun!

I don't know why people complain that he says "right" after a lot of his sentences, I think it's hilarious. Like the teacher from South Park.."mmkay?". He is an amazing teacher. I have no doubt that he teaches the materials as best and simply as it can be taught.

Amazing teacher but this class is not easy. He explains the subject very well but the tests are all about application of what you learned so you have to understand the concept very well. He bases his class heavlly on the book but he does skip a lot, I recommend you read it and try not to fall behind. Overall best biology class ever

This is a quality professor.  Don't expect an easy course, but his teaching is amazing.  He challenges his students, and expects engagement on their part, but explains concepts clearly. You may not get an A from him, but you will learn alot.
He definitely likes teaching biology.
His goal is to really help you understand the material and how it works.  If you're wanting to just go through this class by memorizing like other classes, too bad.

If you take Temme's class, listen to how he says RIGHT after every other word or sentence. It will drive you absolutely mad. Once you have been cursed by this, it will make his class unbearable. Right, right, rye, hurright, rye, right, right. Avoid this class if tourrets bother you.

Prof. is intelligent and funny, and breaks down concepts to a very -I mean VERY- basic level. This sometimes obstructs learning in some ways, that he isn't willing to combine some more involved aspects earlier. Lots of time wasted in such thorough recap, is painful. Testing involves more applied & abstract knowledge than is available thru lecture.

I really enjoyed this class. It was hard and you really had to study for it, but overall it was a fun class and I learned a lot. Temme expected a lot from you but he was very helpful and wanted you to do well in the class.

He has very interesting lectures, and the lectures are very useful for the tests.  The tests are hard, but if you go to class and at least skim the book, they are manageable.  The TA's for the most part are great.  Overall, I enjoyed this class.

Temme is an excellent teacher who wants his students to understand the big principles and not just memorize stuff.  His class is difficult but by paying attention in class, reading parts of the book and going to TA sessions you can do well.  This class made me enjoy Biology.

He's a really great teacher.  I loved his teaching style which has made future classes so much easier to understand.  His style is sometimes harder for some students, but if you go to class, study, and use the TA's, then it really opens your mind!!  His tests are the hardest thing.

An excellent Professor that some people have difficulty with. His teaching method and thought processes are unorthodox, but once learned make any future biology classes easier by teaching you an easier way of thinking about things.  He focuses on learning concepts, not memorization.  People who don't like him usually don't make the effort to learn.

He is a great teacher who knows what he is talking about... But he is very hard and his tests are so so diffucult. If you do not study you will not pass period. But pay attention and you will get a decient grade.Overall i learned a ton from Temme

You better have somewhat of a science background before this class, this class is hard!!!  He's a really smart teacher and definitely knows what he's talking about.  But the class is impossible without somewhat of a background.  Don't think that if the very first day you don't understand some things that it will eventually come and get easier!
makes you adopt his own method of thinking for human physiology. not as applicable in my opinion. enthusiastic teacher, but you could learn this stuff from the pros in any book...sorry dave

Temme was a great lecturer! He may be hard especiallyl for first time freshmans. It is harder than your average biology class, but i promise promise promise that if your going into any medical field it will make every class after that easy. Its very conceptualize and different test setting. Go to the TA sessions, they will help you get through it!!

Loved his class. Every lecture, he would make us laugh. He has such passion about teaching and biology. One of the best classes I have ever taken. He's also the best science teacher I've had. I've learned so much and he's kept me interested the entire time. Take biology from Temme!

He has a passion for the subject! He is both entertaining and informative. It has been a pleasure taking his class. I wish I had another class with him. There is nothing bad I can say about him or his class. Take it, embrace confusion!

If you want to learn anything about biology and retain that information, this is the class! Best part is Temme actually cares if you understand the stuff or not! And he teaches you to learn which spills over into other classes! Definately be dedicated and attend the TA sessions!
His class is fun but Test is  whole different story. International students need to be really careful!! Try to go to TA session as many times as you can.
For being a required GE class, this class was way too hard. He is very unhelpful, and very nitpicky about everything. Don't take this class. Find a different Prof.
Writes his own book, and his lectures are pretty much the book verbatim.  He's pretty hard but still a great teacher.  Best advice I can give you:  GO TO THE TA SESSIONS!
Interesting...
Extremely difficult Quizzes and tests. TA sessions have to be visited or expect to fail, get there early or good luck getting a seat or somewhere to listen.
One of the best professors I have ever had. His class is difficult and taught in an unconventional manner, but you really learn a lot.

Dr. Temme teaches in his own way.  I respect that his is willing to use his own methods to teach biology.  He is very passionate about biology.  He often became angry at the class for being zombie like during his lectures.  He demands active participation in the class.  The TA sessions are a useful learning tool before quizzes and tests.

Temme is awesome! I absolutely loved his class, lectures were never dry or boring and you will actually remember what you learn. Go to the TA sessions before core quizzes & you'll do fine. He doesn't make you memorize little details but instead focuses on fundamental concepts. You'll have to work for your grade but it's really worth it. Great class

You either hate his teaching style or you love it. I really liked it. It helped me conceptualize and understand the principles of biology. The core quizzes were extremely easy and educational at the same time, they serve as buffers in case you aren't a great test taker. *BONUS: The TAs are good looking.

He doesn't make you memorize all the little details, you just have to get the big picture. The easy way to pass this class is to e-mail the TAs and they will help you study for the exams, and pass them with flying colors. Do well on the core quizzes and you will be fine.
Amazing professor.  Hard, but amazing.
very very good teacher. Different approach to biology. more logical than rote memorization
He is truly one of the greatest teachers if you are willing to work.

Temme is incredibly brilliant, and so passionate about biology. His class is best if you really care about learning the subject. If you are just taking it because you have to, choose another teacher. He is difficult, but his class is so rewarding.

Omg....this class is really hard...reading....vocab...really hard...but somehow, it s usefull n Temme is funny teacher. But the exam n quiz are really hard...the words he use to asking really new...International student should be careful....
Fun class but.. he's not too fair when grading.

This is not a class for those who wish to be scientists. He teaches his own hypothesis as to what life is and he does not like being disagreed with. If you want a class that only requires spewing back what the teacher says and not thinking then go for it. To let you know that I'm not failed student, I'm currently in grad school studying viruses.

Everybody hates temme, but he is an excellent professor, he teaches a little  bit different, the only thing i am worried about is that he doesnt teach you the words to biology terms, he just explains how it works, which is great, he is excellent and pretty funny too. he loves to dance and make weird movements.

David Temme is an awful professor. The material he teaches in class never shows up on the test. The tests and quizzes are impossible. My advice is to go to EVERY TA session you can find, especially before quizzes and tests. The TAs are usually extremely helpful. All in All: FIND ANOTHER PROFESSOR.
Temme was a very difficult teacher, but also tried really hard to give us the tools to succeed. He gave us plenty of TA's and plenty of study sessions. If you put in the effort, you got the grade.
Very interesting. A lot of reading a lot of work. Rewarding though.
He is a wacky guy, but very smart.
Temme is awesome.  Hard class in that a ton of material is covered but if you're willing to do the work and do what he tells you to do, you'll excell in the class.

The class covers a lot of material in a little bit of time but he is avaliable whenever you need him and he has a ton of TAs to help out. He writes his own textbook and basically teaches it word for word.

His class was the best I've ever taken.  He's such an awesome guy, and he's so passionate about bioloy.  He also really cares about how the students are doing.  Just go to TA sessions before quizes, and they'll basically tell you exactly what to write.  If you do that, the class is cake

He is great. Really hard class, but he actually cares how students are doing! Tough because the class is so huge... but make use of the TA's! Go to TA sessions before EVERY "Core Quiz" (you'll learn what those are) and exam... it makes a WORLD of difference. Temme is passionate, a nerd, and fun.
Great Professor. Loves to teach therefore makes the class fun. Ratings on him are low because he teaches a Gen Ed class that is hard.
He is a fun and interesting teacher.

The worst teacher that I have taken so far at the U. His tests are ridiculous, and he won't help you out. He pawns his students off to his TAs to help answer questions, which isn't all that bad except they don't even understand all that much about the crap he teaches. Its all from his own book, so prepare to learn his vocab. Expect a low grade.
Awesome teacher. Very helpful, interesting and unique.

Temme sucks.  Anyone that says otherwise is just pandering to his Leftist propaganda, which always finds its way into class.  His tests are NOTHING like what he teaches.  The book is lame, typos, b/w stick figures, honestly... it is embarassing.  Temme berates an belittles students.  I can't believe anyone would give him a positive review.

I like that he tries to challenge us, but is still very willing to help us understand the material.  If you feel he is unclear then you aren't putting in the effort to listen and try to understand.  The only problem I have is that he likes to dot things that don't need to be dotted and mumbles "all right" after explaing a concept.  Watch and listen it's kinda funny sometimes.

I guess he's just one of those love it or hate it professors. I loved him for his passion, but he does make things confusing by oversimplifying sometimes. Biology is just one of those subjects where you need memorization at some point; and trying to eliminate that process as much as possible isn't always helpful .. but TA sessions help a LOT.
dave changed the way i think about life.

this class is boring!  you don't even have to attend lecture, just read the book and you'll know everything, since he wrote it and practically recites it word for word.  he does seem like a nice guy if only the book was used just as supplemental instruction and not as the only instruction.
Dave rocks! I've been enlightened to the loopy nature of life!

He keeps the students attention, and teaches Biology in a way to keep the students attention.  It's college, of course you have to work hard, I'm just grateful I have a prof. who loves teaching like Temme does.
No Comments
This guy wrote his own text book...it's obvious the class will not be easy, but with the right attitude you can do anything!!
I love that he is so passionate about the subject and about teaching it to us!

Anyone who has made a negative comment about Temme is crazy.  He is a great teacher who instead of making you memorize dumb facts, he makes you learn how to really THINK about concepts.  So stop complaining and being lazy and you might like him.
No Comments

I love Dave's enthusiasm for teaching.  This guy is also very knowledgeable.  Sometimes he lost me on discussions, and often went off on odd tangents.  The TA help is awesome!  I like Dave and how he can tie everything together.  He gives just the right amount of homework, quizes, etc.
I hated this class.. He tries to make biology fun by being unorthodox but just succeeds in being confusing.  The tests do not match the lectures.

Without the help of the TA's, I would have flunked the class for sure. His exams were extremely hard and they really didn't have that much to do with the textbook. This class was unnecessarily boring and it was hard that it made me hate biology
This is not a slacker class - you have to work your butt off.  It is a great foundation for future classes. His exams are tough cause you have to read his mind.

Professor Temme, or just "Dave" as his followers call him is unhelpful, annoying, and a terrible teacher. He goes out of his way to be unorthodox and changes biological concepts and vocab. to arbitrary words of his choice. I have an A and I stil

I hate Tmme! He has got to be one of the worst teachers I have ever had. He teaches in such a roundabout way that by the time he gets to the point you are so bored you've fallen asleep. He teaches as if the class is stupid and can't comprehend anything.
Dave's a great teacher.  He's excited about the material and he gets the students excited and interested.  The material may be new, but if the student works hard there's no reason not to get an A.
knows what hes talking about and loves teaching it, life is loopy!

I actually took Calculus 2 from this professor, and he tends to ramble a lot. It was difficult to understand what was actually important, and he kind of just skipped over some stuff. Super nice guy, but really difficult to understand.

Calc1 with this professor was enjoyable and easy. The least enjoyable parts were mainly the labs, which were so complicated that most groups werent even finished when class ended.Exams are very similar to practice tests and you should have no problem taking exams if you do them. Lectures werent too helpful since he rambled a lot. Veryyy fair grader
