Loved this class as gen ed fulfillment. It was super easy but interesting. There is a movie every week, with 2 assignments and 2 quizzes. They are not hard and super short, so it is not a heavy workload. The content was fun to learn and Loewen is a great professor!

I loved Science in Cinema. I love film, too! Learning how the earth works & all about natural disasters was fun, & realizing how inaccurate Hollywood can be, too! Mark is a fun person, super chill. There is a midterm & a final test, two quizzes per week & two assignments per week, but it sounds worse than it is. It doesn't really take long at all.

Literally the easiest class I've ever taken. Fulfills a science credit, absolutely thanking the lord above for that. The movies are pretty fun, and you honestly don't have to go to class at all to pass. Slides were all available, usually the class watched the movie during class, so it didnt rlly yield much info.

This class was absolutely amazing and Mark is a wonderful professor. His lectures are fun, hilarious, and lively, and the homework and tests are ridiculously easy. I felt genuinely sad when the semester was over because I didn't want his class to end. I highly recommend Geo 1040 from Mark if you want an easy and fun life sci credit.
He isnt a harsh grader or assignment heavy but as a result of that I actually learned a lot about a variety of subjects.

This professor uses a lot of movies to teach which is very interesting. He makes you wanna learn things. He also welcomes any types of question related to geology or dinosaurs! The quizzes are very easy. He also allows  discussions among students for most homework. Best teacher for this semester! EASY A!
This class was my saving grace. Professor Loewen is super nice and wants everyone to do good in the class. Just watch the movies and do the assignments and quizzes and you will get an A.

Very easy class to fulfill a physical life science credit. Several assignments are dropped at the end of the semester and grading is pretty lenient, some assignments can be time-consuming. The tests are VERY easy, open book/open note, and are pulled from previous quiz questions. The class was IVC but not necessary to attend at all.

Extremely easy class. He really didn't care if you googled answers or anything like that. His lectures were kind of a hot mess just because some of the other students had no chill on Zoom, but informational none the less. Sometimes the homework load felt a little excessive, but in all fairness you could finish a week's worth of HW in like 45 mins.
Awesome class!
I LOVE MARK
This Geology course was so so easy, and fulfills you're applied science credit. Mark is not only does to earth but also so funny. Overall a gem of a class!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Loewen is really passionate about his interests and he makes it facsinating. We watch the movies during class and the quizzes are pretty simple. He's a funny professor and I wish I paid more attention since the topics he covered were pretty interesting. I'd take it again for credit in the future and it's just a fun class to take overall.

If you're contemplating taking this class, as Nike once said, just do it! I'm going to miss this class a whole ton. Our class had set up a group chat to work together on things and it was the best. He shows the movie during class and it's fun to chat about it in zoom. Had his class 2x a week. Loved this class, you get to learn a lot without stress.
Not sure the course code, science in the cinema. Best class ever
Hes amazing. Is very engaging and grades very quickly.

The grading is super lenient so it's not too hard to do well in this class, but it got more technical/complicated than I was expecting -it's a lot harder than his science in cinema class. Mark's obviously very knowledgeable and passionate, and pretty funny sometimes too. He can be a bit short with students sometimes but it's often deserved tbh.
Honestly one of the easiest classes I've ever taken while still learning a lot. As long as you do your work and watch the movies you will get an A. Hilarious guy.

This mans is funny and nice and you really dont have to go to class to do well BUT classes are funny so you might enjoy this. Invest in Amazon prime/Hulu/Netflix before you enroll its cheaper than buying each movie, oh yeah all you do is watch sci-if movies! Take the course man!
Mark's class was simple and entertaining. He picked lots of great movies, and the tests/quizzes were pretty easy. He had lots of fun stories.

Mark is really a top notch professor. His science in cinema class is a lot of fun, and basically is a broad overview of geology. Although his class is set up to be an easy A, I still feel like I learned quite a lot from it. His criticism of some of the cheesy movies we watch is hilarious. He is also very lenient when it comes to late work.

Such a fun class. You can not watch the movies and still get 5/5 by googling but some of the movies are really good! Weekly quizzes that you can google, exams are based on quiz questions, and movie review worksheets that you can google. Such a great professor with a great sense of humor! 10/10 recommend for gen ed science credit!! Easy A
Easiest class ever, love science in the cinema.

Easiest class I took this semester. Four assignments due each week, two open-book five-question quizzes and two five-question worksheets. Midterm was all multiple-choice. The guy is easy-going, funny, and a gem. You don't even have to go to the Zoom classes, but it's fun to attend. Highly recommend.
This guy really knows his stuff. The Science is Cinema class is very low-pressure, but still a really great way to learn a lot of interesting science. I would highly recommend this professor.

Love Mark. Hilarious guy. Watch bad movies, listen to funny guy talk about bad movies. If he offers the chance to go on a field trip to the museum for extra credit, totally take the opportunity. He gives you a personal look behind the scenes at paleontology at the U, it's really cool even if you don't care about dinosaurs. Seriously fun experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I LOVE MARK. seriously one of the best classes I have taken at the U. Most classes you just watch movies, not documentaries or anything actual hollywood films. He is really funny and has a lot of interesting stories to tell. Really easy class because if you show up you get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Watched movies almost every class����
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Easy class. Has very easy homework assignments and he even drops a few at the end. Tests are so easy, he does reviews for them a couple days before and gives you the answers. Learned a lot about dinosaurs.

Mark was a great professor. World of Dinosaurs was a very fun class. Do the (VERY easy hw assignments) and go to the REVIEW SESSIONS (hosted by the TA's) and you will easily pass this class. It's an easy class but you do have to put in a little work. Also go on the field trips, the rock;)

This was easily the best and easiest class. All you had to do was watch a movie each week and turn in 2 assignments that were 5 questions each. One on the movie and one on the topic being learned from the movie. So easy. Go to class though. He has quizzes just to make sure people are there. He gives you the answers to the quizzes as well lol.

I love Professor Loewen. He's very down to earth and gives lots of time for questions. There are 15 "projects" but you only do 10. There are also tests, the TAs do well to prep if you go to their study sessions. The field trips are really fun and count as projects!

I took science in cinema from mark and it was a pretty easy class. We watched lots of movies and talked about how natural disasters were portrayed in the film. He has daily quizzes only to make sure you show up to class. Quizzes are easy and there is little homework assigned. Easy class, great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: First, he looks like Hagrid from Harry Potter. I took his Natural Disasters class. There were no tests, just a few papers and group projects. The Final Project was easy. His due dates for things change, and you watch a lot of movies. If you show up you can get an A.

Mark's classes are awesome! Only grades daily in-class assignments and there's hardly ever homework. If you show up and do the assignments you'll get an A. Final project is super easy as well. He's a very chill, laid back guy. Lectures are interesting and he's very open to questions and discussions. If you have the option, take this guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: I did not need to use the textbooks at all to pass this class. Attendance is not mandatory, though if you miss class you might end up missing a pop quiz. The exams hold the most weight so even if you miss several of those, you'll be fine. Each exam has an essay, but the professor gives out the possible questions before the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you fail Mark's Dinosaur class you're a bad student. The man is one of the world's leading paleontologists, and that class wasn't hard at all. Field trips are the bomb, and he's fun to hang out with.
not flexible at all

Watched movies in this class half of the time. Very easy class overall, no tests, simple homework assignments. One final project of your choice at the end of the semester. Attendance not mandatory on movie days, but most assignments were based off of the movies or in class discussions.

So the whole class was so easy it's stupid, I honestly thought the material was meant for middle school. He tho should not be a teacher, if you need help with something good luck him giving you an answer without him acting like a .... Very disrespectful in my opinion easy A , have to handle his disrespect tho

Fun teacher who knows what he's talking about. The tests are hard (for some reason taking a dinosaur class seems like it would be easy) but he curves the grade at the end. Super interesting class, but one you'll want to actually go to, not just show up to on test day. Overall, no complaints with the teacher. Oh, and I never opened my textbook once.

This class sounds more fun than it really is. The subject is interesting, but the teacher is very unhelpful. Luckily, my class had a good TA, otherwise we would all have gotten confused on the dates of assignments. One thing that was annoying was that he didn't have a Canvas page all year.

He is an awesome teacher! He totally knows what he's talking about, he is hilarious and keeps everything really interesting, and his homework assignments are simple and good grade padding if you don't do awesome on the tests. (Which aren't that hard so far.)I think one of the reasons that I like him so much is because he reminds me of Hagrid.

Oh I just love Professor Toscano! I had her for my humanities credit, Mythology, and absolutely loved it. I would definitely study for a bit more on tests if you want to get A's but overall incredible teacher and I loved the class.

Dr. Toscano is amazingly kind and gives very enjoyable lectures. Every class is about a different Greek god or hero and is filled with fun stories and artwork. It is very important to come to class because lectures are not recorded. Slides are posted, but usually missing some information that can be relevant to the exams.
loved this professor

You can tell she has a true passion for the content that she is teaching, and she works hard to make sure students understand the content. She always looks for student participation, but will never require it. Lectures were mandatory by way of participation points. I would highly recommend her, and hope to take another class from her in the future.

I personally really enjoyed her as a professor. Later in the year I was concerned about my grade and she met with me and went through my previous tests to explain to me how I could do better and get better scores. The tests are based on a lot of memorization, but if you listen in class you can at least get a B-. I was always very intrigued.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Toscano was great and the class was pretty easy! Go to class to get participation points, pay attention, and attend the review sessions.

Very awesome teacher, super funny and awesome class. If you come to class and pay attention, trust me you'll be all good, even if you miss a day or two you should be good. I missed two days and still did well; I ended up receiving a 100.48% in the class. She is a very engaging teacher, hope to get another one of her classes.

This class is incredibly boring and lecture heavy. It is quite easy because there are little assignments, but tests are hard because it is a LOT of information and is a majority of your grade. Also it takes multiple weeks to get grades back. Participation does matter. Dr. Toscano is a super sweet and knowledgable but the way she teaches is boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Toscano is a very good teacher and made the Mythology class very fun and interesting.

The most intelligent and engaging professor I've ever met. Class is a treat to attend and is interesting and fun the entire time. It's quite easy to get a good grade, since she clearly wants everyone to succeed. Her class made me change my major. If you're on the fence about this class, take it.

I really do not recommend this class. I feel bad giving a 1/5 because she is a nice person so I gave a 2/5. She loved to hear herself talk, was constantly talking, then would ask students questions and not let them get one word out. I hated and dreaded this class. I would not say it is possible to pass this class without taking notes as well. GL.

She was such a wonderful teacher and understanding. She did attendance by asking questions and we would write them down and turn it in at the end of class. You are allowed to miss a few lectures though.
Wants you to succeed in her class. So, if you make the bare minimum effort in this course, then you will pass.

This class could be interesting but Toscano is not tech savvy whatsoever, so you'll have to deal with lifeless powerpoint lectures. Lucky enough, you don't need to pay attention if you go to her review sessions. She'll cover every topic that's on the test and it doesn't take long to memorize. I treated this class like study hall and easily got an A

Such a great professor who clearly knows her stuff when it comes to mythology! If you take this class, be prepared to attend lectures regularly because daily participation points add up. She hardly ever gives homework, but when it is assigned she expects you to put your full effort into it. Her review sessions for exams are really useful as well!
Very helpful and understanding of each individual's situation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Toscano was wonderful! I had her for Classical Mythology, and I would highly recommend this class if you're interested in Greek mythology at all. If you go to class & take notes, you won't have any issues with her exams, and this course is pretty light on homework.

I have Professor Toscano for beginning Greek, and she has made it my favorite class. It's okay to miss class, but we go over so much material in class and do so much practice that you need to be there. She's incredible at teaching the material and is very clear about what it going to be on the weekly quiz. She's very kind and understanding.

Good teacher, stuff on tests isnt covered sometimes. Its tough to stay focused in class as all she does is go through powerpoints. Be expected to already be an expert in Greek Myth before the class because she really doesn't teach she just talks and tells stories and goes on tangents.

Shes an awesome teacher. Shes really passionate about what she teaches and she wants you to do well. Not much homework at all but you have to write a paper every once in a while. Mostly teaches through PowerPoints but make sure you pay attention because all the stuff in the PowerPoints is on the test too. Be ready to memorize.

I had taken CLCV 1550 before (different professor) and received a less than desirable grade, mostly because it was difficult to be engaged. However, Professor Toscano does a great job of making classes enjoyable and her clear love for what she is teaching makes it all the more interesting. I would highly recommend her.

Go to class every time and you'll rack up a ton of points and extra credit. Her lectures are very entertaining, she is a fantastic teacher. The two papers are pretty easy and actually fun to write. Go to her review sessions before tests, she tells you everything you need to know. One of my favorite teachers I've had.

Ms. Toscano loves her students! For each exam she offered a review session that went over all the material to know. She even brought candy! Just go to class because she does some participation points every once in a while.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Would take again

reviews.comment: A very sweet lady! He class wasn't difficult but you could still feel her passion for the subject. I love her.

Professor Toscano did an awesome job with this class. While it is lecture heavy, she makes it interesting by having class discussions and relating it to a modern world context. She gives you a lot of information, so be sure to attend the test review she holds to get the information that is most important. It helps a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Toscano obviously loves her job and she helps to project her love of Mythology onto her students. She is very entertaining, and if you pay attention and go to class, then you can easily pass with an A. I highly recommend this course. It is one of the best courses at this University.

Shes amazing! She has 16 total participation points, and only counts 13 of them for an actual grade. The rest are turned into extra credit!! The papers and exams are easy if you show up to class and actively listen. She has review sessions and gives away some answers, plus theyre SUPER helpful.
Unless you love Ancient Greece this class is boring. She gives out participation points if you stay till the end of class and some extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's very passionate, but lectures can seem like she's rambling on a bit. However, if you listen in class, and go to her review sessions you should do well on the tests. Two essays that were extremely easy and she doesn't grade very harsh
Really good professor that taught long but good lectures. The subject matter was totally engaging and interesting, so it wasn't hard to pay attention. Good class i recommend for a humanities credit!

The class is simple, but it is a lot of memorization. You need to go to class since she does random participation points, and she does specify important trick questions and what their solution on the test will be. Also if you miss a few lectures and don't want to memorize everything, just go to her review and she tells you what is on the test.

Lovely person. She is there to help you and cares about her students. Passionate about Greek Myth. As others have said, her lectures tend to get kind of boring and u really don't need to take notes b/c of study guide. If you want to get an A, you get A. If you want to actually learn about Greek Myth, read textbooks. Overall I would recommend this.

Half way through the semester I didn't even want to show up to class because I was beyond bored. The lectures get a bit dry, but over all the class is easy. There are participation points that don't add up to too much, but there are two essays and two exams that are your entire grade. Really easy to pass if you just use her study guide.

Dr. Toscano is one of the coolest professors I've ever had! She's so sweet and knowledgeable and so passionate about Greek mythology. CL CV 1550 is a great class to take for an easy HF credit but take it from Toscano if you can. If you show up for class and do the study guide before the tests and submit the papers, you'll pass just fine.

Pretty easy A. She does participation points like half of the time but they aren't too important for your grade. She gives you extra credit just for going to class every once in a while too. Your grade pretty much consists of two tests and two papers. Her test reviews will save your grade! She's super awesome though definitely take this class!
I love Dr Toscano. This class was really joyful. No stress or pressures. I'd recommend this class and other classes.

Dr. Toscano is a delight. I have zero interest in Greek Mythology, so the material bored me, but I loved listening to prof lecture. Such a sweet lady who wants to see her students succeed. Tests are quite easy, and so are the two papers. Attendance is graded once in a while, so go to the class. Readings can be fun, but aren't essential.

Toscano is such a great prof. Lectures can get boring and long. Tests are not that hard if you go to reviews and study. Participation/extra credits are given randomly if you attend class so it is mandatory to go to class if you want a good grade. you also have to write 2 papers which were not hard. Very easy gen ed class!

She's an amazing teacher! She has a great passion for the classical civilizations and shows that in her teaching. She makes this class interesting and sometime fun. There are only 2 papers you have to write, and 2 tests you will have to take. she holds review sessions before each test, so you literally have to be stupid to fail.
Awesome teacher, great stories, and pretty easy A, really into her teachings.

Dr. Toscano is hugely engaging and genuinely cares about her students. Her lectures are fun and very enlightening. Her diverse background in literature, language, and the classics fills every session with unexpected insights. I'm happy she takes roll and cares that students attend regularly. Very highly recommended.
I liked the subject, and I'm glad I understand these myths because references are prevalent in our culture.  However, the class was pretty boring.

This class is a joke. You have to sign a roll and she places a TA in the back to make sure nobody leaves before its done. If you're looking for an easy gen ed, this class may or may not be it. you have to actually go to class everyday.

Toscano, very passionate about her teachings, and knowledgable, however. COMPLETELY OVER RATED. this class required more useless busy work and was more difficult than my 3000 level classes. And because of her broad topics for papers, it made it impossible to get an A on a paper. This class, interesting, but COMPLETELY over rated.
Prof Toscano LOVES TO TEACH! She makes you work, but somehow you WANT to work hard for her. Her passion for her subject is just infectious! (Class was Classical Myth & Religion. Wow, cools stuff)

so amazing and intelligent. this woman completely inspired me and her class has been my favorite so far. encourages discussion and helpful.  Really great, don't hesitate to take a class from her if you ever get the chance.
margaret is da shizz, she explains things very well, and makes class very interesting, and shes very friendly and accessible
She is a very dedicated teacher.  She enables students to be able to think for themselves.  She encourages students to share their opinions even if it doesn't match with the majority.
awesome teacher; challenging and entertaining; really cares about students

She's a really nice person, but not a good teacher. I went to her office hours for help and all she told was that learning new material is like a baby learning how to walk. Didn't teach me how to use any of the formulas or help me with the hw.

Trig is a hard subject. First math class I have ever taken that I didn't end with an A. DO NOT TAKE ONLINE. Exams are difficult and not like the study guides. But you are given a page of notes for each test and Rebecca gives a lot of opportunities to fix mistakes and get extra credit. She's a tough grader on quiz video assignments. Be careful.

Great at explaining, but very unforgiving if you make mistakes. I was docked 20 points out of 50 on a quiz because the formatting was poor. Another times she took 10/50 away because she had to zoom in to see my very average size handwriting. Another quiz lost 10 points cuz the pages were out of order. She's very picky with formatting.

Incredibly unforgiving. I experienced sudden homelessness this semester and asked for an extension on the material. She refused and told me that "if I believe it's serious", I should speak to the Dean of Students' office. If you take this course, get ahead ASAP. She's overly difficult to work with when you have emergencies or make mistakes.

I love Professor Rebecca!! She is so forgiving and understanding. She is always appreciative of any questions or concerns you may have and is always quick to respond! Truly happy to help and will recognize when you are doing your best. I highly recommend taking her class!
Nice lady, but honestly, not a great teacher when it comes to understanding students. She would mark you wrong on tests for the smallest things. Our class average was terrible.

Professor Rebecca was wonderful! I do not like math, but she did her best to break it down. She always took time to answer questions and understood the material. She also offered bonus points throughout the semester. There is a lot of homework but, it is a math class. One thing is she teaches with terms like "math journey" lol.

I've struggled with math since my sophomore year of high school so when she takes her time to fully explain the concepts I really appreciate the hands on teaching. She also makes a point to get to know her students which some people think is her babying us but I like the effort she puts into her students.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I actually liked this class a lot. The professor was very helpful to me every time I reached out, and so were the TAs. There is a lot of homework, but combined with the weekly quizzes and zoom meetings, it helps you be prepared for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great especially I you are unsure about your math skills. Great at explaining every problem in a way everyone can understand but does often lecture as if we are in elementary school. However, you will learn more from her than probably any other 1090 class. Does do a check in every class which is a bit annoying. 3 exams total. HW every class

honestly i really liked her. she does treat us like children which is bittersweet because sometimes it helps me understand things. two midterms and a final, 1 homework per lesson (1-2 per class), and quizzes every like 3 classes. and "habits" which are annoying but easy points. kinda all over the place but she was decent enough so can't complain.

She seems to think that her students are under the age of 12. Her course is full of errors and it's such a headache to figure out what she's trying to say. When I attended office hours for individual help she didn't pay attention to my questions. When you try to ask questions during lecture she never directly answers them. The TAs are terrible too.

She talked to us as if we were elementary schoolers, which was just kind of annoying. She teaches fine but isn't anything spectacular. If you struggle with math she's a pretty solid professor. She has a lot of opportunities to improve if you're willing to take extra time to take advantage of them.

If you are nervous about your math abilities, Rebecca is the best teacher to take. She will work with you, reassure you, and reach out if it seems you are struggling. There is a lot of homework, quizzes, and exams plus attendance is mandatory, but it is very doable. It might seem like she is asking for a lot but it is straightforward and clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She teaches like we are in middle school, and does not explain the material very well.

Super nice professor. She teaches like we are in high school thinking it helps us but it doesn't. When learning new things rather than explain what shes doing or why shes doing something, she'll just do the problem and expect you to figure out how she did it. She is not good at explaining and usually other students could explain it better than her
I love this class! Taught me so much about math

She was great to me throughout the whole semester. I struggle with math and she provided many opportunities to get extra help outside of class. I also found that she was willing to give helpful advice. The tests are a heavy part of your grade but the are extra credit opportunities.

Rebecca is a super kind teacher! She genuinely cares about you as a person as well as how you are doing in her class. She offers many office hours and if you can't make those she is open to other times. Lots of homework though, and oftentimes the homework was a lot harder than things on tests and quizzes. Plus usually a quiz once a week.

This is the best math teacher you will ever have. Rebecca is clearly passionate about her job, she puts in a lot of effort to help and get to know her students. She is kind, respectful, and engaged with her students. The class is as difficult as you would expect, but if you apply yourself you will have no trouble getting an A. Highly recommend her

Sometimes she approaches math like a therapist would, but it's really to help those that always struggled with math. She is great at taking things slow and is really good at explaining things. The only professor that remembered my name.

Rebecca's a great teacher! There's a quiz every week but she lets you have both a cheat sheet and group discussion time for each quiz. On the exams you are also allowed to have a cheat sheet. There's no group discussion time, but she does have two periods where you can ask her any questions about the quiz and she'll explain it to the class.

I've never had a teacher memorize all 100 students names before - you can tell Professor Noonan-Heale cares about her students. Grading was fair and she offered many opportunities to earn points and receive help on the material. You'll do well if you attend the classes, I don't recommend skipping. Textbook is accessible, and she's quick to respond.

I had to switch to this class 3 weeks into the semester and she was very understanding and willing to help. Always accessible and provided great feedback during office hours. The homework and quiz grading were a little harsh but she was always willing to explain your scores. Totally recommend her over my previous math professor (Singh).

Do not take any online classes from her. This class is way too time-consuming for the material and everyone is extremely stressed about the unnecessary workload. 3-4 lengthy homework sheets a week and a 3-4 page quiz every week. Her syllabus is full of errors and you literally get extra credit if you find errors. This class is such a headache.

She teaches really well and clearly, and if you don't understand anything she makes the textbook accessible through canvas. Attendance is only 2% of your grade and 25% of them get dropped. A lot of study and learning opportunities outside of class so you can get help whenever you need it. Recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Noonan-heale makes an effort to get to know each student. Her conversations and help are very personal, and she goes out of her way to help you. She's very accessible inside and outside class. it's a fast paced class, but she makes it very managable. 10/10 would take a class with her again.

If you attend the lectures and complete the homework this class is completely doable! it is a difficult course, but most math classes are. Go in with the expectation that a 5 credit course involves much more work than a regular course and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: ATROCIOUS! She gives an insane amount of homework for precalculus. I dropped out of all of my other classes because I couldn't keep up with all of her work. BTW I'm a IB Diploma kid. I know what an insane course load looks like and this is worse. A full course load isn't even as bad as this one class (I compared with other people).
She does not have clear grading criteria and does not actually teach the content

I would take this class with Michael if you can, but Rebecca is a fine second choice. The course structure and her grading style are a little bit weird, but if you pay attention and pick up on her patterns, you can easily do well in the class. The textbook she uses is very helpful, so even if you don't usually use textbooks, I would recommend it.

Dr. Noonan-Heale is an excellent professor. If you reach out and ask for help or explain that you have some personal issues that interfere with class work she is so happy to help and create opportunities for you to make-up work and exams.

Professor Noonan-Heale is the best professor I've ever had! She cares about student success above all else. She is exceptionally good at teaching concepts and answering questions. She also has the most organized canvas page I've ever seen. It really makes the work much easier. If you can take her class, do it!

She is a great option for 1090. If you ever need help she does homework sessions 15mins before and after class, and during sometimes. Quizzes are every week worth 50pts but always have the option to have a group discussion in the last 15 mins of each quiz. Pretty easy if you show up take notes, do hw, and study. She does move through fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very difficult professor and not flexible at all. Definitely do not recommend if you are taking this course online.
Rebecca is very clear in showing who her favorite students are and you better hope you are one of them. To sum it up quickly I am just incredibly happy that I never have to deal with her again.

LOVED Rebecca! She was super willing to work with all her students and gave very specific feedback on all assignments. All assignments included only what we found on the exam, pushed course objectives, and always had a rubric. She encouraged flexible thinking and new ideas and was very explicit with her explanations of the concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Homework is very hard and there is a lot of it
I enjoyed Rebecca's class. She has a passion for teaching and learning. She was also super willing to work with you outside of class.

Honestly, I didn't enjoy or thrive in this class at all. I know everyone makes mistakes but she quizzes us on stuff before it's even due. She put wrong info on our reviews so we waste time studying the wrong things. She even accidentally emailed a PERSONAL email for just one student regarding her exam to the ENTIRE class. Very frustrating for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took this class in the summer (fully online) in 5 1/2 weeks. It was extremely intense but she helped me so much! She was generous with points and provided several opportunities for extra credit. She is one of the very few math teachers out there that willing to take extra time to help you. You have to be on top of homework! There is a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: AVOID THIS PROFESSOR AT ALL COST! This professor writes her own questions and isn't helpful when you need help. Rather than helping students grasp the concepts, she makes other students who answer/and herself give hints rather than help you figure it out. Lots of homework and there's a final project. For a 100 class, the work is too much. AVOID HER

She is a pretty good professor who spends a lot of time thinking about how to properly teach the material. None of the content is too foreign to most students, but the pace of the course does make for a constant work load. She does not shy away from questions. Homework is a bit ridiculous, but it is an accelerated course. Be ready.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Noonan has an incredible bias in this class. She will take students who she doesnt like, make them do problems on the board until they cry. 3 separate students have had this happen to them and it's appalling. She has no rubric for tests and will grade you. You could get the same answer as other students but will get a different grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Rebecca is very organized and clear, Sometimes a little fast, but 1080 hes a ton of information to get through. Genuinely cares about student success and makes sure that the students who are actually trying are comprehending the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Rebecca is super nice. This was her first time teaching this course. She is helpful but she explains things and makes things more confusing. Simple concepts turn into confusing. She also grades very particularly. If you figure out how she grades, then you're good, but if you don't then you're done for. Just read the text and you'll be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Don't take this class
Quiz every friday, and 2 test and a final. Professor is super nice and is willing to work with students! She truly wants everyone to succeed but you have to do the work to get an A

Rebecca is such a caring professor. She takes to time to know everyones name and everything. She has lots of office hours and is very accessible in person and over email. She teaches a lot different from a high school teacher, but if you're confused, she's more than happy to answer questions anytime, even in the middle of the lecture.

I loved her class! She provides you with a packet/book that you can get off of amazon to fill in the blanks in the notes during discussion. She will put in the effort to help you as long as you are proactive and ask for help. If you miss class, go to office hours and catch up. Just stay on top of your work and this will be an easy class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I've taken many math classes, 1010 twice, and Rebecca is the best math professor I've ever had. She builds concepts from the ground up, leaving foundational holes only if you aren't paying attention. She's eager to help and personally invested in student's success. I could not recommend a teacher more.

Rebeca made concepts that should have been easy somehow more difficult by the way she tried to explain them. She wanted to go into the "nuance" of the concepts, but that just made things worse. I got through this class by figuring it out myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: If you took college prep math in high school, this class will be a breeze. If you havent taken a math class since high school and youre a sophomore+, dont take her. She likes things her own way and comes up with weird ways to describe the math. Attendance is mandatory and she does it through clicker points. There is lots of hw and quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I would not take this class again. She explains everything in the most backwards confusing way possible. She also gives out SO MUCH HOMEWORK. Just be prepared for this class to take over your life (math 1080). Also watch out for her tests they are definitely not easy and she likes things done her way.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Worst teacher i ever had. She doesn't know how to teach and makes everything a million times more confused. 10/10 would NOT recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough Grader

reviews.comment: Rebecca was really kind and tried to be helpful.  Her teaching style was really difficult to grasp.  I left class more confused than the last everyday.

She is really sweet and quirky. Sometimes problems get a little confusing when she explains it but with the TA's help they sort everything out.  Attendance is important. She does "clicker points" and they are easy points, just go to class. She assigns online math problems and you need to do them! they are worth a lot of points! She's great!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Very confusing

Rebecca is a talented teacher who has mastered teaching an online class. She is easy to get a hold of and cares about students understanding the materials. If you're taking a course from her make sure you stay on top of your work and ask questions when needed or you're not going to make it.

Very tough class.  I worked at least 2 hours a night on homework, notes were unclear, attended class religiously, went to tutoring sessions, met with instructor twice a week, busted my butt ended with a C.  So much homework, course work, and webworks.  Paper homework wasn't reviewed for accuracy, webworks had specific inputs. lectures confusing
Difficult to communicate with and receive help from.

Did you take college prep? You will totally pass. Easy but not fun. She grades easy, but if you have never taken college prep or something similar be prepared to tons of terribly confusing explanations of simple algebra .  Homework everyday and  lectures that should last 5 minutes instead of 50. Not worth the time or the money personally.

Homework module is super touchy, you HAVE to enter it in 100% correct or your work is wrong. Quizzes are weekly and are due before the homework, which made no sense. Announcements were GRADED and there were 3+ mini announcement quizzes a week. For a summer online 1010 class, it was stupidly tedious. I would definitely NOT recommend.

There is so much to keep track of. Announcements are in quiz form and there are like 4 things due every week. Quizzes are due BEFORE the homework which sucks because homework should help you study for the quiz. The problems in the homework and quizzes are like 10x harder than anything in the textbook. She is helpful & there is lots of extra credit.
Great professor.  Teachers the material very clearly and in a personal matter.  There is quite a bit of homework and weekly quizzes.  Loved her class!

For the love of everything that is holy, listen to the previous reviews! If you are taking 1010, you obviously struggle with algebra. Rebecca knows her math but she doesn't know how to teach.  Homework is worth nothing. The exams are tough and she takes a percentage of your score for EVERY minute that you go over. The final is everything.
Great person, terrible teacher. I understood her substitutes better that I understood her. The students had to correct her errors on the board. She expects a lot more from you than she teaches.

She is not a very good teacher. I took this class online, BIG MISTAKE! She's not even the one on the videos teaching it's her colleague. Her lectures are confusing as heck. Her tests don't match up with the study guides at all. It was a super hard class. I don't recommend her.

She is not a great teacher. She is very confusing in lecture, and uses strange vocabulary to explain things. I am doing well  in the class only because I have taken precalc before in High School. The work load is normal for a math class, and the test aren't bad. She also makes a lot of simple math mistakes which I think loses the class sometimes.

She is probably the best math teacher I've ever encountered, take her class if you can! She really cares about her students. She will learn your name quickly, seek you out to see if you need any help, and gives very clear lectures. Wish I could take a class from her again.
I took MATH 1010 online, and I thought it was really hard. She's available to help students, but her online lectures were not very comprehensive and I felt lost most of the time.

The class itself is not hard, however the course work and the quizzes are a pain. There are explanations before every quiz that explains the correct format to input into the test, however, it is confusing. Format is key on quizzes! If you get the format wrong you get that answer wrong and can only get half credit back.

The amount of work given was not an overwhelming amount, but it was very confusing. The professor used oddly worded questions, lectures were very basic and unhelpful and commonly unrelated to most of the coursework, and there were always incorrect answers in her practice exams and coursework. I hated this class and was surprised I even passed.

She assigns mountains of very tedious homework problems.  It takes me four plus hours a week, not because the problems are difficult, but because it takes four hours to write them down.  Also, her tests are online and never accept all of the right answers so be prepared to go through the appeals process ever week. I would choose a different teacher

Rebecca was great.  I was nervous taking math online, but the lectures were clear and the workload was very manageable.  She went out of her way to be available to meet and discuss issues.  Highly recommended.
I took the class online, and she was very helpful. Organized, attentive, and the book work was optional. Manageable workload and she will re-grade things that are simple mistakes on tests.

She overwhelmes you with busy work.  You can asks questions but if she feels it will give away the homework question she will not finish working the problem with you. You only get a third of a point for every make up question you do.  She is very kind to talk to after or before class Her assignments sheets can be confusing and not explanatory.
Lots of work that is not explained, but she does help when asked. A LOT is required for this class (4020 as well), and late work isn't even worth it. Lots of busywork, but she knows the material.
It felt like a lot of busy work with everything we were expected to do.

Colee is a QUEEN. She wants her students to succeed and that is made very clear throughout this course, especially with her participation points. This course is definitely difficult, however, she made the information really digestible. Exam material was explicitly stated which made studying for the exams much easier. 10/10 professor and person!

This course is challenging. Weekly readings and case studies require time, but staying consistent helps a lot. Exams reflect the material and are clear. She explains concepts well and keeps lectures engaging. Often tells you what will be on Exam while lecturing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is an excellent professor and quite funny. She actually made it easy to sit through a zoom class and prepared you well for the exams which are tough.

This is one of these required business courses that is mostly a waste of time. However, there are some important topics. Colee is passionate about what she teachers and wants her students to succeed. Participation matters but you can get away with not participating in class, just make sure you do all the readings, quizzes, & extra credit. Good luck
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Pyne is an amazing professor! She did such a great job at making the Zoom class engaging and helpful for learning law, especially for me who was not familiar with law. She offers plenty of extra credit opportunity and points for class participation. Just make sure to watch her lecture videos and study for the exams 1-2 weeks in advance.

As a senior, she is the best professor I have had while at the university. She really knows her stuff and genuinely cares and gives good feedback. I would strongly encourage you take her because I wish I took more of her classes. GOAT Professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the easiest classes I've ever taken from the university. I didn't even pay attention to the lectures, read the textbook, or do any of the participation. I just recorded the lectures made a transcript, and put it in chatgpt to make notes. I also asked it to make practice tests. I got an A by doing the least amount of work. Lol
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Pyne is a fantastic instructor—clear, engaging, and supportive. Just be prepared: your grade is based mainly on two exams, and there are only 8–9 practice problems. Start studying at least 2–3 weeks before each exam. Read the textbook, take good notes, and use the Quizlets under her name—they're super helpful for review.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Colee was a great professor in a class that was really difficult. My section was half in class and half recorded lectures which worked well for me. Very participation heavy but she offers a lot of extra credit options upfront. She's very understanding and was willing to shift exams due to an injury I had. I really recommend taking Blaw with her!

Colee is one of the best professors at the U. I was worried about taking B-law as I've heard it's a difficult class. However, Colee made it one of my favorite classes! Be prepared to do lots of reading and participate in class (this is a crucial part of your grade). Take advantage of extra credit opportunities and TA office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: she's so great! one midterm, one final, one court hearing paper, participation. midterm and final are curved heavily which was amazing. she also curved our overall grade. our class was hybrid, so just watch the lectures, read the case studies and go to class and you'll do fine. i never read the textbook at all, just took decent enough notes

Amazing teacher. It is an intensive course with a lot of reading regardless of the teacher because of the content, but there is no one else I would rather take this class from. Very approachable, helpful, and reasonable with grading. Recommend.

This class has been my favorite that I've taken here at the U so far. Colee does an AMAZING job at explaining hard-to-learn concepts and throws a lot of humor into her lectures. This class requires more reading than I've ever experienced, but it was all very fascinating and worth it! Even if I wasn't required to take this course, I would take it!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: B law is hard no matter who you take it from but Colee is certainly the best option. So much extra credit offered and she prepares you really well for exams. I really didn't like the material or class but I did like Colee as a professor. Attendance is mandatory and you are mostly graded on exams, though.

She is my favorite professor thus far. She wants her students to pass and understand the material so they can apply it in their careers. My hybrid class required attendance and cameras on.  Her exams are extremely specific, and hard. However, if you participate in the lectures, ask questions, and read the material you shouldn't have any issues.

Colee is great. Lectures are awesome and also supplemented with videos to reiterate concepts. A lot of reading, honestly I stopped reading the textbook and was fine. Make sure that you read the cases before class. Participation can make or break your grade show up to class. Loved this class and made me consider going to law school.

Great professor. She knows her stuff and explains hard concepts well. The law content is hard at first, but gets easier as you go. Most of the HW is reading and being prepared with cases each class. Participation is a large part of the grade. 3 curved exams, application of content is key. If you actually read the textbook/cases you will succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This was probably one of my favorite classes I've taken so far at the U. You're graded on 1 assignment, 3 exams and participation so you can't skip class. A tip for studying for the exams that I found was to make sure you can actually apply the concepts, not just memorize them and the exams are a breeze. She curves on all exams as well which helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very engaging, thoughtful, and kind. She's the best. Do the work and you'll do well.

Colee is an amazing professor. The class was a hybrid set up with recorded lectures and in person lectures (taken summer semester). She is always willing to answer any questions and she makes the class very engaging. BE SURE TO READ ALL OF THE CHAPTERS AND PAY ATTENTION TO HER LECTURES! Definitely one of the best professors at the U.

Colee is such a great professor who only wants her students to succeed. She gives you all the resources to and lots of opportunities for extra credit. The class and tests are easy as long as you go to class and read the textbook. 10/1o recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Horrible grader. Changed Canvas exam to proctored exam last minute and required us to do unnecessary things such as show the room behind your screen and behind you. This is an online class and is trying to force us to do exam's in person. Attendance is mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor and not too much work as long as you divvy up the work throughout the week. Lectures moved quick but she made sure you knew what she was teaching. TBH I had straight Cs on the exams and near 100 in everything else and with the curve it came out to a B. Participate in class and there is no way you'll get lower than a B.

Colee is the best professor in the business school! You definitely have to put in work for the class. Ask questions if you're confused about anything!! READ THE CASES in the textbook. The extra practice cases at the end of each chapter are extremely helpful for studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Colee is the BEST professor I've had. She makes her class fun and gives tons of opportunities to boost your grade. Your grade is mainly participation and exams, with one other assignment that is an easy way to get full points. The material is hard, but if you take good notes and study you'll do fine. She gives multiple extra-credit opportunities.

Colee is easily the best professor at the U! Her teaching style is incredibly knowledgeable and fun, and the class is one of the most useful courses I've ever taken. The exams are difficult but if you pay attention to the lectures and review the slides you'll be fine (the healthy curve helps). The effort you put in is what you get out. Take it!

Colee was honestly an amazing teacher! Her class mainly consisted of reading from the textbook and going over what you read in class. There is no homework! just make sure to do your reading and attend class and you'll be fine! she is always open for questions and willing to help. She has a midterm and final which is curved.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Pyne is honestly one of the greatest professor at the University of Utah! It was a tough class with a lot of reading and heavy lectures. However, you can get an A in the class if you take extensive notes and come to class prepared to discuss! Pyne is hilarious and always made class engaging and understandable! She's very knowledgeable!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was a very hard class. But it was also one of the most informative classes I've taken. Colee is an awesome teacher who is strict but fair. It is very important to participate, it raised my grade massively.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Pyne was hands down one of the best professors I've had here at the U. She is dedicated to her work and genuinely cares for her students. This class comes with heavy material, so know that you will need to spend more time than average reading and studying. Colee gave us so many different opportunities to earn extra credit.

This class was HARD, don't get me wrong. But Colee is just such a light and enjoyable professor. She makes jokes, she has fun with the class. If you don't read and if you skip you won't pass, but honestly she's enjoyable enough skipping didn't cross my mind.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Colee is easily one of the best professors because she is extremely passionate, caring, and knowledgeable. She is very clear about her expectations and the nature of the course. He doesn't explain well and his notes are pretty bad. I used to be good at math
