reviews.comment: Chong is the man.  Even for non-Information Systems majors, this class should be easy, informative, and useful for every student.  He explains, at a high level, many interesting and crucial IS topics ranging from Social Media to Business Intelligence.  If you don't do well in this class, you didn't do anything.  Enjoy!

There are a lot of assignments, including weekly tech article summaries. Labs are interesting and usually very easy to complete. The tests are pretty tough, however Professor Oh was reasonable about omitting questions that were perceived as unfair. He offered extra credit about half-way through the semester that saved my A.

IS just isn't my cup of tea so this class wasn't my favorite as expected. Some of the labs were interesting, but most of them just felt like busy work. This class also didn't fit my learning style since the textbook chapter reading is required before the lecture on the chapter with an in-class quiz following immediately after.

Professor Oh is a great teacher. He is very fair in how he conducts his class and is straightforward from what he expects from you. He lets you know what you need to do to get an A and while it isn't an easy A if you apply yourself and study the material you will do well in his classes.

Chong seems to give more assignments than other Professors of the same course. Every week there is a Reading Summary Due (a half page response to an article relating to IS), a quiz and a lab.  As far as tests go there was only a Midterm and a Final. Not a terrible course load, but more than the others.  The book is helpful for studying for exams
Awesome class! Heightened my interest in big data. Labs were excellent, synopsis and reading assignments were very very helpful
The class was very simple and very informative. Better than rigorous and forgetful. Possible the best class in the MSIS program.

Prof. Oh is super clear in his expectations. He covers everything that will be on the test in class. Basically, if you read the book, you're golden. Some of the labs are time-consuming, but nothing too drastic.
a great professor easy A
Great guy, who really does care about the success of his students. Lectures are straight from the book, but attendance is required. If you go to class everyday it is an easy A.
He is a very professional teacher and very knowledgeable in information systems.  The class was very enjoyable, and I would take a class from him again.
I really enjoyed this class. Chong is a great teacher! I hope I can take more classes with him!
Great class and great professor!
Great professor, would take any class from him.

Very useful class. Got burned out on the coding due to the condensed nature of the course (5 weeks long). I would have appreciated to be introduced to Javascript and have chance to practice it more in class. Or also to be able to  do exercises that involved writing original code instead of just regurgitating the in-class exercises for the projects.
perfect
Wonderful professor, you will have fun!
Professor Oh is lack of programming knowledges. He is not able to answer any out of textbook questions even it is very basic. All the examples and exercise in this class are from the textbook.
Good class
Great hands-on learning.  Useful real-world practice of downloading tweets using the Twitter API.
I learn a lot, all positive feedback!
I really liked the way he taught and keep things in a structural  manner , step by step learning .
Lots of content, work, and materials.  But it was all worth it!
Chong is a great teacher and he is really goes the extra mile in helping students when they don't understand the concepts. I would highly reccommend Chong Oh as an instructor. IS 4415

Chong is a such good teacher. He has great energy and enthusiasm for teaching. He is always available when you have questions. He gives you quick and helpful response. Data mining is a challenging course, but Chong's teaching makes it easy to follow and interesting.  Highly recommended!
Wonderful!! He was always so helpful and easy to get a hold of. Highly recommended!! If you just ask for help he is there.

Chong is a great teacher who takes time to help his students learn. He is more than willing to go out of his way to help you understand the subject and will really help you when you get stuck on a particular tricky line of code. I highly recommend his work and his class. He is very nice and friendly and has a laid back attitude.

I had no experience in programming when I took this class. I thought programming was a bit boring but Chong was very knowledgeable and made it more interesting through his real life examples and funny jokes. This class is for beginners.  He is very willing to help students and is always available. Attendance is enforced through open book quizzes.

While professor Chong does have real world experience with Java, his expertise with it is limited. He also simply does not have the skill of teaching the knowledge which he has.  Most all students who have taken this class would advise you to take this from Prof. Ramachandran if possible. Attendance is not mandantory, but homework is everything.

I was FOUR POINTS off from an A Grade.This guy will absolutely just grade you based off of grammar.He will mark points off for grammar and then not explain where there was miss spelled grammar. I checked my grammar and still got points off for no reason. One time he gave me half points for an assignment because I had two run on sentances. Dont doit

His grading is absurd, believing that "losing points equals learning". Endless lectures drown students in work. Participation is required but barely accessible. Pronunciation corrections happen nonstop. Huge projects every quarter, but daily assignments leave no time for them. You just cram, burn out, and struggle. No learning, just exhaustion.

I learned a lot in his class but did have to work hard.

Worst professor I have taken at the U. Almost all homework is automatically graded through Supersite. Very little homework and quizzes are actually made by him. Half the class we were sent into breakout rooms with little interaction with him. Grades harshly on participation even though it can be hard to even get called on with so many students.

He also has you write small compositions but doesn't give you any guidance on how to write them. Not the worst choice, but not the best.

The worst professor I have had at Utah. His lectures were not engaging at all; he would go on tangents that had nothing to do with the course, but rather "Current events" that had no relation to projects or tests. There were so many spelling errors on the slides and exams. Questions and answers were worded in a way that made zero sense.

Phil should stick to finances OUTSIDE of the classroom. WORST professor I've ever had. I felt bad the entire semester for the freshmen in the class. He also has boring, non-engaging lectures, and his exams, NEVER matched his practice questions. Even as a junior, who took FINAN 3020, I struggled. Would never recommend a student take him again.

Phil is the worst. The canvas is a mess, and everything has typos and grammar errors, including the tests. Lectures are boring, and he either reads off the slides or goes on a side tangent that has no relevance to the course. His tests are impossible because his questions "make you think" when they don't match the material or lectures at all.

I would not take this professor again. Very test-heavy, unengaging lectures, and sample questions are nothing like the test. The only good thing about this class is that since no one shows up, he frequently gives extra credit just for coming to class, which is saving my grade. He also does not know how to use Canvas, so you can't see your grade.

reviews.comment: This professor moves way too quickly during class. I can't even write down his questions before he has given the answer and moved on.  He doesn't explain things well and seems confused himself. The exams don't reflect what you learn in class, and he makes them unnecessarily difficult without having given the information or resources to do well.

Definitely would choose a different professor for this course. The way he lectures is difficult to pay attention to since it's not interactive and he sits down. I found the exams super difficult and felt like I was always unprepared for it even when I studied hard. You're lucky if u get a B.

Prof. Sisneros is possibly the worst professor I've had at the University of Utah, and that is really saying something.  If it is not on a PowerPoint slide, he is incapable of teaching the subject. There is nothing that gets me more upset that a professor who has just phoned it in and Phil has definitely stopped showing up, if he ever did.

Phil is smart, but the class lacks structure. The exams were different each time, homework was inconsistent, and the canvas page was a disaster. The lectures are really mundane and it's difficult to pay attention. The math parts are over complicated and students would be better off buying a TI84 and teaching themselves how to use it.

Finance 2020 was a disaster. Supposed to be freshman level, but confusing and horribly taught. Tests are 75% of your grade, inconsistent, and hard. Canvas was a mess. He's kind, smart, and accommodating, but teaching is not his strength.
All his homeworks were participation only and his tests were pulled straight from the homework. Super easy A if you just study the homework and learn from the slides.

I got over 100% final grade. I had no idea what was going on. He's a good and fun professor if you want an easy class, however despite getting As on each test I had no idea if I did them right. Such an important class for later, I wish I got more out of it. He's may be the easiest professor for a B, and the hardest for an A

Professor Qu is passionate about his field. His lectures are hard to follow and unengaging. Homework wasn't bad and would offer extra credit. He was hard to understand at times, so it was hard to follow the material. On the syllabus, there was an optional final, but he removed it after we took our last midterm. Midterm reviews weren't clear.

Professor Qadous was great! He explained the assignments very well and was open to questions. He offered office hours and always answered emails quickly. I would definitely recommend professor Qadus and don't be afraid to ask for help.

Professor Qadous is one of the most caring and considerate professors I've had, which I really appreciate, but I felt like most classes did not have much of a point to them and were quite dull. This class is a super easy A though if thats all you're concerned about. I was glad about how easy the class was, but barely learned anything in class.

Prof. Quadous is great! Took wrtg 2010 with him in the summer and he was easy to get in contact with, not super strict on deadlines as long as you communicate, and gives really good feedback. As long as you show up to class and apply his feedback you'll get an A. Lots of papers, but each one connects to the last (he talks a lot about scaffolding).

Amazing professor! Truly cares about his students.

Professor Qadous was great! He is super understanding about attendance and deadlines and you can tell he really cares, believes in his students, and just wants to help every student succeed. The lectures were okay. The finals were pretty doable but the midterm project, for me, was somewhat difficult, and I felt there wasn't a lot of exposure as to what my paper should have looked like. With that knowledge, I easily got an A on the final paper. Otherwise the class was just pretty boring, but nothing bad.

Professor Quinn is an excellent professor. She is extremely knowledgeable and cares about student success. I always looked forward to her lectures and she was easy to reach and open to set up office hours. She also helped advise my thesis and was incredibly helpful to work with throughout the process. Overall, a great mentor and educator.

While this class was quite difficult, had lots of readings and, at times, long lectures, I never felt like I was lost. She was clear on what she expected and how to get a good grade. Really easy. Read the assignments, do the labs, and you'll get an A. (I got an A- because I was a little bit lazy, so it's really just my fault.)

supa awesome dude. his slides are funny and entertaining and his tests are very much "did you read the lecture and the articles??" he is very serious about late work but then again the deadlines are set way before they're due so unless you're dumb you can't miss an assignment. 10/10

I've taken 2 classes from Tom (pop & society and social epidemiology) both were really chill. He is a good teacher and clearly explains EXACTLY what you need to do for each assignment. Both courses were set up in the same way and it is extremely easy to get an A if you just follow the instructions. Chill guy, highly recommend.

Tom is a great professor, his lectures are easy to follow and he has a good sense of humor. Tells you everything you need to know, very lenient grading and tests are open note, great class and a great professor.

Tom is one of the best professor's I've had. He does a great job teaching the material and making sure everyone understands the concepts. The quizzes and tests are very easy, open note, and open internet. I would take all of his classes if I could!

Tom is funny to the point and very easy to understand. He almost always finishes class early and the course is slow paced. Tests always come with 1-2 review days with exactly what will be on the test spelled out for you. Assignments are simple. He will teach you the basics, help you get and A, and not waste your time.

Tom was funny. For an epidemiology class, he made it fun with engaging us in watching podcasts, reading literature, and analyzing data. The class could have easily been sad and boring when talking about the spread of COVID or some other disease, but it was relevant. He brought forth relevant issues and put humor into assignments and rubrics.

Dr. Tom Quinn is probably the nicest professor I have ever met. He really cares about his students and makes it so easy for anyone to succeed. He expects work but the assignments are so straight foreword if you are just willing to do the work (assignments take maybe 1/2 hours to 1.5 max). The class is graded in such a way that points matter. EZ
I would recommend Professor Quinn to anyone! I took his online course and he made it fun and engaging. The content was extremely interesting and up to date and he gives great feedback.

Had him for 3650. Honestly if you write down all the slides in a doc, you can use CTRL + F to find the answers super easy for exams. Very understanding and would even change your due date if you tell him "I'm not feeling like turning this in Wednesday" and then he would change it to the Wednesday next week. Super cool guy, I recommend him.

Tom was a wonderful professor who was very understanding and helpful. You do have to attend class in order to pass, because there is not a textbook and the online material isn't really a replacement for the lectures. He was also really funny and fun to take a class from. It made statistics a lot less painful.
Great teaching style, one of the best professors at the U, Dr. Quinn really cares about every one of his students, patient and helpful.

Professor Quinn is freaking hilarious! Hands down, my favorite professor at the University of Utah. His sense of humor kills me. I have taken 3, going on 4, classes from him. He is fantastic and an easy-going person. Not a tough grader. He sheds light on subjects that would otherwise be mind-numbingly boring. No textbook. Fairly easy A.

By far one of the best professors at the U. I took social stats from him and I'd take from him again for any math class. Very understanding, patient and helpful. If you ask him for help be prepared for a passive aggressive/condescending answer.  Also a good chance he will tell you to ask copilot instead of actually helping.

We had no idea what the exam grading rubric was, and we were confused about what he wanted us to do, including on assignments. He is a good person, but not a good professor, and his lectures are long and confusing. Everything is super group heavy and you don't get to choose your group and it doesn't change. So if you're stuck with bad ppl gl.
Just RUN be prepared to not learn a thing other than how to detect a Chat response from a teacher!!

This class seems like a nothing burger, just busy work. Every week theres a research badge that gets graded differently every time. I can put the same effort in on two papers and get different grades. I sure hopes he gets a TA to help him with this overload of grades. Definitely a great guy but I wouldn't touch this class with a 10 foot stick.

Hello if you want to take a class that you never want to walk-in to after the first class take this!! He is one of the worst professors that I have had here at the U and please don't even try to ask for why you got what you got on the assignment because then it goes down into a whole world of messes.... Hes nice and just really passive aggressive

Baldwin was not very effective in his teaching. He was a nice guy, but the grading for the many research badges we had to submit was very unclear and he was not very helpful in feedback. Attendance is not mandatory, but he had required in-class knowledge checks, so be prepared for that. Class wasn't too hard overall but I would not recommend.

Professor Baldwin is kind, but his teaching style makes it difficult to do well in the class. A lot of the assignments have unclear grading criteria, and when you do poorly, he doesn't provide any feedback to help you.

After a whole year, I'm still not sure how to work in his class. I try on all of the assignments, but my effort is graded with Chat GBT and no feedback. I will turn in the same level of work and get somewhere from 100% to 70%, and when I talk to him, I get scoffed at for asking questions. He's a nice man, but I'd stay far from his class.

He was a great Professor. The Tests were not difficult at all; they were more like quizzes. Notes are allowed on the quizzes, mostly group work assignments and a guest panelist option instead of a final exam.

Great professor with great lectures. Uses adaptive teaching, so he plans assignments based off of the class and takes any feedback when making assignments. Though you don't have to attend class I'd encourage you to because he's super funny and entertaining. Definitely an easy A, I'll be taking more classes from him in the future.

He is a great professor. he keeps his lectures informational to the point I felt like I was learning, but he was funny that I wasn't bored listening to him. Allowed a sheet of paper on tests, and used the study guide which made tests easy. Would recommend!

Tom is the best professor and his lectures were hilarious. Easy A, there's group quizzes every class for participation (you get 3 drops), online labs and quizzes, and 3 exams. Everything is open note/open internet, even exams. You can't run the required lab software on a chromebook, but you can rent Macs from the library. 1000/10 take Tom's class!
Tom is a beast! Super nice guy, puts himself in students shoes, and I learned a lot from his class! Would highly recommend and take again!

Such an easygoing professor, I seriously commend him for being so chill. Seems to understand a lot of people are taking the class for the QI requirement and not because of an interest in stats. Very lenient with due dates so long as its ahead of time. He even lets you use notes on exams. Made what was a very stressful semester so much easier.

Prof. Quinn is by far my favorite instructor I've had so far. Extremely lenient with grading and turning in assignments if you give him an ample amount of notice, also uses an adaptive teaching method. Great sense of humor to keep you engaged, even while completing online quizzes. If you have the opportunity, take one of his classes!!

Prof Quinn is a awesome professor and I wish i could take more classes under him. He is super funny and engaging and he is always ready to work something out for you if extraneous circumstances arise. I would highly highly recommend.

He was a very great professor and taught using an open and adaptive approach for his students. We were able to joke around with him as well as have serious moments but in general he adapted his teaching for our best learning and would always give extra time to complete work and gave a lot of 'get out of jail free' cards for quizzes and gave prizes
Outstanding, one of the best professors at the U, patient and helpful. Dr Quinn really cares about every one of his students. Great teaching style.

Tom is sooo funny! I literally love reading his notes and modules, they're laced with humor which makes the class so much more fun! Take this class if you want to have fun and it's not too much homework yet you learn so much from it. The reading can be heavy at times but the assignments make it so much fun. Take advantage of all the extra credit!

I won't lie. You can do the bare minimum and probably get a high grade. But I promise you if you actually read the stuff he assigns, engage in the HW (which are actually interesting), and engage in discussions you will LOVE THIS CLASS. This is one of the few classes where I really learned new information that I've wanted to learn about.

This stats class was not supposed to be online, and because of that Professor Quinn made it super easy for us to be able to contact him, and get any of our questions answered. I feel that despite having this class transition to being online I learned a lot still, and managed to enjoy his class. He's super funny and a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Quinn was by far my favorite professor this semester, his class was based on both the lectures and readings, but they were easy to read and understand. Participation in the discussions is important but he gives you two weeks to complete the assignments and the discussions which is definitely a lot of help.
Awesome teacher, keeps a less interesting topic very entertaining. Would reccommend.
He is a fun, entertaining, and educational teacher. He makes demography enjoyable. I wasn't interested in the beginning, but I was at the end.

Always enjoyable. Even though this is a lecture class and there are a lot of students, I feel like I'm getting a personal experience from it and Tom is extremely relatable and humorous. Demographics aren't my #1 interest, but I love coming to class.
Pretty good professor and he has good lectures, but there aren't many things you're graded on so make sure you get the attendance credit and don't slack on the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His teaching is engaging and makes you actually understand the material instead of just memorizing it. Participation matters a lot in his class, and he creates a comfortable space where everyone feels okay speaking up.

Amazing and engaging lectures, attendance needed for participation points. Very passionate about the subject. Homework was challenging but beneficial. Tests are weighed heavily so study and attend office hours if needed. He responds via campus wire very quickly for homework questions. The final was harder than the practice test unfortunately.

Prof. Azadeh had amazing lectures, he also had a lot of passion for the topic so that helped. He answered all of my questions very clearly, which helped lots. The homework can be a bit hard so try and start it earlier than later. All round he was an amazing professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: keeps you awake with engaging lectures. he is super passionate about what he teaches, responds to emails well, encourages students to go to office hours, is always happy to help. 100000% would take his classes again
Professor Ranjbar is very passionate about the content he teaches. Every lecture is high intensity, and he definitely keeps you interested even while the content itself is boring.
Most engaging dude of all time and great at explaining stuff
Very good. Loves to keep you motivated and focused
So organized, all of the material is very easy to find and he supplies everything that you will need to pass the class.
Great professor 100%!!

Dr. Azadeh was honestly one of the best professors I've ever had. He had so much energy and passion for his subject, it was hard not to pay attention. His class was extremely organized, which made the content 10x easier to learn. He also gave us multiple practice exams to work through and study material for each midterm. He is honestly amazing.
Lectures are organized and clear, Canvas is easy to use, open to help students in and out of class, the class challenges you to think outside the box.

Vahid is one of the best professors I've had. You can tell he cares and brings energy to every lecture. Statics isn't easy, but if you put in the work you will see it is not hard too. Office hours are super helpful. Would 100% take again.

Dr. Azadeh is a passionate, dedicated professor who truly cares about student success. His engaging lectures and clear expectations make a challenging course fair and manageable. He's always available, responsive, and incredibly helpful in office hours. Highly motivating and highly recommended.

Dr. Azadeh makes it obvious that he cares about every single student's success in his class. He's always willing to answer questions in detail and responds to messages about homework questions immediately. Lectures are slightly hard to understand and he can over-complicate simple topics. But overall, homework and exams are very straightforward.
Vahid teaches with such enthusiasm that it makes me actually want to pay attention to class, teaching aside -which he does really well- he's a super nice and caring dude, highly recommended

This man cares about your success. You will never find a more passionate professor. Do your work and you will be rewarded. I've had him twice now, and he has always been there to give help to those who are willing to ask for it.
This is not the easiest class but he is a very good teacher. Homework can be hard so I went to most of his office hours and that really helped. Would highly recommend this teacher.

This professor is absolutely amazing! The class kicks your butt, but he genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Go to office hours, answer questions in class, pay attention in lectures and you'll do well!
Dr. Azadeh is a great professor. He is incredibly caring, gives awesome and engaging lectures, and keeps the course well organized. I highly recommend him to anyone taking Statics.

First, I must say I really enjoyed the course/material. I actually liked Vahid but if you can, take a different professor. Double check EVERYTHING they grade. If the TAs can dock you they will, when they can't they invent a reason to. Homework took up to 8 hours some weeks. Pre-lecture assignments 2x a week and homework weekly.
Very funny professor and really cares about his students. There's a few homework assignments each week that stem from the lectures and chapter from textbook.

Honestly class is super chill beans. Lecture was good and discussion was very helpful. Lots of homework but it was very similar to what was on the test. Final in class was worth almost the same as a midterm so its super easy burger.

Rhett is a great professor. I came into the class with no prior physics experience (only chem and bio) and was able to follow along just fine. His lectures are clear and informative and he is just a fun/funny guy.

I took him over the summer for Physics 2220 and I will say one of the easiest Physics class I have ever taken. At least over the summer your grade is curved and his test are exactly what the practice problems are like on the homework as well as in discussion.
This professor is great at explaining things clearly, even for students who are not very knowledgeable about astronomy.
One of most caring professionals ever!
The class was honestly super interesting and fun. The exams were very passable just go over the study guide. I took this as a general education credit but it was a super cool and engaging class.

Despite the fact that I checked the participation as "Mandatory" it is so only for discussion classes, not for lectures. It's solid 5 without any doubt. I've taken both 1500 and 2210 with him. Professor just as h should be. If you ever need to take either of these classes - don't hesitate.

When it comes to Professor Zollinger, I feel he deserves a cumulative 5 on rate my professor. He makes the PHYS 1050 class based on how hard you continually work on not just the exams but the home works and quizzes. And he's so engaging! If you have any concerns or questions he shows how much he cares for your success.

Prof Z is the GOAT ! He is such an amazing professor, I'd recommend this class to literally anyone. The class takes effort, but it's super achievable if you try. Also, a really great teacher, he's very passionate and wants you to truly understand. Funny as heck too. I'm terrible at physics and was amazed that I got a B. It is srsly thanks to him!
Really good lectures in class and uses Smartwork to do homework/readings. It was a super fun class for me.

He really cares about the material he is teaching. Had him for astronomy and you can tell he has passion for it. He is very funny and cares about you thinking through problems vs actually knowing the answer. Would highly reccomend.

He's a good teacher with great lectures. Homeworks are easy and there is exam prep extra credit before each exam. With no prior exposure to physics, I struggled on the exams but still ended up with a decent grade in the class due to the generous grading system.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Zollinger is a great professor overall. The homeworks weren't bad, some of them were a little time consuming.  Exams were very manageable and the overall structure allows you to get a lot out of the class. I hadn't taken a single physics class prior to this and had no trouble.

Had a great high school physics teacher who got me to love physics as a subject. But this teacher has only solidified my love for this topic, made the class engaging, had great jokes, full of energy. Yeah, at times the class got hard, but it never seemed like it was ever overbearing. Would fully recommend to anyone with prior or no experience.
Professor Zollinger made the physics 3 content easy to understand, and formatted everything in a way that flowed well.
Professor Zollinger was an amazing professor! The lectures, homework, discussions, and exams all match up really well.

Dr. Z is one of the best Physics 1 professors at the U. He ends most lectures with fun demos, like launching a stuffed animal out of a cannon to teach projectile motion. His classes are engaging, clear, and easy to follow. The review assignments closely match the exams, and it's clear he truly cares about his students' success.

Had him Fall 2024, don't know why he doesn't have any reviews. Solid professor, one of the best I've had in my years of education. Clear and concise, taught things in a way that just made sense. Homework and lectures weren't difficult to follow, did perfectly fine even missing most lectures. Everytime I talked to him, he was knowledgeable and kind.
Super easy and nice professor.

Professor Quinn was a great professor. He was by far the best math teacher I have every had. This is the only math I have been able to actually understand because of his teaching style. He wants you to succeed, attendance isn't mandatory but it is a math class you it is a good idea to show up as much as possible for best grade/understanding results
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Tom has taken the cake for my favorite professor so far at the U. He is very friendly and easygoing and understands that many people are taking this class for gen-ed credit. The hardest part of this class is the math, however, it is only needed for the HW and is never on the exams. Amazing lectures, great humor, take this class.

Tom is one of the best professors I have had at the U. He made a usually boring subject interesting. He cares about his students, and his lectures were entertaining. If you do your assignments and your (open book!) exams you will easily get a good grade.
He will make sure everything is okay and that his class is open book and open note which makes quizzes better. Highly recommend to take 3112 or any of his classes
You have to take this class with Tom, he is so funny and such a great teacher. Really sad it is over.
Take every class that you can with Tom. He's hilarious and easygoing. If you do the assignments you will get an A. Super easy, super fun.
Would recommend Professor Quinn to anyone! He made this course fun and interesting and was not afraid to show his personality! Extremely caring and understanding and just overall a great guy.

This class was super easy, and it was in large part to how Tom teaches the course. He doesn't have an ego and he cares about the students in his class. He's cool with extending assignments as long as you talk to them a day or two in advance, and his grading is very lenient. Take Tom if you like sociology and want to knock out a gen ed.

If you ever have the chance to take a class with Tom, DO IT. I was really worried going into this class since I've never taken any kind of statistics before, but I got over 100% for most of the semester. Very laid back with funny lectures and minimal work outside of class. Exams were open note.

Professor Quinn is wonderful! I enjoyed the lectures that he posted, and he made sure you understood exactly how to complete the assignments so that you used the correct calculations and got a good grade. He made his lessons very relatable and didn't assign any busy work- everything we did had a clear purpose and helped with my understanding.
I took Professor Quinn for social epidemiology, it was an interesting and easy class. The course was organized; every two weeks you had 2 quizzes and a discussion due. Highly recommend
Kindest professor I've had, understanding when you need help, and really delivers an outstanding class experience, would take again anytime.
Such an interesting class!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I've taken a bunch of his classes. He's really great and has good reviews for a reason. There is a lot of homework, but just don't wait until the last minute and reach out if you need help. He definitely wants all of his students to succeed. Classes are always well organized. Grading is very clear. I would recommend a hundred times.

Tom is so funny. Reading his content and taking the quizzes actually made me laugh sometimes. This course is a breeze. I devoted about 2 hours each week to doing the assignment, exams, labs, etc. There's only 1 assignment and maybe 1 lab a week. All easy stuff. Provides you with lots of material to do well. Will be taking a course from Tom again!
Tom is awesome. Class was interesting and simple! No stress! Lots of reading, though, but still very doable. Highly recommend.

Hands down the best professor I have ever had. I went into this course dreading statistics, turned out to be one of my favorite courses I have taken at the U. If you don't get an A its because you didn't put in any effort.

This guy is awesome to learn from. He is organized, straightforward, and engaging. Everything is clear. It is work, but the work is achievable. I plan to take another class from him again in the fall. Both are online. GO QUINN!

reviews.comment: hes amazing
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Quinn was an incredibly caring, well-organized, and hilarious professor. For each module, he allowed two weeks to complete (very attainable) and all the material to succeed in his class is given to you. The information learned was interesting, it always left you wanting to know more. This was an amazing class w/ an even better Professor.

Professor Quinn was a very well-organized instructor! You have an assignment, discussion, and quiz due every two weeks (very attainable). The material itself is very interesting and he does a very good job of showing you how to do the assignments. The assignments do contain some math material but he explains it thoroughly. Totally recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Quinn made statistics fun. His lectures and even test questions always made me laugh, and he made statistics seem understandable and doable, even for the average Joe who is not a math person (like me). This class was very educational and did an amazing job even as an online class. 10/10 would take again!

I took Toms class online Fall of 2020, and he was hilarious, accessible and understanding of how hard life was at the moment. It makes a large difference when you know your professor actually cares about your well-being. Will take another class from him if I get the chance

Took this class online. It does involve some stats but it's very easy if you watch the videos he provides and have some knowledge on how to use excel. Really nice guy and does zoom Q&A's for anyone with questions. 10/10 would recommend this class especially if you take the first/ second half classes because it goes by really fast. Awesome teacher.

Tom is the best teacher at the U. His class is interesting and he makes it fun. Willing to help and work with you to help you understand. Doesn't give you loads of homework, just enough to help you learn the content. Provided plenty of tools to help you understand concepts.
Prof was always ready to help. An easy A if you show up to the class and learn maths. he will guide you if you feel uncomfortable with the assignment. Not a lot of pressure even in a summer class.
One of the best professors at the U

The class was easy going with a few quick and easy homework assignments, quizzes which are credit or no credit based, and excellent test reviews which prepare you without having to study more. As long as you attend the lectures you'll be prepared and should do well without stressing about your grade.

The best professor, he's super funny and the class is easy. Explains everything very well. Easy A because his exams are basically open notes. Quizzes are every day (to mark attendance so no go  no points) but you can do it in groups. He gives the answers for the homework and the labs are pretty short but there's no late work allowed.

This one a hybrid course, all the quizzes were online and open book. There was no final. Just weekly assignments, and weekly discussion, but they were very easy. As long as you do the work, there's no reason you wont get an A.

If you need a stats class - look no further. This course was as plain and straightforward as a math class could possibly be, all while having a hilarious professor. I never had to touch the textbook because material was explained so clearly in class. In-class quizzes are important for your grade so show up to class. Put in little work and got an A.
Prof Quinn is awesome! He is caring and way funny! This class was pretty easy, sometimes had harder material but he makes it easy to understand. He is easy to work with.

Prof Quinn is awesome! I have taken a few of his classes and am enrolled in 2 more next semester. He's straightforward, organized, only gives you valuable information for the course, and explains things in a way that is easy to understand. And he's hilarious! He makes hard topics bearable.

I'm not a soc major, but I took this course online and Tom was super chill. He gives you 2 weeks to complete an assignment, discussion, and quiz for each module. It is very doable but DON'T WAIT TILL THE LAST MINUTE ON ASSIGNMENTS. They are time consuming and there was a lot of (simple) math. He records videos of him teaching practice problems.
Prof. Quinn was a fun professor who took the stress out of a college class. His assignments are straight forward and you learn a lot by doing them!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Quinn (*NOT* medicine woman -- his joke), is my favorite professor at the U of U, by a mile. His humor is dry and will have you in stitches. He is knowledgeable about his subject, which makes it easy for him to break it down and teach the information in a super approachable way. I use his study guides for a bunch of other classes.

Tom is the best!! He is hilarious, witty, and makes learning statistics way more fun than it should be. I had taken a previous stats class so I passed very easily. Group quizzes weekly, tests are straight forward and he gives you reviews. I wish I could take more classes from Tom.

This is the second class I have taken from him and he is the best. He makes his topics interesting and he explains the topic well. He is also one of the nicest professors I've had and is always willing to help. If you have the chance, take his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Would take again

reviews.comment: So funny! So awesome! And pretty cute...

Quinn was a great online professor. He is hilarious and you can tell he is very intelligent. All of the topics are thoroughly explained with examples. He is also very helpful in answering questions and being available to help you with the homework. He makes a challenging subject easy and fun to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I took an online class, however it was a lot of fine, I learned a lot, very informative, fair teacher and well thought out lesson plan. I am taking justice 101. I have never met this professor personally however if I am on campus I would stop by and thank him for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Tom is so great at teaching in a way that is clear and well understood.  Exam questions are taken from review, allows a page of notes on all three exams, only six homework assignments and a final paper that he tells you exactly how to get an A. This is the easiest math class I've ever taken; if your bad at math take from Tom.

Professor Quinn was hilarious and knows this subject really well. This class was a breeze as long as you show up for participation points, come to test review days (you get to bring your review sheet to the test), and do all of your assignments.
Challenging, yet very interesting subject.  Required a lot of reading/writing papers.  But it's really interesting so you'll want to do  it.
Soc 3051 online class have 6 weekly paper (2-3 pages) and 1 final paper( 6  pages).  Not hard class. I would recommend this class . Tom is good teacher too.

Professor Quinn is awesome all around! That being said their is A LOT of work involved in each assignment. I would often spend upwards of 6-7 hours on one homework assignment. The plus side being he is the worlds EASIEST grader so I didn't mind to much. Take him for a fairly easy QI! He also provides lots of helpful resources and actually cares!!

This is the only class I actually attended every class and I legit read the full textbook (I cant say that about any other class). Quinn is an amazing teacher and his lectures are hilarious, interactive, and very well done. I learned an amazing amount in this class and Quinn is by far the coolest professor I've ever had. Plus his humor is on point.

Tom is amazing. There was a lot of labs involved, but he is very organized and clear on what he expects. Material itself is pretty easy and is scheduled perfectly to ask any questions to him or other students if you are struggling. I would take this class again & would definitely take any other classes from him.

I would take this class again in a heart beat. If your group finishes the review first he allows you to skip the next assignment. Hes basically an undergrad with a doctorate, and I would definitely hang with him. Take this class, you wont regret it.

Tom is definitely one of my top three Professor out there,  I would highly recommend this professor. His lectures are awesome you learn a lot from his class,  he make sure he students are engaged during his lectures. The assignments are somewhat hard but  if you have question he's always willing to help you out and exams  are super easy.

Tom is a fantastic professor. He doesn't give pointless tedious assignments, and uses real world examples to support his lectures. His class was lecture and discussion based. He asks students to participate in discussions because he not only wants to teach, but also learn from his students. He is extremely helpful and likes to throw in humor.

Tom is the best! I would take as many classes from him as possible. He's one of those rare teachers that are actually entertaining as well as informative. He really related with students and is really down to earth. Now stop reading this and sign up for his class!

I took Sociology 1010 and 1020 at SLCC. Tom is easily one of my favorite teachers ever. He is funny and uses real world examples in his teaching. If you can't get an A in his class that is solely on you. His classes are lecture based so your attendance is important. But you're paying for it so why wouldn't you go anyways? HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!!!!

Tom is awesome, I would highly, HIGHLY recommend him to anyone needed to take Statistics. Math has never been my favorite subject but honestly he made it make sense for the first time in a long time. His lectures are hilarious, and he truly cares about his students.

Quinn was my favorite professor so far. His class didn't involve almost any assignments. He doesn't take role but there are a few simple pop quizzes that you'll pass if you're there but if you're not you won't get the points. He really cares about his students and his lectures aren't monotonous. And he's not bad to look at.
Not very friendly and a bit full of himself.

I took this at SLCC. All the reviews he has are spot on. One of THE BEST professors I have ever had! Knows how to teach and get people interested and actually learn. He is laid back, understanding and funny. Just an awesome person in general! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Best professors I've had at the U of U. I've taken his other three classes. He's very clear on grading, very easy, and hilarious. Super understanding and laid back! I would highly suggest his classes. He is an awesome human being.
Very enthusiastic, you can tell he loves to teach. Very helpful, and a very easy grader. HIGHLY recommend taking his class. Also the fact that he's attractive helped hold my interest in the class.
Most layed back, stress free stats class ever.

This is the easiest class you will ever take and Tom is the coolest professor. The class was supposed to be 3 hours but never lasted that long and was so simple. You are allowed to use a cheat sheet on the tests so you don't even have to study. Tom actually made the class interesting. He is a very nice guy. Take this class if you need a QI.

Loved this class and loved Tom. Any chance you get to take something from him, do it. He is hilarious, easy to follow, helpful, and super hot. You need to go to class to do well, but that shouldn't be a problem since class with Tom is fun!

I was dreading taking stats but it was a requirement for my major. Tom is a great professor. I would highly recomened his class. I actually looked forward to going to class. Workload is not overwhelming.
Hands down best professor ever.

an easy and interesting class. all lectures, handouts and assignments are on Canvas. 5 assignments, 5 online discussions, 3 tests (+ very helpful review test) . I love to take any class from Tom again because he's amazing!!!

Tom is AWESOME!!! He was amazingly clear in his explanations, he never made anyone feel dumb for their questions, and he knows his stuff. He gave extra time on tests, extra review sessions, and hardly any homework. He also provides such detailed lecture notes that you don't need a book. I would take ANY and EVERY class Tom taught!

Prof Smith is a kind professor who is passionate about the world of accounting. She is knowledgeable about the course material but sometimes has a hard time getting it across. She moves through slides pretty fast and works through problems fast, leaving the class feeling disengaged sometimes. Just do the practice exams and you should do fine!
Copies professor Scott Pickett's format for this class but doesn't teach at nearly the same level.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Jenn Smith is a very kind teacher, which alone will make up for the drawbacks. However, sometimes the class can feel a little unengaging and the material feels far too complicated. But she is patient, and makes up for it ten fold. Highly reccomend.

Exams are easy, but she doesn't teach well and constantly messes up what she says in class. She goes through the slides way too quickly, and you have to raise your hand after every slide to clarify what she got wrong. Ended up teaching myself the course through the slides and excel files. Definitely try to get Pears for 5120.

I really liked Jenn! If you pay attention and do the homework and short pre-class readings, the class is pretty easy to understand. She's very sweet and wants her students to succeed. The material is very conceptual, and she explains it well. Practice exams prepare you very well for the tests. One of my favorite professors so far!

Not the best lecturer and relies on McGraw-Hill for material. Doesn't do many walkthrough problems, but will have exam review sessions, which are very helpful. She takes maybe a week to respond to emails if you're lucky. Otherwise, she is very sweet, and the class is fine when you kind of know what you're doing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's really nice but her teaching style is a little confusing also she will help you a lot so use that to your advantage
jenn is new but is definitely a good professor! she is often available after class, so i would take advantage of that. this course is extremely difficult so be ready to study

Not a bad prof. You can tell she's new, but ask questions if needed. ACCTG 5120 is a tough class, but she made it easier. She had exam reviews before each exam that were very helpful. Great professor overall. He was really chill and the environment was really chill. I learned a lot in this class that will help me later on.

Daniel is such a nice professor and super considerate of others. Always willing to help! He will work with you on deadlines and how to start your assignment. Uncapher is probably one of the nicest people on earth and definitely the nicest professor Ive had. His class is super fun and focused. The class was inclusive, welcoming, and accepting. Uncapher just really cares about his students. Lots of tips on publishing and kind and detailed feedback. I am lucky to have had him as my professor.

He is very understanding if you are unable to get in a paper on the deadline, and he will always make accommodations for you. He always listens to what his class has to say, and will treat you as an equal. He is open to criticism him and always is looking to improve.

Great professor! He's really good at engaging the class by helping lead the discussion. Is super friendly and creates a comfortable space to voice your thoughts. You can really tell how passionate Daniel is about writing and how much he knows as well. He's a really likable, knowledgeable guy, and he made the class one where I learned a lot that was also one of my favorites!

Daniel Uncapher is an amazing professor. I had him for creative writing and he is a real gem. Easy A (90% and up is an A and 87% to 90% is A-) 4 proctored exams with the chance to participate is psych research pools for a small amount extra credit. Reading is a must but in depth reading not needed as he posts the highlight from sections mixed with his own additions (of which are on tests).
Great class, professor obviously has a lot of enthusiasm for the subject. Read the text, study the study guides, and maybe watch the lectures (or not); 4 proctored multiple choice tests… that's it!
I took this class online and it was fairly easy. Just watch the lectures and read the book and you'll be fine. You have to go to a testing center for all 4 tests.

Caution to students taking this class online: The class format is that you take 4 tests during the semester that each count for 25% of your grade. The videos however were recorded in 2011. There are no direct updates/interactions with Dr. Uchino during the semester. He seemed like a great professor but I would recommend taking his class on campus.

Great course! Very interesting. I could tell that prof. Uchino really enjoyed teaching this class. He is funny and engaging, makes lectures feel shorter than they are. Read the book and watch the lectures and it's an easy A for sure. Also very entertaining.
Very helpful and nice. Answered all my questions and was really understanding when I had surgery.

I am supposed to graduate this semester and I took Ulysses online class to complete my final gen ed requirement. Now I'm not cleared to graduate.

The content is easy itself, but the lack of communication from the professor is irritating. He doesn't grade stuff on time at all (almost end of the course w/ no grades on anything). go in with a good attitude and willing to take criticism, you'll learn a lot from maureen. she can be a little dry but if you don't take it personally, you'll realize she's actually a kind person. get to know her. she's a great connection to have. the work is a lot, but really will improve your drawing skill.

Try to get to know her, and I think a lot of you will be pleasantly surprised at how caring she truly is. Would definitely take another class from her.

1st half of the semester was only continuous contour line drawings: painfully tedious and difficult. Absurd, can't say I learned much from that. Vague feedback. Absurd amounts of homework. Every assignment is a continuous contour line drawing. Her critiques are nonsensical bull. Sadistic. Said perspective drawing "isn't realistic."

Maureen is a terrible teacher! She spent every lecture bashing other artists and hyping up her own work. Maureen doesn't allow phones in class. I spoke to the TA who confirmed this.

reviews.comment: great course! Interesting lectures!
great course!

Yes, professor is well versed in the topic of Contemporary Artists but that knowledge leads to her being pretentious and a HEAVY condescending tone. Loving and caring genius. She is one of the most resilient, happy and supportive people I have ever met. She has a gone through some serious life challenges recently with an amazing attitude and while still taking care of her students the best she can.

If you think that she comes across as not a nice person, you must be blind to dry humor and a little sarcasm. She is extremely nice and caring, and so funny, actually, if you realize some of the things she says that you think are serious are actually jokes. Also, she speaks at a high level of vocabulary sometimes, so if you cant keep up, sorry...
She has a potluck at her cute house end of her senior seminar. So caring and wonderful. Take time to talk to her and get to know her. She is very intelligent and conscientious.

It's cool to learn about contemporary artists, but she teaches in a dull way. Two hours of picture slides with her giving her opinion/subtly jabbing an artist's methods she doesn't care for. reviews.comment: I feel like most of these reviews are angry students who didn't get the "easy A" that they wanted. Want an "easy A" then you clearly don't realize what college is. She only did lectures, and would breeze over each artist that she would talk about in the lectures, but would then expect you to know a ton about said artist when it was time to take the exam.  Oh, and her exams are basically the same as taking the SAT or ACT in high school-leave your jackets/bags/hats/electronics at the front of the class.

Clear on what it takes to do well in her class: Attend, pay attn, ditch the cells. She goes the extra mile to introduce recognized artists, and to bring in guest speakers/heads of art dept.'s at the 'U' - great for first year students looking to define their direction. Dry humour refreshing. Upon occasion artistically supercilious. A true artist.

She is one of the best professors that I have ever had! She is an artistic genius, but a genius in many other ways. She really cares about her students and wants to help you succeed outside of school, thus her classes are very applicable. Go talk to her, because you won't understand how cool she is if you just go sit in class with a bad attitude.

My drawing ability improved greatly after taking Maureen's class. Be prepared to be in class on time and work hard. You want an easy A? Drop out of art school and join the business majors. Coffee is for closers.  Show up early so you get a seat. A few times I ended up working on the floor because I was late and there weren't enough desks.

I felt I deserved an A in the class, but at the end of the semester found out that it didn't matter how well I did individually, but in order to get an A you had to have the top piece in the assignment 3 or more times.  Not that it was easy to tell what would get you to the top. We also had to buy a bunch of materials that we didn't or barely used.

I felt I deserved an A in this class. I spent the most time out of class by far (10-15 hours each week when only 4 hours was req.) & I was the only person in the class who was early every day & never missed a class. She said that she only gave A grades to ppl who got the highest score on at least 3 pieces So that only leaves enough room for 3-4 As
study the slides and you will get an A in the class, also she takes random attendence so i would go to class just incase to ensure your attendence doesnt bring your grade down

I thought the class was pretty interesting. I enjoyed it when I didn't really expect to. Attendance is not mandatory but she does do random attendance checks. You could literally not go all semester and just study the study guides she puts up online and get an A, but I highly recommend attending because you will learn.

fairly easy course and teacher. study the slides she posts online and attend art exhibits and you'll pass the class no problem. making notecards for the slides is the best way to study. don't cram the night before, start studying at least a week in advance. if you say the names out loud how they are spelled it really helps with the spelling aspect

I'm a student writing this in Prof. O'Hara's defense: 1) This is college. Get used to spelling; it might even help you land a job. 2) Have any of you taken a college-level exam before? This test is cake compared to a sociology or psychology exam. 3) The slides are not for shock value. They represent the contemporary artists of our time.
I hate how she grades on spelling!
I hate how she grades on spelling! It'll screw your grade over if you can't spell!

She's well-informed about the art community, and occasionally has a spark of dry wit, which has been somewhat refreshing. But, it feels like she puts her intellectualism on a pedestal in front of us (and we know we're not that educated yet, but come on), so the arrogance is there. It was an okay class; learned some, left some.
No Comments

I definitely did not relate with this teacher.  She was arrogant and egotistical.  Her curriculum was ridiculous, and most of the slides she showed us were for shock value only.  I would avoid this teacher at all costs!  It is easy to get an A, but not worth the misery of sitting in a semester of her class!
Awesome instructor, gives good feedback on assignments, and helps you improve. Class was normal difficulty, not tough, not easy.
He da goat

He is genuinely the nicest most caring teacher/professor ever. Greatest professor I have ever had.

Uzor is awesome and I highly recommend. I hate reading and writing with a passion, yet I loved his class.  Attendance is mandatory, but the classes are fun and he encourages humor. reviews.comment: Professor Uzor always made classes interesting and made writing more enjoyable for me.  He was super relatable and helped me learn while making it seem less like work.

Mr. Uzor is phenomenal and I am lucky to have had him. I was worried about being taught nonsense beyond how to write better in WRTG 1010, but nonsense was nowhere to be found thanks to his teaching and knowledge of writing. He also teaches in a way that involves the class in an entertaining way.

Uzor was amazing! As a person that has been out of school for a long time and who's English is my 2nd language. I was very nervous to take English 1010, that quickly changed once I met the professor. If you do all the work and attend class you will learn a lot from him. Totally recommend. Great teacher! really wants his students to succeed 10/10.

Professor Uzor is great! he really cares about his students and wants you to succeed. His lectures are easy to follow. I learned a lot from his class. He is a great teacher, very funny. He works with you if needed outside of class. Totally recommend him. You will LEARN A LOT in his class. He will make sure you are ready for the next engl class.

Prof Kenechi Uzor is a well respected professor. He is hilarious and fun in class. I really like his teaching method and curriculum criteria in WRTG1009. Basically, we have just one essay though out the course. Every week we will discuss one of a component to write that last essay.

Kenechi is a very empathetic professor. However, the class was incredibly awkward and quiet. Lots of awkward silences, misunderstandings, and nervous laughs. Kenechi is a generous grader; he makes the class much easier than he has to.

Professor Uzor is my favorite professor I've had at the U of U. He was very informative and helped me take my writing to a level I though I would never get it to. When reading my final paper for his class, I was surprised I was the one who wrote it. He is also super cool and made class fun and easy going while still explaining things well.

Professor Uzor made writing 2010 enjoyable and stress-free. He is a very welcoming, great teacher who cares about his students. It's easy to pass this class with an A as long as you participate and keep up with the work, which is pretty simple in his class. Coming to class is easy as you want to come, due of the light-hearted atmosphere.

Professor Uzor's class is super easy. You only have one paper for the entire semester, and the homework can be done very quickly. Attendance was mandatory, but there was only a 50/50 chance that you would actually do anything worthwhile during class other than just talk. Very reasonable when it comes to adjusting the curriculum, as well.

Professor is super funny, our class was talking and laughing everyday. He likes to joke and talk about life in general as well as what he is teaching. Makes the workload easy, if you fail his class it is your own fault because he gives you every opportunity to succeed.

I loved Kenechi! He's such a fun teacher and is extremely nice. He's so funny and makes the class really fun! The assignments aren't hard, but they're a good refresher.

encourages class discussion and sharing opposing viewpoints. You feel free and safe in this class topic wise which is pretty rare. on the other hand the feedback from my papers was pretty spare, like a couple of sentences.

Best class I've had so far. Prof Uzor is hilarious, understanding, and he genuinely cares about his students. The homework wasn't bad and we only wrote one major paper.

Professor Uzor is a fantastic teacher. I've never really enjoyed writing, but this class was enjoyable. We read about real-world issues and had relatable discussions. I would definitely take a class with this professor again.

I loved this class.

This professor wasn't organized at all and the class was honestly a mess. Hes awful. He made multiple mistakes every lecture which made it difficult to follow the steps of the equations. He doesnt answer your questions clearly and does not explain the material well. He told us we dont need to go to class because the videos teach better than him..., yet the videos he gives us dont help half the time. Would not recommend but I dont think the other professors are much better.

Worst professor ever! He didn't actually test us. We had to watch a video from another professor then we could as questions in class. But he never answered them good or told us to watch a video. He is the most unprepared, unprofessional, worst professor ever, he doesn't deserve the title of professor! He also moved the final up by 1 week.
Brilliant teacher. Truly cares about mathematics and his students. Would take again.

Jason Underdown was just okay. I took Math 1050, and I'm glad the class content was decently easy, because I ended up teaching myself almost all the the material. Makes an ungodly amount of mistakes. Insanely long homeworks. Tests are fair, quizzes are not graded. Honestly, he's a jerk when you ask questions in class, he makes you feel like an idiot. I did not enjoy his class, but in his defense its a hard class to teach. I didn't learn much from him, his teaching style didn't line up with my learning style.

Literally, he is the best math teacher I've ever had. He is passionate and really cares about his students. Always willing to help outside class. The tests and the quizzes are fair.

Jason's style of teaching is much better if you attend his office hours. I frankly learned most of the material by going to his office hours than actually sitting through lectures. He is very willing to help you understand the material as long as you put in the effort! Not a bad class at all.

Underdown is an amazing professor! He was very clear on grading and what material would be covered throughout the class. I learned so much from his lectures! Doesn't teach well,  Messes up in the middle of lectures!

Great professor, Great lectures. presents the material well. Very helpful.

he okay at presenting the material
He has no idea how to teach. He helped write Webwork or what not. He's useless when it comes to answering questions, go to the SI because you wont do good if you dont go to those.

Very bad at teaching, she just does the problems on the screen and doesn't explain how or why. When I took this class in previous years there were times when the entire class had no clue what was going on and it all felt so rushed.

she cannot teach.

I liked his lectures, but sometimes it felt like they didn't prepare me very well for the assignments in the class. Also it took a very long time to get grades back. Overall I like him and the class was good, but it wasn't my favorite.

Vlas is a great professor, who explains everything clearly in his course if you just read the syllabus. The homework was long but taught me a lot, and the final group prject was enjoyable. Would definitely take it again.

At least half the time I spent on assignments was spent trying to decipher what it was he wanted us to do. The final project was a group project and the instructions were literally just "do a group project using class materials", then we got docked for not going into enough detail LOL

This class is hard if you have no coding experience, homework takes a whole day if you don't use chat-GPT, and exams are hard and stressful because you only get 3 hours to do them. There is a group project at the end, but this class is fully online, and he doesn't give you the resources to code with one another, so it tends to fall on one person.

Often the codes he was writing in the lectures had errors and it was clear the software had updated since recording. Rather than answering questions, Vlas would ask for my code to be sent in a different format then never respond after I resent the code. The T.A.'s graded the MANY assignments AFTER the semester was over. We got no helpful feedback.

Not sure how this class was pre-GPT but it honestly isn't too bad currently,and Vlaz does a good job walking you through it all in his video lectures. The second half is for sure harder but he is lenient with grading the group project and homework. Tough class for sure especially with no coding background, but if you use your TA's you will be ok.

Just the HW assignments took +12 hours. Professor's materials are outdated and full of typos (bad for coding). Profesor does not care to answer questions. Tests are impossibly hard but graded on a huge curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is one of the best math teachers I've ever had. He is very experienced, knows exactly how each problem works, and is very kind, gracious, and fair with the way he grades. Sometimes he would even take problems off homework if he didn't think they were that relevant to our quizzes or exams. Anything unfortunate about the class was completely on me

There is a quiz every week, but it is very helpful for learning trigonometry. The professor explains things clearly and is always willing to help if you ask. The three exams were straightforward. Overall, they are a great teacher for trigonometry.

This guy is the best math teacher I've ever had. He's upfront & won't make you learn things that don't matter. He loves drawing pictures for examples and it really helps visualize the concepts. He throws in a joke or 2 every class that's acc funny and will catch you off guard. If you show up to the class and pay attention you won't need much else.

It may be a matter of I just don't do well with his teaching style, but I found him to skip over things and just assume you knew what was happening and why. I also found the lectures to be boring and not engaging.

Michael was PHENOMENAL. I have had a lot of math professors and Michael explains things better and more concisely than all of them. His lectures are super followable and he always gives great motivation to everything he is teaching. He is also very flexible with homework and will help you if you are getting stuck. Definitely recommend.
Michael really understands math, and is great at explaining it. He taught me a lot about math fundamentals in a way that made so much sense. Great professor, great class.

Take this professor! I took him in 2021 of Fall and only wish more were like him. This man is a great educator and a very respectable person. Also, something very unique about him is he wear a priest outfit everyday, I like this about him a lot and he is funny sometimes. Reviews are just like the exams no tricks, and fair grading across the board.

I cannot recommend this professor enough! His lectures are very clear and he is great at noticing when students are confused and giving extra help. The class is graded on homework, weekly quizzes, and exams. There was also a little extra credit. I will say that the class builds greatly off of 1050 so brush up on trig if you didn't take 1050.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Michael is attentive and always happy to help with any questions that you might have. Excellent professor.
Michael is AMAZING. I will definitely try to take him again. He cares a lot and definitely knows what he's talking about and loves it. I had an amazing and fun time in his class

Professor van Opstall is one of the best math teachers I've had, which is hard to come by these days. Expect to complete about 2 hours of online homework each week. Small and relatively easy quizzes each week. Three midterms and a final exam. He tests using straightforward questions, he doesn't try to trick you. Study and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Great Professor, really goes into detail in his lectures but it can be easy to get lost and lose track of what he's saying so take heavy notes. Has always responded to emails quickly. He's very generous to the class so far he's made two extra credit opportunities for students. It's a usual math class but with a knowledgeable professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Van Opstall is clear in his lectures and his tests reflect exactly what is on the reviews. Obviously it is a math class so you still have to put in work, but his assignments are usually not super heavy. He always responds to my emails, and he cares about his students understanding the material. One of the best professors I have had.

This class is amazing with Micheal. He assigns homework regularly but it doesn't feel pointless, it helps so much on the tests. The class is challenging enough that you feel like you are actually learning new things, but it isn't so difficult that you get discouraged. Going to class is important but you will be okay if you have to miss a day or two
For my first math teacher at the U, Vanopstall set a high bar. He does plenty of problems in class and explains thoroughly, and always answers questions well. I will take him again if I can.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: He was a really great teacher. He would start right away and just go through the problems. There was a quiz every week and homework for almost every day but it never felt overwhelming.

Michael is the BEST! I've had him for 3 semesters now and he never disappoints. His lectures & homeworks are very interesting. He's such a caring professor and was very understanding throughout the whole semester. I highly recommend taking him. One of the best math professors at the U!

Amazing prof. Can teach in a variety of ways to reach his students. Make sure you ask questions if you are confused, don't be scared if you get a question wrong! Michael is able to understand why you think a certain way, which is great because then he can teach you accurately.. and he doesn't make you feel stupid. He is also pretty funny!
Vanopstall was my favorite teacher of all my math career. He was passionate about what he does and he really knows his stuff. I would highly recommend taking him.

Vanopstall was wonderful! He really knew how to explain the math behind what we would be teaching, and taught us effective ways of how to teach that. He was constantly making funny statements in class, and liked to have us involved in the lessons. He responded to emails incredibly fast, but don't message on canvas.

Enjoyed this class. The only downside was that if you asked a question in class, he would either be helpful, or clearly annoyed with you depending on the day. He hates memories formulas so if you ask him what the quadratic formula is he will just roll his eyes and tell you "that just sounds like magic to me!!"

Vanopstall himself is clearly knows what he is teaching, but there doesn't seem to be able to get it through to the students. The book he uses someone else wrote, and it is odd. He teaches a subject enough where you think you kind of understand it, but then the questions on the test are super abstract. Expect a lot of outside work to pass.

Not sure why he's gotten negative reviews. I never tried to get personal one on one help but I know there were plenty of TA sessions. He explains very clearly and slowly so that if you attend class and try to keep up, you can. Absolutely no complaints.

The professor couldn't reach out to students that didn't fully understand what he was lecturing. If you tried to email him, there was no response to your questions. He was never available during his office hours, so you don't have a chance to talk to him. He didn't grade your assignments or quizzes in a way that you would know what you did wrong.

I did not learn a thing from this professor. The textbook was absolutely terrible. None of the material presented in class is on the midterm or the final exam. I took the time to show up to the study session before the final and he didn't even care to show up. Take this course from a different professor if at all possible.

I think this teacher is a jerk. He doesnt care about the students in his class. He doesnt care if you pass or fail, and doesnt care if you dont understand something. His test were way hard, and his practice tests were never helpful. He was an awful teacher. Take from someone else, and you will have a more enjoyable time.

Although class is "flipped" as his syllabus states (i.e. you need to read the chapter before class), I think he was great at demonstrating how to solve the problems. Quiz problems were from homework and the test questions were from the quiz questions for the most part. If I'd gone to class more I'd have gotten an A but I got a B+.
This guy was the absolute worst! He has a condescending attitude, doesn't give us homework problems, and has trick questions on tests. Plus he doesn't ever bother to help his students.

He is great at teaching, often humorous. He teaches without notes and the way he presents his material is very effective. Although I did find that he is a pretty tough grader so you will need to work hard to get the grade you want but he makes learning the material easier than any other professor I have came in contact with.
Lectures were okay, tests were graded on 3/4 problems which was very helpful.

While alright at teaching, he doesn't cover a lot of the content in the homework in his lectures. He (and the TAs) also grade very severely; you have to list everything explicitly or you'll get penalized, but they're not explicit about what they want beforehand.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He wasn't that bad. Difficult material, sure, but nothing that I had against the professor. I was annoyed by the TAs of the class since the grading rubric wasn't clarified until several weeks into the semester, but the class has changed a lot in the past few semesters due to student feedback. I'm sure that helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He doesn't want to teach, i can tell. he expect us to remember everything we had in our pre-req courses. His office hours are pointless, hardly explains anything. most of his backend job were left to TA to do. My advice: attend every LA & TA office hours (and learning center) for hw and revision. Treat this course like 8 hours credit.

Vikram is a smart guy, but he probably shouldn't be a professor. His lectures are very boring and confusing and do not help with the very difficult homework he assigns. Luckily, he did give opportunity to get test credit back (of course, otherwise no one would've passed). He was often rude when answering questions and wasn't approachable.

I had Dr. Deshpande for PHYS 3010. He basically just reads off his notes when lecturing which makes it difficult to understand what he's doing.
