Frisbee is a great professor! He makes learning a completely foreign subject interesting and actually enjoyable. I would recommend his class to anyone :)

Adam was a great professor. He is clear on every assignment throughout the semester. He is very easy to work with and wants students to get a good grade. The class is not hard and he covers everything on the tests in his reviews. By far one of the best teachers in the business school.

Adam is a great IS professor and I would recommend you take at least one course from him. He breaks his lectures down into easily understood topics and explains any tech jargon that you eventually run into. He offers in depth study guides for the midterm and final. His website project at the end of the course is awesome!

Adam was a wonderful professor. Not only was he excited about the material he was teaching, but he took time to help you understand. His tests are actually based off the material covered in the final review and he prepares you in terms of what you need to know. I would definitely recommend taking this class from Adam.

Adam is by far one of my favorite teachers I have had at the University. He made class highly enjoyable, and also is the one who made me decide to declare my IS major. His classes are fun, he makes learning easy, and he never throws you any surprises. He teaches you what you need to know and does it super well. I highly recommend this professor!!
Show up and do the work and class is easy

Adam prepares you for the real world of Business Information Systems. He is passionate about what he teaches and cares so much that he stays current on the latest news and dealings within the IS community.  He also shares what he has and is learning from his 'day' job.  Professor Frisbee is a class act and the UofU DESB is better because of him.
Professor is passionate about what he teaches. He teaches effectively and provides all the resources for you to pass!

Adam's a great guy and a great professor! He's got a lot of experience and has a fun way of engaging with students. He's even known to throw "Frisbees" in class to participating students. His class if fair, with a good balance of reading, assignments, and tests.   I would definitely recommend him to other students!

Such a great professor! He truly cares about his students. He is sarcastic and hilarious! Great teacher to take this class from. He goes over everything before the test so if you show up you'll do well!
Adam Frisbee knows what he is talking about.  He is fun and a cool guy
Prof Frisbee was so much fun and made the lectures very interesting!
Learning to create a website was fun!
He is a very effective teacher.  He works in the industry so his lectures are real world and are actually very useful and practical.  He makes sure students really understand the material well.
Useful class
The guy has jokes.  He keeps it interesting.  I'm not super interested in the topic but Frisbee made it bearable.  Website project was legit.

Adam is a fabulous communicator who excels at articulating his thoughts. He has an outstanding sense of humor which makes his classes active, cheerful and fun. His lectures were concise, maximized learning through focusing on practical applications of concepts, and highly knowledgeable. He displayed exceptional dedication towards solving my doubts.
this class was the best one I took this semester. He is a nice professor and it was a pretty easy class. i highly suggest you take him for physics.

Adam Beehler was an awesome professor who really cares about what he teaches and taught it in a very helpful way. I did not go to class very often, and that was a very very bad idea, so I wouldn't recommend that. Go to class, get the readings done, and you will like this class.

Adam Beehler is an awesome teacher who obviously loves what he does. The workload is not crazy considering its a college level physics class. If you keep up on the readings and pay attention in lecture, you will be just fine. I loved this class.

Although Physics is not my strong suit and I had a bit of trouble making connections outside of class, Professor Beehler was always more than happy to meet with me to go over the concepts in class. His lectures were very engaging and he had the coolest demos! His course is more dependent on conceptual problem solving as apposed to using equations.

I have no notes. This class was phenomenal. I was def intimidated by physics at first but Adam made concepts incredibly accessible and engaging. He has brilliant demos and is always willing to answer questions. He provides great resources; use them and you will be golden.
Great physics demonstrations, entertaining lectures.
Great interactive lectures with tons of demonstrations. Makes physics super interesting. Definitely don't need to attend every class. 4 midterms and a final, one of which he drops. Pretty easy class.
awesome，really

Definitely one of my favorite professors. His lectures are so clear and he is great at stopping and making sure everyone understands what is happening and answers questions clearly. He drops your lowest test grade at the end of the semester and has a lot of little opportunities to get points instead of just lecturing and giving tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Adam is pretty awesome, he is an interactive professor and did 4+ experiments every lecture. I have ADHD and it's pretty hard to pay attention but in his class, it wasn't an issue. He was a funny teacher, he did have 4 Midterms and 1 exam, all relatively easy and we took them on computers... he is a down-to-earth and pretty understanding guy.

When I first chose 1010 I expected it to be a boring class. Fortunately, Adam made learning physics such a fun and interesting experience. Lectures are not mandatory, but I recommend going as he always has interesting demonstrations and is funny and passionate about what he does.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Prof. Beehler was amazing, His lectures are easily comprehensible and fun. He is willing to help his students learn. There may seem like a lot of reading, but in reality, it isn't bad at all and is also easily understood. There is no final, just a paper, and all Unit tests have study guides to prep you for them and have a summarized study guide.

Professor Beehler is one the best science instructors I have ever met. He is so passionate about physics it's almost inspirational. The class can be hard, but you can get by without studying hard. I didn't have a final exam; I just had to write a paper on a superhero based on physics. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I honestly don't know anyone who enjoyed physics lab. But it's bearable and doable! Expect to spend the full 3 hours there, this isn't like a chem/bio lab where you can leave early. Labs are run by TAs. No homework, and hardly any work needed outside of class time. That being said, expect to work hard during those 3 hours of the week.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: If you struggle with science DO NOT take this class from Adam. The class itself was fun but I felt like I didn't learn very much in class. Like a few things stuck but not many. He allows corrections on test but very little time to do them. He was just to all over the place and not very clear. By the end of the semester I was just hoping for a C!

Allows for corrections on tests, all in class assignments are done in groups (which is worth it, I usually hate group work but it definitely helps). About half the assignments are online, they take 2-3 hours, I already knew most of the material and it still took 2 hours on average

Adam is easily one of my favorite professors at the U. If you want to actually learn physics, he's the one! Physics is no easy topic to teach but Adam masters the art of breaking it down in a way that is extremely easy to understand. I'd HIGHLY recommend taking his class! His demos each lecture are also awesome, I have too many favorites.

Adam is an awesome teacher! Go to class, EVERY. SINGLE. DAY! He has clicker questions, even though they are only a small portion of the grade they will help you learn! Weekly assignments and prelecture Q due before every class. Drops lowest test score, so thats a plus!

Adam is an example of what all teachers should aspire to be. He takes complex notions brakes them  down and makes them easy. His demonstrations are second to none. And while I only audited this class online I so wish I can actually take the course for credit. Adam my hat is off to you Thank you for your dedication to education

He is amazing!! Loved this class.  He is clear and helpful. It isn't a super easy class, but it's definitely worth taking it! Great class for non-science majors who need a general ed requirement. Take it!!

He is amazing, and one can tell that he really enjoys teaching. I loved going to class, which is partly due to the fact that he does a demonstration basically every day, which were both fun and helpful. He is by far my favorite professor so far, clear and helpful. A great class for non-science majors who need a general ed requirement. Take it!

He is the absolute best! You will never find a better physics/science/ANY teacher. He is incredibly nice, interested in the subject and helpful. He connects your questions to the lecture-never making you feel stupid for asking questions. Talk and interact with him, physics will be fun! Perfect for moving onto upper level physics courses. Go Adam!

Made a very engaging class. I really like this professor however we used AI for the majority of the class. It was a very different experience than a lot of other classes and I just wasn't used to that much AI usage. I enjoyed a lot of the assignments though and felt like I understood marketing a lot.
I don't understand how but my grade was 92.9 and she gave me -A. I don't understand her grading

I really wanted to love this course but it was so dissapointing. The whole course was generated by AI. Assignments, presentations, final projects, everything. Even taking our tests it was obvious it was AI. Our final project feedback was 100% AI generated and had errors all over the place. She's also completely unaccessable after the last test.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was great and pretty casual class, fairly easy assignments and minor chances of presenting. She got everyone in the class chatgpt preimium through the school which is sick. I had a 89.3 in the class at the end of the semester without a way to increase it and she just randomly gave me extra points to bump it to a 90 without saying anything.

She is a very nice and good professor. She lets you use AI on most assignments. Tons of group projects and small graded assignments in class. Attendance may not be mandatory but there are many assignments in class that you cannot miss.

Attendance is mandatory (even though she says its not) due to random graded assignments given in class. She will then deduct your grade after giving you permission that things are ok to do. It was clear that our 17-page final project was graded by AI and never clearly looked at. When put into multiple AI checkers her feedback came back at 100%.
Great teacher, easy class

Loved her, she was pretty engaging compared to my marketing professors now. The first exam was easy until she caught kids cheating and then made it harder. Her content was really interesting and I would take her class again

I took MKTG-4760 & MKTG-4730. She has great guest speakers who are actively hiring students. AI friendly. Surprise (easy) in-class assignments to make sure students show up. Expect 1-2 out of class "real world" assignments. No exams. Only critique is assignments can be random and not clear at times. Show up and check canvas. Finished with 98%.

Rita was a great professor! She would lecture for 20 minutes and then have us break out into presentation groups. Group presentations seemed somewhat pointless. Everyone would present on the same thing. Same groups would present every time. I never learned much from them. I didn't love how the class was structured but Rita was amazing and helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great class. Truly enjoyed it!
This isn't the most difficult class, but assignments will be useful in the future.

Since this was an online class, I  didn't really experience fully who the professor was. The lectures for the class were from a different person. Though this is the case, I still got to interact with her through email and from what I remember she replied to me. She helped me on and assignment and was fair with my situation.

This 1 credit class will have you doing more work during finals than some 3 credit classes. Do not procrastinate, get the required club and networking assignments done as early as you can in the semester, since there is no late work, and around 10 points of extra credit. Procrastination will lead to failing the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For a 2 credit hour general university required course RitaMae really does care. Coursework is easy and she's more than happy to help you with job searching on an individual basis, even after you finish the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Good teacher the subject was very topical and I'm sure if I had questions in the future she would help
the professor was great and answer to you when you need her
She is a great professor. Her class is very straight forward.
She was great and helps you to clean up your LinkedIn profile and make it look attractive to employers.
The lectures are super long, but other than that the work load isn't too bad!
Prof. Adamson-Schwisow is great! She is ready to help any students that need extra help and is easy to contact. She responds to any questions quickly and wants her students to succeed!
Super fun and doable and knows what she's talking about
She is amazing
one of my favorite sales classes yet. She gives you a lot of good resources when it comes to sales. Her approachability and willingness to provide guidance and feedback are highly appreciated.
This class was easy to follow and keep up in. I enjoyed the videos and the set up of the class. Not a super hard class. I would definitely take a class from her again.

She was a great professor who really wanted you to learn rather than memorize. She use a lot of skills in her finals which helped me feel like I was actually applying myself to something that will benefit my career rather than just getting through another course. I really appreciated her class.
This was an online class with very little expected of you, and all of the assignments are easy to do.

Rita is a great professor and an even better resource and person; you can tell she truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed! I felt welcomed to class every week and the lectures were engaging as well.

Rita is awesome! Her classes have a light workload and her lectures are great. She's a resource that I am genuinely glad to have. She does a good job making the content very relevant to real-life situations. There aren't many "wrong answers" in her class. She helps identify potential careers and helps you prepare to get started in that field. A+
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you feel like you haven't learned real-world skills in your classes, this is the class for you. You will learn skills that translate into the working world (not just sales). Most of all, you will learn how to get a job. (I got a job using her advice and have used it to help friends get jobs as well.)

The professor was very caring and easy to work with but was very hard to get a hold of. When messaging or emailing it will take several days to get a response so make sure if you have questions about an assignment, you message her at least a week in advanced.
Did this rating for extra credit, this was an online class so I never saw her
She was really good. The class was really easy. She took out lots of busy work which was nice. Everything was always to the point and no fluff.

Has very much of a "laissez faire" teaching making it very accessible for various demographics of students. Very easy and informative class along with amazing connections created in the class with guests speakers and such. Would recommend if interested in Sales Industry!
Clear and overall a good teacher.
She is amazing and has a lot of knowledge in the industry, which is super valuable as business constantly changes. Very collaborative group classroom setting.
The in-class career planning activities were a lot of fun and informative.
Great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Rita is an awesome teacher and an even better resource, she has helped me excel at interviews and made my post graduation life a bit clearer with her career guidance. Would definitely recommend her!
This was a simple class, no issues. Ritamae was always available when needed.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I liked this professor even though the class was not the most exciting class. I did this online so it was a pretty basic structure. But the professor left a few assignments just hanging without a date that I didn't see until like the last week of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I love Rita! This is my second class with her and she brings alot of real world experience. She cares for her students and her assignments are applicable to careers in sales and many other fields. She does take awhile to grade, and some of her assignments aren't clear, but besides that, if you do your work you can easily get an A in the class.
Great semester, workload was not very excessive, lectures were very informative.

Rita was great to work with this semester! She was easily reachable and I never had a problem getting in contact with her and getting help. She gives great lectures, is very professional, gives great advice, and was very patient with her students
She was super helpful throughout the whole semester answering any questions I had. There is a good amount of homework so be prepared to spend time working on those assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great professor for Tech Sales. Very understanding about personal matters, as I had to take the class online half way through the year. The only problem I faced was lack of a precise canvas. I am sure it is hard to change the matierial after every semester, but I found the canvas to be fairly disorganized and sometimes provided the wrong due date.

Although this was just a 2 credit class, there was some good career prep that helped us know how to better position ourselves for a job. It was mostly left up to us to learn since it was online, but it was pretty easy and straightforward which was nice.

The class is pretty easy but Rita is very unorganized so that makes it a bit harder. She teaches a sales class where communication is emphasized but she is not very good at communicating. Instructions are often very unclear on assignments and tests.
What you learn in her class is great, in my opinion, she asked a lot for a class that is only worth 2 credits. But I had a great time.

She really cares for her students. She loves to help her students get ahead in their careers rather than help them for something in return. She has real world experience which translates very much to the classroom and helps us gain real experience. Definitely recommend.

The syllabus and communication is subpar, but if you come to class you will know everything you need to do well in the class. Rita is very helpful and resourceful if you are willing to ask for help and do the work!
Rita is a very good professor, and explain instructions, and how to do things very well. I feel like I learned a lot about sales in this course.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Rita was a great professor this semester. The class was fairly easy, but I still learned a lot. I would recommend her for anyone who needs to take this class!
great professor super nice definitely would !
I took this marketing class online and everything was laid out nice. Prof is very understanding and cares about her students.

Hard assignments with unclear instructions and she didn't reply to emails but she has assignments that will help with your career. We created a good LinkedIn, an interview slide deck and learned how to use sales software. Overall would recommend but if having unclear instructions or lack of communication is a deal breaker, this class isn't for you.
She was an awesome teacher! I tore my acl during the semester and she was very easy to work with. I didn't go into class very much because of the injury, but it did not negatively effect me.

Rita Adamson-Schwisow is an empathetic teacher who is easy to work with. She shows care for her students and their success. She has great industry experience to teach from. Her class is not overly difficult, but it is not an easy A either. Her lectures are engaging and she gives class time to work on a lot of the assignments.
This course was exactly what an online student wants. Not lecture heavy, or creating unnecessary busy work. 10/10 would recommend!

Rita keeps class fun and entertaining. Super easy A if you just show up to class. All of the homework she will give you in class time to work on and collaborate with your peers. She is not the best at communicating or using canvas which can make things confusing, like due dates. But overall great professor, super knowledgable and a great resource.

Rita is great. Class is easy if you attend lectures, she makes them short but informational. She helps you prepare for whatever future career you want by improving your LinkedIn and helping you prepare for interviews. Overall, great class.
Rita is super nice and understanding and doesn't like to assign too much busy work.
This class helps you prepare for your future career. She brought in guest speakers and we made a presentation for future job interviews. Great teacher, always willing to help.
Rita Adamson-Schwisow was one of my favorite professors and the MKTG 4760 class was great. I felt like I was learning real life skills that I could use in my profession after graduation. 10/10.
Great Class, Great Professor. Learned a ton and lectures were very beneficial to real world situations.

The class was very understandable and engaging, we used tools and skills that will be beneficial in the process of getting a job and maintaining one. Overall I a very fun class and a wonderful professor.

Rita prepares you well for a sales position. You must be in class if you want to understand how to do the assignments. She is super understanding and works with you on extensions or missing assignments.
Very easy class! Fun vibes! I looked forwarded to coming to this class.
Casual, yet professional. Very understanding in case there are issues with grades, assignments, absences, etc.

I liked the class. Assignments weren't too difficult to get done. However, if you're the type of person who is busy with work almost most of the time, I will maybe look into a different instructor since there are some assignments were you need to participate in clubs or events and that messed up my grade since I was unable to attend.

This class helped me have a better understanding of what it is like to be a sales rep. I am very certain that after taking this class, sales is something I want to pursue, and I leave the class with energy and excitement for my future.
This is a good class and Prof Rita is knowledgable and energetic.
I enjoyed Prof. Rita. She definitely knows the material and has a lot of energy.

Sources that this class introduced me to will be very beneficial in any business setting. Attendance isn't required, but Prof goes over the assignment and gives in class time to complete it.  Exams were not difficult but very time-consuming. Very understanding and easy-going professor with lots of experience and knowledge to share!

I am not someone who plans to go into sales, but I feel that this class was still useful and taught me some solid apps and programs that I had no idea existed. I felt that the exams weren't necessarily difficult, but were extremely tedious and took a very long time. Sales is not for me, but I still enjoyed the class!

I felt like this course prepared me for a role in sales after graduation. She taught us how to use applicable tools like LinkedIn, HubSpot, and ZoomInfo. The class was easy if I attended because she tended to explain assignments and class schedules in class rather than on Canvas. Class never went for the full 3 hours which was nice.
This course was fun and great for learning how to take on interviews after college. I am happy I took this course and would recommend it to everyone.

Participation matters. If you don't attend classes, you will have trouble understanding. If you do attend, it is super easy.  It is 3h class but she leaves us most of the time for 1h and a half. She also brought some specialists to class, which was helpful in understanding how the "sales" are.

MKTG 4760 has been one of my favorite classes in my college experience. Her incorporation of real life tools such as LinkedIn, Zoom Info, and HubSpot truly prepare you for a job outside of college unlike any other class I have taken.

Rita is extremely caring and understanding, and is very flexible when it comes to submitting late work. She also has great connections in the business world and is always willing to offer help where she can. Ask her lots of questions!!!

There are assignments due at the end of almost every class that you won't know how to do unless you are present. Sometimes instructions can be unclear for homework but she is really reasonable to talk to.
Rita was an amazing professor. She really does care about her students and is willing to help out! I had a rough semester and she was so kind and checked up on me. I definitely recommend taking her.

Rita overall is a great professor who is passionate about what she is teaching. She doesn't assign excess amounts of homework and all the assignments work to help you complete the final and midterm. It is key to attend class to understand what you need to do for assignments because she shares information that isn't usually translated onto Canavs.

Rita is a great professor. She's very understanding of student's workload, and there are not too many assignments. If you attended the lecture, she would almost always give time to finish all homework for the week. The only thing I disliked was how slow her grading was. It made it difficult to know where your grade was at through the course.

Rita is awesome (2nd class w her). She is a super good connection to have when looking for jobs in the future, especially in sales roles. However, the class is unorganized and it's difficult to know your standing in the class. I ended up with a lower grade than expected because assignments were not graded quickly and instructions were unclear.
This was overall a great class. It was nicely set up with a good balance of group work and individual assignments.
Rita is very helpful and engaging with students. She knows what she is talking about and is a great mentor/resource.
Rita's great! She took personal time to help me fine tune my resume and Linkedin. Would highly recommend!!
If you have to take this class, try to get Rita because it is the easiest class ever.

Rita is great! Class never goes the full 3 hours but she gives enough time every class to do the assignments. The assignments are always straight forward and she'll help you if you need it. I feel like everything in this class is actually helpful and applicable, there's no busy work.
Super easy class and professor. Said attendance was going to be mandatory but then never followed up with that. She is super nice as well.

I loved this professor. She cared so much about students and their mental health. Her tests were online, which relived so much stress. I am not even a marketing major, but I am looking to take another class from her. She is very experienced and has some of the best lectures i have ever seen, very interactive. Very easy to get an A.

I honestly really liked Rita. She took FOREVER to grade assignments but the class was super easy. She is super funny and I always enjoyed her class. She gets all of her exam and homework questions from the textbook so I recommend taking notes on the chapter summaries it was super helpful for me. Definitely take her over the other 3040 professors!!!
She is a great person but seemed very unorganized at times.

Rita is very nice! She wants you to understand material and grasp concepts by using real world examples and hands on, in class assignments. Her slides are text heavy, but are a great tool for studying for the 4 midterms. There is no comprehensive final. She's easy to get ahold of and is accommodating and understanding. Take her over Prof. Sandomir!

She only reads the words on the slides. Disengaged, lack of enthusiasm, and lack of skills. She seems like a nice person but stubborn for some matters. Easy grade, easy pass. If you are not a marketing person, take it from her for easy credit. If you have passion in marketing, then don't.

Rita seems like a great person. She is approachable and receptive. That being said, she struggles with lectures. Often times she would say, "Let's just get through this," as she was reading the slides word-for-word. Nothing disengages students like a disengaged professor. Even in a required course, I would love to see enthusiasm for the subject.

This class was easy, lectures were fun and felt super short. She offered extra credit and you actually learned a lot in this class. She has to tweak a few things still like grading things faster but as long as you do the HW you will pass. Study for the tests.

this was daniel's first time teaching an undergrad stats course. multiple times in the semester, he noticed that we weren't all following the material and he took the time to slow down, reexplain, and make sure we understood. that means a lot! he's very clear on what he's looking for in assignments, gives extra credit, and overall is a cool guy!

Took his SOC 3112 class and was very impressed since it was his first semester teaching this class. He worked hard to make sure the class understood topics and would even spend time on topics over multiple days when needed. He offered extra credit on random class days so I recomend attending class frequently to get the most out of it.
Awesome professor, in my opinion! Made stats so interesting.

Overall, I learned a lot in Daniel's stats 2 class. Great course for developing both applied stats skills and solid intro to stats. I didn't enjoy the experience of taking this course. There was this sink or swim mentality in the class which was unnecessary.
Daniel is very knowledgeable and gave a good intro to stata. He can be flaky and unreliable. He had office hours for students but wouldn't show up to them and took months to grade assignments.

I took Daniel's graduate level statistics course and did learn quite a bit of skills. He has a very hands on approach to teaching which is helpful for learning stata. However, I found Daniel to be unapproachable with the material. He is clearly very knowledgeable but not very good at meeting students where they are.
Very good professor and very nice. Easy to talk to if you have problems. Brings pizza to exam days and gives very good advice for career. Would take again.

One of the worst professors I have had. Failed to grade labs and group case studies until the day final grades were due to the university. Had no idea where my grade was all semester. Issues with group project and he did not respond to any requests sent to him via email. Grades very harshly when he does grade. Pick anyone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Don't bother with the extra credit. He will ONLY apply the extra credit if it does NOT bump your grade to the next percentage. If the extra credit bumps your grade to the next percentage grade, he will not apply the extra credit. He informed our class of this the last day of the semester. Did extra work for no reason.

He will not grade any assignments until the last week of the semester. When he does grade your assignments, he is a harsh grader with little feedback. However, his feedback doesn't matter at that point because all of your assignments are past due. I never knew where my grade was, and he was impossible to reach outside of class.

Well respected and obviously knows his stuff. However, I have noticed that he barely mentions anything on the quizzes or exams. You are obviously expected to read as this is a college course, however he probably only mentions about 15-20% of the terms you are actually tested on. If you have the chance take this course with another professor.

Biochem is a hard topic, but Dr Puri makes it as easy as possible. He is such an amazing teacher and actually cares about his students. The exams are what you would expect and only content taught in lecture is tested. 

There is a project instead of an exam which can bump your grade up too.

Professor Puri genuinely cares about his students. Learns people's names and is super kind. 
His lectures are good. The course is well structured. Only complain is the lack of a practice exam. Lecture notes are published on canvas. Teaches well and clearly knows the content.

Professor Puri makes biochem 2 as smooth as possible but that does not mean that it is an easy course. The pacing of the lectures was a bit slow but it helps to cement important ideas that will show up on exams. He is a great lecturer and really helps people stay engaged in the course.

Prof. Puri does a great job making a lot of material seem simple and straightforward. I agree with prior posts stating that he understands how students learn, and does so both effectively and with good humor. Tests are fair and concise and there is no issue understanding the questions.
Prof. Puri is literally the BEST PROFESSOR IN THE DEPARTMENT. He is difficult and the midterms make up a lot of the grade. However, I would take it again with him any day of the week.
Phenomenal professor. Absolutely amazing. Definitely take it from him if you ever have to take this course. Super nice and caring. He really knows what he's talking about and his exams are very fair.

Great teacher, he definitely understands how students learn. There are plenty of resources to get help, and he structures his lectures to help you understand both the biology and the biochemistry. This helped me understand the "why" behind a lot of these biochemical reactions. He focuses on arrow pushing which makes reactions make 'more sense'.

Professor Puri is hands down a top tier professor at the U. He genuinely cares about every infle student and their success. He will answer student questions until everyone gets it. He is also funny and his lectures are interesting and not overwhelming. I cannot recommend him enough. One of the best!

Professor Puri is great, communicates material very effectively, and is concise. Expectations are clear and fair, but exams are graded incredibly harshly. The material is not terribly difficult, but making one tiny mistake can make you lose 20% of your grade. Better weighting of exams could fix those problems.

Dr. Puri has become one of the best professors I have ever had. Weekly lectures took only about an hour to get through but he was very thorough in his explanations. Exams and quizzes came straight from powerpoint lectures, never used the book. One paper due during the semester but was easy to put together. Definitely take him for biochem!!!

AP was amazing! Would recommend him to anyone. He is one of those professors who understands students and works for us. His lectures were always super interesting; course projects were relevant and allowed real world practice. Felt like he actually cared about us as individuals and wanted us to succeed. You should 1000% take his class.

Personally found the in class lectures to be kind of boring since it was just Professor Phillips talking for most of the session. This class will help you with public speaking if you struggle with it. Phillips grades strictly on some assignments, less on others. Sometimes you don't really know what grade you're gonna get.

Professor Phillips is hilarious and cares about what he is teaching. While there isn't a strict no phones policy, I rarely found myself ignoring his lectures on a screen due to how engaging he is. Professor Phillips also cares about his students individually and works to give the highest reasonable grade. He is an excellent guy and professor.
Great person, Great Professor

Phillips is passionate and wants students to succeed, but the course was frustrating. Two exams were 50% of the grade and very specific, testing small lecture details over concepts. Lectures had minimal slides, making review hard. I did well on projects but still got a C+ due to exams. Even with heavy studying, the detail made exams very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Grade relies on speeches

He was a fun professor and every class was very enjoyable. His grading was a bit tougher than expected, but nothing ridiculous. He encouraged participation in class and I made so many good friends through the small groups he put us in.

He's a great guy who takes the time to get to know each student in the class. There isn't much work outside of class at all, but he is very strict on grading and won't give out high scores very easily.
Fun guy with a lot of energy. He cares about his students and just wants you to learn. He is a stickler on his grading tho.

AP is great! He emphasizes that he is always available to help outside of class. For MGT 3810 get ready for lots of public speaking. I hate public speaking but he makes it feel very welcoming and low-key. I've definitely gotten lots of practice with presentation skills in his class. Overall 10/10 would recommend!

Every class felt like a waste of time. Everything is common sense imo. He's a nice guy, but def needs to chill. His grading doesn't make sense; you can get marked down by .35 of a percent on some assignments. It's a super easy class, but if attendance weren't required, I wouldn't go cuz it's a waste of time.

In class, his lectures are great and not boring. He has energy and it shows that he loves to teach. He is a tough grader though, rarely gives out 100% to people in the class. His "exams" can ask very specific questions which makes them difficult but not impossible. These are the only main negative aspects. He is lenient with due dates if you ask.

AP is a wonderful professor who truly cares about his students. His energy and enthusiasm made lectures enjoyable. There was occasional group work and a few guest lectures as well. Would 100% take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: AVOID Professor Phillips, if possible. He tells his students in the first week that he will grade harshly because his grades can't be too high. Doesn't give out 100%'s. The only assignments I have gotten 100 on have been the exams that have only been multiple-choice questions. For online speeches, he takes off 50 points for camera angle andearbuds.
Great enthusiastic professor that is passionate about their content and wants their students to learn
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: AP was an incredible professor. He has lots of energy and made learning about communication fun and inspiring. He does grade a little hard on the assignments, I never received 100% on any assignment. He is lenient and flexible with due dates. This is the type of professor hat really want to see you succeed. I highly recommend him.

This is a weird guy. Failed an assignment because of two writing mistakes, but acts like a chill guy in person. Can tell he's very old school because he wants all the attention and will kick you out of class for being on your phone. Runs around the classroom during his lecture and will assign you A LOT of hw.

Aaron Phillips is super nice and understanding. He doesn't have an assistant so he does all the grading by himself and gives you really good feedback. I took his class online and he made weekly guidance videos which was really helpful. He is also always willing to give you an extension if you needed more time on an assignment. Highly recommend!

AP was by far my favorite professor this semester. I learned so much from his class, and it is all applicable outside of school! He is very flexible about due dates and understanding. He is also hilarious and makes class really fun and engaging. Assignments/quizzes are easy if you meet requirements and pay attention in class.

AP is a great professor, he really is! Super funny, knows how to get the attention of the class, and overall is a lighter hw load than most. However, he is one of the harshest graders on campus! Whether it is a quiz, presentation, speech or a paper, do not expect full points. Quiz questions are usually pretty niche things as well :/

Left this class so disappointed. He raised the A from 93 to 95 because too many people had A's and he needed to keep a "high academic standard". I never once got full credit on an assignment - closest was 29.5/30 which is absolutely ridiculous. Takes everything was too seriously, and expects CEO treatment from his students

The class is interesting and informative. There are a few big assignments you have to do so give yourself ample time to complete them. Some of the assignments were due at 5 PM. Professor Phillips gives great feedback and you know exactly what you were docked on and what you did well on.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Aaron is a professor that truly cares about his students! He is a great professor and you are missing out if you don't take a class from him.

love him! great upper division writing credit because it is pretty easy. mostly just discussion posts. he does grade the bigger assignments kind of harshly (in my opinion) but i also just suck at life sometimes so that could be my bad. he is super chill though and you can tell he actually likes his job unlike many profs
Great guy! Highly recommend for 3815/3810

AP stands out as one of the best, if not the best professor I have had at the U. He truly cares quite a bit about each student and will invest considerable time in your success. He could teach at an Ivy. He provides good feedback and will listen to student input carefully. Each assignment is purposeful and this class has little to no busywork.

Loved this guy! One of my most fav professors. Lots of energy and really cares. My only thing is I dont think he should be teaching this calls (3815) personally I think all the stuff could have been covered in writing 2010. Such a good professor I think he should be utilized in teaching other courses. There wasnt a lot to go over in this course

He really cares about his students and is willing to work with you. His assignments are thoughtful and take time, but they are not just busy work. He ended up moving some due dates around because he knew it was a stressful time for his students. He wants you to learn and pass, you just have to put in the work.

AP is a great professor who really wants his students to learn, you can see it in the way he teaches. He is very interactive in class with entertaining content. Some times he reminds me of Michael Scott with his jokes, but also with how he cares for his students.

AP!!! I truly loved this class and felt like Professor Phillips cared about me as a human. He knew all of our names and remembered small things about us that just made, me at least, feel special. He creates meaningful assignments that you truly want to do well on. He respects hard work and rewards it.

AP never gives any students full credit on any assignment no matter how simple. He probably has a homework assignment due every day and expects them to all be extremely well written and in depth. No matter how hard students try they will never receive a 100% on any project his highest grades on assignments are always 90%. HOMEWORK HEAVY

Aaron Phillips is a professor who takes business and professional communication way too seriously.  He assigns too many homework assignments that require too much depth and effort for it all to be theoretical.  Aaron Phillips is the professor to not give a single student full credit on a basic homework assignment.

AP is one of the best professors here at the U! He makes lectures always interesting and fun. Participation does matter, but this is a class I loved going to. He is always willing to help his students and gives great feedback on every assignment you turn in. Honestly, you will take a lot away from this class and have so much fun.

After 3 years of college, Professor Phillips is my favorite professor I've ever had. His class is the only one I've ever enjoyed. Assignments are practical and legitimately helped me find a job and feel more comfortable in the business world. Would recommend completely!

AP is the man, could not recommend him enough. One of the few professors who has really left a positive impact on me. Wants to see you become a better writer and gives amazing feedback. Great guy all around and made my last semester here enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: AP is such an amazing professor. He is very energetic which makes the class more fun. He gives assignments that are fun, and they are also meaningful in the way they can be applied to concepts taught in class. AP is also great at providing feedback on assignments. He is always willing to meet if people have questions.
Knowledgeable professor, cares about students' progress and learning. Interactive speaker, flamboyant personality which makes material fun. He's big on group work and communication in this course.

Professor AP is the bomb. His class does require participation and for you to be in class, but it is well worth it. I learned a ton and was able to enhance my public speaking and writing skills. He is very organized on Canvas by weeks, and outlines in a weekly announcement clearly what needs to be done in preparation for the coming week.

Great teacher!  AP seems like he really enjoys his job and it makes class so much better. He is entertaining to listen to and he creates fun and interesting assignemntes. Great class, would take it again.
AP was one of the best professors I have had. He did an excellent job teaching the material. He did an excellent job making sure we got a good grade in this class. He wanted us to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Nice guy but all the assignments are pointless. Hella stressful assignments for no reason. Waste of time.
AP is fantastic. He really shows students that he cares. Going to class is important because he makes pop up activities in class so make sure you are there!

AP was such an awesome and flexible professor. He truly cares about the success of his students and was always available for additional help outside of class. He also has a very fun personality and would always come to class excited to teach. Not a lot of homework but you learn a lot. As long as you do the work, you'll be great in this class.

AP is a phenomenal teacher. He truly cares about his students and what he is teaching. The class was online but he still was able to give amazing feedback and was available for help. Pretty easy to get an A if you do all your work and he doesn't have too many assignments. A great class for business credit.

One of the best professors I've had at the U. I learned a great deal. Professor provides usable feedback to improve on speaking + writing skills and was very understanding during this time of online classes- if you need an extension, just ask! The workload was reasonable as well. Glad I got this opportunity to take this class w/ Professor Phillips!

Professor Phillips was an amazing professor who clearly knew and cared about what he was teaching. He was so animated and made coming to class very enjoyable! He somehow makes a nearly 2 hour class fly by. I would take every class with Phillips if it were possible.

AP was incredible. His classroom was inclusive and comfortable. He was a positive, light hearted, engaging professor with a desire to help every student achieve. He gives very realistic assignments with straight forward instruction. He will make you feel like you are an incredible person who deserves the best that life has to offer. He's amazing!!!
One of the best professors Ive ever had. He can grade kinda tough sometime, but hes always willing to work with students and is very understanding. Super entertaining lectures too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: AP is an exceptional professor. He wants you to succeed as a student, and provides you with the information and tools to do so. You aren't allowed to use technology unless given authorization for specific assignments. I enjoyed that rule, because it created an atmosphere of giving your full attention to class. Will taking another class form AP.

Not only is Dr Phillips a great professor, he also genuinely cares about his students success. He provides excellent feedback on all assignments and is even willing to give you direction outside of the course work. Most assignments are fairly easy but will assist in your professional growth. But dont skip class because participation does matter.

Professor Philips is hands down the best professor I have ever had. Not only is he one of the most personal people, but he truly cares about student's success as a whole. All expectations were clearly stated and he gave us tools that were above and beyond what we needed to complete them.

There were hardly any homework assignments, but group projects and in class work offset grades and made it easy to know how you were doing! He was so dynamic with his lectures and, as a result, made sure everyone was interested and involved. I would take this class again if I could!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: AP is awesome, he really cares about helping his students succeed. His lectures are really interesting and easy to pay attention to. This class is not too difficult, no formal tests, just papers, individual projects. He really cares about participation and attendance so don't miss class. Side note- he will call you out for using your phone in class

AP is wonderful. Colorful, super likable, makes class enjoyable even with dry material. One of my favorite teachers I've ever had. HOWEVER, he's a hard grader. I've never had a problem writing papers, but I'd put a ton of work in and receive B's on my assignments and projects. Attendance is crucial.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: By far the greatest professor I've had. He's more than willing to work with you and help you succeed while still creating a challenging and fun environment.

AP is a good professor! He cares about the success of each of his students. He does grade pretty harsh, however he gives good feedback. He tries to make each of his lectures entertaining. Cell phones and laptops are not tolerated. Overall he is a good professor!

Great guy full of energy, I loved this class. AP is great with feedback and is always willing to help you actually learn the material. He's easy to listen to lecture and gives good feedback. I would definitely recommend.

Professor Phillips was by far one of my favorite professors I have had. His lectures were all interesting, fun to listen to, and easy to follow. He does a couple in class assignments so its important to go to class. Phillips is very understanding and will help you out if you communicate with him. I really enjoyed this class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: AP is one of the best professors at the U. You can just tell that he cares about the success of his students so much. His lectures are always interesting and full of energy. Take him if you can!

This class is really fun and has a different kind of challenge. Instead of memorizing equations, principles, and lectures it requires a lot more interaction and challenges your public speaking skills. The professor is also very supportive and a well rounded intellectual. He helps you where you need it and is very flexible.

An INCREDIBLE professor. By far one of the best professors I have ever had. He is very intelligent, funny, and caring. I had him for Business Communications (MGT 3810) and Foundations of Business (BUS 1050). I loved both. You definitely need to read and go to class, his classes are tough, and you get the grade you deserve. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
Aaron is a great teacher. He is a bit of a stickler on grammar and papers though. I really enjoyed taking his classes.
Dr. Phillips is an awesome professor! Seek out advice from him on assignments and it will help you succeed. As long as you listen and do what he asks, you'll be golden.

I had Dr. Phillips for MGT 3810 a communications class. Dr. Phillips is really funny and makes class enjoyable. He is definitely a tough grader but make sure you communicate with him and ask for his help and you'll do fine in the class. Overall, I enjoyed the class.

Phillips is a very inspiring teacher, I am not a business major, nor do I plan to be, but this class was very interesting to me. I would definitely suggest taking it. As long as you show up to most of the lectures, there is very little work involved (beyond studying and reading).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's a great guy and extremely dynamic when he lectures. He will be very meticulous when grading so expect to proofread even your comments on discussion posts for errors.

He just got his doctorate last year, which seems to make him feel entitled, because he will nit-pick anything you turn in and dock you points. For a 3000 level class, his grading methods are a joke. Unless you are perfect, expect a B at best.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He gave wonderful lectures considering the course content is very dry on its own. You need to read the book to pass the class, and attending the lectures will help immensely with your comprehension. He tends to digress from his original points, but appears to really care about the content and his students.

I was particularly worried about taking this professional communication class because the grading is clearly very subjective. However, I was pleasantly surprised to find that Professor Phillips is very reasonable with his grading (something I have rarely found with writing professors). I would strongly suggest taking MGT 3810 with him.

There's only 2 tests, and 3 quizzes. Not an extremely difficult class, but you have to read a lot and comprehend it even better. He's very helpful and really cool too. Good lectures. Very fun guy and easy to listen too.

This is probably one of the easiest English/Writing class I've ever taken. Aaron is very supportive and always is willing to help out. There were just a couple assignments that I had difficulty understanding how to do it, but besides that this class was straight forward, instructions were crystal clear, and very easy. TAKE THIS CLASS!!! RECOMMENDED

Aaron's online class is a piece of cake. He is by far the best writing teacher at the U and made me enjoy the class. My writing has drastically improved and I credit him for that. Low time commitment and short papers. Don't hesitate to take this class!

I'm in the online class right now and it's one of the best classes I've taken so far in my college career. Aaron is the best and is very quick in his e-mail responses. He's a very fair grader, too. You have about one writing assignment due each week & peer reviews. They're very short assignments..the longest we've had is 750 words. TAKE THIS CLASS!

Aaron is fantastic.  He interacts well with students and is extremely fair with his grading. Aaron is a great teacher; I actually enjoyed going to class.  I would recommend any course from him without hesitation.

Aaron really gets you to think about writing from a rhetorical standpoint to make the best impact on your audience. Class was never boring. Even though it was my earliest class I always enjoyed going. I think Aaron has helped my writing more than any other professor ive had spending a lot of time and grammar & word choice to really improve writing

He relied more on his personal tastes for grading than on writing ability. If he didn't like the subject matter or the writing style, the grade was lower and his grading notes didn't explain otherwise. The class was fun, but someone else should teach it.
Phillips is awesome! He is a funny guy, who makes you feel comfortable and not afraid to ask questions. He is very understanding and is always willing to help out!

Phillips makes the classroom a laid back enviroment, easing students into subjects that can be very difficult to understand. He makes students with no previous interest in writing come out of there shell and do something few people ever do. . . THINK!

Aaron's class is fun and it's NOT difficult to get a good grade.  He provides the entertaining and casual setting required for good learning.  If the student works hard and sincerely tries to improve his writing skills he'll be fine.

Took WRTG 1010 and 2010 with Lovik. I get why some people avoid his classes, but I actually really liked them. He's a pretty chill guy and gives interesting assignments. Heads up, he's a tough grader and not super flexible, but he's really understanding and does his best to help you out. His rules are super clear from the start. Get ready to think!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Ron doesn't teach you writing. He teaches you rigid philosophy and is hyper obsessed with structure. His feedback is unhelpful, vague, and passive aggressive. All I learned in that class was that he is a prude for philosophy and Peter Singer readings. 1 essay every week. If you need a basic writing credit, go elsewhere. You won't learn anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Lovik's "Writing 1010" is a philosophy gradudate course in disguise. Obsessed with rigid structure, bans emotional writing, gives vague and unhelpful feedback, drills endless Peter Singer essays. You won't learn real writing. Very tough grader. Cares more about structure than real writing. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!

Lovik was a great professor and made his lectures pretty interesting. He was very laid back and willing to work with students if they had any problems. I took him for writing 1010 and 2010 and got the best grades I've gotten on my writing before. He makes sure to give feedback so you know what you can improve on which I appreciate.

This class was not writing focused but philosophy. Graded based on philosophical ideas and not always the writing. He graded tough on the arguments. The papers are always counter arguments against philosophers with multiple PhDs. So many papers on animal ethics. Essays every week and due before each class so there is no way to receive help.
This class is basically just a philosophy class. He's a tough grader and he's not that fun to be around either. You will hate Peter Singer, and you will not have fun. ever.

Ron wasn't a bad teacher just a bit hard to follow throughout class. It was hard to take effective notes and his questions to the class for participation pts seemed broad. There are papers every week and they arent super hard but the grading is on the tougher side. I emailed him abt excused pts from family deaths and he never responded.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: The class is about logical consistency and making essays easier with an outline. The papers have you argue the opposite side's stance each week: First, about animal treatment and then human population concerns. Read his feedback on each essay, talk to him, read looking for the claim, spend more time outlining, and follow the misc references page.

Follow the instructions, or you will lose points, read and write the papers throughout the week, or stress out over the essay the day before. The readings can be hard to follow, so eliminate all distractions. If you see the same feedback, stay after class and TALK TO THE PROFESSOR. Participate in every class as it may save your grade.

Ron does a great job explaining that he simply wants you to think critically. His papers come with fairly simple instructions and if you're a somewhat good writer you should have no problem with this class. His teaching method favors those who can actually formulate ideas for themselves so if you do take this class be ready to do so. I'd recommend!

Sorry Ron, but I didn't like your class.
First of all, he assigns one essay EVERY WEEK. This was definitely more of a philosophy class and coming up with the arguments was HARD! It hurt my brain with all the morality stuff. Get ready to hate Peter Singer, too. I'm thankful for the challenge and practice, but I'm so happy that this class is over.

Does not do well with explaining how papers should be done. We learn the material the week after it is due which makes it harder to receive a good grade in the class because the students have no idea what they are doing. Highly do not recommend this professor.

I did not enjoy this class at all. His grading was unclear he left passive aggressive feedback that didn't help me towards my next papers. The very first paper I wrote was the hardest one. More of a philosophy class rather than writing. Essays every week and your main focus is on Peter Singer and animal rights.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lovik loves to pride himself on how impartial he is when grading papers, I have to say this is the most partial impartial class I have ever taken. 10 papers on complicated philosophical arguments plus one final paper. Lovik is an incredibly harsh last second grader who leaves vague comments for how to improve your papers. Dodge this teacher!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Lovik's lectures are the most interesting I've ever had. Participation isn't mandatory, but it is graded. He is a very fair grader. he will grade you well if your writing is good even if he doesn't agree with your views. The lectures never have slides or anything, They are entirely discussion based which is really nice. Highly recommend.

You write 11 papers about philosophical articles over the last 11 weeks. Ron has his "correct opinions" on these articles so beware. There is never any explanation for why you lost points, and most of the comments left on your papers are condescending. I almost failed this course because my final paper would not load on his end. All around terrible

The best you will have IF you work for it. Although the course does not "require" rhetorical devices of philosophy, it be better if you have prior knowledge OR read LOGIC and papers that contain philosophical structuring, otherwise you will fail. He will not spoon feed you. Will teach you how to TRULY write without personal opinions, but REASON.

Weekly essays and lecture participation. You are given about a 10 page paper by a professional philosopher and asked to write a single argument in a specific given outline. It's a ton of thinking, I had to carve out a whole day every week just to write my essay. It's more of a philosophy class IMO, it's tough but will change your points of view.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is not a writing class it's a philosophy class. You will learn nothing about writing but be graded by doing things wrong that you are never taught not to do! There is a 4-page weekly paper & they all are argumentative and revolve around Peter Singer. You write 10 papers and a final all on one subject. You will learn nothing about writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was definitely more of a philosophy class than writing. If you are looking at a class to help you learn how to write different types of papers, this class is NOT for you. You will write a 2-3 page paper each week, always argumentative. I wish I had a different professor because I wanted to learn about different writing styles.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Reading to accompany a weekly writing paper. Final paper as well. Argumentative papers with a specific 3 step format. Strong teacher that helps to develop new writing and thinking skills.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class literally made me stress tf out. He assigns a reading every week and from these you have to come up with an argument and write an essay every week of the semester. Not only that but the readings are all on the same topic so it's like you're going back and forth. He also is a tough grader and doesn't tell you how you can improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Lovik himself is funny, has interesting lectures, and is always willing to help. What's irritating is the weird grading criteria (which he never explains, even if you ask him) and the lack of feedback he gives in essays. I would say it's a good and interesting class, helps you identify logical fallacies in your arguments/opinions.

Ron is a very genuine professor with clear intentions about what he wants, his class is quite philosophical which definitely helped me increase my thought process but at the same time frustrating. MLA format is not taught as the class focuses on thought. 10 papers due weekly and one final paper, class is doable if you can adapt and work.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I'm not sure if I just have trouble understanding this class but Prof. Ron's class is difficult to understand. This is my first C in 3 years at the U, and this is the one class to provide that. This is also a philosophical class that argues one idea the entire semester. If you're not ready to write a 4 page paper weekly on the same topic, avoid!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Very objective, and teaches with clarity. Very helpful when answering questions, and is communicative outside of class via email. Also very personable and willing discuss homework related topics outside of class for additional help.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Ron is one of the best professors I've had. Although I feel as I did not do well during the beginning, Ron helped me get on my feet halfway into the course. He gave me a much better insight on my work, and offered a lot of advice during his lectures. I learned many important aspects of writing from Ron, and I recommend that you take a class of his!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this writing 2010 class. Ron helped create a writing environment that promoted critical thinking that will help prepare me for real life situations. I would recommend this class to all my fellow students. He was great at getting a discussion going and making people feel comfortable in participating.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took this class in Fall 2016, but Ron was so great that I had to come back just to rate this class. Ron is funny, respectful, and he really gives great feedback and help on every assignment. I would recommend any class by Ron, he is as good as it gets.

Excellent class and superb professor. Ron is extremely knowledgeable of subject matter and he seamlessly relates the course material to real life experiences. He challenges each student to think critically and objectively as they navigate the course. He created an atmosphere where students could speak freely. Absolutely masterful teacher!!

Easily the most enjoyable class I've ever had the pleasure of attending. Ron is easy to talk to, understanding and an easy-going guy. Truly enjoyed every lecture and always appreciated his way of conveying his ideas and thoughts. This class was always full of laughter and I always looked forward to it. Thank you Ron

His premise was that better thinking leads to better writing. He did an awesome job in pushing students to think critically about how people write and what they say. I believe that the critical thinking taught in this writing course leads to success in any academic class that follows. Plus, Ron was pretty hilarious, class was fun and easy to go to.

Ron is an awesome teacher. He actually makes a writing class interesting! He's also probably one of the realist homies on the U of U faculty. This class is fairly easy. Just show up to class and be capable of forming a rational opinion for your papers and your good. They should definitely pay this guy a lot because quality is excellent!
Great teacher

Ron is very intelligent about what he teaches. His lectures are very important so be sure to attend, and you'll be fine. He engages his students for the entire amount of time and keeps the whole class involved in the subject. He requires little homework and is very straight forward in what he expects. Definitely one of the best professors out there

The class in and of itself is not very hard, but his way of thinking drives me up the wall. If you take this class, be ready for a philosophy coarse, not a writing coarse. You write one paper every week on the exact same topic, it never changes, and you just debate it to the ground all semester. Gets old v fast.

Great professor! 2 rules: come to class and write one paper a week. Very easy class if you do that! He assigns 12 papers, but you only need to do 10. The final is a 6 page essay. He doesn't use a textbook or assign books, just a short article a week. Good feedback on papers, doesn't grade on grammar, only that you present a good argument.
Well worth taking the class, just follow the directions and show up to class. He will work with you and he has great feedback. Take the class it's worth it!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Before I took this class I wasn't the strongest writer. But Ron helps expand your mind and makes you actually think in a different perspective than most writing professors! He helped me develop skills that I never thought I'd have. This class was the best I've taken at the U. I love Ron!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Ron made my class such a great experience. Every week I was excited to attend class because he is so passionate about what he teaches that it makes lectures much easier to stay awake for. He is very clear with grading and helping clear things that you don't understand. You will write several papers but all the topics are generally interesting!

Ron is a fantastic professor; he is probably the best professor I've had at the U thus far. This class will challenge the way you think and write, but isn't so overbearing that you can't handle the workload. Everyone should take this course from Ron!

Ron is the coolest professor I've had at the U. He is so real with students its refreshing. You have to write 10 papers and a final, and you have to go to class to get participation. He focuses way more on getting your brain to think about how to write than he does on simple grammar and what not. 10/10 would recommend.

Ron was an amazing writing professor! He focuses on critical thinking rather than punctuation, spelling, etc. His lectures are usually really fun and interesting. The papers you have to write aren't horrible, their based on interesting topics. Only thing I didn't like is he doesn't use Canvas, so you aren't completely sure what your grade is.
Awesome class if you're into critical thinking, argument, and philosophy.

Mr. Lovik was hands down the best writing professor that I've had at the University of Utah.  Rather than focusing on format, punctuation, and verbiage, he's more interested in getting your brain to work and think about situations down to the core. Writing is a subject that I typically struggle with and therefor don't enjoy, but his class was great
A great way to broaden your horizons and see things from a great different perspective!

I was used to the typical classes where you just had to produce work and get a grade.  Lovik makes you work for your grade.  Frustrating, but insightful.  Amazing professor.  Have to do hard work, but it's worth it.  Totally would take another class from him.  I grew tired of writing about animal rights though. 10/10. Loved it!

Ron is the bomb. He is the best teacher I've ever had.  You have 12 papers assigned,  you choose the 10 that you want to do.  Besides that,  just a final paper that you will be well prepared for.  All you have to do is pay attention in class and take the time to think about your arguments. I learned so much in this class. I love Ron!!!

Ron is a great professor. I am a weak writer and he helped me become more objective and analytical. The class went well--he just requires active participation. He literally writes down your comments and grades them. I got used to to saying around 3 somewhat "intelligent" comments a class and got full participation points.

One of the most interesting classes I've had the pleasure of attending.  It will be tough, he picks some hard topics to write on, but overall it is worth it for the pure expanse of your mind.  His structural way of creating an argument and looking for possible counters really helps build skills as i noticed my writing improve over the semester.

Ron is truly passionate about what he does; he teaches how to write well and is damn good at it. I really had to try my best in his class, as a result, I was rewarded with an "A." Often, I had to argue against a viewpoint that I supported, this helped me become a much better writer, by learning to use facts instead of opinions.

Ron loves his lectures and expects you to participate. The class is a lot of work if you let it get to you. The articles you write paper on are really long, but you only have to do 10 out of the 13. There is one small paper (200 words) and then a long paper (2-3 pg) a week. He is there to help if you ask and is an overall great teacher.

Ron is a great professor, and the discussions were interesting. Participation does matter. There was a LOT of homework though, so if you can't commit at least a few hours every week to writing papers (2 papers every week), look elsewhere. Overall, it was a challenging, yet great course.

Ron is awesome! He makes class interesting and he makes you actually want to listen and not fall asleep.  There are quite a few assignments but I learned a lot and I really left that class feeling like I knew more. I honestly wish Ron taught more classes! I am pretty sure I will never have a professor as good as Ron!

This is a great class if you want to drown yourself with papers. Ron himself is an awesome professor however, there are two essays each week totalling 32 papers and then a 6-8 page final. Great professor, but I would look for another writing 2010 class if you want time for a life.

Insane amount of papers. Two papers per week. 32 papers per semester! Controlled my semester, difficult keeping up in other classes because of the work load in this class. You must read a philosophic article about the environment and then argue about it.
Interesting class. He kept my attention because he was funny and insightful.
I would totally recommend this teacher. He is interesting, funny, and worth the class time.

Very interesting professor. Very sociable and talkative. It was actually a very easy class to take so that was nice. Just have two papers to write, quizzes every now and then (which are easy as long as you listen to his lectures). I had a good experience in this class. You will too.

He is very interesting and i liked listening to his lectures. the concepts are hard but he is very fair, as long as to keep up with the weekly writing assignments. he is willing to help if you ask. i just had a hard time wrapping my hear around the concepts and what he expected.

Amazing teacher. Focused on the environment an animal rights for all writing assignments. Half of the class was online, which was just a blog submission to be done on friday nights - CAKE! He himself is loads of fun. Really enjoyed listening to his lectures; witty and funny.

Ron is my favorite professor ever-- he makes a boring subject and lecture into one where you are very engaged because he is so hilarious.  He was so good that I ended up taking both of his courses he teaches (WRTG 2010 and PHIL 1000)- both in which I thoroughly enjoyed (and I'm an engineer!)  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED- YOU WON'T REGRET IT

Ron's class is very easy! you only have to do 8 out of 15 weekly writing assignments and the final and midterm is an easy 5 pg paper on a topic already discussed. He grades you on participation which makes the grade even easier. I think the way he talks and taught was entertaining as well

Ron LOVES his subject! His class is basically an environmental philosophy class.  If you want to learn how to be a better thinker, take Ron's class.  He grades you on two things- whether you got the argument right and how clear you are.  8 2-page papers, 2 big argument papers.  Very fair grader.  He wants you to succeed.  And very unbiased.

Genuinely is so aggressive with any critiques on any type of paper. I don't even think he's the main professor of the class but if you see his name anywhere I wouldn't recommend taking it. It doesn't feel like he gives constructive or reasonable feedback everything is so passive aggressive and mean and ruined my confidence in writing.
