Extremely passionate about the subject matter, making learning and engaging more fun. Bans cell phones in class, shows that he cares.

Dr. Alf is fantastic. He's remarkably knowledgeable and is an excellent teacher. Class is always entertaining and fascinating, assignments are clear and well organized, and readings are relevant. This class challenged me to think about literature in ways I haven't before. It's hard work, but well worth it. I highly recommend this professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Alf remains the best professor I've ever taken. I've been graduated a year now and I just came back to write this review because his classes STILL affect me a year later. His lectures are amazing, he's incredibly caring, and he puts time and effort into your learning like no other professor. Do yourself a favor and take his class!!

While this was the hardest class I think I've ever taken, the professor did make it passable as long as you were willing to put in the time and effort. Don't think any of his classes will be easy, but I would say they are well worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I have taken 2090 and 5090 now, and Dr. Alf is easily the best teacher I've ever had. He's incredibly passionate about what he teaches. He makes every lecture engaging, and he seems to genuinely care about students and their opinions. His classes are not Easy-A's, but if you care about the material you will do well.
Awesome class. Best humanities credit I've ever taken

He is very passionate about what he does and keeps class interesting. His tests are not hard. If you study your notes, you'll probably get an A. There's a critical response page due almost every week, but they're easy. Dr. Alf is a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: QUICK NOTE: Do NOT take Alfs Lord of the Rings class if you have no interest in the subject matter. Only take this class if you are really invested in the subject. That being said, Alf is probably my favorite professor at the U. His lectures are inspiring, the text is a fun read, and assignments are very applicable. Class is well organized.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Seegert is probably the best professor I've ever had. I worked really hard in his class - the course is tough, but it's worth it. It gave me a good foundation for all my other coursework. Seegert's online content was really well organized and interesting. He gives really useful feedback on papers too.

Took his theory class last fall (late review). It was online, and there were always really interesting videos and movies that we got to watch. He makes the material applicable, since we watched cloud atlas, black mirror, etc. (things that we've probably watched). Not to be cliche, but he's by far my favorite professor, and I've never even met him.

Definitely one of the best professors at the U! Just as everyone has rated, he is a great and fantastic lecturer and knows how to organize the classroom to encourage discussion. Put your work into it and you will enjoy the course and do well, though it can be hard for someone who does not work hard.

Alf is the best professor you could ask for. He fosters student  conversation. I could tell he loves the content and cares about his student's  success. The vgs class has 9  500-word critical responses. They are every two weeks. There is a midterm and a final. If you pay attention and read you will do fine on the tests. Grading is fair.
Awesome professor.  Fun, interesting, and invested in what he teaches.

Don't take a class from Seegert unless you're very passionate about the subject matter. I'm a senior, and I've never taken a 2000-level class anywhere near this difficult. He will expect you to have done a very close reading of texts and paid extremely close attention in class. Midterm and final are in depth, no curve. Lectures are intimidating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Alf is easily my favorite professor. Taken him for several courses, and he always manages to teach me something new. He's on the cutting edge of new media pedagogy: always a movie clip or funny picture to illustrate important points. Great for visual learners, but he's also quite cerebral. Very intelligent guy.

One of the best teachers I have had at the U! Very knowledgeable in what he teaches. He has writing assignments based on the books or movies you watched but it is like half a page of writing. So easy! But it is not a class you can miss! I would retake the class again!

Dr. Seegert is amazing. Lots of reading, two discussions every week. There is a midterm and a final test, and there is a paper due around midterm + the final paper. The midterm paper is basically do it and you get full credit, which is nice. Dr. Seegert is funny and smart. He gives a ton of extra credit, too. I got points for pointing out a typo.

Dr. Seegert is intelligent, passionate, and genuinely has a gift for teaching complex information in an exciting and informative manner. He offers the most engaging material from various sources and offers unique perspectives (and allows students to form their own without judgement). TAKE CLASS FROM DR. SEEGERT.

It was online, so the lectures were pages of reading on top of the assigned reading and there was a lot of discussions. My favorite part was he used multiple forms of media and mediums to help you understand and engage with the complex theories you were reading about. I took this class without that element before and didn't learn a thing.

He's quite good, his 5 to 15 page (lots of pictures, so bit shorter) lessons are great, and way better than any lecture.  His syllabus says everything is required, and you have to read every reading and class will be  super hard, but its  just for show. Got A on mid term w/o reading. D- on final paper, still got B+ in class.  Very helpful feedback.

Alf is a great professor! I've taken a few classes from him but the 5010 Virtuality and re-enchantment was the only one I wasn't super sold on. We read some really awesome stuff and some really horrible stuff. This class is definitely an acquired taste.

Alf Seegert is one of those professors that strives to run an intellectually stimulating lecture that sticks with you for the rest of the day. His tests are rigorous but fair, and his weekly assignments are fun and thought provoking. He offers extra credit if you are willing to work for it. Well worth your time and tuition, take his class!

One of the best teachers I've ever had. Great discussion based lectures. Good assignments, always willing to provide the most help he can to his students. I'm not even all that into video games, but still loved the analysis and insight into them as a medium that this class provided.

Alf is an amazing professor! I've taken two classes from him and I wish I could take more. He is so passionate about what he teaches and he  is open to learning from his students. Conversations are never dull. There are usually three papers and he offers extra credit from time to time. Great professor!!

I took Alf's class a few semesters ago. He's so awesome that the next semester after I took his class, I decided to stop by the classroom just to listen to his lectures again. He makes learning fun, he's super engaging, and it was essentially an (intriguing and stimulating) English class except with video games as the literature. Super fair grader.

He makes it fun to learn. As long as you do the reading each week, you'll have a blast. And in this class, "reading" often meant "play cool video games." Also, take notes on key terms and characters, since they'll be on the cumulative final. I wish all professors loved teaching as much as Seegert.
Alf Seegart is the best professorteacher I have ever had and I will be looking for more classes of his in the years to come. Do yourself a favor and take a class of his!

He was a very excellent professor in which he was engaged in his lectures and provided thought provoking lectures and ideas which I found fascinating. He is very lenient with his points and deadlines.

Professor Seegert was amazing! You have to work for your A that is for sure. But you learn in this class. Even though it is online, he made is relatable and the material used is funny and memorable. Must take this class by him!

Examining video games as literature is amazing. The lectures are wonderful, the material is wonderful, and I love going to class (which is good, attendance is vital). Discussion is lively. I finally get to play video games for homework. Prof Seegert is a joy to learn from.

Excellent listener. Excellent learning environment. Excellent lectures. He works hard to keep his teaching material current and to apply critical theory. We studied everything related to the topic of virtuality. Genuinely cares about his students. He clearly loves his job. Be advised, though, if you want an A you will have to work hard for it.

Alf is one of the best professors at the U. His lectures are absolutely amazing. I was hesitant to take a Virtuality in Nature course because I don't even like "virtual" stuff, but this class legitimately changed my life. His class changed the way I think about things. He's a very fair grader and easy to talk with if you need additional help.

Dr. Seegert is the best professor I've ever had and is one of the greatest assets the University of Utah has. He is intelligent, thoughtful, and passionate about the material. He is very fair and is helpful to all students. If given the chance, I would take another course from him in the future. You'll work hard, but you won't regret it.

Arguably one of the most liked teacher in the U's English department. His classes are fun, mentally stimulating , and his lectures are always on point and will not only help you think critically, but also open your mind to a lot of new possibilities on seeing the world. Doing the readingshomework is mandatory and participation really helps.

Alf is a wonderful professor who clearly states what he expects from the very beginning of the class. His lectures are always interesting, well-researched and complete. He's a brilliant theorist who teaches the most riveting subjects. Take this professor every chance you get! He does make you work for the grade, but he's fair and realistic.

This is an amazing class. I was lucky enough to be in the pilot course, so it was a smaller group. But really, it is fantastic. You learn so much, and the fact that we have a class about virtuality and gaming is a testament to how awesome this professor is. He is super passionate about it and it's really interesting. Get ready to play!

Fantastic course. I was initially apprehensive about taking 3600, but this class was worth it. He finds way to make theory interesting and relevant to you. It is a lot of work, but you get so much out of it. Be sure to participate and learn to recognize theoriststheir passages. Highly recommend.
ABSOLUTELY INCREDIBLE. I took this class last year, and STILL think about Seegert's lectures! If you want to learn a lot, take this class. It is time demanding, but definitely worth it.

I LOVE HIM! I took one class from him by chance and I have found a way to take one of his classes ever since. He honestly wants you to do well in his class and wants you to understand the concepts talked about in class. He welcomes students disagreeing with his thoughts and is always respectful of what is said. MAKE SURE YOU DO THE READING!
One of the most talented teachers I've had.

Alf is fantastic! Took two courses and wanted more. He is committed to student success, provides solid feedback, works hard to help you, is humorous, uses multimedia, validates all opinions but keeps class text-centered. I recommend him for any course! Even wrote me a few letters of rec and has a great system for doing so.
Weird fiction? Pan's Labyrinth? Cthulu? Yes, my friends. Everyone you know will be jealous because your english class is a million times cooler than theirs, and because your teacher is AWESOME. ;)

Alf was an amazing professor.  I never wanted to miss his class because everything he taught was so interesting!  He has a passion for what he is teaching and is willing to help the students.  This is one of the first English class es I've taken that I actually loved enough to participate in class discussions.  I'd take classes from him again.

Great Professor who use of multimedia really helped the class understand Critical Theory. He very helpful and he class is easy if you do the work. What is more he makes the class enjoyable so you want to go and do the work. He is the best professor I've had while at the University of Utah.

I totally recommend Alf for theory classes; he's a great teacher and makes materials interesting. I took his online class and it was well organized/structured. Reasonable amount of homework and participation. Fair/generous grader. Best thing about Alf is his enthusiasm for his subject and his students. Highly recommended.

Amazing teacher! This was my first class with the honors college and I was worried it would be way over my head, but he made the difficult information interesting.  By far my favorite class I've ever taken, and the best teacher! You have to work for your A, but Alf is always willing to help, as long as youre putting in the effort.

Literally the best professor I've had. He is dedicated to the course material and committed to seeing his students succeed. I've taken two courses from him and plan on taking as many more as I can. His classes made me actually think and question, but if you aren't interested in critically engaging with the texts and working, don't take from him.

Prof. Seegert is the new standard. He knows where literature and social commentary are headed, and is willing to take you there. Savvy, Energetic, committed to his students and the ideas. Yes, he'll make you work, but he knows you can do it, and will back you up all the way if you give it some effort.

Alf was always very prepared, took it seriously, and was very on top of taking care of assignments and feedback for students. Knows his stuff, but I wish he would've pushed a little harder. It seemed like he was often holding back his own views and calculating what to say. Highly recommended overall.

Took his online class and found him extremely helpful.  When grading papers he not only helps instruct you on how to make it better but also points out areas he really likes.  Appears to try and keep his online class as much as an on-campus course as possible with his mandatory MWF discussions and interaction with other students in class.
Alf rocked my world.  He was by far the most organized, the most prepared, and one of the most knowledgeable professors I've ever had.  Class isn't the easiest, but is worth it.  Take him if you can.

If you can take a class from Alf, DO IT. You will not regret it. He takes his class very seriously, so you need to be there, and you need to do the work -- but it's worth it. Fun, entertaining, and you'll remember everything you learned, because it's that great. Heart him!

Alf was a great Professor. He was funny but kept it in check. Very helpful and reasonable. The material was difficult but he made it accessible. He picked awesome texts which helped immensely. I would highly recommend him to anyone.

Provocative lectures, good feedback, clarity of ideas. Makes material fun! I highly recommend Alf. He is demanding and takes your progress seriously, but is flexible. Very knowledgeable. I was never unhappy with a class session.
He is an excellent Writing teacher. I highly RECOMMEND Alf Seegert as one of your Professors when attending the University

I had this professor during the Summer for Environmental Literature.  He is great!  He has a wonderful personality and knows his stuff!  Participate and show up and you will have fun.  Nice, reasonable

There isn't a better instructor than Dr. Lenz. She finds a way to make Statics engaging and clear, and her passion is contagious. She is incredibly supportive, and her office hours are a huge help. I have never felt more comfortable participating in a large lecture. She is easily my favorite professor and a model for what instruction should be.
Midterms were super easy and she gives all of the answers in class pretty much. Would take again.

Dr. Lenz made statics very easy to understand. She was kind, caring and took every step to ensure that her students understood the material. Her exams were difficult, but with how she preps you, they're not too bad!!!

Professor Lenz was the best BME professor I've ever had. Her lectures made sense, she prepared you well for exams via practice problems and homework. Lab reports were technical which required hard work, but there were only 3 of them, making them doable. I learned a lot and felt that I actually enjoyed a subject I usually wouldn't have. AMAZING!

She is the best in the BME department! She genuinely cares about her students and about biomechanics. Her lectures are easy to follow and if anyone has a question, she'll go back and explain it in another approach. She creates a positive learning environment. Her homework and lab reports are very doable and there were office hours four days week.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amy is one of the BEST professors in the BME department! She cares a lot about her students. She does a great job at making sure her lectures are easy to understand. She makes easy-to-understand rubrics for lab reports and lets you have a note sheet on exams. Her exams are similar to homework problems. Her TAs are an awesome resource!

Dr. Lenz was probably one of the best professors that I've had at the U! She cares so much about her students and does a great job teaching, despite the content not being easy. This is reflected in how much her previous students love her. You'll do great in the class as long as you put in the work. She is amazing!

She only assigns a quiz each week, that goes along with the lectures and the chapter readings. Only 2 written assignments in the semester, and In Class Activities once or twice a week. Highly recommend

Cannot rave enough about Amberli! I absolutely loved her FCS 1500 class. Her lectures were amazing and you can tell that she just loves this class. She is always so excited to be in lecture and it makes you want to be there too. Her assignments are very simple! Mostly just graded on completion and thought. Take this class with her if you can!!

Best Professor ever, passionate about the material, and cares so much about the success of her students. Assignments are very easy: 5-question quizzes, 2-page papers for 100 points, and minimal research is required. She allows assignments to be redone and is easily accessible. The final for this course is a 2-page paper, and she offers extra credit

This has been one of the best professors I have had. The class content was enjoyable and presented in a good way. The professor is very down-to-earth and extremely understanding. Very easy to communicate with and cares about her students. I always felt important in conversations and appreciated feedback on assignments. I can't recommend enough!

This class is by far the best one I've taken. Her lectures are easy to follow and she doesnt overload you with information. She keeps it short and simple. As long as you show up youll get a good grade. There are a couple in class activities but they are easy and she just wants to see that you are engaged. Highly recommend this class.

Prof. Falk is awesome! She's super nice, easy to get in contact with, and the lectures are easy to understand. She brings in a couple guest speakers (family members) that I'm not sure have a lot to do with the curriculum, but they're fun to watch. Show up to every class! Not showing up and completing the in-class assignment dropped my grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She very clearly cares about her students passing and there are weekly quizes online and only two papers throughout the semester.

Great professor. Very informative on the topics and always willing to answer questions. Lectures are posted online but can learn more through in person or Canvas links. Homework no bad. Short weekly quiz and two papers but they are easy to do. Really enjoyed this class.

Amberli is an amazing professor with a background in childcare and development, making her lectures interesting and meaningful. Get ready to discuss with peers and attend class for in-class activities. 4 exams including final and 1 essay each semester.
She is such a sweet person and a great professor! Very understanding if you have outstanding circumstances or have additional questions. I loved the course material as well

Her class was super amazing, not hard at all. She does do the thing where she will occasionally have you have a discussion with the people around you. For attendance she only takes attendance at 12 lectures and you're allowed to miss 2, but more if you get lucky and don't attend on a day she takes it. There were 3 exams, not hard, and online.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Falk was detailed in her lectures and would connect them to real life experiences. The class I took required 2 of 4 written assignments and they had very straight forward rubrics. Her feedback on these assignments were very insightful. She does have in-class assignments but they were simple. I really enjoyed her class and recommend it.
Amberli very clearly cares about each of her student, she gives personalized feedback for every assignment and she is very understanding.

Very kind and caring professor!  The class is very interesting and not too difficult. There are in-class activites spread out throughout the semester, which count for attendance. There are also four written assignments, but you only choose two to do. Tests are open note and she always does a study review. Would 100% recommend taking this class!
She is an amazing professor who has lots of knowledge on this subject and cares about her students
Pretty easy course, and very interesting. She gave very good feedback and was so kind! I really enjoyed the class as well as the professor!

There's 4 writing prompt that you can choose to do 2/4 of them. All of the exams are online and open book with a 4 day period to do them. She makes study guides word for word and goes over them during class the week of the exams due date. There is in class participation that happens about once a week which you are graded on.  Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor. Gave us the option of choosing 2 out of 4 essays. Essays are short and I got 100% for both. Exams are open note and are open for a period of 4 days. Her lectures are interesting and she has in class activities. This helps her take attendance and has us actually interact with others. I would take her as a professor again!

Prof. Falk is one of the best professors I've had! She is so sweet and is always willing to help students with whatever they might need. Exams were all open note, and everything on exams came straight from her lectures. I absolutely loved this class and would take it again in a heartbeat!

Amberli Falk is an amazing Professor. She is super nice and understanding. There is no attendance taken but there are class activates that you have to be there for, or you won't get points for it. It is lecture heavy, but it is also very interesting. She posts every lecture on Canvas so you can go and find it later if you don't go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amberli is an awesome instructor! Her Lifespan Human Development course was very enjoyable and very easy to manage. The course consisted of four written assignments, three exams, and in-class participation points. She only required one written assignment to be completed for each half of the semester. I really recommend taking her courses!

Genuinely the best professor I've had. She is so caring, passionate, interested, and provides opportunities for students to learn more about the material through guest speakers. Her feedback on assignments is amazing and she makes it apparent that she really cares and is interested in what you have to say. Super easy and very discussion focused!
One of the most ecstatic people I've ever met. 11/10 would take this class again if she's teaching

Best professor I have had here. She is so passionate about what she is teaching and wants to hear every students voice and opinion no matter what it is. Her lectures are super interesting too and the homework is extremely manageable.

Easy class, no tests. Don't need to remember anything you learned about. Be ready to participate in in class discussions, they are kinda fun tho. She is caring and is very good about leaving comments on assignments. Would take again.

Amanda is the first lawyer I have ever liked. She is humble on her knowledge and very caring on her students. She wants to make law something interesting for everyone and will use relevant cases to make her case across. I loved her and her class, it was one of the best classes in comm I have had.

Such a good professor, I can tell she cares a lot about her students. Very smart lady and probably the optimal person at the entire university to be teaching public speaking, she genuinely has such presence in the way she speaks!

Amanda is the BEST professor I have had at the University of Utah. I highly recommend you take any of her classes. She loves hearing what her students have to say and shares so many good stories. She is inspiring and really gave me an appreciation for media. The homework outside of class is extremely manageable and participating in class is fun.

Best professor ever. By far the most interesting course I've taken at the U, plus Amanda has so many good stories from her days as a lawyer. Definitely recommend, it's also not too hard because she helps you prepare the day before each exam. Argument at the end is also only 5 minutes long.

Favorite teacher ever!! I took her from Mass Comm Law and it was easily the most interesting Comm course I ever took. She has so many good stories from her days as a lawyer. Class isn't too hard, just go to class before the exams and pay attention when she goes over the study guide. Argument at the end is also only 5 minutes long

Amanda was a super fun professor! She's extremely passionate about teaching and truly cares about her students. There are weekly discussion posts but minimal other work. Attendance affects your grade, but the many guest speakers made class educational and enjoyable. Awesome course and teacher!

One of the BEST professors I've had at the U! I was worried about taking Comm5300 but she made it so easy and enjoyable. Attendance is important for class concepts and exams but Amanda is so flexible if you communicate with her. So glad I had her for Mass-Comm Law compared to what I've heard about other professors who teach the course.

Wilhelm is a great professor! She has lots of experience which makes her very qualified for the class. This class is almost too easy you don't really need to show up, very few assignments. Some discussions were interesting but overall just an easy A class.

I loved this class, and Amanda is an amazing professor! The lectures were engaging and interesting, and there were lots of guest speakers who talked about many different topics. It is not a heavy workload, and I enjoyed the assignments. I highly recommend this class; I will definitely be taking her other class as well!

This professor spent the majority of class time showing us YouTube videos. When there were discussions, she asked only leading questions so the discussion stayed superficial and I didn't learn anything. She speaks in a condescending manner to her students. Her class is very easy if that's what you're looking for, but it's also a waste of time.

GO TO EXAM REVIEWS!! I didn't utilize the first two and only went to one and you can tell in my scores that the review days are SO helpful! She's also super helpful when it comes to the argument (not that scary). You have weekly discussion posts which aren't really even posts compared to other COMM classes (no word count, responding to peers, etc)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Wilhelm was amazing. She always has a great uplifting mood and was a great way to start off my day. Coursework was not too hard and was not too tough on grading. I genuinely learned something from all the lectures and was interested in the lecture. Something most professors at the U fail to do.

Despite heavy lecture material, she makes it extremely digestible. She is a real professional with proven experience in the field. She is always willing to help you and is incredibly kind. Amanda was the first professor to make me feel like a person instead of a dollar. She gives great feedback on assignments and just wants to help you learn.

Amanda is genuinely one of the best teachers I've had, period. You can tell that she is passionate about the class and what she is talking about and really encourages students to participate. She often asked questions that made me think in class and would bring in guest speakers which were very engaging! I highly recommend taking her.

Amanda is one of the best teachers I have had. She brought food (donuts or pizza) on tests days. She goes over the study guide for the exams and the exams are made from the study guide. You have to study but if you go to class and pay attention to the review you will do fine. Amanda also cares a lot about her students.
Late feedback and poorly written rubrics. Avoid this class.

is this professor quitting this year? His entire second half of the semester is empty in terms of work. Didn't feel like he really taught. AI generated both his slides and his assignments (ran thru 5 separate sites.) Rubrics are too vague, poor feedback, politically motivated, and I felt like I didn't even learn anything that wasn't common sense.

Class 1020: The professor encourages students to speak without relying on a script and recognizes the effort it takes to memorize and deliver a speech. Even if a student pauses or shows some nervousness, their preparation and effort are acknowledged and can contribute positively to their score. Tbh, he might staightforward but he is nice and listen

Avoid at all costs. Everything negative that has been said about him is 100% true. Vague assignment details, responds late to messages and when he does he seems peeved and talks down to you as if youre stupid and then his responses offer little clarity to your initial confusion. On top of all of that he grades extremely harsh with no explanation.

His assignments always had confusing outlines, which doesn't work for an online course. If you messaged about assignments, you'd end up waiting 2 entire days for a response since he "reserved the right" not to respond for up to 48 hrs?? His comments and critiques were entirely passive-aggressive. Avoid the headache and waste of tuition money.

Grading criteria and feedback were poor at best. Gave poor grades on opinion based assignments and then proceeded to not elaborate further on why you received that grade. Lectures were boring and don't correlate much to material, comments on assignments were rude and unhelpful. Would not take any class from this professor.

The class was alright it's very lecture-heavy and boring. I personally did not like Hussein because he did not give clear instructions as to what he wanted. His assignments were unclear, and his feedback was not helpful, just passive-aggressive and nothing positive to say even when there are good parts to an assignment. Find a different professor.

I took 1270 and 3460 with prof hussein and he makes himself memorable by being so interesting. he'll ramble a lot but sometimes it's funny, his grading criteria isn't always clear, and sometimes he'll take forever to get back to you, but he cares about his students and loves what he teaches which makes you want to continue to learn from him

Ammar's feedback was not only passive aggressive and unhelpful, but his 2 hour lectures were full of nothing relevant to the class. He also couldn't figure out inclusive access for the textbook we were supposed to use, and then sprung it on everybody the first week right as we needed it. If you like condescending time wasters, consider him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved him he is so funny , mostly we were talking during lectures. Quizzes can be confusing but open notes. Definitely take him for Leap.

Dr. Hussein was a fantastic, optimistic and loving teacher. Be a good listener and come to class with intent and you will succeed there are only 2 exams midterm and final and they are easy. The work load is quite a bit but it is very easy to get through. His lecture and tonality is perfect and he cares. for everyones involvement and opinions.

I've had him for three courses at this point and I absolutely love him. He is never biased, he's funny, and genuinely cares about our learning and futures. He is a fair grader and allows late work. Media Writing is a lot of work, but it's not hard and classes can be engaging. The class itself isn't super fun but he's a good professor.

He told us to do a speech within 4 to 6 minutes, but we have to write a 1000 words draft for it, the problem is in normal speaking speed, it's most likely you cannot even read 1000 words in 6 minutes!

Professor Hussein is alright, but I did not like his commentary. Also, the final is time consuming. Writing 3,000+ words for a single paper worth a lot of points is horrible. It feels like I'm in graduate school writing a thesis when this is an undergrad class. Mandatory attendance & lectures are long & somewhat boring. Do not reccomend.

She was brand new and didn't have any of her own material. Made a simple course seem extremely hard. The tests worth 80% of your grade is not great also, but the professor definitely could have done better at helping students to learn and understand.

She teaches in a very personable manner and is very good at explaining concepts. She also has no issue with re-explaining for those who did not understand and will work through example problems with you until you understand the content.

This professor was a really nice person and easy to ask questions to. I felt the lectures were a bit rushed because Utah changed the ECE curriculum so this class was brand new (I took ECE 1220). Her exams were a bit random with having labs be part of the exam. With that being said, I felt that some exams were way harder than they should've been.

Professor Verkler was amazing! Her ratings are low because of non major students that had to take a hard EE course. She is really flexible and willing to work with you at all times. I do feel like she is a little too smart for the low level class that she teaches. She would sometimes gloss over important fundamental concepts she knows. Great Prof!

I took ECE 1220 with Amy. I thought she was a very nice professor and was always willing to help and answer questions. I never attended her office hours, so I don't know if her 1 on 1 interactions are different. I would take another class with this professor.

I'm not quite sure why her rating is so low. She is incredibly helpful and cares about her students. Gives many options to succeed in her class (retaking tests). The exam grade is heavily weighted, but the tests aren't too hard. Very little homework. As long as you do the labs and come to class, you'll be fine.
Not hard and barely any homework. As long as you attend lab every week and do the quizzes you will be fine. Verkler is a fine lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Verkler was AMAZING. Maybe she had a change of heart recently. She was super helpful and very easy to get ahold of in class. The TAs were also great. Our classroom environment was so friendly and welcoming. She was always quick and willing to help if you needed it. She would also offer job search help and strategies. Highly recommend!

I took the TA training course with her and did not enjoy it at all. It felt like such a waste of time and there were definitely weeks where I definitely had more homework than what felt deserved for a one-credit hour class. I would not recommend taking classes with her.

Not great professor. Chill person, but learning material in this class even attending every lecture is almost purely out of class on your own. No textbooks, lecture slides are pretty much useless for review, and tests are much different than any of the practice exams given.

Exams: Nothing like the Homework and lectures
Lectures: Bullies students, Errors, Way off topic
Personally: She needs to seek help, Absolutely rude, Takes her anger out on students, Disorganized, Screams at TA's

Fitting everything wrong about this professor in 350 words would be an absolute miracle. If you are in MEEN, take this class at SLCC

If I could fit everything I wanted to say It would be the longest review ever written. Amy is the single worst professor I have ever had. She is just awful. Tests nothing like review and homework's nothing like the lectures.A single TA had to teach me the entire course because she was unable to do it herself and she made me feel inadequate for it:(
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: "When I was a TA at Stanford" was the most common phrase out of her mouth. Horrible homeworks that not even TAs understood, exams that covered untaught material, lectures full of errors. Any student feedback led to her basically bullying them in front of the whole class. Do not take at all cost, she should be fired. Go back to Stanford.

Amy is the single worst professor I have ever had. During lecture, she would go over material incorrectly, then would mention in next lecture, telling us that we could fix it for her in our own notes. When questions were asked in class, she would degrade everyone. Homework, exams, and lecture had no correlation, no exaggeration. gO sTaNFoRd!

Objectively terrible instructor, everything she did felt malicious. For example: homework that had nothing to do with the lecture, lectures themselves being hard to follow, not adding tests to canvas grade, talking down to students for asking questions, and making annotated lecture slides nearly impossible to read. I'd add more but I'm outta space.

Genuinely terrible professor. Lectures were hard to follow and essentially useless. Lectures had nothing to do with homework or tests, and the homework had nothing to do with the tests. Lecture notes impossible to follow if

Is not suited to teach. Lectures are extremely hard to follow, very fast, and unorganized. The classes have nothing to do with the homework, which tends to take all weekend even when they are short. She doesn't like feedback and yelled at students for 5 minutes for politely asking about grades. I was excited for ECE, not anymore.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was actually unbearable.I was excited to be taking my first electrical engineering class, but she absolutely ruined what could have been a really great class.She has an extremely high ego that gets in the way of her teaching.She should never be allowed to teach a class again.She should go back to her "head TA job at StAnFoRd"

Amy Verkler is a terrible professor. She was outwardly rude to students. If you want to ask questions or try and provide feedback in class be ready to be patronized and talked down to. Her lectures were hard to follow and didn't seem to provide the information necessary to do HW easily. Her tests would add concepts never discussed. Good Luck :)

I took Dr. Verkler for TA training and it was one of the most engaging and fun classes I've ever taken. Most of the class consisted of group discussions and was very insightful. Every week is a new topic regarding how to better be a TA. Attendance is mandatory as it is part of your grade.

Professor Verkler's lectures are an endurance test. They drag on endlessly, leaving students mentally exhausted and disconnected from the material. Verkler's immaturity is evident in her teaching style. She lacks the professionalism and maturity expected from a university professor.

The lectures for this class are useless, so be prepared to teach yourself everything. You or the whole class will be demeaned for asking any questions. She is also extremely immature and her large ego prevents all the students in the class from receiving any kind of learning experience.

Professor Verkler is unable to teach. She only does lectures that are an absolute waste of time and don't help on homework or tests.  If you ask any type of questions you get ridiculed and embarrassed. Her TA's don't even know how to solve the problems on her long and unexplained homework. This class is horrendous don't take it would not recommend.

I am taking this class this semester but not happy so far. I'll follow up with my feedback at the end of the semester. She doesn't welcome feedback. In class, she says she encourages asking questions but when asked, she ridicule in front of many students so  I lose interest

This is a TA training class. Her grading criteria are not clear. I participated in all classes on time and submitted all projects/assignments on time but I was surprised to find out my final grade was B. When asked, she said the last assignment I submitted missed some elements(it was a video preparation giving a short lecture). I don't recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I found this course very confusing and the lectures were virtually worthless. She is not keen on answering questions and makes you feel like a clown when you ask her something. The homework take forever and even when you go to the TAs to get help, they can't even solve the problems.On my momma I would rather risk it with Arn over this
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Verkler is not suited to teach. Her lectures do not translate to homework or exam problems at all. When she does examples in class she does them incorrectly forcing many students to find resources outside of the class. Homework is weekly and time consuming, exams are problems never discussed in lectures or discussion sessions.

This professor uses a flipped classroom approach, which worked for me, but also kind of lectured. She worked through the homework assignments during the lecture, with the expectation that you came with a basic understanding of the concept from the videos in canvas. If you stay up to date on assignments and labs you'll do fine

Dr. Amirsoleimani is one of the most caring and wonderful professors I've had in my four years at the U! Our course materials were thoughtful and enjoyable to read, and classes and exams were reasonable and fun. I honestly looked forward to class every week. I highly recommend this course and Dr. Amirsoleimani to everyone!!

I took two classes with her: Muslim Americans (required for degree) and Muslim Mysticism (I loved her class and wanted to keep learning from her). She is very knowledgeable and passionate about what she teaches. She takes care to have individual relationships with students and will do anything to make sure you succeed. Genuinely loved both courses.

Taking God, Love and Mysticism from Professor Amirsoleimani was a tremendous experience. She is easily the kindest professor I have had, and she is deeply knowledgeable and passionate about the subjects we covered. Class discussions were always thought provoking and professor Amirsoleimani did a great job fostering a healthy learning environment.

This class was incredible. Professor Amirsoleimani is brilliant, kind, and has the best teaching style. We read so many beautiful words, dove deep into mysticism, and had memorable class discussions. Definitely a favorite class I have taken at the U! I hope you get a chance to learn from her!

She is the most genuine professor I've ever had, evidenced by her deep care for students long term goals and lives in general. She is very open-minded, creating a student-friendly classroom environment. Very knowledgeable about mysticism and related topics. You will always take something away from a class session.

Dr. Amirsoleimani is a wonderful and well-experienced professor who not only is highly passionate about what she teaches but desires for her students to also benefit from her courses also! I highly recommend any of her courses as I've taken multiple different ones of hers.

She is the kindest, most understanding professor I have ever had.  The way she teaches her classes, you can tell she has much love and passion for the subjects she teaches.  After her Muslim-Americans class, I enjoyed her class so much I wanted to take a second class with her.  I wish she was my professor for every class I take!

I highly recommend every student take a class with Professor Amirsoleimani. She is one of the best professors I've had, providing valuable insights into the Persian-speaking world while helping me improve my language skills. Her thoughtful selection of books, poems, and news articles has greatly enhanced my vocabulary and cultural understanding.

I have yet to have a teacher that cares as much as Professor Amirsoleimani does for her students. Every one of her lectures is engaging and thought provoking. You need to show up and participate but I've never felt anxious raising my hand in her class because she's so inviting. I appreciate how supportive she is outside of class affairs as well.

Dr. Amirsoleimani is seriously one of the most incredible professors I've ever taken! Not only is she focused, disciplined, and incredibly intelligent, but she's also extremely caring! She is extremely reasonable with accommodations and desirous to help students fall in love with the course material and succeed. I would recommend her to everyone!

Professor Amirsoleimani is one of the loveliest women I have ever met. She is kind, intelligent, and incredibly well spoken and passionate. I would advise anyone considering her to take her class because while the lectures might be long they're incredibly engaging. She truly wants her students to succeed.

This has been my favorite University class I've taken thus far. Professor Amirsoleimani is kind and caring and intelligent and passionate. The readings were incredibly relevant and enjoyable; the selection of authors was amazing. Our class discussions/lectures were always fun with lots of participation. 10/10 would recommend this course!

Mrs. Amirsoleimani is a great understanding professor. The class discussions were very interesting and she engages very well with her students. The novels that we read were also easy to read and overall really loved her class! Papers and presentations were graded fairly according to the class curriculum, so definitely a class worth taking!

The coursework is outlined in the syllabus, reminders and changes announced in class and emails. Although she explains thoroughly how her grading works its fairly difficult to know what she wants. She makes an effort to connect with her students and is always available to help but sometimes questions can be answered with impatience.
I really enjoyed taking her course and I would reccomend

This course is the rare collision between fun subject matter and great professor! Professor Amirsoleimani is shockingly respectful, aware, and tolerant. She is clear about her expectations, but generous with opportunities for improvement. She wants her students to succeed. I leave this class with a deep respect for her, it has been a privilege.

Attendance is a huge part of your grade, and you don't get any excused absences. She grades papers like her life depends on finding your mistakes. My 5000-level papers easily get As, so I'd like to think I'm a good writer, but it was difficult to get a B on her papers. Felt like I was in high school again, in a bad way. Wouldn't reccommend, sadly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Amirsoleimani is one of the most caring professors I have ever had, and her class is amazing. She really cares for her students, and it shows. Class was often a group discussion, and there were readings and papers for the class. We also watched a few films. I would 100% recommend this class to everyone. It was a great experience.

Professor Amirsoleimani is tough, but fair and caring. She rewards hardworking students. Make sure you prepare for every class. Read the material, look up vocab you don't know, rehearse your presentations, etc. She's understanding and believes in second chances. As long as you try, you will improve your Persian skills and enjoy the class.

I adore Soheila. She is the embodiment of kindness. Honestly, if you do the readings for each class and come prepared to discuss, you'll do fine. The 3 papers on which you are graded are known about from the first day, including prompts. She is available at any time to meet, so if you don't understand the paper, it is your fault.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Amirsoleimani truly cares about what and who she is teaching. Most of this course consisted in reading and group discussion, so participation is key. She is great at encouraging good discussion and wants to develop a good relationship with her students and encourages her students to develop relationships with each other. Amazing class.

Soheila is one of the best instructors I've had during my time at the U. I had PERS 4010 & 4020 w/her. I thoroughly enjoyed her classes! She knows her stuff and assignments are engaging, tie in well with the course, and are clearly defined. She genuinely wants her students to succeed and is incredibly accommodating. I can't recommend her enough!

Prof Amirsoleimani was such positive presence for me this semester and I genuinely looked forward to being in her class every week. She cares about the well-being of her students so deeply and frequently extends deadlines so things aren't stressful. Lots of readings, but they're interesting I promise. Just do them and participate and you'll pass :)

This class was great, the classroom environment was calm but still engaging, the readings were interesting, and the course structure was clear. Prof Amirsoleimani was very caring and expertly guided our discussions. She encouraged everyone to speak, but it was never mandatory. She always left in-depth feedback on my papers and graded them fairly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Dr. Amirsoleimani is extremely knowledgeable about the topics she teaches and you can easily see that she is passionate through her conveyance of the material. She gets excited to see students understand and contribute to the conversation and has a genuine commitment to the progression of her students. I highly recommend taking a class by Soheila.

For being an Intro course, I felt that I was expected to have previous knowledge. Our assignments consisted of three papers and attendance. There is no rubric for the papers, so I didn't understand why a paper would be lower than I expected. Overall, it is a good class and you will have good discussions with your classmates

This was a wonderful class. The structure is very clear - readings are scheduled and communicated well in advance, and all expected coursework is explained on the first day of class. If you do the readings, apply yourself, and participate, you'll do well. She is also very kind and encouraging, and it's clear that she wants her students to succeed.

I highly recommend Professor Amirsoleimani and the course! The class consists of many readings, in-class discussions, and 3 essays. The essay prompts are clear, and she was beyond fair in ensuring that we had enough time to write our essays, as well as providing many opportunities to meet with her and discuss the essays or their prompts with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best professors ever. I was one of the only people who wasn't a Persian major in the class, but Professor Amirsohelimani helped me and would never make anyone feel bad when questions were asked. She gives out the Exam prompts on the first day so you can prepare months beforehand. Lots of reading but very fun overall. Lots of feedback too
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The course revolved around readings and showing up to class prepared with at least some insight, whether provocative, contemplated, or general. Three papers, with topics broad enough to be creative, are given over the length of the term... so not too horrible. You'll enjoy this class if you enjoy reading, writing, and general discourse.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I won't say that I dislike prof Amirsoleimani, but there were things during this class that I really disliked. For an intro class, it seems like she expects students to already know how to analyze literature and favors deep observations that not every student has. Grading was based on 3 papers with unclear grading criteria and vague prompts
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I've taken this professor before and she is genuinely one of the best professors I've had, hands down. Lot's of reading and heavy on lectures, but she's very receptive to questions and feedback and seems to genuinely care for all of her students. I highly recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took Soheila Amirsoleimani's WLC 2010 course a number of years ago and learned a great deal about the history and culture surrounding some of the world's most renowned authors. I look back on the course fondly as one of the highlights of my time in college, and that is due in large part to Prof. Amirsoleimani's passion for the subject.
Very caring and kind. The more you engage with the material and class discussions, the more you will get out of the class. I definitely recommend her Islamic mysticism class.

Professor Amirsoleimani is very respectful. I never felt that my beliefs or view points were diminished or unwanted in her classroom. The class "Muslim Americans in the US" was very eye opening to me about integration and diversity around me. I really liked how she would bring in many different perspectives into our readings and discussions.

Professor Amirsoleimani was a fantastic professor. Even though the coursework can be considered a bit heavier, she approached it with grace and true enjoyment. Read the assigned material and go to class - and you'll be fine. Make sure to put lots of detail into your essays - but again, she goes over every single detail in class.

More than 5 years after the class and this professor is still helping me grow. The readings alone are something I still use today, but her class helped me to develop academically and dare I say spiritually as well. Soheila has stayed in touch all these years and has always challenged me and been deeply caring as well. Best prof at the U!

If you're looking for a diversity credit this is it! This class surprised me in a good way. Professor Amirsoleimani is kind-hearted and passionate about what she teaches. The material, topics, and discussions were awesome. The lesson learned go a long way. You'll do well, so long as you put in the effort. Take the class, you'll be better for it.

Soheila has been so influential for me academically and personally. We have stayed in contact even after the course. She listens to and respects her students more than any other professor I've had which creates  thoughtful/meaningful discussions. This course greatly improved my reading, writing, and critical thinking skills. I definitely recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great literature professor. Varied and interesting reading assignments. Great job keeping students involved and interested. Kind and welcoming of comments. For this class we did three short papers which are fairly natural to compose from the reading materials and the prompts.
Amazing professor, one of my favorites.

This is one of the best classes that I have taken! I loved the materials, topics, and discussions that we covered. I would highly recommend taking this class to meet the Diversity credit. The professor is very kind, understanding, and informed about the topics covered. I highly recommend taking CLCS 4325 with Professor Amirsoleimani.

Professor Soleimani is a WONDERFUL teacher. I was taken out of class for a month due to military duty and she worked with me to hold extra classes at times when I could attend and was incredibly flexible. She is kind and cares about her students, and always takes time to provide additional feedback as necessary.

This professor facilitates an open class discussion for this course and allows the students to participate by sharing their own perspectives. She can be brutally honest, but in a manner that is constructive which allows the students to grow in their abilities and knowledge. I definitely recommend, to anyone, to take a course from this professor.

My experience in this class and with this professor was amazing. She clearly is extremely knowledgeable on her speciality and teaches it well. She also gave fantastically in depth feedback on assignments and obviously cared about her students. There is quite a bit of reading but I wouldn't let that discourage you. Very grateful I took this class.

The class seems harder than it is in the syllabus. The professor takes her time to explain things in detail and gives plenty of time to prepare for the exams. She cares greatly about her students. Always ask questions and never be afraid to go to her for help. She was my favorite professor I have had and I would take her again.

I enjoyed taking this class for my diversity credit, despite the class being online this semester (I'm not a fan of online classes). If the topic of "Muslim-Americans in the US" interests you at all, then you'll certainly enjoy the assigned reading material. Prof. Amirsoleimani is a great teacher and will give you every opportunity to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Due to COVID-19, our class was over Zoom. Despite this, Dr Amirsoleimani lead an excellent class. The books we read were enlightening, the in-class discussions were helpful, and the tests were challenging without being unnecessarily difficult. I waited quite a while to take this class because it is not taught very often. It was well worth the wait!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Amirsoleimani is fantastic. I've taken a couple classes with her at this point, and both have been great experiences. The lectures were accessible and comprehensive. The class overall is a great look into the Muslim-American identity and provides clear context of how Muslims have experienced life in the United States.

Without a doubt the best Professor and class I've ever taken. By far. Prof. Amirsoleimani is an incredible teacher. TAKE THIS FOR YOUR DIVERSITY CREDIT! This class is life-changing. My assignments for the class inspired a few people in my family to examine their part in the race issues so prevalent in the US today. I can't say enough good things.

Professor Amirsoleimani is a wonderful teacher. She is caring and respectful and nurtures an open class and discussion environment. I learned so much in her Muslim Americans class and enjoyed nearly everything we had to read. She genuinely cares for each and every student and makes them feel welcome. You won't regret having her as a teacher.

Loved Amirsoleimani's Muslims in America course for diversity credit. Incredibly caring person, you can tell she is truly passionate about the course material and cares about her students. The essay-style take home exams are great for anxious test takers and the class is mostly discussion based. Just attend class and read the books.

One of my favorite professors I had while in college. Soheila managed to create an extremely open and positive classroom environment that was perhaps the best discussion based class I had in undergrad. Soheila was also extremely caring and I genuinely felt respected by her.

I say this without any hyperbole: this class was life-changing. The most simple proof: I still read the class texts. The professor is kind and supportive, inspiring, and genuinely cares for her students. I highly recommend taking any class professor Amirsoleimani teaches, because she is a truly generational talent and a remarkable human being.

You can tell Professor Amirsoleimani is passionate about what she teachers and is extremely knowledgable. Being up to speed on the readings and participation is key! This class is not an easy A, but she is more than willing to work with you after hours to make sure you get a good grade on the essays. Overall a very fun class!

No mindless lecture slides, busywork, or forced group projects here! You read actual books* in this course and then discuss them as a group- makes the class seem more intimate. Prof Amirsoleimani is so very wise, kind, insightful, and approachable. I learned so much. Fav. Prof. Ever. *a lot - but do them, participate, and that's about it for grade

Professor Amirsoleimani evokes a warm and inviting environment for students to freely express their ideas. Also, the care Professor Amirsoleimani shows towards her students is amazing! She periodically checks with each student throughout the semester to ensure they are being the best version of themselves in and out of the classroom.

Coming from Iran herself, shes a true scholar of Persian. Very nice and personable. And what a bank of knowledge! She has a lot to say about differing translations of Rumi and Attar. Do the reading and be ready for fascinating discussions.

I took Dr. Soheila's class on Islamic mysticism and thoroughly enjoyed her lectures. We had a small class so each day's discussion was genuine and intimate. She's very knowledgeable and passionate about Persian studies, I wish I could find the room to take her other courses! Do the reading and work hard, you will see just what a gem she is.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: The professor promotes class discussion by having you read her mind on specific details. She tested us on subjects that were not focused on. Very unclear grading criteria, especially for papers. She is quiet and nice outside of class, but is incredibly anal when it comes to the subject matter. Not a terrible professor, but look elsewhere if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Horrible teacher. She can go from being happy to upset very easily. She requires you to remember super small details from the books you read. The grading criteria of assignments was very unclear and she would dock points for the most random things on your papers. I absolutely dreaded this class as did other of my classmates. Don't take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Super easy class and awesome teacher. I always thought her lectures were interesting. She really tried to make things engaging, even the homework.

Stillwell was my favorite professor of my first semester. You can tell that she is extremely dedicated to her work. I hate group projects and was stuck with a sub-par group, but other than that, I thoroughly enjoyed this course. If you show up to class and put in some effort you'll be just fine!

Dr. Stillwell is an overall great professor. She clearly cares about her students and what she is teaching about. Also, the class is interesting and relevant. Make sure you show up, because attendance is taken every class period. Other than that, it is not difficult if you pay attention. Good start to freshman year
Repetitive. Boring. Not engaging at all.

Class was so easy she had to curve everyones grade down lol. Attendance is mandatory which is annoying because the class is so boring. 

Great teacher though, you can tell she cares about what she does, even if the material is super basic.
My least favorite professor ever.

All I wanted to say is that its crazy how I had pretty much an A at the end of the semester but then it became an A- when she graded our team project. Because of that, I still had a good score but she changed up the grading policy last minute because everyone did really well. She made 3.5+ an A and everything else below 3.1 - 3.5 an A-.

This professor made a simple class beyond difficult. My entire section struggled with her. This was my only A- in the block, which shouldn't have been the case. I found quizzes and exams beyond difficult based on the material in class. No matter how hard I tried in class, it seemed impossible to win. I wish I would have taken a different professor.

This woman had me on the edge all semester. You can tell she is passionate about what she does but my gosh this woman is frustrating. Grading criteria are not clear, exam/quiz questions are vague and always have more than one right answer, and she lowered all of our grades to lower the class average. I don't recommend taking this class from her.

Professor Stillwell was ok. Her lectures were clear. This class has lots of quizzes but she drops a couple of the lowest as well as your lowest exam. So do well on the first two and you won't have to do the last. She does have some attitude if you talk during lectures. Application of knowledge is important on exams. Put in effort on group project.

I thought Amelia Stillwell was a good professor who was truly passionate about her job. However, I felt like her quizzes and exams could have been a lot more clear in what she was looking for. Group projects are also very heavy in this class and she does not let you pick your own group which kind of is hard-especially when it's a video project.

Attendance is graded, but she drops a few of your lowest participation scores. She also drops an exam and quiz grade. Quizzes and exams are not difficult, especially if you attend class regularly. There are lots of discussions compared to the other classes in the BCOR block, but they aren't too bad. She is accommodating if students speak up.

Amelia TRIES hard, but ultimately she tries TOO hard. Her voice is like nails on a chalkboard. She makes attendance necessary because she knows if she didn't, nobody would show up. The class isn't overly difficult but the professor is possibly the most annoying I've ever had.

Class was really boring and vague. Exams were not difficult but extremely vague and I could see how students could have easily been mistaken by certain answer options. Only business fundamentals class which grades partially based on attendance which is annoying and inconvenient.

The class is fine and very manageable. My main issue with her is that she's the only professor I have ever had that's made attendance worth 25% of your grade. I currently have an A, have not missed a single point on any assignment, and got 100% on my tests. But after inputting what ifs for the classes I've missed my grade has dropped more than 10%!
I had Professor Stillwell last semester and she was a great professor. Her lectures were entertaining and she was kind to students. Really good professor overall!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I will say that the professor is very passionate about what she teaches but I just couldn't pay full attention in this class she was teaching, mainly due to it being very basic stuff. Just show up for the attendance points and you'll be fine

Stillwell is awesome! For exams you get a cheat sheet so tbh I would copy down things from her PowerPoints and stuff she mentions on the review day for them and you'll do great. :) she also drops an exam. I asked for feedback on the group project she was v helpful too... the group project isn't too bad in comparison to the BCOR marketing project.

Dr. Stillwell wants you to do well. If you didn't get a good grade, you straight up didn't do the reading or take any notes. She hands you everything you need to excel, including giving detailed study guides. She's also just a pleasant person and I feel for her as a younger professor trying to establish herself at the U.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: you can tell that stillwell cares about her students. classes definitely are not interesting but going to class helps significantly on tests. She will help you get a good grade if you want one.

She is more focussed on putting her social and political beliefs onto students than she is about meeting the class expectations. This is a class taken to decide if a major in management is best for you, but she does not take time to show students what a career with this degree would look like.

I am a good, motivated student, but I would suggest staying away from Stillwell. Class includes discussion post (easy points), quizzes that "help you prepare for the exam" (and all answers are somehow correct, you just have to choose the best one), and exams which follow quiz format. My grade was a B, missed 1 assignment, and then ended with a C..

Professor is actually interested and passionate about her discipline. 3 exams (1 gets dropped), 2 discussion post, 6 quizzes; probably the hardest quizzes ever, jk, but seriously are difficult 1 final group project. Class is very informative and splendid. Study and read the material and you could easily average B+ or A-. Abides by her syllabus!

Anna was a great professor. I have had her for multiple classes and have enjoyed her being my professor in all of them. She teaches slowly in her lectures, making it easy to understand. Attendance is not mandatory, but is on quiz and test days. A quiz is given almost every Friday at the end of class. I would recommend taking a class with Anna.
labs are really long, be prepared for a 1+ hour of math labs. also can't use calculator on quizzes and exams. a quiz every friday

She is a very sweet and kind person. She teaches very slow but I understand that some students might find that helpful. There is a lot of homework to do but the due dates are reasonable and there are late passes. I understood the material and I think she teaches ok but I would prefer if she would go faster when doing practice problems.

I've never struggled so much in a math class and it's supposed to be easy… get any other teacher or even do online. It would be better to teach yourself than to sit through her class 3 times a week. If you ask for help all she will say is focus more on the homework and the labs. None of her tests or quizzes EVER reflected the labs or homework.

She is nice but just writes numbers on a board and expects you to follow along. Thankfully 1010 is not that difficult and you can just teach yourself everything or learn from the TA's. She is also very bad at giving partial credit on tests.
Everyone who says shes nice but cant teach is right. Khan academy will save u
She does not listen to students who are trying hard in class and outside of class to succeed when asking for help because said student is a bad test taker.
Very kind person, terrible teacher oh my god

she taught so slowly I would play clash royal mid lecture and after the battle was over she would still be on the same topic. she came across as nice but was very short and not accommodating when I had some questions for her. This is a low level math class, but she would literally ask the class what 7+2 was and treated us like middle schoolers.
Teaches so incredibly slow and talks to you like you are 5 years old. Gives quizzes and homework over topics before it is taught. Bring a pillow because you will fall asleep.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I mainly took MATH 1010 as a review course entering into college, so the material was not new to me and I already knew how to do a majority of it. However, Professor Schoening was a great instructor that was easily accessible if you had questions. The course is very lecture-heavy, which can get slightly boring at times.
Truly Fantastic. Really what i needed as a math review entering college and she was very nice in addition. Great teacher who cares about her job.
I left more confusing than entering

Anna was awesome. I suck at math but she was a great teacher and I learned a lot from her. There are lots of quizzes and homework, just make sure to stay on top of it. Show up to class or you will miss her teaching material.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Anna was super nice, though a little hard to talk to. I expected this class to be easy considering I had already taken pre-calc in high school, but that wasn't the case. She doesn't just hand out A's. I struggled to go from a B- to an A after I didn't do well on my first exam due to being ill-prepared. Getting an A is possible but you have to work!
So much unnecessary homework and sucks at teaching the material

This was the hardest math class I've ever taken and its supposed to be the easiest one. Participation matters way too much for her and she's not very understanding if you need extra time for an assignment. I also had some technical issues that made it impossible to complete my work a few times and she was never willing to help me out.
I learned more from my TA's on our weekly labs than her. She did not answer questions and she went too fast through the work.

Anna is a solid teacher. She goes at a decent pace and explains concepts well. As long as you participate and take it seriously you should be fine HW: weekly. Some assignments are easier than others so start early! Exams: 3 tests +final, one pg quizzes weekly. Book: 5 bucks on Amazon for physical book. She does give a free PDF but def buy.

reviews.comment: Professor Schoening was a great professor. Her teaching method is very helpful. She goes at a reasonable pace and focuses on problems and examples from the workbook. Great at answering questions and helping during office hours. I recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved her class, she's a litle strict about phone use and talking in class but I get it. This is just 1010 and if you're in it you should probably pay attention. I had a rough start but wound up learning a lot by the end. It's a super easy class and Anna is a preety nice teacher and she is always willing to help.

I took her 1010 class, and after moving on to 1050 I realized that I had learned absolutely nothing. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Felt like a high schooler again taking this class. No phones in class and participation is 8% of your grade which doesnt sound like its the reason I got a B. WebWork is what she uses for homework and is THE WORST .If you are pretty good at math this class wont be hard but you need to participate and not have your phone out in class for an A.

reviews.comment: No phones in class. If class gets loud, she'll wait. Very big on announcements. Also very big on extra credit/ cutting lowest quiz scores!! She gets the job done and she'll get you through math 1010. She always has office hours too. Some units felt rushed and I got left in the dust, but that happens in any math class so ymmv. Free textbook!
She's a really good teacher. And also WILLING TO HELP YOU. If you're sleeping you obviously won't pass. She's quirky and makes jokes occasionally. Just be attentive and ready to learn.

I took this class summer semester and it was no joke. Miss Schoening made sure that we knew what we were attempting was hard. She expects you to be professional (ie, no cell phones or excessive talking). If you can't handle that, I don't know what to tell you other than you're in college now. Professors aren't meant to lead you by the hand.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Anna is an interesting person, and many of her ideas of being funny are quite strange. However, I learned a lot throughout the semester and feel very prepared for calculus.

had her for the online math1030 class. It is definitely harder to do a math class online, but all of the directions were very clear and direct. There are many oppurtinites to get extra credit There are is one homeowrk and one quiz due every week, but you get a week to complete the homeowrk and four days for the quiz. Wasnt a fan of the project.

Welcome back to highschool! Anna doesn't allow cell phones or laptops. If she sees them, you're asked to leave the room and loose participation. She is a nice lady, but very awkward. Her class is test heavy, and she makes you take a lab. Her textbook is about $10 so that's nice. She seems to be a very hard 1010 professor out of all of them.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Shes an odd duck, but she explain concepts in very clear and easy ways. Easy A if you go to classes and labs.

I struggle with math, with that being said.. i struggled even MORE with Anna. She was boring, rushed through everything and never explained things in the easy way. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This teacher sucks! Explanations are hard to understand and rushes over material.
