If any other professor had taught this material, I probably would have been zoning out, but Sandomir keeps you interested for the entire class. If you pay close attention, take good notes, and study, you should do well in the class.
He is like a lot of great minds half genius half insane. Take everything he says with a grain of salt or you will be offended no matter who you are.

If you don't read the text book AND go to class, you will not pass. Prof. S is very passionate and encourages questions and discussion. His lectures are pretty engaging, however the tests are not as straight forward as the material seems to be. Most quizzes are T/F and are meant to trick you a little. But with study comes success.

This was my  fifth class with Professor Sandomir. Nobody can create an exciting mix of business, philosophy and mathematics like Sandomir.  Anyone who has had a class from him will tell you that he is as close to the idea of absolute excellence as can be found.  My husband attended some lectures with me and called Sandomir the Hitchens of business.
He is one of the best teachers I have ever had. Stay on top of the readings and attend the lectures and do well in the class.

Loves what he teaches and applies very dry concepts in a interesting/relatable way. Easily the best professor I have had at the U. His tests are tricky but with diligent studying they become quite reasonable. I look forward to taking all classes he has to offer in the future. I cannot say enough about how much I appreciate his class.

Great professor, make sure you attend all lectures pre read the material hefore class and take lots of notes.  His TA study sessions are very helpful.  Tests are challenging consists of primaily T/F questions and short essay questions on the mid term and final.
Sandomir is brilliant, the best professor I have had. His lectures are extremely insightful and inspiring. Sandomir's class is a lesson in re-creation, not recreation. (Let the Ubermensching begin!)
Lectures are great. Sandomir is super funny, but covers bucketloads of information. Tests are difficult and the curve saves you.
Attend the study sessions and take good notes. Listen to what he has to say.

Simply put, he is one of the best professors I've ever had.  His class was very engaging and captivating: I never missed a class session.  He brings personal knowledge, experience, and insightful opinions to the table: in other words, he is not a powerpoint/textbook regurgitator.  He was very passionate and sincere about what he taught.

One of my favorite teachers. Too bad he doesn't teach more marketing classes way better the the waste of space names Ballif. Might take his Mktg 3010 just to learn more. Challenging class but if you can handle it, its one of the best classes at the U. The tests are hard but he gives you enough info that you can get an A.

I am sitting in on the summer 3010 (again) because it is the best of all the marketing classes I have taken at the DESB. Professor Sandomir is the best lecturer I have ever had at the U. His take on everything is original and he inspires me to more serious study. If he taught on the moon I would follow but--no worry--he is afraid of flying.
He's a great professor, very passionate about his lectures, but the course was very intense.

This class was insightful. Some people say it was diffcult but if you read the assigned stories, attend class everyday,and strive to understand each concept you will do phenomenal.Overall it was a great experience. Sandomir brings a refreshing enthusiasm to the business realm and does a more than adequate job in igniting interest to some dry reads.

Sandomir was interesting to listen to and very passionate but he was too smart to teach beginners. It wasn't simple business strategy and technique, it was analyzing readings of Thoureau and Mill and understanding them metaphorically and analytically. For my literal mind, it was too much.

Bus 2000 and Mktg 4510. Sandomir is amazing, but not for everyone. He's a genius and his mind--and mouth--move fast. Lectures could go anywhere, but that makes class fun and interesting. He has real-world advertising expertise and can really open your eyes to the fascinating art of advertising. My all-time favorite professor.
If you want to learn then take this class.  If you are just taking it for the credit then don't bother, it is way hard and way boring.
Excellent professor. Learned so much at every lecture. Attending class and doing all the readings is a must. Tests and quizzes are tricky, but he has a fair curve.

I am an Engineering major looking to fulfill a general credit and broaden my educational experience.  This class is trickier than your everyday general class.  Sandomir was fantastic though... very captivating lectures and thought provoking.  Overall not REALLY all that difficult, my only downfall is I didn't prepare much for the first quiz.
he is a great professor. loved every second of his class. it was difficult but i plan on taking every other class he offers throughout the rest of my college career.

He's pretty brilliant, but his foundations class was the most I've ever had to read for a class. The material is intensive to say the least and his tests are extremely challenging. Expect to devote a lot of time into studying the readings and make sure to attend class.

Great teacher in any class i've taken from him. Foundations, Power, and Intro Mktg were all captivating and challenging. In the class on power all you need to do is show up to get an A, as long as you don't miss more than four days(but you won't want to).

His classes were awesome.  People sat in just to hear him lecture.  He spoke about the texts in a modern light so you find the themes applicable.  I almost changed my major to business after his class. This class is more than grade it really makes you assess your outlook on life.

Excellent professor! He knew the materials and always keep the class interesting even if it's a slow and agony day. However, his assign reading is a must if you want to pass the class. I skip a few days of reading and was completely lost in his lectures. But overall, he was the bomb!

Marketing 4510 was a hands-on class. I have had Sandomir for all of his lecture classes which are stunningly brilliant.  And he is just as wonderful as a mentor in his marketing classes.  Don't be afraid of the work--you will leave his class with REAL skills!

He's briliant -no doubt. Class is very challenging but he makes it really interesting. If you like philisophical debate, varied and incredible use of language and massive intilectual stimulation - you'll love it. If not, he may be too far over your head.

Not recommended for non-business majors! WAY too hard of a class for a general studies credit. Ridiculously hard tests/quizzes designed to make you get answers wrong. Has a fair curve, but not worth the work and worry. He is extremely smart and interesting, but makes simple ideas complicated and complicated ideas even more complicated.

My favorite professor I've ever had. He's electric and the discussions are beyond brilliant. You would be crazy to take this class from any other teacher. As much effort as you put into this class, is the grade you will receive. I did spend a lot of time studying for his exams, but I received an A.
This was my third class from Professor Sandomir.  You do have to put in a lot of work but you get a lot back.  His lectures are excellent--you will never be bored.
This was my third class from Professor Sandomir.  You do have to put in a lot of work but you get a lot back.  His lectures are excellent--you will never be bored.
Lots of reading. If you study you can do ok on tests and quizzes, but they are difficult. Interesting lectures, no outside assignments besides reading to prepare for tests.

Incredible mind! His tests are pretty pointless as far as gauging your grasp of the material and are very difficult to prepare for. After an entire semester of reading all the assigned material, printing off lecture slides, and attending study groups, I managed to get a B (lowest grade ever received in a bus course) but his lectures were worth it!
Amazing guy and amazing class.  Changed how I view business

This is a great class and Mr. Sandomir is the best teacher for it! You cannot graduate from the U of U in business and have not taken a course from him. He only gave two quiz' and two tests which were not comprehensive, but still challenging. The homework included readings from the textbook. Attending the class in essential. Tests were curved.
I took Power Basics at the same time I took Foundations.  Very different approach but equally brilliant!

Foundations of Business Thought is a class that requires a lot of work. However,it is worth the effort just to experience Professor Sandomir.  He is electric.  And he is as much a poet as he is an intellectual...and in there is nobody teaching in the college of business who can even approach that combination.
great teacher but his tests are basically to confuse you.  if you go to the review sessions with the TA and study that you can get a really good grade.  the guy knows more than anyone should.
He's really good in terms of grading to international students. I got 3 Ds and a C, and he ended up giving me a B-
Lectures were interesting.  But the tests covered completely different material.  He would not respond to my inquiries regarding my grade.
I am taking Power Basics right now and this is really the most interesting class I have taken.  Sandomir is quite amazing, I think.  He is a very powerful lecturer and has an ocean of knowledge,

Best class i have ever taken bar none. This class takes everything you know about business, and about life and turns it completely upside down. As a student and friend of Professor Sandomir I highly reccomend foundations of business thought, and power basics. I would take his marketing class also because he may not be doing it much longer.
Sandomir is the man. I learned so much about business philosophy that has influenced how I see the business world and even how I live my day to day life.
tough class but fabulous lectures--the prof is totally solid
very good class and excellent professor
Truly astonishing class--in every way
incomparable lectures with references to everything--a stunner of a class.
without a doubt, the most cerbral and the finest professor i have ever had
Bottom line....the best Prof at the U. Take him for any class that you can.
Exams are very hard even though they are T/F. Go to class and take very good notes.
Great class, very interesting readings.  turned my understanding of the world on its side.
Enjoyable class
Very provocative lectures. The literary approach to business is priceless. Great Class but be prepared to work.
Good class. It is very fascinating to see the philosophical aspects of business. Sandomir delivers. Well-worth the money.

Professor Sandomir is a genius. He is a very eclectic man with a powerful understanding of business, philosophy and literature. It is refreshing to have a business professor who can think outside the box. Don't expect to learn formulas or rules, but do expect to expand you understanding of the world and business.
I got an A in the class but it wasn't because I didn't work.  Not a class to get an "easy A"  Sandomir is intelligent, but not shy about letting people know it either.
He is very intelligent, but his exams are way too difficult and he is too into himself and brags entirely too much.
No Comments
Amazing teacher with great insight. He is super intelligent. Never ceased to amaze me with his lectures, This is a great class and a great professor

The class may very well kick your ass, but it's well worth it.  Hard tests, but they're fair and only cover what's in the readings or lectures.  I learned a ton in this class, and the concept is applicable in all areas of life.  Sandomir rocks!  He really knows his stuff, and is always willing to answer questions or clarify things.  He also makes the lectures extremely interesting.  I highly recommend it, even if you're not a business major.
a true academic and friend of the student
nice lectures, lots of reading, maybe even a little irrelevant to real life

Very interesting class and professor, you can get a lot out of this class.  As far as tests go, not to hard if you get to the study sessions and go to most lectures, esp in the 2nd half of the class, I didn't read all the material and got an A.

This was probably my most difficult class I have taken at the U. However, I REALLY enjoyed Sandomir as a teacher. The content was very difficult and you have to attend EVERY class, but Sandomir is very intelligent! The midterms and Exams WERE HELL!!! I RECOMEND a study group wit at least 10 other people. That's what helped me! VERY TIME CONSUMING! But it was a VERY interesting class.
No Comments

Foundations of Business Thought was a tough class, but I have a lot of respect for the teacher and how he teaches.  If you want to learn, Sandomir is great, but you have to be prepared to put in some work.
No Comments
blah
Full of himself, but I liked his lectures alot, recommend his classes.
No Comments
He was a great prof. I enjoyed the class even though the tests were really hard and required actually studying...imagine that!

I really enjoyed the class. The tests were difficult, but as long as you read and understood the material, along with attending the lectures, it wasn't that bad.  But then again isn't that the way it is with all classes?
No Comments
Really interesting prof, just gives difficult tests.

never attended to the lectures, only attended to 2 quizes and 2 tests, never ever studied for this class, still gave me a C. great for anyone who wants to have humanity requirement passed for nothing.
He is arrogant and seems to only help students he thinks are worth talking to. His tests are friggin' hard. However, his lectures are very interesting and  I liked his teaching style.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments

Elena is a super easy-going person. Better know some advanced quantitative trading before taking this class. If not, still gonna pass. She is embracive in terms of technology. Feel free to use ChatGPT for learning. Not an easy A class unfortunately. But you will definitely learn a lot. She is an experienced expert internationally within the field.

Elena is so awesome, she says the funniest stuff and is brilliant. She she cares about students mental health and happiness as well. Sometimes she can be hard to understand, but she is always willing to clarify. She is a legend. I was taking her 5140 Class "FinTech Trading Lab" and it is hard, but she won't let you fail if you show up.

Elena is a very knowledgable and insightful professor, unfortunately she is an ineffective teacher and struggles to explain concepts in simple terms.  Her understanding of Finance is entirely academic and theoretical, having no industry experience.  I strongly recommend taking FINAN 4050 with another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Extremely disappointing class. She means well, but class was unorganized, dry, and grating. If you want to learn anything, your time is better spent simply reading the textbook. I would highly suggest taking this class elsewhere.
Brilliant subject matter knowledge. Great hands-on learning experience and very down to earth professor! Class organization is the only factor that could possibly need improvment.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She is very helpful and extremely brilliant.  She is there for you to help. I went to her office several times for additional help. But with being so brilliant she has a hard time simplifying topics. Had to go to the TA's  to explain what was taught. There were only 2 tests. I had to teach myself the content based off the practice tests. Hard class

She says she will be easy with grading homework. This is a lie. She grades very harshly and most people getbc's on their homework assignments. She has an accent which you spend most of your class time focusing on because you are trying to decipher what she says so you don't spend enough time focusing on the actual material.
Amazing professor! She makes a potentially difficult class really accessible, and utilizes mnemonic devices that help retention of the material after class ends. Highly recommended.
The course is much harder than a micro class should be. Take it online or in class with someone else, you will be thankful you did.

I really liked her teaching style! She provides blank notes that you can fill in during class. If you miss class, you have to get notes from a friend because she won't post them unless there was a mistake or confusion during lecture. Super organized! Go to TAs and tutors. This is a hard class, but the professor and resources are there to help.

Dr. Dalrymple created one of the most organized classes in BME. Guided notes, homework, and (easy) weekly quizzes helped teach the content. Exams were fair, and the class is curved. Plenty of TA office hours were provided for homework help. If you apply yourself to this course, you will do great. Overall, an effective, doable, and enjoyable course.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Dalrymple is stubborn and unable to take accountability for mistakes. She often times made significant mistakes while teaching and which resulted in the TAs needing to reteach the class during office hours. The only way to do well in this class is attending TA office hours every week. Overall, she is an extremely poor professor.

Dr. Dalrymple's downfall is the homeworks she assigns and the midterms she writes. The homeworks are excessively hard and take forever. They do not help you study for exams or practice because each problem is so long. Office hours is always packed and getting help can be an issue. Never-seen-before exam problems.

She was really amazing and super approachable! I came to her with questions about her education pathway and she was happy to help. her lectures were also super interesting and the course work wasn't overwhelming. 10/10 recommend taking her class.

Super passionate and actually wants you to learn. Participation matters but she gives lots of opportunities beyond speaking in class. Multiple extra credit opportunities but if you pay attention you will do well on exams and won't even need them. Class was T/Th but we only met in person Th, and were expected to watch recorded lectures with our time

I normally don't do these, but Dr. A was so amazing that I had to. This class is easy to succeed in, with lots of opportunities for extra credit, clear grading criteria, and great feedback. It's one of those classes that is worth tuition. It's super interesting, too! I highly recommend taking this course or any course from Dr. A.

Dr. A's class was amazing! It was straightforward, there was no busy work, and the material was interesting. Exams have some tricky questions but if you watch and review the lectures you'll do great. I look forward to taking more of her classes

Dr. Asnaani is a great teacher: in her expectations of the class, the work she assigns, and the lectures she gives which include her own work experience. The class is fairly easy with low work load, but very interesting content. I highly recommend taking this class and any others that are taught by her!

I absolutely loved professor Asnaani. She is one of the best professors I have ever taken in my 70 college credits. She genuinely cares about her students and is always available. Participation matters but if you watch the lectures you should pass with an A. Lots of extra credit offered and great lectures. She adapted well to online learning.
Averie does not seem to care about her students' success. She is not flexible and grades harshly, especially for a 1000-level course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was very difficult. Extremely dense materials and homework immediately following papers and exams. It felt there was never a moment to breathe while being enrolled in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Averie was a really fun and communicative professor who was good at teaching us the skills of public speaking. That class had an amazing and interconnected environment which encouraged us to get to know each other. Made a ton of awesome friends in this class. Highly recommend for a credit.
This is honestly one of the best gen ed classes you can take, and Averie is definitely the prof to take it with. Most of us in the class agr
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Probably my favorite general education class I have taken yet. I really felt like I learned something from this class. I lost my fear of public speaking after this class and felt confident in the best way possible.

This was a great online course! If you study the slides and do the reading, you shouldn't have a problem with the quizzes. The assignments weren't hard at all! She emails you right back, which is a plus.

Nice enough person but not incredibly organized. Initially told us the wrong book and so the entire class bought both books. Lots of reading and the tests were confusing. I felt like she was kind of an absentee instructor most of the term. I wouldn't take a class from her again.
Very easy to understand, attendance optional but tests are from the lecture material. Tests are on application of knowledge, uses interesting examples of experiments. Really interesting class.

For context, I speak Spanish fluently. He's clearly trying his best, but should not be teaching any sort of Spanish class. Quizzes frequently included flat-out incorrect grammar, omission of accents, misspellings, or things that made no sense (e.g. "say 'I don't understand' in the imperative form." That's not how that works my guy).

Don't take this class. You won't really learn anything. I already speak Spanish (as a second language) but I was hoping to learn some new vocabulary. The content is honestly outdated and it is very apparent it is not taught by a native speaker. Lots of typos on quizzes.

Lazy at best. I'm a fluent Spanish speaker and there were countless times where quiz answers would be flat out wrong. Getting 100% is based off luck. Grammar and spelling errors in quiz questions about direct translation. Content is catered to never before Spanish speakers but topics covered are far too advanced. Save the headache and don't take it
class is easy enough but the quizzes are very sensitive to capitals, mistakes, and formatting. None of my spanish speaking coworkers could get the quizzes correct and spanish is there 1st langauge.

Very simple class yet extremely unpleasant. Weekly quizzes ALWAYS contain spelling and grammatical errors. This is very annoying because it is hard to tell what he is asking for. Is the correct answer "none of the above" or an answer that he has translated incorrectly. Would not recommend to those looking to improve Spanish skills. Nice enough tho
awesome professor

Medical spanish was an easy class if you have a general understanding of spanish. Its a combination of basic spanish concepts and medical terminology. There are 10 quizzes and 4 tests all of which are online and open everything. I didn't even have to look at his online notes and I got an A easily. Emails quickly.

Although she was a bit extra with the thought papers, there is only three of them and only two pages. Quiz every week and discussion post, very easy. You do NOT need the textbook I am upset I spent money on it, I just read the lecture notes. Overall, easy class, she is very specific so just be careful.

One of the easier professors I've ever taken. I myself enjoyed her class and thought it was very informative. Sometimes she could be a little snooty for an older gal but usually she was incredibly insightful and helpful. Easy A as long as you do the work with medium effort. I took 3 of her classes because of this first class.

I took Atara's class at Centralia College- but for some reason, it was not showing up on the list. Anyhow, wonderful teacher, very thoughtful. Informative class, not too difficult, yet you actually learn.
Great class. Love this professor.

She is very sweet and really wants people to do well in the class. If you just go to lectures and do the readings you will do great! She is very understanding if you are working and have a crazy schedule as well. She's not (like many others) trying to trick you!
Great class, super instructor. She really knows her stuff.
What a great course and a super instructor.  I would love to take another class from her.
No Comments

Such a fun professor and class. Makes learning Spanish exciting and easy. Gary really cares about his students and wants to see them succeed. There is quite a bit of homework, but nothing crazy. Mostly writing and gives good feedback.

Best Spanish teacher I've ever had. He is the first person to acknowledge the vulnerability that comes with speaking a different language, he isn't judgmental at all. His class also never gave me the level of anxiety that other Spanish classes have so that's a plus. Easy homework and overall chill lectures. I took SPAN 3040, that wasn't an option.

Professor Atwood-Mendez was my favorite professor for Spanish that I've taken. I took two of his Spanish classes and loved them both. If you show up, read the lectures that are given, and do the short questions after the readings, you will get a good grade. Do the study guides as well for the tests, as they are almost exact copies. Favorite teacher

I enjoyed my time with Dr. Atwood-Mendez! He's extremely caring and considerate of every individual student. I greatly enjoyed the structure of the class and the readings were really thought provoking. If you don't have an interest in literature, you're not going to do well in this class because it requires a lot of enthusiasm around the subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A wonderful teacher, very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He has barely any assignments and when he does you don't get a grade till late in the course.  I waited over a month for my grade on my first assignment.  He also doesn't give feedback on some grades, just gives the grade and thats it.
I really like Dr Atwood. He has a very easy personality. The fact that there are so many readings makes it hard to have the time to discuss them in class in  a way that would be useful.

I'm going to find other classes that Atwood teaches and take it for my minor. His class is like what I dreamed university would be. I'm not frantically scribbling notesI relax in his class, listen to his lectures (that he's super passionate about)and I learn. Class was a piece of cake, he's super nice, and I actually learned a ton wo much work.

Lectures are a bit long, not much class participation making it hard to pay attention sometimes. I have no idea what grade I have and finals week was last week so that is a little annoying but other than that Gary knows his stuff  and I learned a TON in this class. I would love to take another one of his classes.

There aren't very many assignments at all, making it very difficult to build up a grade. There are no assignments for most of the reading. Strict attendance policy, but only took roll 13 of the time. Due dates were changed to later, but no announcements online. 1 week left and still haven't got most of my work back, so have no idea how I'm doing
Doctor Atwood is a very clear, concise, and exceptional teacher. He knows his material well and can articulate it well to the class.
Very Helpful and concerned on the students progress

Took him for Lang 2010 and liked him enough that I have him for Span 4550 next semester. No real "text" book, but there are a lot of little novels/excerpts posted on canvas. Clear expectations, fair grader, interesting class discussions. Adult themes including homosexuality and race issues so if you're uncomfortable with that don't take it.

Prof Atwood is an amazing prof. Very easy to work with and gets his points across. Sometimes it can be a little hard knowing what he expects, but he always welcomes questions and gives clear answers. I highly recommend him for any class.
Great Prof. Amazing command of the subject and uses real examples from his experience. I liked the current financial news he would sometimes cover. Absolutely recommend!
Great guy. Honestly, I could fall asleep to his voice- very soothing. Take that as you may.
Professor Ellahie was great at giving many examples to help explain the topics. The test was defiantly much harder than what we had covered in class and on previous quizzes.

He is a cool professor and treats us like people (unlike many other professors). But, he goes through slides quite fast and it's not enough time to retain the information for weekly quizzes. No retakes on quizzes or anything.
Atif is super nice and I was glad I had him because you can tell he really cares about his job! He does a lot of lecturing so you have to be ready to sit through a 2 hour class.

Professor Ellahie was so great! He always made the class laugh and was such an inspiring teacher. Accounting is hard but he made sure his students were always prepared and he gave us breaks when needed and didn't assign difficult tasks. I really enjoyed my time in his class and would recommend him to anyone!

Not a very difficult class at all, I was expecting much worse. He allows a "cheat sheet" to use on exams which is extremely helpful. Exams are straightforward and tests on what was covered in class. Lecture heavy, without required participation, so many students didn't come to class except on exam days, though going proved to be helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: --Online Section-- I enjoyed the class. I've yet to encounter a course with as many assignments as her section but regardless, she was helpful, always available by phone or email, and gives great feedback on assignments and tests.

Really liked this class. She's very kind and helpful, a very pleasant teacher. Work is not hard at all. She really gives you feedback on what you can improve if needed. No textbooks for GEOG of Utah since it's online, you just do research.
Good class, however too much work not related to class. Tests are easy.

Strangest grading system I've ever seen. I still have no idea how she came up with the arbitrary numbers she did. Plus SOOOO much busy work, pointless assignments, and waste of time. I did learn a lot, but it was overshadowed by daily pointless drivel.

He loves to call on people in class be prepared to be called on. You have to pass the final to pass his class even if you get an A on all other tests and assignments........which does not make any sense. It's super annoying don't take his class!!
This professor had some unreasonable grading scales leaving the entire class with lower average scores on tests. He is difficult to communicate with and rarely understanding.
Worst experience of my life, says he prepared us for the final and the class average was 6.3/9. Just impossible to please him.

He is extremely knowledgeable and very nice, but this class was hard. The exams had an average of 70% and there was no curving and almost no points were given back. He made it clear that he was happy with over 50% of the class having a C, which is difficult.

I would drive to class with my seatbelt off, hoping I would get in a crash and never have to go to class again. He wastes the first hour going on tangents about the articles you read, rushes 30+ slides in 20 mins, assigns outdated videos, skips content, Perusall is painful, lots of research, and 70% of your grade is two unclear random group papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: There are so many assignments and they are almost all on content we have not or have barely covered beforehand. We have to complete assignments only on weekends sometimes, and he does not give good help or suggestions. Attendance is mandatory and he also does not adequately cover what is on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There are so many assignments we are expected to do with extremely little instruction. We are not taught what we need to know for homework. Assignments take a minimum of an hour and some are only available Friday to Monday. Attendance is mandatory and we are still expected to watch and annotate lecture videos if we don't complete them in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Jasons actually a cool dude but he completely streamlines your learning experience into how he wants you to learn. I have him for another class right now and I have to send my notes in as an assignment every week. He almost always runs out of time in lecture, making the following lectures feel choppy and disjointed. Nice guy tho.

Jason is great. I took him for PA Epidemiology and he was great. He is very kind, and is more than happy to clear up any questions regarding content. For our final paper he let anyone visit him during office hours, just to give early feedback for the final. I ended up getting 100% on the final because of this. Great prof for a class like this.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have this professor for Exercise Instructor and he really took a class that had so much potential to be fun and then made it boring and pointless. He goes off on tangents unrelated to class, you are tested on the same thing every other week, and he will dock points with no real reason, he just won't give anyone full credit.

I signed up to take this class with Arwen Fuller and he showed up on day 1. I am often scared to go to class as he is very demeaning and will shame you if you answer a question wrong. His midterm (and potentially final) is an essay done with a group... that he assigns. He is not afraid to give a 0 on assignments and probably does so happily.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I had absolutely no idea what was going on in this class. The discussions were very helpful, but the lectures consisted of him quizzing the students on stuff that he would teach us after the quiz was turned in. He also fell behind other professors, so our first test had material on it that we didn't learn until the next week. Beware, it was rough.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Atwood was great! Everybody who says he's horrible just didn't do the homework. It's very important to read the online textbook, because in class he does clicker review problems. The tests are just like the homework, he gives a ton of extra credit, and is always available after class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He expects you to already know everything. He teaches everything as if it's just a review. And sometimes hostile when you ask a question. I would not recommend. I'd recommend Mr. Statler
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Atwood does not teach. His "lecture" is a series of practice problems which you are not supposed to know, but are graded on anyways through clickers. He hardly explains these practice problems and any questions are responded to with hostility and confusion. Homework, quizzes and tests do not match up AT ALL and you are stuck reading all on your own
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Teacher focuses on clicker questions more than homework and tests. clickers are graded on correctness not participation. so you can go to class and still get an F! Also does not take student questions well. if you take this course be wary the class material may not be hard but the teacher may make the class itself hard.

If you want to be taught chemistry then this professor is not for you. If you want to spend hours outside of class teaching yourself chemistry in order to be ready for the daily quizzes then he is you man. You will have 6 quizzes a week for this class, one everyday you are in class and in discussions plus an online one every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Prof. Atwood is great! Do the HW due the day of class BEFORE that day; it helps lots! It is a mix of review and then a preview for the next class. When he asks " are there any more questions," which he does quite frequently, be sure to raise your hand! He is happy to answer Qs until all is clear. The tutor lab REALLY helps. Be positive and work.

Lots of outside work, really have to be dependent on yourself to learn the information and rarely teaches inside the classroom. Attendance is mostly mandatory for daily points that make up 20ish% of the final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This guy acts like he's being held against his will to teach chemistry. This class was so unbearable that sometimes I fantasize about getting in  a car crash on the way to school, so I can miss his lecture.
Overall good class. Attend all lectures and discussions, put in the time and you'll get a good grade.

It's not impossible to do well in this class, but Atwood does expect you to read ahead and teach yourself. You need to attend both lecture and discussion for the clicker points. The homework is done online and you get 3 tries, so it's easy to do well on it. He's very straightforward about what you're expected to know for tests.

He does not really explain anything. He fails to realize that students have other classes and jobs. He expects you to have read everything before the class begins so that you can sit there and wait until he asks you the clicker question that counts for your grade. All his class is, is clicker after clicker. No lecture/explanations whatsoever.

Dr. Atwood really seems to know his stuff, considering he has written the lab manual. However, his teaching definitely needs a lot of work. No visible enthusiasm about neither the subject nor the students.

Do not take Atwood's class if you want to actually learn and understand Chemistry. Atwood does not lecture, this is a class based on clicker questions, clicker questions that are rarely explained. The only thing I learned from this class is  that the practice of tenure should be abolished.

Terrible lecture, teaches it like he doesn't want to teach it. One time when a student ask to draw out the ICE equilibrium problem, he just blew it off and they were no next question, after that he lecture us about how we should be  studying than teaching. I hated  going to lecture. Because of clickers, attended is mandatory.

I am a high school student taking an optional course from Atwood. I came because I love science but this man made me kinda hate it. He teaches it like they did in the 70's and thinks his southern idioms make up for it. He gave no clarity whatsoever on assignment and hates when you ask "stupid" questions.

Atwood is a good guy, but teaching this many students can be difficult. He expects you to read the book and come prepared. If you don't do that, you won't pass. You need to study, but if you do that you'll be fine. ACS final is much easier than his midterms. Sit in the front if you can; he likes people he sees and knows.

This class was definitely not an easy A. If you want a good grade then you better plan on going to every single discussion and lecture because the clicker questions count every single day. His lectures often go ahead of the homework and you have to read way ahead in order to know what is going on. He quizzes you before teaching most of the time.

Yes he is tough. It seems like you won't pass until the end. Then you take the ACS test and you get way above average. Usually the final replaces your grade anyway. Just work through it, and you'll ace the ACS final.
Not a lecture class, it is a clicker class, no teaching is done whatsoever

This professor will quiz you on material that he hasn't yet taught as he expects you to learn everything outside of class. Take the class from Statler, as he is actually willing to make sure you understand. I currently have around an A- in this class and it has been the biggest joke to maintain this grade.

Pop quiz everyday. Most professors teach you something then quiz you on it. He is just the opposite. He will quiz you on something he hasn't taught you yet, then he will teach it to you. Very few problems performed in class. Tests are really hard. The examples done in class are not even close to problems on exams.
When his lectures didn't get off topic, there wasn't much clarity and was disconnected with his students needs to learn. In addition the tests never coincided with his lectures.

Terrible in lecture. If you visual learning, you'll get nowhere in his class. All he does is reads from the slide in class and barely sometime write out problem in class. I learn nothing showing up in class, only to teach myself.
Funny guy, not too tough of a class. Just do the Homework and go to class and you should be fine.

Absolutely one of the worst teachers I have had ever. He does not teach at all and you will have to learn everything on your own. If you expect to get an A, then you will have to spend any extra time studying for his tests. Take it from Statler if you can, He is an awesome guy and great teacher. He actually cares about you learning something.

Very helpful and nice professor with his assistant Mr Statler. Hold your hands to show how to solve the problems. Homework system is great with solutions and video telling you about what you are learning. Spend his extra time to hold help sessions, which is great.
This course is for those who take the initiative to learn the content themselves. With that, the rigor of the course seemed excessive throughout.

this teacher does not teach what so ever. He expects you to read the book and come to class prepared to know what you are talking about. Teachers are suppose to be there to help, not coming to class already prepared, take Statler, he is an awesome teacher! I like Atwood as a person, he is nice, but not as a teacher.

The class is ROUGH. You need to read the book and teach yourself the material. Once you have gained an understanding, he is there to help get it through your head. I did not pass, but I have a tremendous understanding of chemistry because he made me learn it for myself. If you are willing to put in the hard work, his class is great.

Absolutely worst Chem teacher I have ever had. Ironically, I took Ochem I after recieving a C- from Atwood and easily got an A in Ochem. Due to this teachers high level of incompetence (he failed half the class around) I will need to retake Gen Chem II and hope for the best in terms of my GPA. Avoid this teacher at all costs!
He answers too many questions in class, some of them are not necessary to answer in the whole class. But he sometimes emphasis a lot on important points, which is pretty helpful.

His "lecture" isnt a lecture at all... he just makes you answer questions from the book. Doesn't answer questions about the quizzes. Useless for the exams doesnt help you at all. Hes just not a good professor.

He get pissed when he wanted question from a student after certain time, but no one want to reply. And when a student reply, he get pissed and ignore you. I recommend taking Bartl, who show more passion and like to answer your question.

Worst Professor I've ever had.  He never teaches in class.  You teach yourself the material, do the homework on it, then go to class.  All he does is ask clicker questiosn.  He never responds to email requests/questions, or messages via canvas/the student online system.

Proffessor herself was very attentive and responded quickly to emails and questions. Class was just a lot of reading, but nothing ever too difficult. Quiz+300 word essay every other week and discussion posts in between, as well as a final group project+online exam. TA used chatgpt to grade everything though which was annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Be ready for a lot of reading each week (multiple pdf readings per section) The class overall was great overall with lecture heavy 2-4 sections and readings per week. And discussion posts are key for your grade. Clear grading criteria, overall a lot of work but well organized for those who can keep up with an online course. ECON 3190. 10/10 highly
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took health economics, if your taking this class its mostly lectures with outside reading and there are four group projects, the presentations aren't to bad and she grades well. Participation matters and is apart of your grade, so make sure you ask questions and contribute at least 16 times. She was a good teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Article and Study intensive readings, If you love heavy reading this is the class for you. The instructor is straightforward, has clear expectations, and will grade on participation. The heavy reading was draining for me but it wasn't too difficult. I am more of a visual learner so it was more challenging. I would recommend this instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very straight forward and easy lectures with some movies to watch. Quiz are every 2 weeks with no final. Great class.

Very organized, manageable workload. She is not a nitpicky grader. Each week there's 2-6 readings/videos & a discussion post about them. Discussions do not require responses to peers. 

As much as I recommend this class, know that almost every reading/video is about sexual violence. Do not take this class if you can't handle heavy subject matter.

This was a heavy subject class, but Prof Archuleta did a great job providing materials that you actually want to read and were easy to understand. Her grading was clear and she provided feedback on every assignment. There is one "big" project but as long as you genuinely try on all assignments, you will get an easy A
She's great. Has heavy discussion assignments. Not a though grader. Will let you know about what she thinks about your responses. Gives good feedback and overall a nice teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Archuleta is an amazing professor! I would definitely recommend taking one of her courses. The class was discussion based & there was a bit of reading but not hard at all. It is a super interesting course and she gives incredibly amazing feedback on your work.

AWESOME PROFESSOR! I would definitely take this class again. Professor Archuleta is so caring she obviously cares a lot for her students and this subject. She is super helpful and considerate she also provides amazing feedback on your assignments. The assignments are discussion based and there is a 3 part final project.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Pretty easy and fascinating class. The homework is decently time consuming and the quizzes and exams call for pretty specific details from the textbooks and readings but it's all open note & open book. Archuleta is especially kind and understanding when you reach out with questions or for help.
I had Dr. Archuleta for the Diversity Scholars Class. She is a passionate and caring professor and I would definitely recommend taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: between 20-30 assignments due a week although they are not hard they are still time consuming and it is very easy to get behind with the workload given
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: While online French isn't my favorite, Madame Vigil did amazing. I've had other French professors, but Vigil did amazing at explaining things in French and English. There was a heavy amount of in-class participation and activities which I think really helped me out. the 2.5hr lectures are rough, but just because they are lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Madame Vigil was an amazing French teacher. She was patient and understanding of those of us who struggled to lean the language. Learning French can be intimidating, but thanks to her vast knowledge and empathy, it was very possible for those of us to tried.

She teaches more lecture based, rather than participation in my opinion. You're going to need to practice pronunciation and talking more outside of class, since you don't do as much in class. To get better at French, you need to force yourself to participate and be engaged. Everything moves really fast, and it's easy to get behind.
Don't take any of this professor's classes. Don't waste your time with this guys classes.

The lectures were boring but important. For this class I had IVC and the exams were based on the lectures he gave. You have to take notes quickly as he doesn't post the slideshows online. It gets awkward at times as he wants people to respond to him but no one really wants to. Reading assignments before class, which was twice a week.
No explanation for why he gives your papers a horrible grade. Most boring professor I have ever had. Honestly impressive how a professor can be so boring.

Professor Solorzanos class was pretty easy. You have a set of reflections and two essays along with 3 easy tests. Pretty easy A, he does take awhile to grade though. I took this class under covid so he doesnt like when people do not participate during lectures and he cares if you have your camera on. Overall pretty interesting class.

He is an old fashioned prof. Grades on very few things, which makes each assignment important for overall grade. He is intelligent, nice, and means well, but the class often felt drawn out and he would get frustrated when students wouldn't participate. It is an interesting course but it requires patience, attendance, and extra work from students.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I thought he would be easy because everyone says fill out the study guides for an A but I did the study guide and it wasn't even on the test. He is nice but to me he isn't a good teacher I wouldn't take it if you don't have to.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Class requires you to attend every day to earn a decent grade. Often didn't do the readings, but made sure to fill out all the information on the study guides for the exams and got A's on both. Extra Credit is given for presentations. Attendance is a part of your grade so I don't recommend missing this class. Watched a lot of documentaries.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class. If you fill out the study guides, the tests should be easy. He provides extra credit opportunities throughout the semester. He also provides prompted questions for the essays. Overall, I thought it was an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He talks for most of the class and goes off topic but as long as you do the study guides, the tests should be fairly easy. I did not read one of the required readings (skimmed to fill out study guides) and I received an A on every test. There are two pop quizzes but they come off that days class. He also provides opportunities for extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Armando is a very knowledgeable and proficient in the subject! He teaches a really interesting and easy class, but the way he teaches is often difficult to understand, and somewhat outdated, so you have to learn a lot of the information yourself. Make sure to come to class, as attendance is taken and pop quizzes are often given.

Armando is hard to understand in regards to class material and how he runs the class. He tries to make lectures funny, but it's monotone at best. The class knocks out lots of FCS department requirements, but I wouldn't be taking the class otherwise. His A is high (95%) and the lecture slides are chalked full of grammar and spelling errors. Avoid...

Armando is really hard to understand. The lectures are really long and boring. He makes students fear answering in class by manipulating their replies and makes them feel inferior, so no one wants to participate. It was a long semester. Avoid this class if you can.

Has a heavy Spanish accent and is hard to understand.  His lecture slides are full of grammatical errors, and he goes off topic frequently.  The last month of the semester we didn't learn anything for exam material.  He is very disrespectful to those that want to participate, and he talks 99% of the class.  I do not recommend his class to anyone.
He is hard to understand and times due to his strong accent. However, it is a very fun class and hes a good teacher
Hard to understand sometimes. Doesn't like when class doesn't participate. Sometimes he's not clear on the perspective of the infomation. Easy class though.

The teacher is really nice! If you don't enjoy participating in class, then he is not the teacher for you. He begs for participation and when he gets annoyed with the lack of, he won't finish his sentence (which is usually info that you need to know.)
ok guy, kind of hard to understand sometimes. average class, average grading.

Really well done assignments. The practice quizzes helped, but I didn't need them. The course content is a bit difficult to understand, but just doing a couple youtube searches should clear up any misunderstandings. Good professor, but she talks a bit slow at times, and it's kinda tough to see how the concepts are applied to real life sometimes.

I took Econ 2020 as an online class. She does record lecture videos but I didn't watch them and just read (mostly skimmed) the online textbook. The practice tests for the weekly quizzes and exams were really helpful for the actual tests (some of the questions were the same). She also responds fairly quickly to Canvas messages!

Very straightforward and is a fair grader. Cares a lot about student input and how people are doing in the class. Her exams reviews are very helpful so make sure to study them well and you will do fine on the exams!

She was a very good lecturer and covered material in a clear and easy-to-understand way. She knows the material well, and is very good at answering questions. The weekly quizzes ensure that the material is learned well enough but aren't too difficult.

Incredible teacher who is really into the subject matter she teaches. She will help anyone who needs it and offers lots of opportunities for bonus points. Does a thorough review before the test and does't throw any ridiculous curve balls. Do the homework (only 1 assignment a week), participate in class and you should be just fine. Great Econ class.

She is very helpful and understanding if you go in to her office hours. She responds quickly to email. Class is hard to understand but she is willing to give out bonus points freely when working in groups.

She is a decent teacher.  Thick romanian accent makes her hard to understand.  Going to class is pretty worthless but her assignments and tests are easy enough that you can learn from the book.  Test questions come directly from the study guide and hw assignments. Requires use of myeconlab.com which is expensive.

A great class and teacher.  She knows the material and is willing to help in class and out.  Although there isn't much of a break from the material, occasionally she will have the students do something more interesting than simple problems.  She's a great person to learn from.

Man was this a hard class! I dont know if it was so hard because of the material or because of her teaching. She really knows her stuff. But I was just not getting it. Luckily I had a lot of outside help and that's what helped me get by in the class. She is really nice and was very willing to help outside of class.
He is really helpful with HW and the exams are fair. He genuinely wants you to have a good experience. He also offers some extra credit, which is a plus.

The kindest, most leniant grader is Aryaman. He cares about his students and doesnt want to fail you. Responded to my emails ASAP and made math enjoyable  Gives so much extra credit.  Even took time out of his day to hold a specific office hour for me since I had work during normal hours, he truly is the best professor. Would not pass without him
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Do not take. Hard math class. Flew by in lecture, doesn't explain things well had to learn everything outside of class.
She gave everyone a perfect score on the final exam. Think she probably got fired and just said screw it. Class was terrible but it ended up being easy since all the exams were online

I'm only giving her a 4 for difficulty because she messed the entire semester up so bad that all of our exams (final included) ended up being online. I would not expect this to happen again (assuming she somehow manages to keep her job) The entire class was furious with her by the end, and I have to imagine the math department isn't happy either.
exams are not bad, but lecture is horrible. Also, she rarely respond my email even when I really need response for the practice exam etc.

I'll put it this way: if you'd prefer teaching yourself differential equations, Noy could be an excellent professor for you; if you'd prefer a professor who gives good, clear lectures with well-written examples that help you understand the content, I can't recommend her.
All exams were take-home and homework was graded super leniently.

Lectures were impossible to follow, and I say that as someone who generally understands math. Homework and exam reviews not from the textbook were full of mistakes (problems meant to be solved a certain way were actually impossible). I like math and was excited for this class, but Dr. Aranov completely ruined it. Nice person, terrible teacher.

Tbh I feel kinda bad for her. Most professors this bad, you suspect they hate teaching and students. I don't think she does. She just genuinely doesn't seem qualified. Grading policies, test formats, etc. change randomly. The most feedback you get on assignments is "small mistake". Tutoring center stares at the problems she assigns with confusion.

Accidentally revealed the day before the final that some people were being allowed to take it online. People bombarded her email asking if everyone could take it online and she said no. She has been an abhorrent teacher all semester, her lack of ability and professionalism is astounding. She should be fired and never allowed to teach again.

She just reads from the book, if you were to read from the book you would learn 2x as fast. I attended most lectures but she did not engage us very well. Many people just didn't show up after 2 weeks. You really can just teach yourself with paul's online math notes and other resources. It's much better than her teaching style. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She just reads out of the book and still messes up, lectures are basically useless. Lab didn't line up with what we were doing in class. I'd say roughly 90% of her class stopped showing up by the end of the year, and with good reason. Really unsatisfied with her final exam prep, lots of errors and conflicting information
Terrible teacher, she has put far too little effort into preparing us for the final. She better curve this test otherwise everyone is going to fail it. Take anybody else lol

If you're reading this Dr. Aranov, do literally anything else with your life. You are wasting your time and your student's time. I have not met a single person who has had a single positive thing to say about your class. You are unfit to be a teacher.

Avoid her like the plague. She has completely ruined math for me. Before her it wasn't too bad, but she has made me resent the subject because her "teaching" is so unbelievably frustrating. She should NOT be a teacher.

Insultingly bad. She should've never made it through the hiring process. Terrible at teaching, rambles like other people have said, doesn't explain ANYTHING well, takes forever to grade, unclear syllabus, and worst of all, does not learn from her mistakes. Either the most incompetent professor ever or just doesn't give a single " " about her job. Canvas, grading, and the syllabus are a complete disaster. what a joke the U has put on with not firing after all the complaints and letters written to admin. i pay for this joke of an education. set up for failure for the rest of my degree. the class is hard enough but makes exams impossible w lack of teaching and problem difficulty. if i fail this final and don't pass I want my money back.

Lectures are awful, unclear, not helpful. rambles from the textbook, back tracks, does not explain, spams example problems, no teaching. Frequent mistakes, skips steps, impossible to follow along or understand. Wasted time and money on this class teaching myself everything. whole class is going to fail the final and if I have to retake, I'm suing.

Unclear syllabus, doesn't respond to emails on time, just reads out of textbook, talks too fast, skips steps, makes constant mistakes, took her half the semester to start uploading lectures to canvas even after she'd been asked several times to use an iPad because she was writing so small on the board nobody could see. 0/10, nothing good about her
Just no lol
Very unprofessional and unprepared. Final review material is all over the place, takes forever to respond to emails.

Should be fired. I wouldn't be surprised if most of the class fails the final. Practice finals full of errors, not specific as to what is going to be on the final. She just reads out of the book and still makes mistakes all the time.

She better make the final a cakewalk. This class has been miserable and she doesn't even seem to realize. Only good thing was that our midterms were take home, but that was only because she was 20 minutes late on the day of our first one and I think she just kinda gave up. Don't rely on her midterms being take-home in the future. 0/10, TERRIBLE

Noy is a good person, but isn't a good professor. Can not figure out Canvas at all. The homework is all over the place and NEVER consistent on due dates. reviews.comment: Doesn't know how to teach (literally just reads the textbook). Assumes that everyone in the class always understands the material and cannot work canvas for the life of her. Due dates are off about 70% of the time and some homework is way too hard. Luckily grading is super light and both midterms were take home or I would not be passing this class.

Don't take Math 2250 with Noy. She is a terrible teacher. The only good part of the class was that we got take-home exams. The homework is all from the textbook. Class isn't mandatory, and honestly, it made me more confused to go. If you do have to take this course, use Paul's Online Math Notes. Those saved me.

Lecture got very boring and she talks in circles because she teaches straight out of the book. Our tests were very curved. The homework is very hard but helps you learn the material on your own. Our TA and professor had no communication at all so sometimes we were doing practice problems in discussion on thing we didn't even cover in lecture.

Horrible. Should be fired. Went to class today for the first time in several weeks. Only 10ish people in our lecture room made for 100+ showed up. Even this late in the semester, 3 people walked out because of how bad her teaching was. She will have you tearing hair out of your head.

This is by far the most useless mathematics professor I have ever had the misfortune of being around. Unbelievably bad. She's basically given up trying to fix the class because it was such a mess from the beginning. Worst math teacher I've EVER had

Update: I originally gave a 1/5 bc she does a bad job of explaining concepts and reads straight out of the textbook, and so I've had to self study instead of attending class because I couldn't understand her. I still would not recommend taking anything with her, but I'm bumping her up to a 2 bc she made the midterm take home, and often extends HW.

This class was impossibly bad. In addition to what other reviewers have mentioned, she let students do a take-home test if they were sick or had other conflicts. For every test, 3/4 of the student body was "sick," and the average was still below a passing grade. The only thing that made up for this was the monstrous curve she was forced to give us.

Started off as the single worst lecturer I have ever had the pleasure of listening to. Has gotten better as the semester is going along, but cannot make up for the start. The lectures were literally a joke. She struggles to understand how much homework she assigns, and some mistakes in the given homework are laughably bad. Avoid if possible.
She gave all of us 100 on the first midterm, so I am not gonna give her 1 star. If I get an A, I might even give her a 5-star review.

Ok, so she's not actually bad. The first few weeks were tough—it's probably her first time teaching, which is why we got so many 1-star reviews. But her class is getting better; she even uses an iPad and lecture notes instead of just doing all the work on the board. I think she deserves one 5-star rating.
Horribly under qualified. Constant mistakes, doesn't know what she's doing. I feel like I'm being robbed of a proper education in this subject. HORRIBLE, AVOID

The math department at the U has some of the most underqualified professors compared to other subjects. I have learned to adapt, but Noy has been by far the worst. She seems nice and responds to emails quickly, but lectures are worthless. We are 3-4 weeks behind on content. We deadass might not finish the class. At least everyone feels the same way

She is absolutely awful at explaining anything. All lectures are just her reading from the book and not explaining. Tests are extremely unfair and homeworks are extremely long and tedious. Take advantage of your TAs!! 0/5

It's the morning of our first exam, I feel sick with nervousness. She prepared us terribly for this exam. In class review was a total joke, constant mistakes and irrelevant examples. This is my 12th year of school. This is the worst teacher/professor I've ever bear witness to. In lecture she's more confused than the students. I am completely baffled that she is qualified to be a teacher. I have never had a more miserable experience in a math class. Confusing, usually irrelevant homework.  Lectures straight from the book full of mistakes.  Told us we had a quiz and it was actually a midterm.  Take from someone else.

Do not take any class with Noy Soffer Aranov, period, full stop.

reviews.comment: Unfit for the job. Lectures are miserable, she just reads out of the book. lectures are just writing from textbook onto chalkboard with no real explanations, homework sets are long and are not great for improving your understanding of the material. homeworks are consistently posted less than a week before they are due, and often have typos or are very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Do not take 2250 (or any class) from Prof. Aranov. Lectures are bad, she just does textbook examples and messes up a ton. The labs move at a faster pace than she does so TA's have to teach during the lab.

She asks students to solve problems and they won't be able to do it, and she just moves on. Absolutely terrible experience so far, everyone I know in this class also dislikes it. She never explains anything, just writes out of the textbook.

This class is very difficult. She's kind and knows the content but isn't good at teaching it. The grading was heavily weighted since none of us understood the class. Her tests allowed no notes or access to the textbook and felt unrepresentative of the homework we'd done. We rarely saw "correct solutions" to any problems outside of those in lecture.

Already getting a bad feeling. Her lectures have been pretty bad. She just shows super short example problems and doesn't explain them at all, offers zero conceptual structuring. Pretty unhappy so far, already feel like I'm behind. I'm not the only one either, I can hear people whispering about disliking her teaching style over the room.

Avoid this instructor! Her teaching style and requirements are unfair. She uses an outdated proctoring software for everything. Her quizzes and exams are extremely poorly worded and hard to understand. The amount of weekly material we had was unnecessarily high for this class. Do not make the same mistake as me, take anyone else.

I'm a senior with a high GPA, and I found this class to be more difficult than expected. The weekly quizzes require LockDown Browser and a webcam, which adds extra pressure. The questions can be confusing, which makes it hard to know exactly what is being asked. The lectures did not always feel like they prepared me for the quizzes and exams.

This 1.5-credit online course requires 8-10 hours/week. The class and assignments are disorganized and unclear. Attendance is required; extra work is required if missed. Overall, not worth the time or effort. I would not recommend taking this course with Bonita Austin.

reviews.comment: I am a senior at the University of Utah... The most poorly structured class I have ever taken. No, the content is not overly difficult. I strongly urge choosing another professor.
Take a different professor.

My least favorite class I've ever taken at the University of Utah. The quizzes have more security than Fort Knox on an outdated, laggy and overall bad proctored browser. The weekly quizzes honestly make me want to drop out and work at Mcdonald's.

reviews.comment: Bonita is tough, but really cares for her students and wants to see them succeed. Her rating is skewed from most students' perception of her, hard to speak for other courses, but she is amazing in Scholars.

This means giving them a tough time, and not spoon-feeding others, which, if you are not ready for, don't take her class. But if you want to step outside of your comfort zone and learn what it means to be a professional, she is the professor for you.

NComplains about ai, but it makes all of her lectures. There is so much reading, but if you say anything Tabout it she will make you feel stupid.

I am in the Professional MBA program, working full time and taking classes. This class is a crazy amount of work easily pushes 20 hours of work a week if you want to do everything. I will never take her again she teaches through assignment and informational overload ie bad precorded lectures and reading becasue she doesnt want to teach over zoom

Where do I start! She is so incredibly rude. She is short in emails, does not always provide consistent and clear rubrics, and is too harsh on students. She clearly forgot we're freshmen. Definitely will be avoiding her courses in the future.

She is not a good professor! She is incredibly rude to every single student regardless of how polite or respectful they talk to her. Bonita is not understanding at all and completely irrational

bonita is a puta

I took a 3 week section from Bonita, and she was super awesome. She has a lot of experience with management and knows what she is talking about. I would definitely take more classes from her in the future

Why I will never take her class again 1- Loves Men 2- Doesn't clarify or relate class instruction from book to real life scenarios 3- Get ready to raise your hand for clarification 4- Bored if you are over 19 and have actual real life experience in work field 5- Doesn't grade on a curve 6- Test are her own thoughts and very interpretative
Great teacher and expects a lot out of everyone

She was a great teacher; very passionate and knowledgeable about what she talks. However, the class is a little tough grade wise; specially during Summer when there is no curve. Quizzes everyday (daily quizzes aren't that hard). Overall a great class, just put a little work in it.

Fairly easy for a 5700 level class. Quizzes every week before learning in class so you hav to read before class. She's just really annoying in my opinion and gives extra credit for dumb stuff, which I think brings down the curve for everyone else.

Great Class. My last semester and ready to be done. She grades hard - but she is a good teacher who knows her stuff - which is a con as well because she grades so hard. But her class is interesting.

passable but almost impossible with her

Professor Clark should get a rating higher than a 1.4/5

AURORA CLARK IS NOT A 1.3 STAR PROFESSOR!

Honestly guys, just put in the work and you will be fine. Prof. Clark is a fine professor. She's nice and you can tell she really loves Chemistry. Her tests are really hard and her lectures are confusing. But shes a fine teacher, it feels like you constantly have to be on top of things in her class, but I think she gives the resources to do so.
