The class is graded entirely on exams and attendance so keep that in mind. The lectures were boring and long but he tells you throughout what will be on the exams. The class does prep you for finance 3040 conceptually. The professor is nice and tends to crack jokes but overall he's good.

He is very knowledgable on finance and is a nice guy, but not a good teacher. Lectures are rushed and hard to follow, weekly readings are long and dull, and exams had no clear direction until a week before.There was no study guide for exams. He's kind, but this was one of the most frustrating classes & worst teaching experiences I've had.

I took Gene abroad, so I obviously had a very different setup than how a normal class would be. however, i LOVE this man. his lectures might get a little boring, but it's finance, its going to be boring and difficult. he is very understanding and will talk to you about anything. truly a freaking icon.

Gene is very knowledgeable about finance and extremely kind. However, he does not know how to teach. He goes through lectures extremely fast and assigns unbelievably boring readings every week. The exam expectations, or lack thereof, were not disclosed until a week before each test. Great guy, terrible teacher.
Very fun lectures and would answer any questions students had.

2020 with Gene was enjoyable. Gene is a nice guy who enjoys the topic and cares about his students. The textbook reading was the worst part, but we did not use it a ton. If you pay attention to the lectures, the exams will be easy, and the HW is also easy. He also gives extra credit opportunities and drops one of the midterms.

He's a nice guy overall; you can tell he knows finance very well. However, he does not know teaching at all- unless you think teaching is breezing through lectures and dumping 40+ pages of mind-numbing textbook readings every week. The other reviewers must have taken his class when he still made the course and bothered teaching.

Gene is amazing! He has great amount of knowledge in his field. His professional experience in Fintech is highly persuasive. He gets very humorous when students are getting distracted. He is also easy when it comes to grading. Highly inspirational lectures if you are into Fintech.

Gene is one of the coolest professors I have ever had at the UofU. He's crazy smart and fun. While attendance isn't mandatory, show up. He will always be willing to help you out if he knows you, and that's by participating in class and asking questions. He loves to break subjects down, so if you are interested in something specific, ask.

Good guy + an interesting class. There were two major projects that he did not grade or give feedback on. The final project was a group assignment, so pray you get a good team. These projects impact your grade greatly, so not being able to see your score/feedback leaves your final grade a mystery until he inputs it in at the end of the semester.

I took him for 2010, Jordan is easily the best option of the physics teachers. His lectures are a little sporadic, but he gives so many extra credit points and his practice exams are almost identical to his exams. Make sure you understand the basics of the practice exam, turn in EC and go to lecture this is a free A in physics. Great class.

I took him for 2010. Gerton made physics so digestible. Tells you exactly what you will be tested on with practice test, replaces lowest score of tests and drops a lot of attendance and hws. Lectures are definitely freestyled but with this class structure i dont mind.  Gerton is your guy if you want to take physics.

This was for 4010. I'm writing this before the second half of the class that's taught by someone else. Gerton was a fantastic professor. The workload was heavy at certain points, but it was relatively easy to follow the material.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Really great for a lecture hall, overall he seems like a cool guy too so that helped

Professor Jordan Gerton has been the kindest, most approachable professor I have had at the U. Jordan cares about student success and lets you know exactly what will be tested on exams. He also gives ample opportunity for extra credit assignments, which relieves the stress of studying just to get an A.

His lecture slides are way too complicated. He doesn't necessarily teach than just reading what's on the slides. His voice is monotonous and he doesn't explain things very well. He uses circular reasoning and often goes off on a tangent with no clear goal in mind. Discussions were a nightmare and TA's were of no help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He seemed kind, present, accessible to students, and generally met any expectations I would have for a professor. I have no issues with his course, nor did I find it exceptional. I would expect an average experience and a fair understanding of the subject.

His lectures are too technical and hard to follow.

He gauges class understanding with multiple choice concept questions during lecture. The problem is they are common sense and falsely indicate understanding.

Dont go to lecture. Do the discussions by yourself. Watch pre class assignment videos. do hw early. go to study hall.

He's great. He gives you the scenarios that will be on the exam prior. He also opens up the homework at the end of the semester so students can get 100% on it. His grading scheme is very fair where exams only compromise 50% of your final grade. Approach him and go to TA study sessions and you'll easily get an A in the class.

Dr. Gerton is one of those professors who genuinely cares about his students and puts visible effort into his lectures. The exams are hard, and the homework is not easy, but the material is very well presented. He is very helpful if you approach him with questions. You will learn, but be prepared to work hard.

Gerton is an excellent professor. Although my class was very large he was dedicated to helping students and providing the means for his students to succeed. His grading/class expectations are very clear. The only thing that may frustrate students is there is no room negotiating those rules concerning grading and test taking.

This guy is fantastic. He will go out of his way to help you in so many ways, and his tests are completely representative of the homework. He was even nice enough to reset everyone's smartphysics homework at the end of the semester so we all had the possibility of 100% homework grade. Is very accommodating.

He knows his stuff but because there is so much material crammed into the semester it is hard to get a full understanding going to just the lecture and trying to do the home work. He is excellent in organizing opportunities for you to get extra help.

Attending class is totally useless, all of his lectures are exactly like the online videos he gives you to watch the night before. You have to learn everything by yourself & the textbook is awful(3 ex /chap). Buy a REAL book. Exams are difficult and pressed for time. Take this class at SLCC if you can. Prof is a nice guy, but his class is terrible.

Dropped after a few weeks. 2 of his 3 lectures a week were the same as the online hw. He didn't go over any examples except on Fridays. The Smart Physics system he uses has few examples and is worthless. Expect to learn by yourself or from discussions where you actually do problems. Also expect to buy an actual Physics textbook to learn Physics.
His course material is difficult but he is very concerned with his students understanding course concepts. He and his TA's spend a lot of time helping students outside the classroom.
Excellent Professor. His demos in class really help.
Great teacher, interested in subject and good at presenting examples. Hard subject but go to class and do all the work, should get a good grade.
Very helpful, very clear, passionate about subject. Great teacher. Subject is hard, but go to class every day and do all the work, should get an A.
Awesome, nothing else to say.
The professor is very nice, and begins lab with lecture so you actually get to ask him questions. The class itself is not too hard. The TAs were nice and helpful.

Prof. Laicher is alright. His lectures were helpful & he was pretty funny. The TAs make or break it & (at least this semester) they werenot helpful. Ex: laughing at people when asked questions & made students feel slow (across sections). Pre-labs weren't bad & took me 10-20 min. I had no previous coding experience and reports were not too hard.

His labs are easy and short; more often than not, you just plug information into a given MATLAB file. His explanation of Capstone was unhelpful. I tended to tune his lectures out. I would say class could have been better based on TAs, but it was easy enough I didn't really care. Plus, he drops two labs at the end. Easy A!

Your lab experience will depend on your TA. Gernot will lecture at the start of a few labs, but will often mention topics that are meant for students in higher level classes. Very little instruction on how to utilize the software and for us to be self sufficient students. Had to rely heavily on an LA to basically walk us through the labs.

I've taken several of his classes. The first few weeks of his class are a chore with the homework. But less than 15 minutes of homework after the first weeks when the MatLab Tutorials are complete for the intro Physics Labs. The fun and satisfaction significantly increase with his optics class, I would recommend taking it!

It was hard to learn new MATLAB concepts, but the labs we did in class were pretty straightforward and interesting. The only issue I had with the lab was that a few of the prelab quizzes were a bit difficult, and I struggled to figure them out. Aside from that, I would take the lab again.

I don't understand why many people rate him/his class poorly. Only the first few prelabs are somewhat difficult if you don't already have experience with MATLAB. Lab reports hold your hand a lot. He's helpful and pretty nice too. Nice guy. Just do the prelabs, look at the lab beforehand, ask for help when needed and you'll get an A.

Prelab work was not as bad as most people claim besides the first intro to MATLAB assignment. The labs are well written and done in groups. I had a great group so I found most of the labs to be informational, fun, and easy to complete. The main thing that could be hard in this class is learning how to code in MATLAB. I would take this class again.

I'm halfway through the semester: The amount of pre-lab work is insane. 3-4+ pre labs due on average. Grades on a 0.1 scale, so labs out of 20, everything else out of 3... you miss a question that's a 75%. Nobody TAs for this class, so TAs aren't good. Mandatory attendance. I'm tired of this ONE CREDIT CLASS. Feels like a 3 hour.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Unlike many other lab professors, Gernot was actually there most of the time. He was fair on grading, set up assignments well, and was very helpful. Good professor.

For a 1 credit hour class this felt like 4 all on its own mind the fact I was also in PHYS 2210. Let"s just say I spent probably just as much time on the labs as the lecture. On top of that if you don't know how to code plan on spending all 4 hours of every lab in pain as you try to learn. This was definitely one of the hardest classes I have taken
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Very helpful and knowledgeable in lab. If he has the time he will help you through each setup of the lab and help you know what you're supposed to get from it. Usually two assignments per week, prelabs and reports. Has a rubric he follows exactly for grading. Passionate about physics and seems to love teaching.

This may be an unfair assessment because I am graduating this semester in physics and this class is typically taken by first-year physics students, so taking this lab was more of a refresher for me. This class was fairly straightforward and the professor has clear grading criteria. He graded fairly and the labs were representative of the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: he assigns math that is technically past the pre-requiste of the classes he's employed to teach. on the surface, there's nothing wrong with pushing students to learn. but, this stinks more like an individual who's trying to dress for the job he doesn't have.

For a lower level, 1 credit hour lab, there was way too much homework. All the labs are written by the instructor and had very confusing instructions. The labs consist of three people in a group working with one computer. The instructor is rarely able to answer your questions.
Uses a coding system called matlab. Very difficult and overwhelming for a first physics class.
He has the worst grading criteria, very very unfair, and he doesnt care at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: The labs are so confusing and the TA's don't even speak english. Everyone is asking everyone how to do the poorly written labs and no one understands physics. Absolute horrible lab, but unfortunately we have to take it for medical school and he's the only professor with crappy TA's. Good Luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This is the strangest lab that I have ever taken. It is more focused on data analysis and computation than actual physics concepts. Some of the homework was time consuming. The minilabs that I had were fairly straightforward and my TA was very generous with grading. It was an easy class to get a good grade in.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: First off, you never meet him and there is no lecture. Because of that, you walk in blind to every lab! The TA I had was sarcastic and clueless. The homework doesn't make any sense, but thank goodness there are only 6. There is absolutely no guidance for the labs. Yet, it's not hard to get an A if you beg for help from the TA (they give answers).

The prereq for the couse is calc 1 but the professor was making us do calc 3 work. I worked way harder in this lab than the actual physics class. His manual is impossible to understand and his TA couldn't figure it out when I went to get help. This class in no way supplemented my learning of physics

I took this class and the first physics lab from him. I disliked them both. The material in the lab was sometimes interesting, but any interest I found was quickly squelched by how tedious and time consuming the labs were. WAY too much homework for a 1 credit class. I wish I would have followed  Heather's advice and taken the gen physics labs.

I have taken 6 labs between Chemistry, Math, and Physics, but this is certainly the worst.  The loose bound lab manual is full of errors, unclear procedures, and is sometimes just plain wrong.  The homework aisusually quite easy, albeit time consuming.  I am a straight A student, but I wish that professors would hold themselves to the same standard

Get in a group with smart people, and you'll ace the class. Labs are due at the end of the period, so ask your TA if you have questions. Grading is very harsh, and there isn't much middle ground on grade distribution. Some of his homework assignments take 10 minutes and some take 3 hours, so don't blow it off until last minute.

Stands by his TA's and assumes students don't know anything instead of working with students to reveal that they DO know it, but don't know how to say it. His lab manuals are riddled with grammatical errors, unclear instructions and schedules as to when homeworks and labs are due. TA's have NO structure and has no consistent grading.

The textbook (which he wrote) can be confusing, but the links he provides on Canvas are helpful, and he is great with explaining things during office hours if you are still lost.  If you go to lab prepared, it's a breeze.

Uses his own "text". I consider myself a bright student, and his lab manual is poorly written (typos, etc.) and incredibly difficult to follow and comprehend. I have aced every physics lab and class I have taken thus far, and his class is the most frustrating class I have has in my three years here. I enjoy challenges, but this is ridiculous.

Overly verbose and unclear assignment specifications. Unpredictable grading. Constantly encouraging teams to begin coding early while simultaneously assigning hours of busy-work. Overall, the class was frustrating but manageable if you find a good team.

I have enjoyed Germain's classes a lot. It's really rare to have a professor that can distill complex topics for beginners and drill some real world rigor into your SWE process. Yeah I've got gripes, he's a tough grader and kinda surly, but I've never learned more than when I was in his class. If you want to learn, go for Germain.

Be aware: this course provides minimal study or practice materials. Students are expected to self-teach, often instructed to use chatGPT, with limited guidance or posted resources. All tests and quizzes are hand written code. Choose this professor only if you're comfortable learning independently. if not, don't give the U your money to take this.

Professor Germain has no idea of how development works in the real world and often rambles about pointless topics. He grades pointlessly hard on some things and doesn't care about other which should be important

The kind of guy that likes the sound of his own voice. Lectures are him yapping about pointless topics not related to computer science. Most of the class is busy work, and the final grade is based on how he feels about your project. Honestly a disgrace to the university, by far the worst professor I have encountered. AVOID LIKE THE PLAGE.
weird class, does not help with preparing you after graduation.

Professor St Germain (by his own admission!) never tells people when they do things right, only when they do things wrong. He's structured the course in a way that makes 60% of the assignments feel like pointless, bloated busywork. And he's been in academia for far too long to be leading a class that's supposed to prepare students for industry.

He takes a beginner level class and turns it into an advanced level class. It has stuff we have barley talked about from the 1010 class, he requires you to make your own high level programs from scratch, and if you have a question be prepared to be ridiculed by both the TAs and the Professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He would sound judgy if you asked questioned in class or office hours.  His tests would take more time then given to complete and the homework would take several hours to complete. This is an intro class.

Terrible professor. Requires partner work on assignments that are so easy they can be done in a day by yourself (a CS class should not REQUIRE social interaction). Requires attendance for CS2420, an exceedingly easy class that anyone with previous Java knowledge can pass without learning anything new. Extremely boring lectures, disorganized grading
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Pretty easy course, the professor was really cool, but you could tell he was getting fed up from the lackluster discussion posts. Actually interesting information, weekly discussion + review slides, occasional quiz + behavior change assignment. The final didn't try to trick you. Would recommend to anybody for Gen-Ed or more credits.

The work for this course is very clearly outlined and manageable- mainly being to do chapter readings each week and respond to discussion posts. Some weeks there will be additional assignments or quizzes, but it is not hard to follow. Make sure you know the material for the final but overall great and fairly easy course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is so doable and Loomis makes the assignments and outline of the course so clear. I took it completely online and spent about 15 minutes on it every week. Really enjoyed the class, would definitely take it and Loomis again if I have the chance.
I really enjoyed this class and highly recommend this professor to anyone!

Defiantly would recommend this course to anyone, has really good information about an overall healthy life and I like that we were able to practice healthy habits. If you do all the assignments you'll pass you'll most likely pass

This was a 1010 class, so its a given that its not that hard. This was also online, the tests are open book, there will be weekly discussion. Also some community project and papers, but honestly they're pretty easy. You just need to literally do the work and you'll get an A.

This was an enjoyable online class. Geoff required a couple papers and projects, but they were not too intense. Discussions were due each week but they were interesting. I would definitely take this class again.

I took this class online. I passed... I wasn't very passionate about the class but it was easy. All assignments, quizzes, essays, and discussions were clearly stated in Canvas. He even sends reminders. So you won't miss anything. Recommend if you need an A

LOVED THIS COURSE!  Professor Loomis truly cares about his students and constantly stays in touch via email. A lot of times with online classes it feels like the professor doesn't exist.  Therefore it's really nice having him always available if you need him.  The discussions and quizzes were easy and the papers were actually super interesting.

Professor Guevara cares deeply about her students and will always provide you with feedback! Her lectures are always interesting and her overall attitude really makes her class. I've taken way too many classes with her and always learn something new. She's made me more confident in my Spanish, especially on a more professional level!
Knows a lot about what she's teaching and keeps content interesting through her lectures. She has lots of great stories and is funny! Enjoyed this class.

Guevara is amazing. She cares about her students, and if you ask for extra feedback, she will give it to you. She is very knowledgeable, and ever since I took my first class with her, I have tried to make my class schedule work to fit her in. She has high expectations and wants you to grow, but she is also there to make sure you are successful!

Gema knows what she is talking about. If there ever was a class where you get out what you put in, this is it. If you do not want to get anything out of class and want to slack off and not pay attention, go right ahead, she won't stop you. However, if you want to learn some interesting stuff, ask questions and engage, she will love to talk to you!

The book for this class is a giant anthology and I was worried there would be a ton of reading because it is a Spanish Lit class, but none of the assigned readings were longer than 10 pages. Usually around 3-5. Great lectures. Mixes English and Spanish to help with comprehension during lectures. Gives a review that is the exact format of the test.

Knowledgeable, passionate, and helpful. be sure to take notes of what she says in class; it will probable on a test. Also watch out for vague question seeking specific answers. Overall, the best Spanish teacher I've ever had.
Very good instructor. Make Sure you come to the lectures since she tells you everything that will be on the tests. Take good notes.

If you hate math but still need to take 1030, Rahul is your guy. Extremely helpful. Really wants their students to succeed. Gives extra credit to improve your grades even though it was not required of them. This is my only math class that I felt like going every day because the prof made the instruction super fun and engaging. Hats off!

Very good professor who cares for his students. Lectures are the best part of the course. They are clear, with lots of stories and examples. Basically if you attend class regularly you don't need to read textbook. However, if you're taking a math class after long time, you might struggle a bit in the beginning. Attend his regular office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This instructor's lectures are very efficient. Just paying attention to class prepares you for everything. Clear grading criteria and he drops one exam and 2 quizzes. But no extra credit option. There is penalty for late submission. There is a group project as well. Very much available outside class if you have doubts. Highly recommended:)
I never liked math. Rahul made me love it. Sometimes I felt quizzes are a bit harder than exams, but rahul always conducts long reviews before any test. All things considered, best math prof ever.

Rahul is a cool dude who always has stories to tell. Before each topic, he tells stories, and that is the part you don't wanna miss. Beautiful boardwork, great notes, and lots of outside-class help. Only complaint: Too strict with deadlines and no extra credit to improve grades.
Overall, really great professor who wants his students to succeed.

The lectures are very well prepared and has good anecdotes. So don't miss them if you take his course. They will prepare you for all tests as Rahul does all kinds of problems in class and gives similar problems in tests. Grades out just now and I feel I worked hard to earn my grade. Having Rahul constantly answering questions was of great help.

I agree to the previous rating. Only thing I would like to add is the instructor really pays attention to students' needs and really tries to help. Also, he would remember if you made a mistake in class or quiz or exam and will try to fix it one on one, which I felt pretty great. (he might forget your name though!!)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you need to take 1030 before graduation, try to take it from Rahul. He is the best math instructor I got. Really. I switched from another (terrible) section to his course. He cares about his students and creates a really positive classroom where all questions are welcome. Only criticism: I felt the exams are longer for 50 minutes.

Rahul's a great teacher! A bit hard to understand and teaches in roundabout ways, but he ensures no surprises on quizzes/exams—gives study guides with exact problems. There's a group project, but he grades it easily. Cookies and stories are a fun bonus!

Interactive teaching, encourages participating, great time management, prepares good lectures. This is a half-course so lots got covered in a single class.If you take this course, be ready to work hard. Quiz and homeworks in every class. Exams are mostly easy if you follow the lectures. Prof gave extra credits and lots of help outside classroom.

Rahul loves teaching and cares about his students. Down to earth. Creates a positive atmosphere where all questions are welcome. Lots of homework and quizzes but exams become easier after. Also, if you have any emergency or difficulty, he'll try his best to help you. His office hrs helped me to catch up and finally get an A. Highly recommended.

This was my last course at U and Im glad it was with Professor Rahul. Sweet, very caring, friendly, makes jokes (tries atleast)! Followed his lectures carefully, did all worksheets and aced the tests. Calc looks  less scary now for him! Also, amazing hand writing and does a lot of good examples in class.

Clear lectures, and tells cool math stories to explain stuff.
He does a lot of examples in class and the cookies are a plus :))
Best math teacher ever

For his first semester teaching, Rahul did a pretty solid job. There were a few rough patches where he was still learning the ropes, but he came a long way this semester. Super funny dude who cares about you learning. Fun class with a nice environment, good math credit.

Truly the worst professor I've ever had by a long shot. If you already have a strong real estate background (i.e. work in the field), you will still struggle but will most likely pass. If you do not work in real estate, good luck. Andra's teaching is so terrible that the only students who do well are those that knew the material going into it.

Absolutely god awful. Whatever you do DO NOT take this class. Professor favors certain students and the grades show it. By far the worst professor I have had at the U. Wish I would have dropped the class.

Hands down the worst professor I've had over the last four years. She is very condescending and arrogant and does not provide a welcoming class environment. Her class is unfair, and she tests on material that was never taught in class. She thinks she knows everything when she's never seen the outside of a classroom in her career.
Fired the TA, but does not make time to meet with students outside of class. Very unclear grading criteria, and quizzes us on things we were not taught in class (links a YT video on how to do it).

Andra is extremely condescending and oftentimes makes mistakes in class, but won't own up or apologize. If every single student gets the question wrong, it probably isn't because we have "anxiety" or "brainfog". Lacks ability to empathize with students, cannot pick up on social cues, and should not be teaching in a field where she has no experience
She simply is not cut out for teaching. Awful class, DO NOT TAKE.

Required $150 textbook I have didn't touch(no inclusive access). Never knew what I was going to be tested on. Exam questions didn't have information required to fully solve problems. Quizzes have material we weren't taught and take your entire weekend to complete. Good person, but an ineffective professor. Highly recommend taking from someone else!

I have never had a professor as unqualified and unprofessional as Andra. You can tell she has no practical experience in finance due to the way she teaches. She requires you to only use scientific calculators but teaches on excel. She also tests on untaught material and couldn't even do the test she made.

Andra is knowledgable but terrible at teaching. She has no real-world experience being a career prof that makes 700k a year. Her class is made unnecessarily difficult as you cannot use a financial calculator.  Additionally, she spreads teachings of gender identity in her class which is interesting for a Finance class. (Agenda pushing Elitist)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I've had at the U. Does not know how to teach real estate to beginner/undergrad classes and assumes you know all of the terminology going into her class. Extremely hard tests on material she has not taught, does a terrible job at explaining the concepts, and gets annoyed if you do not understand. Take from someone else.

(I took ETHNC 3790 but that course wasn't listed on here) Alborz literally changed my life for the better in ETHNC 3790. Hosts great discussions and wants to know what students have to say. Made a great learning environment and didn't just tell you what you wanted to hear. Could not recommend him more. I will miss his teaching and his class a lot.

He's a fun guy but I found this class useless to me so I got bored of it. Really easy gen ed credit though. Discussions in class were fun. I personality wouldn't've taken this class as a choice I was required to for a scholarship. Really easy grader, not much work needed, do try and read the stuff he assigns us but if you do not you'll live.

ETHNC 2510 is organized a little different. There were four different lecturers in total, and professor Ghandehari was among the ones I enjoyed the most. He is very caring, and he made his lectures very interesting. Every so and often, we met in section, and worked on a group project under his guidance. His feedback on essays was very helpful.

Georgi is a great professor to have. She genuinely cares for her students and wants to teach them about how to communicate professionally. She can be a slow grader, but it depends on the TA you get tbh. She is rather picky so it's not going to be as easy as you would want but it's to help you improve. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN.

Extremely easy and honestly a great class to doze off in!  She's an amazing professor, and all her lectures have meaning, and you actually gain useful skills.  Her assignments are super easy.  Just zero tolerance on absences, tardies, and phones.  Otherwise, I would take this class again.
Georgi does an amazing job teaching this class. She teaches in a way that students feel comfortable in class and clearly understand what the expectations are. Loved this class & everything taught!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is a very energetic teacher. Attendance was compulsory, so you definitely need to attend class. She is a tough grader but has a chill personality. I enjoyed the class.

She is the perfect example of a professor that cares more about teaching her students than following requirements. Her classes are fairly easy to get an A but overall helpful. You need to put in the effort to get the reward, otherwise you feel like you are wasting money. Georgi is an acquired taste something she admitted the first day of class.

Absolute WASTE OF TIME. Georgi spent the semester wasting lecture time to complain about how she doesn't make enough money, she doesn't want kids, she isn't married. It made me extremely uncomfortable throughout the entirety of the course. I did not learn anything meaningful in this course- easy A, but don't expect to take anything away from it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Georgi is a very nice person, with that being said, she teaches her own opinions as fact. She lectures on nuanced topics as black and white, and when challenged or questioned, she just dances around the question. Her class made me roll my eyes more than a few times. I understand why people like her, but just not a realist's cup of tea.

Georgi is the best! Super easy management class, just go to class. Grade is based off participation and exams. She allows 3 classes to be missed. There's 4 exams and as long as you review her slides you'll be good. Doesn't try to make the class hard, she cares more about learning lifelong skills. Georgi is also super funny and makes class fun.

Georgi is amazing! So kind and helpful and the course is very easy. Graded on 4 exams and attendance, and the lowest exam is dropped. Use her slides like flashcards to just memorize everything, go to class, and you'll get an A on the exams and in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Georgi is one of my favorite professors I've had at the U. Some of the content feels a little simple but she is so passionate about what she teaches I actually found myself learning a ton from the class anyway. I would highly recommend taking this class from her if you have a chance. 4 tests and she drops the lowest one.

Georgi is very energetic and she genuinely cares about your well being. Just come to class and listen to her lectures and you'll do great in the class. Study from the slides and what she tells you to study and exams are easy.

If you get the chance to take this class DO IT. This class has honestly changed my life and will change yours. You learn so much about yourself and others in the workplace. Plus Georgi is one of the best professors I have ever had. For one she is extremely smart and hilarious. Her lectures are always engaging and interesting as well! PLEASE SIGN UP
Hands down the best, most caring professor I have ever had and most likely will ever have. Two words, Enroll now.
The only class I have ever been excited to go to and sad to leave.

Georgi is definitely one of my favorite professors at the U. She genuinely cares about her students. As long as you show up to class and study the slides like flashcards you'll pass this class with flying colors. She is not a tough grader and really cares about having her students at least try. She's great! 10/10 recommend.

Georgi is super nice & her class was really easy. I was dreading having to learning stuffy industry terms but she really made the material her own. Just show up and you'll pass. Her energy might not work for some people but she's really great overall. Focus is more on how to build and stick to your own ethics rather than learning theory.

She is very energetic, has high energy, not your normal college professor. If you don't agree with something she says or the material, she is very open to discussing it in class and getting the whole class's input. There are 4 tests, she drops the lowest one, if you go to class you don't really have to study. It all comes from slides and lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: I don't think I share a single opinion with Rausch, yet I love and respect her and would take her class again. She clearly cares and shows compassion for students as well as for the course material. Lectures are as good as you make them! She wants participation and discussion. Otherwise she trails off on something sad about her life :'(

The professor is very open, energetic, and welcoming. The course turned out better than I expected, and I gained applicable skills. 4 exams, the lowest dropped, and actually covers materials from the lectures. Just study her slides like flashcards, and you should be golden.

This was one of my easier online classes by far. There were weekly zoom meetings which covered the lecture material for the week and went over the homework, which was a bit of light reading. Grades were based on participation and 4 tests, with the lowest dropped. The tests were very easy and based on the lecture slides and in-class discussions.

She is the absolute BEST teacher you will have at the Business School, she has a new perspective of going into business and wants to see every student succeed. Additionally, she has a huge emphasis on mental health and always works to build student's confidence in themselves! This is a class any business student should ensure they take!!

Georgi was e very nice and organized professor. Exams reflected the content covered in class. I didn't like her method of grading participation. I always did the readings and classroom exercises she assigned; I never missed a class or have ever been late to class and received a B-, C+ grade for participation; That was a little unfair in my opinion

Honestly, this class began to feel like a chore past a certain point. Georgi gets distracted while talking in class a lot, and makes sports analogies that really don't make sense, but this is all still graded for participation/attendance. My advice: make friends with the people in your class because they're the ones who will make it enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Georgi is an ok professor overall. For the most part her class felt like a waste of time and I was only going for the participation grade. She tends to talk a lot and go on tangents quite regularly. She is very nice though and treats all of her students fairly. Had five quizzes with easy common sense questions and 3 filmed presentations.

This class is nothing what I expected it to be. There are 4 tests and participation for your grade. The tests are not hard and her questions are very practical. She is full of energy and is so funny. Georgi is awesome, I would take any class from her. She is very smart and I learned so much from her.

Georgi is one of my favorite professors at the U. She knows the material very well, she's laid back, very caring, has a sense of humor, and is very respectable when it comes to her professional background. I highly recommend taking her class. Attendance is mandatory. She is flexible to an extent, but plan accordingly!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Georgi was a great professor. She's always laughing (which I love) and clearly communicates her expectations for each assignment. She's always willing to help students out and is very understanding of individual circumstances.

Took it for internship credit. Side note, you can make your job count for elective credit! Completed weekly 1 page papers detailing what I learned. Easy, educational, and fits into your existing schedule. Thumbs up to the U for creating this as an option. Nice to get credit for my hard work outside of school.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Georgi is an awesome professor who really wants everyone to know that it's okay if you're not 100% amazing at things, as long as you can improve yourself. Highly recommend. She's a little granola, but really enthusiastic and one of the few professors who recognizes that mental health is important in school.

Georgi is the best. She's funny, smart, and really does care about her students. As long as you show up, she will help you to succeed- maybe not A+ succeed, but B- at the worst. Basically, as long as you improve and actually show up and try, you'll be able to pass and not hurt your GPA.
Georgi is the best. Very knowledgeable, well organized, great activities and lectures.

Georgi demands a great deal from her students, but helps you to gain confidence in yourself as a writer/speaker. She treats everyone well and allows for a lot of discussion. She comes off a bit granola in her attitude and apparent lifestyle and tries to implement that in the class a lit. However, she is altogether a great professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Georgi is friendly when she is teaching us and care every student. Most of our questions can be responded by her efficiently. However, she is strict at grading papers because my papers were scored low. She let our presentation to be recorded by cameras, so we could be a little nervous when presenting.

Georgi is genuinely the best teacher I've ever had. Ever. She cares so much about her student's success.  She's funny, warm, and SMART.  If you want to be a better public speaker, increase your confidence, or get a job after college, then Georgi is the right teacher for you.  I can't recommend her enough.  Absolutely fantastic teacher.

The work you have to put in isn't hard and totally worth it, she really cares about her students succeeding and that is why she makes you work. Everyday I left her class I felt more confident and motivated to do well and be successful. If you want to be a future leader of America I HIGHLY recommend taking any class from her.

Georgi is hands down one of my favorite professors at the U. She has a lot of experience, makes lectures fun, and pushes her students to do their best. She gets to know her students and is so easy to approach with questions or concerns. Take any and every class you can from her, it is absolutely worth it.

The best teacher I've had in my schooling career. Yes, all the other reviews are right, she does grade fairly tough, but she gives you all the tools to succeed. And she grades tough for a reason: to set you up for the real world. She is fun, hilarious, genuinely caring, and a real joy to be around. I highly suggest taking her class.

Georgi is amazing.  She transforms you from a student to a Business professional.  You will have to stand in front of class and talk.  There is some reading but not much.  Everyone enjoys the class (which is small) and makes friends.  She is funny and her lesson plans are very structured and easy to understand.  Instrumental in getting jobs!
It's a very useful class and I learned a lot. She is VERY picky on written assignments. She makes class interesting, but she is an extremely slow grader. A lot of class presentations.

You will feel easy to get a not bad assignment grade at the begining, but no matter how hardworking your are, your final assignment would have a low grade. Maybe high online evaluationS is important,but inorder to meet course requirement from the U,  many of you wont get what you expect.
Great professor! Expects a lot, but the class is very rewarding. Make sure to take classes from her!

Georgi is a great professor! She cares about her students and wants to see them succeed. She does grade tough but it helps you prepare for future classes. I would highly advise you take any classes from her that you can!

Georgi is a very friendly and caring instructor. She does grade hard, but she is also ready and available for students whenever they need help. She also collaborates with class to make it better for the students to understand  the subject better.

Really fun instructor who really cares about seeing her students succeed. She tries to make public speaking as bearable as possible. It's not an easy class, but as long as you show improvement throughout the semester, you will get a good grade.
The class itself is beneficial but at the same time she grades pretty hard. More specifically, the writing gets graded the hardest. Again, the class is beneficial but not an easy A

A very easy pass fail class. Dr. Ghandehari is very kind and relatively quick to answer questions. The purpose of this class is just to expose you to research ideas so it's very simple. Pretty much show up and think of some questions, there are some very interesting topics covered in the class.

Prof Ghandehari organized some great lectures for this class. It was one credit, show up and pass, and it was a great way to learn about what's going on in the bioengineering world. He picked good speakers and was good natured.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bioen 3091 is a seminar class (1 credit), so there were no tests or grades. Professor Ghandehari organizes a lecture series from several different professionals in the field. You take notes on the lectures and write down 2 questions per lecture. You turn in all those notes at the end and if you have 12/15ish lecture notes, you get the credit. Easy.

She is a pretty good teacher, she makes sure that everyone understands.  However, she is actually a bit too lax, there doesn't seem to be any punishment for not completing homework on time.  She does make the class fun though.

Shireen is the best! I highly recommend taking any of her classes. She is entertaining and makes the subject material animated... I have the feeling she really cares that her students learn. She is passionate, humorous and lovely.

She is fun and easy to listen to.  You can miss class if you email her beforehand letting her know why.  Makes the subject fun and gets class involved. Definitely a must take if you have time. Easy to stay on top of HW.

still completing class, I am in progress and will give an updated more detailed rate then.  But fun teacher that is very animated and passionate about this subject.  So far seems helpful and leant with students.

Professor Gibson is funny and made class super easy. My main concern is that her lectures were not really intriguing and were really vague, and they wouldn't really prepare you that well for her tests, which are all scenario-based questions. However, she does drop your lowest test score and offers extra credit for class participation
The absolute worst professor ever. If you are taking her class, drop it NOW! Run, don't walk away. The class is a mess, and so is she.
All other reviews are spot on. The exams are vague and confusing. She is so insecure that her course is super easy and to come off as a legitimate teacher, she creates unnecessarily hard exams.
She is dismissive and condescending. Hates male students.
Just read off the slides with no explanation. Pretty pointless class with a pointless professor. Dresses like a clown.
She is disorganized and lectures make no sense whatsoever. Should not be allowed to teach college and I am surprised she still has a job.
Super boring and uncaring. Absolutely could not care less about teaching and is just there for a paycheck. Cancels class whenever feels like it.

I would not recommend taking Dr. G. She rushes through the material and lectures often feel unorganized. The exams do not closely reflect what is emphasized in class, which makes it difficult to feel prepared.

I feel like she cared about the material and the students but made the class harder than it should have been. The test questions were confusing but the content of the class is really easy. Participation mattered a lot.

harsh grader with a lot of confusing questions in her Exams. Absolutly not recommended, if u could take it with another professor go ahead and take it. But she is nice and available, not my type of teacher. Her slides and the tests are way different.

Awfully boring lectures. VERY test heavy, a student just asked if she curves exams and she said "students usually do very well on the first exam, the average is usually 73-78%". I'm sure she's a great person but NOT my favorite class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lindsey Gibson has fun to attend lectures which I found valuable. She gave great real-world examples with good lessons throughout. Most classwork was done through class, and she drops the lowest out of 3 exams, which is nice, though the exams were a little more difficult than anticipated. Overall, I can definitely recommend this class.

Dr. G is a great professor! I found this class very interesting and fun to attend. The exams can be tough so be sure to study well in advance. All the other assignments are pretty easy though. The workload is pretty light besides weekly readings.

I mean it's an easy class but she makes her exams way more harder than they need to be its ridiculous. The average for exams are C's????? The scenario based questions sometimes have nothing to do with what we learned, she also DOES NOT curve and provides NO extra credit. Get ready to read 50 pages of nonsense sometimes..
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I got a B in this class and an A in my business law. If that doesn't say something, I don't know what will. Tests were extremely difficult, with averages of early 70% and apparently zero room for curving or extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: She's so insecure about how fundamentally easy her class really is. So, to counteract this, she inflates the difficulty so much to prop herself up and appear as a more legitimate and tough teacher. Insanely frustrating honestly. Pointless and hollow class as well, but sure I guess I learned something. Expect to wait weeks for your exam grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I don't understand why Professor G. got poor reviews previously. Dr. G was a great professor. As long as you go to class, engage in the material, do the reading assignments, you will likely pass the class with a good grade. From what I witnessed she really cares for her students and wants them to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Gibson is probably the best professors I've had at the U. She really cares and gets to know students. Her classes are useful/relvant and interesting. You do have to do the readings but at least they are the main topic of lectures. Test questions can be challanging if you don't understand the concepts but she is a fair grader. Would Reccomend

The review below me makes no sense... the articles she assigns are all from peer-reviewed business journals that are just as legitimate as texts. She can refresh the material to make it more relevant. Case studies are PART of business school. Anyway, Dr. G is friendly and always open to making the course better. Drops one test!

Instead of a textbook, prof has you read hours upon hours of articles and cases before each class. Tests Q's seem to be written w/o care and worded poorly, so even if you know the content inside and out, the wording's ambiguity will be your demise. Very average prof. Didn't pay tuition to be taught by articles. (No group projects, so that's a plus)

Professor explained the content well and moved at a good pace. Quiz + test questions are heavily weighted so missing even a few could be fatal (both open-book). She does drop lowest quiz out of 6 and lowest exam out of 3. The quiz questions seem more subjective than anything, so that can be frustrating. Lots of article readings before each class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. G is overall a really solid choice for a professor. I may not like management but I thought she did a solid job teaching us. Her slides are good and tests aren't bad. Lectures are interesting other than the topic being pretty lame. A lot of stuff on theories. It's all pretty subjective. Quizzes HARD!! Tests were easy. GROUP PROJECT WAS AWFUL

Dr. G I amazing! I'm almost done with her IVC class and she makes it fun to participate even though there is not a lot of time in class. She is very organized. She assigns weekly readings but usually covers the important stuff in her lectures. Although attendance is not required, I recommend the lectures because not everything is on the slides.

I haven't completed the class, but for anyone signing up for classes next semester, there should be one review. So far what I can say is Professor Gibson is amazing! She has worked with us so well this semester and is a very kind person in general. I would absolutely take another class from her in a heartbeat!!!
Love her! Def one of my favorite professors here!
One of the best professor's I've ever had and feels like my Italian mother.

Giuliana is absolutely incredible. She is sweet, funny, kind, caring, and an amazing teacher. You learn a lot in a very safe, chill environment. Participation is huge though. She is very clear about what will be on her exams, and they are very straightforward and easy if you study.
Amazing professor. Attendance is mandatory, but her class was engaging, and she genuinely cared about her students. Would recommend.

Professor Marple is great, she really cares about all of her students. Homework problems are short, but you have to commit some time if you want to master the material. Tests are easy if you study. There are a few oral presentations. You have to converse in class every day, and she may call on you at random. It's not scary though, she's very kind.

She gets to know you as an individual which really helps you stay enthusiastic. The course is a bit unorganized and the textbook jumps around a lot so take notes! The tests are easy if you study. She's usually very receptive in emails, but can be kind of scatterbrained so you might need to go to her several times if you have a question or concern.

Professor Marple is my favorite professor at the U. She is so kind and really cares about her students. You will have to understand the language in order to get a good grade, but she makes class so much fun and focuses more on understanding than memorizing. She will take the time to ensure that everyone is on the same page.

Professor Marple is wonderful! She really cares about her students, and worked with everyone to make sure that they were doing well. She makes lectures fun and interactive. There is a lot of work that goes with the class if you want to really learn, but the tests are pretty self explanatory and easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: One of the greatest professors of all time. I have taken many classes from her and have received and Italian Minor. I have traveled to intern abroad with Professor Giulianna and there is no better professor around. Amazing instructor. Incredibly involved and caring for all of her students. In Professors Marple's class, you matter!
Professoressa is such an amazing teacher. She is easy-going and super knowledgable about Italian. She's an incredible lady and a fun teacher.

Giuliana is one of the best teachers I've ever had. You can tell she's really passionate about the language itself and about passing the knowledge of Italian onto others. She's hilarious and sweet and makes you feel comfortable enough to learn and speak in front of others.
Vey kind and super fun. you read a lot in Italian and she has you write and speak in front of the class but its nothing too serious.

Professor Marple is the best language teacher I've ever had.  Right from the start, she uses immersion technique to help you comprehend Italian at a much better rate.  Very caring and willing to discuss a topic until it is clear to all students.  Liberal grader, easy assignments.  I learned a lot of Italian, especially for an introductory course!

She is the best language instructor I have experienced at the University level. She moves at the pace of the class, all assigned homework isn't just to kill time but to help your language progress. There are verbal presentations and quizzes but she lets you know what to expect and helps you in any way she can. She is an awesome professoressa.

Giuliana is a great professor. She pays attention to each student, and does her best to make sure you understand each section. If you put in the work you will be successful in the class. She also gave plenty of opportunity to talk and thus become comfortable speaking Italian. Very clear about what is expected in each class.

Passionate about what she teaches. If you show interest and put forth a sincere effort in her class she will take care of you. Easily one of my favorite professors. Wish she taught more upper division classes I could take from her.

Awesome teacher! She really knows how to teach a language. If you sincerely try your best in learning the language she does notice and gives you a good grade. Be sure to always show up for class and do the homework, it also helps to practice the language outside of class as much as possible
Best teacher at the U

Giuliana is a very enthusiastic, organized, helpful, lively, and sweet person. She expresses a genuine desire for her students to learn and gives special attention to each student. The best professor Ive had at the U of U.

One of the best teachers around.  Very organized and understands material very well.  Not sure why the negative comments below.  Students in my classes love her and because of that will perform for her.
Giuliana does a very good job teaching but seems a little self involved at times. I like the class and still would recommend it...
Mrs Marple did a very good job and made learning italian fun
good, energetic teacher to have 1st period

I have had Giuliana for 3 semesters, and am currently in my 4th.  Originally, I had some concerns regarding the class format and her teaching method, but I am not very comfortable conversing in Italian, and can easily read and write it.  She has really opened up to the class, and has made attending class a joy.  She is a great professoressa!!!  A++

Incredible knowledge and commitment to her work. She is the best professor I have ever had, and I am a senior and almost done with my studies.  She is organized and I always knew what to expect from the class.

I had my doubts about Giuliana originally, but she proved to be one of the most enjoyable professors I have had class with.  Her deep love of the Italian language and culture brought the class to life and she constantly pushed the class to use Italian in every possible instance.  She is a great professor.  Take any class you can with her!

I come from an Italian home, so I can attest to the fact that Giuliana's "disorganization" is just a by-product of her background. Unfortunately, it makes learning Italian more difficult. Her pronunciation is impeccable and her knowledge is incredible, but she needs to adjust to her students needs and become a bit more organized.

Took this class in high school through CE in 2024 and I really enjoyed it. His lectures are pretty structured, and Jammin is very knowledgeable on the course material. I found his teaching to be straightforward, & he will also help you if you're stuck. He is a wholesome professor, & the class definitely helped me build a strong foundation in stats!
His ability to communicate with students is terrible.

I like Jammin as a teacher and that counts for a lot, but he a is really difficult grader and shows no mercy. Other math courses give you substantial credit for trying and showing your work so long as it along the lines of how it should be, but Jammin does not. You pretty much have to have the problem and solution correct to get any credit.

Gieber is a great professor! His lectures are very detailed and if we struggle he gives us a lot of examples to really understand a concept. While attendance isnt mandatory I would recommend staying for the lectures as it feels that the people who were regularly present really succeeded and understood the concept. He is professor who really cares.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is uptight and very much follows a schedule of his own. Do not take the class if you have health problems or anything of that kind because he doesnt care. A person in my class got a bad concussion and was out for a week. During said week we had an exam and the professor did not let him take the exam once the student came back.

Worst math teacher I have ever had! his lecture are him writing out everything he says out loud. I had an A the whole semester until the last exam followed by the final (1 week apart) which dropped my grade from a 97% to a 77%. All the quizzes are easy and then the last two weeks he makes you apply everything which we had 0 practice doing. I cried.

Jammin is so nice and has a calming voice. He will answer any questions you have and is very understanding. He writes notes for the entire 3 hr lecture, and students copy these notes down. You don't really need to read the textbook thanks to the detailed lecture notes. Homework is from textbook and can take up a few hours every week.

Jammin is a great guy. He knows his statistics inside and out, but has a difficult time translating that into undergrad terms for students who don't know much. If you attend lectures, he will get to know you and will like you (online night class for 3 hours--not a lot of people last the whole 3 hours, lol). The final was WAY HARDDDDD.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Speaks so slowly that puts you to sleep in class. Needs public speaking classes. Takes forever to reply to emails.

I'm not sure why there's so many bad reviews of her. Lindsay was very caring and always super responsive. I never saw her have any bias and she always answered questions and repeated herself clearly. She teaches slow, but is thourough. She is always honest and up front with things. I can tell she cares about her students and their experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Love Lindsay, if you show up to class the class is very educational for all majors. She is a clear speaker with great lecture slides. You can tell she loves her jobs and cares for her students!

Took online; doesn't seem to actually care about students in online classes. Won't get back to me or several people I know via email about issues. I sent her a long, thought out email, and got a sentence in response that didn't answer anything. She expects perfect timing for discussions a week before due but cant get her to respond at all.
Dr. Gibson is a thoughtful and passionate teacher. She loves in-class discussions/examples and tries to keep everyone engaged. Tests require just a little bit extra outside of class work.

While I took this class online, I still didn't like the teaching strategy of this professor. I felt like I was paying money to read the textbook. The group discussions are the best part of the class but even that is ruined by her organization. You do not gain the freedoms of an online class, she doesn't allow work at your own pace.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Absolutely no excused absence's even if you have a doctors note. Must read full book to pass with an A. She tests on things she has never taught because "everything is fair game". Also very sexist towards men, even the girls in the class don't like her because of how bad it is.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Laughably bad.

Eleanor was great and knew her stuff. Bioethics was discussion based so it was really interesting and dynamic. There is a lot of reading each week, usually 2-3 articles of good size. The was ready to answer questions and give feedback for work. She made class fun while also teaching
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Eleanor is a great teacher. She is obviously very knowledgeable and passionate about Bioethics. She's very willing to help you outside of class if you need it. She gives great feedback on assignments and lets you correct your mistakes. But it is a hard class that has lots of required reading and group work. If you hate working in groups, don't take
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class will teach you to argue more effectively, but you will have to work for it. Weekly assignments included reading long bioethical articles, participating in a discussion board, and writing a paper. Be aware that Eleanor takes a really long time to finish grading assignments, and doesn't respond to email very quickly. Kind of frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: If you're good at writing papers and need the credit this is a good online class to take. All you do is read a couple of articles and write argumentative papers about issues in bioethics. There are multiple assignments you can choose each week to get full credit and there's one final paper. Super nice and convenient. Didn't take up too much time :)

I took her online class, bioethics. The class seemed to be set up pretty well. But if you want any help from her I wouldn't take this class. It took her days to email back, if she did it at all. It made the class tough at times. When I had questions near the end about writing subjects and styles for the final, I actually contacted another teacher.
Awesome teacher.

Lots of reading each week. Participation will impact your grade so be prepared to be fully engaged in class, not miss classes, and speak up as much as possible. Most weekly assignments are graded easily, and the first large point assignment you can meet with her for good feedback and a chance to rewrite.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Middle Ages with Ginger was a tough class. The two rhetorical analysis papers were difficult to understand the instructions for and hard to get a decent grade on. Class was always engaging, usually part lecture, part discussion, with small group discussions sometimes as well. Readings outside of class were long, but that's to be expected in honors.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You will get an A if you put in the effort, she won't just hand it out, but if you try, you have nothing to worry about. Such a passionate, caring, and insightful professor. She cares about her students and pays attention to each and every single one of them. Reacting to the past is still my fav class I've ever taken, TAKE IT!!!!!

A very personable and engaging professor. Cares about her students and how much they learn throughout the class. Also, reacting to the past is a fun class; recommend taking it no matter your background.

Dr. Smoak was a really great professor. She's obviously very invested in the success and learning of every one of her students, and she leads great discussions in class. There was a LOT of reading in this class though, which could get overwhelming at times. She grades pretty harshly, but she makes her expectations very clear with each assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: One of the best professors in the honors college at the U. Was very excited to help me find sources when I needed them, no complaints!

Professor Smoak is a really nice person and good teacher. She is always open to helping you with any and all assignments. But, this class was tough. Lots of reading and class participation is mandatory and a huge part of your grade. Unless you love to read and discuss, do not take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Smoak is a tough grader only for synthetic paper, but she doesn't want her students to get a low grades. There are various extra credit chances, and discussions and response papers are graded very well. If you like to discuss the reading, you will love this class! Professor Smoak is always willing to discuss your paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof Smoak is an amazing professor, but she is a tough grader when it comes to the synthesis essays. Participation also counts so be sure to talk in the discussions. THERE IS A LOT OF READING so be aware! The final was very fun though.

She is so kind! This class is super reading-heavy, so be ready and prepared for that week's classes by making sure you understand the module's readings beforehand. participation is important, but this class is pretty laid back honestly. I had a good time :)

This class is reading-heavy! It is an Honors IT course, so that is expected, but it is important in this class for in-class discussions and the papers she had us write almost every week. Ginger is very understanding if you ever need an extension on an assignment, just be vocal about it with her! She is very sweet and knowledgeable on the subjects.

(Online due to Covid) Very kind and entertaining during lectures; a lot of reading, but if you come to class willing to have a thoughtful dialogue, you'll do well. The class content is very interesting. Grading is lenient, and Dr. Smoak is very understanding with any issues that come up. I'd be more than happy to take her class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I loved Ginger as a professor, but the course material and class discussions were rarely interesting. I struggled getting through most of the readings and could not come up with anything to write about for the papers/projects. Since it was online due to COVID, the class set up was really lacking as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She is one of the nicest professors that I have had so far. Good feedback on assignments and pretty lenient. As much as she is great, her course is so boring and text-heavy. Each week you are reading around 70-200 pages of old English and writing 2-3 assignments/papers plus participating in class. I would love this class if the material was better.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class is very lecture heavy on super old readings. They are really hard to get through on zoom. Small assignments are easy and graded leniently but the big synthetic papers are very very confusing and I didn't find her feedback helpful. Sooooo much reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took reacting to the past from Ginger and she is amazing! She's funny and caring. As long as you participate in class and put forth effort you'll get an A. She's a fairly easy grader and will let you redo assignments if you do poorly. If you need an Honors IT credit, I definitely recommend taking a class from her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Smoak provided a great learning environment where students were comfortable giving speeches, acting, and debating. The course content was fascinating, and the class overall was a lot of fun. I would recommend to anybody who has a little bit of time to spend reading the materials outside of class, which can be a bit daunting at times.

I was skeptical of a reacting course, but Ginger is an incredible, knowledgeable, and fun professor--you will get a lot out of her class! There were 6 papers (4-5) pages, but it wasn't nearly as bad as I thought--it's all relevant to the games thoughout the course. She makes herself very available and I highly recommend her class!

Ginger is a great professor. She is willing to meet with you outside of class to help you with papers and offers a lot of good advice. Class is fun, but make sure to get a word in most classes or your participation grade will take a hit. You also need to know at least the premise of all of the texts, so you'll be reading quite a bit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: There are plenty of papers in this class, including weekly responses, but they are not tough tp get a good grade on. Ginger is super helpful and loves her students - though attendance is mandatory, she makes class fun and interesting!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Smoak really knows the material and she's passionate about it. She assigns weekly reading assignments and 3 papers. She grades fairly and gives you a lot of feedback on your paper. If you put in the work, you'll do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The class required A LOT of reading from the required texts. Be prepared to read between every class period, with a new author or topic each week. Response Papers were simple and graded objectively, pretty easy. Synthetic Papers were very confusing, don't be afraid to ask questions and get help before you turn it in. Participation is graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Lots of reading and Smoak encourages discussion in the classroom. Thorough knowledge of the subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Ginger is an amazing teacher and her class is always an interesting discussion. There is a ton of reading for the class, and lots of papers too, but it is quite interesting. She is always willing to help you with papers and meet with you outside of class. Definitely recommend her!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Ginger was a decent professor. However, her lectures are quite dull. Participation is huge in this class, so be sure to show up and get a word in. I didn't learn very much in this course. You essentially just discuss ancient texts.  I would not take another class from this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Ginger makes you work for your grade, but she is truly an amazing professor.  Her class is easy going, but you better do good on the papers.  She is always willing to review your papers before it is due, and gives you helpful feedback.  Be sure you participate in the discussion because that can make or break you.  Take her classes if you can!

EVERYONE TAKE THIS CLASS! It is seriously the most interesting class, and Professor Smoak teaches it so well. Grading is based mostly on discussions (which is easy!). I had no problem going to class because the class was so interesting and Professor Smoak knew everyone by name. She cared about everyone and was so forgiving! Take this class.
I loved this class and Professor Smoak!

Dr. Smoak is a great teacher who does a great job of keeping material interesting. She will sometimes get off on tangents but never enough to become confusing. In my experience she was very helpful with studying for tests, and she read my paper 3 times to make sure it was satisfactory.  She wants you to succeed and is willing to help you.

I expected it to be a boring humanities course but I was wrong about it all. While there are long weekly readings and short response papers, they will help you with the fun and informative discussions. The three longer papers are not bad, with the option to rewrite one. Final project is as flexible as you want it to be. She is funny & entertaining!

This is clearly a passion of hers. It was a fun class and definitely worth taking. She is clear and concise while throwing in little tidbits that make things more interesting and helpful tips for remembering.  The tests are tough and pretty much make or break the grade, unfortunately. The papers are difficult and you want to get a jump on them.

She knew her stuff and I learned a lot about the time period. The tests are very hard, like grade breaking so study for them. She is available for questions and easy to work with. Watching the lectures if vital and the source reading is essential for the tests and the assignments. Everything flows well and she is easy to learn from.

The the class is fascinating. She knows her information and it shows. The tests are killer! But she gives good study guides. The lectures are online and can be very long but the information is vital. The reading was all online, which was nice in some ways but the chapters were usually very long. The quizzes were pretty easy if you did the reading.

I liked this class a lot! She was hilarious! She would lead the discussion in what seemed to be a circle but at the last minute connect it to the topic in such a way to really make you think about it, but in a good way. The reading is important as we actually discuss it. The papers are not bad and she is great with feedback and expectations. Loved!

In Hist, Smoak was really clear about the subject. Really passionate and made it easy to pay attention, even in the morning. Tests were pretty hard; don't expect any multiple choice! In Honors IT she enabled good discussion between students. Participation was pretty important, but she's not anal. Final Project was fun and easy. You choose it!

Such a fun history teacher. Will definitely be taking her other classes. She will make the class a lot easier for you if she can tell you are putting in the effort, coming to class daily, and participating. Her lectures are not boring at all, tells history like an ongoing story.

Professor Smoak is very enthusiastic about her subject. I took class in the summer that was 3 hours long, and I was able to pay attention for all 3 hours.
