Good luck!

Professor Stolley can not teach. He can not write test questions and will be condescending when you get it wrong. His TAs are very inconsistent while grading exams. He expects you to teach yourself topics he barely skims over and it will be on your exam. He curved the class UP so an A is a 95%. The average is 60% and he likes it that way. Cry.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: People are often scared to take classes from this professor. He is incredibly passionate and direct. He sees people who try and works with them and punishes those who don't. To succeed do all the work, including the extra credit, learn from your mistakes which he encourages through corrections that act as curves.

Dr. Stolley is wonderful! Ochem gets a bad reputation, and it is a hard class but if you do the work and pay attention in class you will do well! He gives out plenty of extra credit on exams and is very accessible in office ours & through canvas messages. Exams line up very well with what is on the activities/lectures. Would 100% recommend

Dr.Stolley was by far one of my favorite professors at the U. Don't get me wrong, this class was extremely hard and took a LOT of time/dedication, I'm really glad I took it in the summer when I didn't have other classes.  Definitely find a study group early on and don't skip class! The exams are brutal but if you put in the work, it'll pay off!

Interesting lectures, terrible adjunct professor. He made some accommodations for certain students but won't do the same for all. The TAs are hardly available to help you as they're also students. The best teacher you could ask for is you, your classmates, tutors, and YouTube. Good luck reaching out to Ryan cause he's hardly available to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Took O-Chem 1 & 2 w/Stolley. Tests/quizzes were tough, but he gives all the relavent info on activities & HW! Picks great TAs. He's a lot like Shrek: comes across as a hard a--, but actually kind and understanding. Lectures as well as any Youtube tutor. An advocate for hard work. So, put in the work & you'll get your grade. Best Chem prof at The U.

Dr Stolley is awesome. Seems very passionate about chemistry and that has helped me greatly. Tough subject, but if you follow his instructions in going to lectures, discussions, and reading the material you will be fine. I believe the most important thing he teaches is not memorizing, yet understanding the how. It will truly help pass this class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Honestly it could've been that I took this class during the first real semester of everything online but let me just say his quizzes were ridiculously hard. I feel like I didn't learn anything in Organic Chemistry, the whole time I was confused and when I would reach out the response I would get was "You need to go back and rewatch the videos"
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Stolley is an awesome guy. He is pretty young so he can relate well to his students. If you are willing to work and study as you learn you will be fine. He doesn't fall for crap work so if you aren't preparing before discussions, your class will get chewed out. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT if you want an A. Cool dude :)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Stolley is one of my least favorite professors I have had at the U. His lab was just a mess and his syllabus was ass. My TA was not helpful at all however there was some good TA's who were available during their TA hours. Wouldn't recommend his course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Stolley is one of the better professors in the chem department. He kept his lectures entertaining, was very willing to help students, and gives extra credit. However, his activities and tests were unnecessarily difficult. Do all the homework and take advantage of the extra credit, you'll need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Had Stolley for lab and for lecture. Lab wasn't my favorite, but he saved my life in O chem 2. Super willing to work with you, really wants you to succeed. Go to office hours, email him, let him know what you're struggling with. He was willing to bend over backward to make sure we were still understanding the material during the pandemic. 10/10.

I really liked Ryan. He expects a lot from you, but he is always available for help. Exams are more difficult than the other ochem sections, but he provides a lot of extra credit opportunities to make up the difference. Focus on the mechanisms, nail down acid/base chemistry, and you should be just fine. Finally, let the mechanism guide you. : )

Dr. Stolley is an amazing professor! He makes learning organic chemistry easier and fun. He lays out his expectations and is consistent. His personality makes you want to go to class and he truly cares about the success of his students. If you use the resources he provides you will pass, and have a great time while doing it!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dont listen to the bad reviews.  Stolley is an amazing professor and cares about his students succeeding.  His extra credit saves lives and you learn soooo much!  If you go to his office and ask questions I guarantee youll do well in the class.  Just work hard and hell help you pass!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr Stolley is an excellent Professor. His teaching ability is amazing and he is extremely funny in class. Make sure to take advantage of all the extra credit provided - IT WILL SAVE YOU. Homework helps study for exams as well as the activities. I would recommend 100%.
His lab lectures aren't required, but they are worth going to. Make sure you have a lab TA or Prof Stolley check over your formal lab write-ups before you turn them in.

May be good teacher but is a horribly disorganized lab instructor. Constant last minute communication and when you bring it up to him he blames students for not checking their emails and doing a new assignment an hour before class. Providing incorrect chemicals to labs. Also will have pop quizzes not listed on his syllabus after saying no quizzes.
Great professor and would definitely recommend. Works with you, but wants you to learn. Very kind and has a great teaching ethic. Makes chemistry fun.

One of the rare amazing instructors for Gen Chem. Classes are usually split in half with a lecture then a corresponding group packet, which is essential for test prep. Come to class and visit him in his office, do your homework without looking at the key and you'll ace the whole enchalada.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Excellent professor, classes were great. If you attend her office hours you can tell she really cares about helping the students in her class.

This course was super easy and Ryleigh was awesome! Homework was graded on completion, not your actual answers and she dropped the lowest 6 homework grades, 3 quiz grades, and a 1 exam grade. This class is a lot of work but it's online so it's expected. I found the homework prepared you for the exams very well and everything was clearly worded.

The logistics of the course are very overwhelming. You have to read like a textbook's worth of stuff just to get how the course works when it could easily be done without any of that. Also, she is often unclear and apparently forgets her initial instructions on assignments and will arbitrarily change them so you don't know which one to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is very understanding and is one of the easiest graders in the department. Show up to class and she will answer every question and explain every problem step by step. This class is a very easy A when you take the simplest of notes for example questions. Quizes are group quizes and tests are super easy.

Ryleigh is one of the best math teachers Iv'e ever had. She is knowledgeable and really knows how to break down each step. She is also really patient with student's questions and gives us everything we need to succeed on the tests. Attendance is not tracked but you can't pass if you don't go to class since all info is given during lecture.
Plenty of opportunities for extra credit. Lots of quizes but its not too bad. I would take again.

Excellent professor. He is very effective and reviewed many examples in class which made the homework easier. Exams were not difficult and were similar to the homework content. He is willing to work with students on their grades

This is the gold standard for professors and I wish I could take every class from him. Very good lectures, lots of example problems, great at understanding and answering questions in a helpful manner. Tons of chances for extra credit. If every professor was like Ryan no one would drop out.

Genuinely the worst professor. Can't teach to save her life, will have 70+ lectures slides and not even make it through 20 of them during class because she is so slow. Her TA's were no help because even they didn't know what she was teaching. Will give around 7-10 hw assignments each week. Her study guides for exams were no help at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Renee was a great teacher at the beginning of this course. She takes things slow on the simple things, but for the really confusing stuff at the end of the semester, she briefly explains the concepts. She is straightforward, and if you follow each module carefully, you will stay on top of the homework (there is at least ).
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I thought Renee was great. BIO 1610 is definitely NOT a breezy class, but Renee does her best to help people understand the content. Her tests/quizzes tend to be EASIER than the class content in my opinion Just show up, pay attention, dedicate a little extra time to study and you'll be just fine.

Renee is a professor you'll appreciate in retrospect. She's the hardest 1610 prof, but her class is fair. 1610 is a weed-out course, so if you want a no-nonsense class that prepares you for future STEM courses, she's the GOAT. For pre-med, her class is prep for courses like 2310/3510. Study guides are clear, so if you apply yourself, you'll pass.

Avoid her. She is the undisputed hardest intro bio professor. Study guides were useless, knowledgeable with subpar lectures. Tons of homework, and her tests were much harder than other bio tests with different teachers. There are better options. If you take her go to office hours and absolutely show up to lectures

In lectures, she treats us like we're little kids. Goes slow on trivial topics so can't finish her slides on time, meaning you're lost on weekly hw assignments (5-10 per week). Teaches in a roundabout way. I learnt more on YouTube than in her lecture halls. Also, you must know her very specific ways of drawing stuff or you will fail tests/hw.
LISTEN TO THE BAD REVIEWS!!! Avoid this professor at all costs. Take this course with Colby if at all possible. I would not recommend this course to anyone unless you want to hate your life.

The class mean on the final was a 55% significantly worse than the average in the class taught by the other teacher. There was no curve to account for this. Renee left in some questions which were very unclear and her lectures weren't helpful. I learned all of the content from the textbook.

Renee is a very nice teacher but she doesn't make the material very easy to learn. She has lots of resources with TAs but ways to help better understand her material was very hard to understand or study.

Hw you do translates to success in exams. Attend the lectures, discussion, and do the given work you won't need to study (exc cumulative final) and can get an A. Hw isn't hard, just tedious. Prof is great and easy to follow if done given work before class. LAs are nice. Some LAs don't do their grading in a timely manner. contact them or prof if so.

Renee has a very enthusiastic lecturing style, though sometimes it does lead to some tangents during the lectures themselves. There's a lot of homework for this class, but they also are very similar to the content that you get on quizzes and exams. If you're having trouble in class, there's a lot of resources and Renee responds very quickly.
renee is very passionate about biology and very caring for her students. biol 1610 is a great fundamental bio class and is very interesting. renee does a great job at teaching it!

I hear a lot of negative things about Renee, but I liked her a lot. This class was a lot of review from high school biology, but I did have to put in a lot of time for the homework. If you do the homework, you'll be fine.

Renee was one of the kindest professors I've ever had. She is always willing to help out if you have questions during or after class. She gave lots of extra credit opportunities and while she assigned a lot of homework it was normally really easy. My only complaint is that she does get a little sidetracked during class but still gives good lectures

Renee herself is a great person. She is funny and witty. The class sucks though. There is a pre class, in class, and post class assignment for each lecture, as well as discussion papers, quizzes, and more. Way too much to do. Also lecture attendance is mandatory. and you will be behind if you miss a lecture.

Renee herself is a great person, but the class style sucks. There is a pre class, in class, and post class assignment for each lecture, as well as a discussion paper, quizzes, and more. Way too much homework. If you miss a lecture you WILL be behind. Attendance to lectures is also mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dont take her class its not worth retaking it again
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Renee was a great lady but the lectures were very fast paced and hard to keep up. It is very easy to fall behind in this class. If you take it with her use the tutoring center, only way to get a good grade. Attendance matters too

I found Renee to be a decent professor. There is A LOT of homework, but I found it to be pretty helpful in understanding the content. I thought she was able to explain content in a way that we could understand even though she went off on pretty random tangents which would often lead to her running out of time for stuff actually important to know.

She is very boring during the lectures however her assignments are mostly straightforward. Attendance is mandatory and as long as you show up, you should be good for the tests. Discussion helps way more than the lecture.
Dawson wasn't necessarily bad, the class was terrible though. SO much homework, long boring lectures. Extremely overwhelming.
Not helpful lectures. Very confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Lectures are long and pretty dull, most of what I learned in the course was from pre-class assignments. A few critiques I have is that she often goes on tangents, has some really random stuff in her lecture slides, and the diagrams she shows are never answered concretely. 
If you can take the other professor, I'd recommend that.
grading was harsh and lectures were heavy

A very hard class, with extremely boring lectures as they are just her reading off of the slides. She also goes extremely fast in class as there is never enough time to cover everything. Has good analogies but also then that just does a lot of talking. Her assignments are hard but they are the only reason that you can learn in her class.

Busy work!! Lectures are her reading off slides. She lies about the clickers having a location on them; you can do them from your home. Her pre-test resources either contain similar topics/questions to what is seen on the exam/quiz or don't at all. Her test questions are ambiguous. I heard of students dropping their biology degree because of her.

She is so nice and I loved having her. Wouldn't really take her again because her lecture style is a little too confusing. She rushes through things and doesn't give explanations that make a lot of sense. Very sweet and her TA's are amazing. This class had a lot of homework, but the homework definitely helped with the course content itself.
She was a good teacher. Very lecture-heavy but helpful to listen and apply yourself to the readings. The TA's are super useful too so make sure to go to discussions and their office hours.
So hard to pay any attention to her during her boring lectures that jumped all over the place.
Her lectures made no sense and I had to go to the TAs a lot. Sometimes even the TAs would give me contradicting information

Heavy lectures, lots of homework assignments, participation and attendance are mandatory and do affect your grade. Renee does a great job with lectures and tries to make things easier to understand. There is lots of homework. This includes pre-class, post-class, worksheets, and draw to learns. The homework assignments do take lots of time.

The class averages honestly speak for themselves, Renee's average on exams was always around a 60 while other professors had around an 80. In lectures she is monotone, completely strays off topic and none of the lecture material is actually on the exam. The reason I began to do better is because I started teaching myself from the pre class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Renee is a nice professor, but she is very monotone. She reads off slides and also teaches based on what's not on slides. It makes it difficult to understand. Had too go back and relearn info on my own sometimes, other than that exams were hard, quizzes easy.

I have been in classes before with lots of busy work but not like this one. There are what seems like a dozen assignments a week. This makes it so hard to want to or have time to study by the time the assignments are all completed. She also makes the concepts in lecture more confusing than they need to be and you cannot read her handwriting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Dawson is one of the nicest professors I have met who truly cares about her students, however, her teaching is ineffective. Lectures deliver 10 minutes of information in 2-3 hours, the textbook substitutes a mountain of information for simple concepts. Once you learn to identify necessary information from lectures the class is easy.

Her lectures are not boring by any means, she's good at teaching but sometimes goes on tangents about material that isn't relevant, (but is sometimes interesting) so being an active listener is very useful. On exam weeks she tries to schedule less assignments and pushes back due dates and is pretty laid back over all.

This woman is truly confusing. She jumps around making it extremely difficult to keep track of what she's teaching. Often times her analogies leave you left even more confused than the lectures themselves. Be prepared to take a ton of notes as to not fall behind. She moves very fast considering her inability to stay on one subject at a time.

Lectures can be dry, but the TAs and extra resources like unstuckstudy ai make up for it. Lots of assignments, but manageable if you stay on top of it. Professor cares about the material, just needs to work on delivery.
Renee's lecturing style is very dry and monotone. She only read off from the slides which made things more harder to learn from. This deeply

Renee is a very nice person and cares about her students a lot. The only issue is her lectures are hard to keep up with and understand, and she gives a lot of homework. The TAs are great for this class though and are super useful. A lot of time will be spent reviewing and reteaching yourself material from class.

Professor Dawson was funny during her lectures that I had while also providing key information. She stays on track and makes sure to provide things that will be on the quizzes and tests. The homework assignments are pretty easy, they just take some time. Overall, she was great and I learned a lot from her.
Long boring lectures. Pointless clicker questions that are all throughout the lecture and discussion so you have to pay attention. Homework easy and tests not too bad.

I love this class. Dr. Dawson really cares about her students and wants us to succeed. There's a lot of pre-quiz/pre-test resources including no-point practice quizzes, TA sessions, and exam reviews. The TA sessions and discussion periods are invaluable. I would absolutely take a class from her again.

All she does is read off of her PowerPoints and nothing in her lectures are entertaining. There's always at least 5+ assignments due at the end of the week where you're basically just guessing. There's 4 exams and 3 quizzes. There's no study guides to work with and no indication on what you're supposed to know from the material and her ppts.

Renee is very hit and miss for students. I particularly did like her, i felt like she tried her very best every class to make it as interesting as she could, crack jokes and listen to others. She is a little on the older side and some of the jokes arent super funny but the main thing is she tries. Her lectures do get boring and the exams arent easy

Professor Renee is passionate about the subject and good at it, but not great at teaching it. She 'taught' off the slides and most students learned from TAs. The class average was low but she wouldn't curve tests. There were excessive, time consuming amounts of homework. She was not empathetic and blamed students when they expressed concerns.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mixed reviews on the professor. Personally, I did a good job in the class without reading the textbook. I like that her lectures and discussions used Clicker. The lectures were very long, we didnt finish it most of the time.  Also, on the quizzes it was more difficult than the practice questions. lots of extra credit. overall happy with class!

Lectures never fully covered what would be on a quiz/test, so reading the super muddled, confusing, textbook is very important. I like her as a person, but I don't find her teaching to be very effective. Very lecture heavy, and yet the lectures don't fulfill all that is needed to do well in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Dawson truly cared about the information she was teaching, and she was passionate about it, but the way it was taught was often confusing or ineffective. There were at least 7 assignments due each week, and DO YOUR CLICKERS. TAs were amazing and made confusing information manageable. The final was not an accurate portrayal of the class.

Class is hard and she made it harder. Confusing and very boring lecturing. The class is huge so she will point you towards the TA's if you need help. She's not the worst but I would go with someone else if you can.
Professor Dawson's class was a lecture hall but it was very well done. Lectures were concise and engaging, tests were easy. Overall a really good experience and really easy

Lots of assignments each week, but I'd say they're pretty helpful in understanding the material. Dawson is awesome! Her lectures & grading criteria are very clear. TA's were the best & SUPER helpful!! Not an easy A class, but she gives LOTS of resources to help, go to the exam reviews!
Professor Dawson is so amazing. She is so good at teaching and gives so many resources for the class. Her tests are not bad and she actually listens to student feedback to improve her course.

Dawson was one of the worst teachers I've had. The average on exams was under 70%, and she said that she was proud of that. She saw no issue that her students were working hard and still not succeeding. It was brutal. It's a very heavy course load and Dawson did little to help. I learned more from LAs/TAs than I did the teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was fine, boring lectures that were way too long and didn't cover much. Beware of the clickers because they will tank your grade at the end of the semester if you skip even a few. Usually assignments due before, during, and after each class.

She was a fine lecturer when she actually talked about things that we needed to learn. My biggest problem was that she had a habit of teaching us stuff, then saying that none of that was going to be on the tests because it was just showing us what we were going to learn in cell biology. The TAs were AMAZING though, very helpful. Go to study hall!

She gets a very bad wrap. 1610 is the introductory course she teaches so everyone that hates biology also hates her, but is actually one of the better professors I've had for biology. She's funny too.

Not the best lecturer and classes were boring, but it was very easy to get a good grade. Exams were all based off memorization, but really isn't anything hard. Knowing basic chemistry before hand is a huge help, maybe take those classes together if you don't already have a high school chemistry background.

Renee is an absolutely terrible professor. She seems like a nice person but her teaching skills are laughable. Nothing taught in class makes sense, her tests have little to do with the material covered, and the clicker questions serve to do little other than further confuse students. The TAs and LAs are the only redeemable part of this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is not a great lecturer and is slow with grading, however she compensates for it with her leniency to give extra credit and curve everyone's grades. Has a ton of TAs and the discussions are useful. It's a hard class, but doable if you put in the work. Be ready to memorize, because that is what you will be doing 90% of the time.

SO much homework. Lectures don't really teach you. You are expected to know everything before coming to lecture.
Some small opportunities for extra credit. Exams are strictly in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class was ok, she didn't do the best at teacher material she mainly would just read the slides. She's very nice and understanding though. I had something happen and wasn't able to make it to class for 4 weeks so she didn't grade my attendance for not being there. You do have to spend WAY more time outside of class then they say too.

Dawson is a kind and caring professor who tries her best to help her students succeed. Although she may not necessarily be the most clear and concise during lectures, as long as you pay attention and spend the extra time to understand the topics covered you will do fine.

Renee is very lecture heavy wouldn't recommend and the discussion classes didn't really help, she doesn't care about your personal life and if something in life does come up it is mandatory to prove it.

Overall, this class wasn't too bad. Some topics were difficult, and the test were hard, but a big portion of your grade is the homework. As long as you do good on the homework and try your best you can pass this class. Renee is a nice professor and tries her best in lectures, but it can be difficult to understand her explanations sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: *Most* people who didn't like this professor didn't put in the effort. Although she can ramble on the subjects, she gives us the materials needed for the tests. There is a textbook, but reading wasn't necessary unless you need extra help. I recommend going to 1 study group that they provide with the TAs for extra help.

She tried so hard to be cool but she has super high expectations. She uses clickers and pays close attention to attendance. If you want to get a hold of her, good luck. I could barely even get a hold of the TAs.

Many people complain about how bad her teaching style is, and I think its mostly just due to the nature of the class. As an intro to bio class, you only learn the base level of things and don't go into depth in anything, that's not her fault. She's not the best professor, but isn't as bad as many people make her out to be. Attendance is required

Overall, her lectures were useless because her teaching method was not good. This course is definitely one where you must put in the time after class. As a teacher who wants to try and let you succeed she isn't bad. She has a lot of resources to try and let you do good in class. If you put in your own time and work you can easily pass this class.
Everyone complains about Professor Dawson but if you apply yourself you will be able to get a good grade. She gives you plenty of resources to succeed in the class.

In class, she'd often go off on tangents about things that we "didn't need to know yet" and breeze over things that would be in quizzes. Many of my classmates were set on a career in nursing - by the end of the semester, they were considering switching majors just because of how awful this class was.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Dawson is okay. I didn't like her use of clickers (one time she did an entire class of clicker questions). The lectures were not very helpful. Be prepared to teach yourself through the book. She did not try to answer students' questions in much depth. I would not recommend.

I took Renee Dawson's Biol 1610 class during fall 2022. She cares for her students and wants us all to succeed. There is a lot of work to be done in the class, but it helps you get a better understanding on the topics you are learning. She also offers extra credit and drops on some assignments. I absolutely loved her class!

I loved her classes so much, She is my favorite teacher I have had so far and I would take all my biology classes from her if I could. She was very understanding and is clear on her grading and she allows drops and has a lot of opportunities for extra credit.
She's ok. Not particularly stimulating and semi vague. BIOL1060 will require a lot of studying and homework outside the lectures.

She is very sweet, it is mandatory to attend this class to pass. Take the time to study and use all the study recourses! This class is tough so be ready from the start, it's easy to fall behind. The tests are graded tough, Take advantage of extra credit if and when available.

Honestly, this class was pretty easy about 80% of the time because of the TA's and the amount of resources professor Dawson provided for us. For the first exam, we had a study guide. For every quiz and exam there was always a practice that was EXTREMELY representative of the real thing. Honestly key to success is study hall & reading the textbook
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take this class unless it is required for your major or you are personally interested in microbiology. Go to the lecture and do the clickers; if you don't, you won't know what's going on and you will fail. Quizzes and tests are extremely challenging and often require countless hours of study and personal research.

Professor is very difficult. A lot of work is involved in this class, a lot of reading. She seems like a kind person but a terrible teacher, the way she teaches is for a finite nitch of students who already understand biology very well. She can make eve the easiest topics difficult to understand a lot of self teaching is involved for a intro class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Renee sucks, whenever she teaches in class the material isn't clear and she makes easy concepts very difficult by weirdly wording the questions on the exams. The material she teaches in class is also not very similar to what is tested on. If you take this class you'll have to rely on the TAs and teaching yourself from the textbook.

Professor Dawson is very fast paced and gets sidetracked easily. There is a heavy workload and exams are heavy weighted when it comes to overall grades. This professor does not clarify topics as well as she could, and is overall difficult to get in touch with.
this was a tough class to take, and Her teaching skills only works for a finite group of students.
Professor Dawson sucks butt.

The exams have nothing to do with the study material and she ignores concerns. She often messes up in lectures and never corrects herself leaving students clueless. She also teaches things and tells us that we don't need to know them instead of focusing on what we do need to know.

I took this course on zoom and I found myself not learning much material; she may be a nice person but it doesn't get transmitted online. I would take this course in person. overall I hated attending this class with a passion.

Absolutely do not take her class. The worst professor I have ever had. Test material was absolutely unrelated to any of the material covered in class. Did not teach at all, the only helpful people were her TAs. Did not respond whatsoever to negative feedback and instead said that her class (with majority failing) wasnt  trying hard enough.

Take BIOL 1610 elsewhere. Much of the material covered in lecture and in assignments/quizzes were briefly in the final exam. They barely were related to one another. Considering this is an entry level course, the demand of work and expectation towards this course is overwhelming. She is very nice but the teaching style of the course is incoherent.

This class is by no means a walk in the park, but she does give you everything you need to pass the class. There's even points/objects that she highlights and says "this will be on the exam." Attendance isn't mandatory but she offers some extra points (I believe) for clicker questions, and helps with practice questions.
Alright teacher.. lots of projects and assignments. Often go off topic and takes ages with one topic so be prepared to be behind schedule.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Dawson seems like an alright person but I do not like her teaching style. She goes into a lot of tangents but doesn't adjust her schedule after wasting an entire hour. Just study your quizzes and ASQs and you'll be fine. She doesn't really answer emails so I'd suggest showing up to the TA's study sessions any time you have questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a great teacher! I learned a lot and it was not too hard. You have to do the ASQ's and to discussion to be successful though. Overall, great class.

She tries to trick you during tests and quizzes. I didn't believe it to start but she really does. She'll have you constantly doing homework, quizzes, and tests that isn't clear on. She is super confusing on her wording of questions and has said "I throw in distractions intentionally" and acts like she's teaching people through failure. DONT TAKE!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: SHOW UP TO CLASS AND DO ASQs! Doing those two things along with the assignments should allow you to pass, but to get a good grade she really makes you work for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Disclaimer: I'm not a bad student. I get A's. Don't think dumb, unmotivated students are writing bad reviews. This class is HARD. Here's the deal. Take this class if you're going pre-med--if not, look elsewhere. I thought I could do this class, but no. Just no. Dawson was really awesome, funny, and likeable though!! This class is just really tough
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I took BIOL 1210 from Dawson, but in all honesty, it was probably the hardest class I have ever taken. I would sit through her 2-hour lectures and once I left lecture I felt like I didn't retain any information. Quizzes and exams are very difficult & she is a very hard grader. I would recommend taking BIOL 1210 from either Vickers or Dr. Horner
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great professor! BIO1210 can be challenging for some students but professor Dawson gives you all the tools you need to succeed and get a good grade. Tests can hard if you don't have time to study, but Dawson gives out lots of practice problems that look exactly like what will be on her tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I thought my biology teacher in high school was bad, but then I had Renee Dawson. She can be funny in class, but for the most part her teaching style was not good for anyone who wasn't as familiar with biology. I had two college biology courses prior to this class and I still didn't do as well as I wanted, because she somehow made it more confusing
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Expects a lot out of you. Great professor if you actually want to remember what you learned. Very transparent about what will be on quizzes and tests. Practice tests help a lot to prepare you for the exams.

Renee is not a bad person. She is funny, and likes to engage her students. I don't feel like her way of teaching is suited for everyone, however. For myself, it took me some time to understand how to prepare effectively for her tests and quizzes because she flipped questions to a degree that didn't even make sense anymore for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Very disappointed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very good teacher. She was very accessible, taught well, fair grader
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: My experience was positive. Renee tells the class exactly what she expects and how to be successful in the class. My advice to anyone taking this class in the future would be to do the ASQs! I would also recommend going to TA discussions, without help it is hard to be successful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: This professor is amazing. Many people think the this class is very hard but she just wants you to learn and to understand. She is very caring and makes you work for your grade. Honestly, go to the lectures, participate with use of clickers, take notes, do homework, and most importantly do the ASQ's (assigned study questions). She's awesome!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I was initially a little wary of this class because of the reviews on here, but I am glad I took it. Renee is a great professor and gives you all the resources you need to get a good grade in her class. She wants you to understand the material rather than memorize (that is why some people find it tricky). Do the ASQs and go to discussions!

Test were hard but totally doable if you look over old quizzes. TA review sessions were a huge help. Didn't really use the textbook much. None of the material was too difficult with adequate studying time. I would gladly take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough--Would take again

reviews.comment: Study well, not just long. Renee gives everything that will be tested so know concepts and know what the information really means, not just what it looks like. Do the ASQs. Spend time on doing them, not just memorizing the key. If you go to class and stay caught up on concepts you will be fine.
Great professor, experienced, cares a lot about teaching, excited to help if you want to learn.

Absolutely the worst class Ive ever taken. Spent many hours weekly on homework had little to do with quizzes and tests. She makes up her own content rather than using the text book material. She tries to make quizzes and tests as hard as possible so that the class can average about 60% on everything. Limited office hours for help. Terrible!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Renee is an awful professor. She cares more about trickery and deceiving her students on tests than their learning and wellbeing. I spent more time studying how to maneuver her tricks than actually learning genetics. All in all Renee is an awful teacher who doesn't seem to care much about her students or their learning. NEVER TAKE A CLASS FROM HER

Overall, a solid intro course, but be prepared to utilize resources outside class (Tutors).Keep in mind that the advice and tips she gives are very relevant to this course (do ASQ's) And take solid notes from lecture because it may not be covered in the book but will appear on a test. This class TAKES TIME so be patient with mastering content.

Renee gives you all the tools that you need to succeed. Studying all the ASQs will allow you to get pretty easy As on the quizzes and exams. If you are having hard time with concepts, the TA reviews will help you understand all the info you need to know. As long as you actually try and put in just a little bit of time studying, it's a fairly easy A

I didn't open the book until the week before the final. I think I would have done so much better if I read the book and attended the TA session's. I did the ASQ's and they were a LIFE SAVER. Don't procrastinate this class! I learned more about biology than I ever have before. Test's are carefully worded to weed out memorizers of old questions.

Renee's class will make you work for a good grade. Her TA's are extremely difficult graders. Make sure you double check all your quizzes and tests for grading mistakes because those are very prominent. Do the extra-credit even if you don't think you'll need it. If you ever need anything go to her office hours, she is surprisingly understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: If you're debating about going into Pre-Med, this is a great class. I admittedly did quite well bc I had AP Bio before this, but it was a really good indicator for me. I am not planning on going into Bio, but Renee was clear about what she expected and you knew how to get an A. Go to the study sessions and DO THE ASQS!!!

She pretty much tells you what you need to do to get a decent grade in the class but she's not kidding when she says it's going to be over 10 hours of work a week. It's a crazy load of work to deal with for one class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Expectations for this class were laid out clearly on the first day and if you followed them, you did well. I strongly recommend going to discussions and doing the ASQ's. I went to 4 discussions, one every day before class and it set me up for success. Renee is a great professor, she's very passionate about biology and cares about student success.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: The class is moderately difficult, but it's not unreasonable. She lets students know the first day of class she expects 9-12 hours of studying and homework a week. Her Assigned Study Questions well prepare you for tests and quizzes. She's tricky because she flips questions. But you'll demonstrate an understanding of material, not just memorization.
very good. A bit confusing sometimes, but very good over all.

Attending every class will only help the most attentive of students as she speeds through her slides and is completely out of order with regards to quizzes, mastering, and lecture. Her tests and quizzes usually do not match with the textbook or slides and your only hope is to do the Assigned Study Questions and hope you understand everything!

Absolutely terrible. The TAs rushed through grading and made a lot of mistakes. The quizzes and exams have confusing questions that are flipped every way to confuse you. She and the TAs rarely help if you have questions, and are quite demeaning if you don't understand something. Despite going to discussions and doing ASQs I have struggled

She is very clear on what is to be expected on the exams and quizzes, plus offers 15 points extra credit. I have not touched the textbook once and I still have a high A at the moment. All you have to do is complete the ASQs and go over the red words and phrases on the slides before the quizzes and exams and you'll get an A. Discussions also help.

Renee is an amazing person and professor. Pay attention in class, do the Assigned Study Questions (ASQs) that are available. I saw a major increase in my grade by reading the book, actually trying on the assignments, and doing the ASQs! Shes tough, but she wants the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: WATCH OUT! Even though I studied like crazy, I still struggled in her class. She lectures on one thing in class and tests you on the complete opposite, she tries to trick you big time. Quizzes are once a week, class average is USUALLY around 3-4/10. She "helps" explain but in person she is very demeaning and expects you to know everything already
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The way her class schedule is set up screws with you, she has you do an online lab on the chapter a week before we start learning about it, then when it's time to take that quiz we are in the middle of learning the next chapter. She also gives very long articles that are only worth 5 points.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Love Renee! Do ALL extra credit, ASQs, go to lecture everyday and try to get trevin for discussion... fun and interesting class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Typical Biology Class. Do the assigned study questions and understand the answers and you'll be fine on the tests and quizzes. Also the TA led review sessions can be really useful for getting another perspective on the content.
Oh boy your signing yourself up for something else. Be careful
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Would not recommend.

Dawson is  super passionate about what she does, I'll give her that. I did learn a lot in her class. But her test and her grading is hard AF! Her test are super  hard and she tries to trick you on them. I like to be tested  on what I was taught and how I was taught. Her tests are what killed my grade. Would not take her class  again due to tests.

Dawson's idea of thoroughly understanding biology is that of a facade at best. The A students in the class just memorized her past quizzes, past exams, and ASQs because questions were almost identical. You can learn the concepts as well as possible, but if you don't kowtow to and conform to her linear way of thinking, you won't succeed.

I took Renee two times. I first time I got a C+. The second time I took the course I got a B+. The difference the second time is that I utilized the resources that Renee sets out to help her students. She wants you to deeply understand the subject so you can use it later on. She teaches beyond just Biology and helps to make you a better student.

People deem her tricky. She is simply making sure you understand the material. What good is knowing the material if it is described to you one way? Critical thinking is a useful skill that she practices. The book is required as additional reading. You can do well in the class without it, but you won't get an A if you don't read additional info.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Renee appears to be a nice person, and I can only gather this personality quality is the reason for so many rave reviews here. She seems to think that it is her responsibility to re-invent the wheel. Course objectives are clear, but they require having a sophisticated level of understanding that many would agree is unreasonable for a freshman.

Renee is an amazing professor who is very passionate about what she is teaching. Her class is difficult, but in a good way. She wants you to actually learn the material, and if you do the work, you will definitely learn it and get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Renee is awesome! Retook this class for a better grade and learned more then I did the first time. Weekly quizzes and assignments, 2 exams and a final comprehensive. She takes participation points with clickers so go to class. 4 review articles to write, not to hard. Go to class, study the ASQ and get a study group and you'll be guaranteed an A.

Renee is an amazing professor that is very passionate and knows her stuff. There is a quiz every Thursday and homework due every Sunday. The quizzes are tricky if you don't go over the ASQ's and look back through the powerpoints. Overall, I would definitely recommend Renee if you are looking for a great foundation in biology!

She truly cares about her students, and she even warned everyone in the very beginning that this class was not going to be easy, but she gives you the resources you need to success.  However, this class was difficult for an intro class. Especially for a student who hasn't taken a bio. class in a very long time. Take this class if you have time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Junior in college, honestly my least favorite class ever. I dread coming to this garbage class, the grading scale is fair but the quizzes are harder than you expect, unless you have taken biology before or have zero life, expect to study the majority of your time. My major is biology, after her class I considered changing my major.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dawson is the best Biology teacher to take 1210 from. She cares about her students and does her best to give you everything you need to do well in her tests and quizzes. Do well on your weekly quizzes, study hard for tests(3 including final), do clickers and her online homework they will bump your grade up extremely. She also has extra credit! (:
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Renee is a great professor because she is so passionate about what she teaches. But her class is NOT EASY. She tells you from the first day that you will have to work for it. If you can't commit to studying 6-10 hrs a week DO NOT take this class. But if you do use all the tools provided and take the time to learn the material you should be fine!

Renee is awesome, however, this class is extremely hard (this could be as I work all day and then come to her class in the evening). Her tests are very hard even with studying the material she tells you to. I will be retaking this class at a later date.

Renee is a really great professor. Her class is hard, but she tells you on the first day of class that you will have to work for your grade. She does a lot to help you prepare for quizzes and tests. And, there are three extra credit assignments to help you out a little.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She really is a professor that wan't her students to succeed. From the beginning she was dedicated to helping even the difficult students succeed. She is frequently available to help and was reasonable
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: In the beginning it seems impossible to get an A, but in the end it is fairly easy. There are tons of points not counted till the end. The quizzes are the hardest part of the class in my opinion. The tests are not nearly as hard though, you get tested on basically the same stuff as the quizzes.

Absolutely fantastic professor, hard class. She loves what she's teaching and that makes it easier to attend lecture. She has tough quizzes and exams, but she gives you all the resources you need to do well. Read the material before class, ask questions, do the extra questions she gives, and review your old quizzes and you'll be fine.

Very kind and passionate teacher, in case that is what you are looking for. But she is very tough.  I studied and understood her materials very very well for each quiz and exam and did not get what I had wanted. Basically, you need to be the smartest person or you had already taken the class and have the old papers!  Don't believe her!!

Her tests are tricky. This makes her make you stray away from memorizing and actually knowing the information no matter what way she asks you. Only take this class if you need this for your major. She provides lots of opportunities to bring your grade up. Study weeks in advance for tests. Do the ASQ's weekly. Go to the TA sessions. Doable class!

Dawson really got me to like biology. The class itself is pretty easy, especially if you remember high school biology. Honestly one of the easiest classes I've taken, but a lot of tedious homework. Do the ASQs, the homework, and discussions and the quizzes and tests will be fine. Also actually try on the clickers and it'll boost your grade.

If you don't attend the lectures, you won't pass the class. The quizzes every Thursday are pretty difficult, but she does give you ASQ's which help a LOT if you actually look at them. Overall a very tough class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Super hard class, I would not recommend taking it if your just filling your gen ed credit. Only take it if  REQUIRED for your major.  Professor Dawson class is super hard. You will need to be putting in 14+ hours a week to get an A. Do the ASQ & go to discussion, they mostly cover everything but Exam/quiz  HARD. You will be taking 1 quiz each week
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Renee is one of the best professors here.  Her class is hard, but she cares that you learn biology and do well, so she tells you exactly what you need to do to pass. ASQs and MasteringBio will help on quizzes, and exams are basically compilations of the quiz Qs just worded differently. Whether you have biology background or not, take this class!

Renee is honestly a really good professor. A lot of comments on here say that she is really hard but honestly if you put in time and actually do the work you will end up with a least an B+. Great lectures,  caring and funny. She gives you everything you need to succeed. Go to TA sessions! They basically give you the weekly quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: There is no doubt can get an A without studying ASQ and lectures before the quiz. Even though, this class is gen ed. You will suffer the most of the time to understand the concept that what she wants you to know. You have to throw out the most of the information what you learn in high school and ready to take in all the information what she said.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Be prepared to work your butt off, but there is plenty to study from. Do the ASQS, GO TO DISCUSSION, take notes in class and at home (briefly), and rewatch the lecture slides. If you do all this you seriously will pass, but make the effort to UNDERSTAND, not just memorize otherwise you will be doomed. Read and review ahead of time, be smart.

The first month is a real pain but you get used to it. She really is a great professor and seriously CARES about all her students, she tries her best to give everyone a chance. There are many easy opportunities to maintain your grade, especially if your quizzes are poor or even your exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: She teaches everything after the homework is due so is hard to listen to the lectures when you already did the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: 10/10 hugability 10/10 trickiness  She's a great teacher, but the class is hard and it's something you need to be prepared for. Be ready for a lot of homework and a lot of tricky questions.

She is very upfront about how to get an A.  Literally all you need to do is read the chapter, do the ASQ, and do the Mastering Biology homework without googling the answers.  If you do those 3 things it should take up about 6 or 7 hours of your week.    For exams  study quizzes and ASQs.  No excuses.  Try a CS class if you complain about this.

Renee really does want students to succeed but it is a very hard class to pass. Be prepared to study a lot and think you know the material just to get mediocre grades. Study the ASQs and lecture slides and you should do fine! But beware the tests are very hard, the average was a 52% on our final.

Renee is amazing! If you do the ASQ's, you will be prepared for the tests and quizzes. She does everything she can to help students succeed, take advantage of it. Tests aren't easy, but if you do everything she says, you'll do well in the class.

Renee's class is very difficult, and she knows it. The mean score on her final was 52 % and she does not curve. However, it is worth noting that she has a few checks to help people who may have received a bad score,  but they won't completely save you. Her tests are very tough. I would not take again. She is a nice person though, bad teacher.

Ridiculously hard tests and quizzes every week. Even if you have done everything there is to do you will still not be full prepared for any of her tests and quizzes. Expect to study allot and then get mediocre grades losing points on minute details that are better suited for cell bio.
You may think you know and understand the topics but you get into her tests and you don't. Her tests are extremely hard and there is nothing you can do about it.
Not an easy class to pass!

Renee is an amazing professor, and her lectures are interesting. She really does want her students to succeed and she provides so many helpful resources. Her class forced me to change the way I study and made me love biology. Her class is hard, but it's possible to do well. You HAVE to be willing to put in a lot of hard work, but you'll learn a lot

Dr. Dawson is very clear and concise about her goals in teaching biology. She doesn't want her students to be good test-takers; what value are good test-takers to the world? This class is difficult because she teaches you to learn in a new way.  Dr. Dawson helped me change the very way that I think. I loved this class and came to love biology.

I think Renee is a great professor. She does all that she can to tell you exactly how to succeed and gives you tools to do so. If your not willing to put in the time and effort to get a good grade you will fail. This class is tough, it takes hard work. Do all the HW and it will help your grade a ton.

Do not take this class if you are just trying to fill a general credit. It would be very hard to keep up and pay attention if you are not genuinely interested in Bio. Renee is a great professor but she is very tough. This class is not one where you can memorize definitions and do fine. You actually need to understand what is being taught.

Dawson makes her quizzes and tests ridiculously difficult. You feel like you understand the material until you're tested on it. Studying the ASQs helps. The clickers are hard but they're optional, and there's weekly 2+ hr homework. She's a good teacher who cares about giving you a strong foundation in Biology but her class is not an easy one.

Mrs Dawson is a good person. Don't get me wrong she's a good person. But as a teacher she is very unclear on the fact that her class is a gen Ed. She expcets students in her class to be going in a bio major. She is also very unclear on what she teaches and her test questions are very confusing.

Renee is an awesome teacher. Even though the class is tough at times you will not learn more about Biology from any other teacher in an easier way. She has weekly quizzes but practically gives you the answers to them before them in her ASQs. She also is funny and you can really tell she loves what she does. She made me really love biology.

Her test and quiz questions are bizarre and confusing unless you have a very thorough understanding of the concepts. To give her credit, she takes a lot of testing material from Assigned study questions (ASQ's). You could read the textbook five times over and still fail, so having a clear understanding of the ASQ's is ESSENTIAL to doing well.

Renee does an excellent job of teaching complex material simply.  She is sensitive to the needs of students and accordingly is flexible on when she assigns homework due dates.  She has weekly quizzes which are a pain in the neck, but are really good to prepare for tests.  Her style of  forcing you to know material in and out is excellent.

Don't get me wrong, Dawson is a great person, but teacher wise, she is terrible. The quizzes every week will wear you down, the exam questions are flipped in all ways, and the study material is very unorganized. If you want to learn anything about basic biology, do not take it from Dawson.

Expects students have a good background in bio 2020 and 1210. Instead of explaining new concepts clearly, tells the class that the material is easy so they should know. Best chance to succeed is attending discussions and doing the suggested problems. Yet, test questions can seem out of the blue.  Lectures more on her interest than test material.

I dislike how Dawson requires you to process and regurgitate material in very specific, not always intuitive ways. It's how she understands it best, but not how I do. She's very straightforward; the ASQ's are the key to success. I do feel as if AP Biology (which I got a 5 on the exam for) gave me a better foundation than this course would.

Does not explain things clearly and her quizzes/tests are only partly based on what is available to study in the book. In order to study, one must rely on her poorly explained slides and a plethora of other scattered materials. It is a hassle. Would not recommend her if you learn best from personal study.

Professor Dawson is as passionate about biology as she is passionate about teaching. Go to class. Also, work through every problem she assigns as homework multiple times and you will do well in her classes and learn a ton. She wants you to succeed and she wants you to learn. She is also hilarious!

You will never feel prepared for her weekly quizzes. Homework takes hours on end to complete each week. It's like getting knowledge through a fire hose. She tries to cover so much information, you won't be confident in what you know. It's not clear cut or at all clear what you're supposed to know. This is one of the most failed classes. Good luck.
Tests are hard. Not helpful

She had two classes, 200+ and 30+ people. Transferred into the 30+ asap. That saved my grade. She explains the ideas behind learning and teaching the first class, so I was able to fall into step with the curriculum very quickly. Very down to earth. Have group study sessions and go over the materials she gives you. It's meant to be a hard class.

Renee is one of the best professors! I had to take her class twice because the tests and quizzes are very tricky, but if you do the ASQ and read the material, you'll do fine! She really cares about her students and will help you if you are struggling. Going to class is a must!!!
Renee is a great teacher. She is quirky, but is passionate and most the time class is enjoyable! Tests and quizzes are difficult. DO THE ASQs they help a ton! Overall great class and teacher

Tests/quizzes are tricky. But overall her class was enjoyable because she is really funny and actually cares that you succeed. She replies to emails fast, and always makes herself available if you need her. the trickiness of the tests and quizzes was the only downside to the class. But she offers like 25 pts EC over the semester.

Renee is very passionate about what she teaches and made genetics extremely interesting. Tests and quizzes were difficult but by doing and understanding the ASQ (assigned study questions) they are fair and manageable. Also was very open to questions and would do anything to help a student out. wants students to truly succeed and do well in class.

super broad topics and really hard tests. I went to all of the extra stuff and still failed. I had a hard time with the tests. that is the most important. and same with quizes. really short but really hard.
Dawson is very approachable and an awesome person overall. Her sense of humor keeps lectures interesting. Do the ASQ's and you will pass no problem. I would take another class from her for sure.

Although Renee's class was one of the most difficult classes I've ever taken, she is also one of the most caring professors I've had. If you ever need help she will stay after class until you feel comfortable with the material. It was great to see a professor who cares about her student and who they are instead of thinking of them as a number!

She is one the best professors I have ever had at the U.  She challenges you to learn the material.  Her expectations are clear on what material you should know for the exams.  She uses simple language to describe complex biological processes.  She understands students and has compassion. I would study 6hrs before exams! work hard, you'll be fine!

She seems unorganized in her approach, course slides are hard to follow wout class attendance. She does a good job of highlighting important topics and reminding you of what will be on the test.  DO the Assigned Study Questions she posts, as they are similarexactly what the exam ?s will be. Other examquiz ?s come from mastering biology homework.
Disappointed.

I really liked Dawson's lectures, I though she really tired to help students as much as she could. She is really cool if you take the time to go to her office hours and just talk to her about any concerns you have. Understand she does have hard tests, but the TA's really helped pull me through! Do Assigned Study Questions (ASQs), and extra credit!

Attend all of the lectures, do the ASQs (practice exams, very helpful!) 2-3 times before each quizexam, keep up with the homeworkextra credit and you should come out with a B or better. Renee loves to teach biology and help students out. If you are ever confused make sure to talk to her or a TA at discussion so you don't fall behind!

Renee is a great teacher.  The course if VERY challenging but I think she did a wonderful job for such a fast pass class. She was constantly talking about how to improve and make it better for us. She asks for feedback. She gives extra credit and if you do ASQ's, homework, clicker, and attend class it seems impossible not to pass.

Renee is by far the best biology teacher I have had at the University of Utah. She is willing to take as much time as needed outside of class in order to help her students understand the concepts and do well on the exams and quizzes. This is a class that requires work throughout the semester but she is there for you every step of the way.

Renee is an awesome genetics teacher. She is very enthusiastic and is willing to take time to help you with any questions you might have before and after class. Her assigned study problems were super helpful when it came to studying and it was exactly what you needed to know for the exams (plus everything she highlighted in red in her slides) :)

Renee's teaching stye was unclear and disorganized.  Exams were confusing and not enough time was given to complete them.  I believe that our class comprehension of key principles decreased during the semester based on a comprehensive quiz.  Genetics seems like an interesting subject, but taking it from Dawson was frustrating.

The lectures and homework are very easy, but the tests are extremely hard. Renee does give ASQ's which are essential to passing, if you study them a lot you will do fine in the course. She is also very willing to help you out if you have an issues and is extremely nice.

Renee is a nice person, but a suboptimal instructor.  She is disorganized and focused too much on trying to teach the class her learning methods.  We have all taken advanced science classes such as O-Chem and physiology and know our own learning techniques.  I would ask that she clearly demonstrates the key principles and let us take it from there.

Renee is great in class lecture. However, her exams are a different story. They are much more challenging than what is presented in class. Good news is that she offers other assignments to buffer the low exam grades. The ASP's, extra credit opportunities, and TA sessions are a MUST to do well in her class.

Her class was very difficult if you are the type who doesn't study but she makes it very fun and captivating. Her questions are only vague if you attempt to just memorize rather than understand the material.  She is very enthusiastic and the class is a lot of work and time and do your ASQs. She tries to help you succees with EC and otherassignments

She offers a lot of extra credit, but she does not give nearly enough time for tests. She is one of the most friendly professors I have ever had, but I didn't learn a thing from her class and she expects too much considering how little she teaches. I had to take her class twice just to barely pass with a C+. Genetics is tough but COME ON!

Renee 's class is hard. I recommend to do ASQ's. I didn't do them at first and it KILLED me. All the exam questions look exactly like them so DO IT!! Go to class & you will have a better chance of passing! If you fail your first exam don't give up. I got 48100 & i still can manage to get a B in the class. Study hard this class is difficult.

She is a very nice person, but out of her element in this class. She was very frazzled for most of her lectures and she would tell us that she hasn't read the part of the book that she assigned. Very unorganized. I hear she is great for the easier human genetics class that focuses more on popular science.

Ineffective teacher.  Tests are poorly written with vague questions.  She has to explain several problems per test multiple times because students don't understand them, after which people still don't understand.  Assigned problem sets do not help with tests or quizes.  Tries to trick students rather than test what you have learned in class.

She is a good teacher, but she is very very tough. GO to class and do the ASQS and do the extra credit and study study study. This class is hard! Make sure you have a study group because they will definitely be helpful. She is nice and funny but her teaching style wasn't very helpful for me.

I loved taking Bio 1210 from Rene! She is absolutely hilarious and is enthusiastic with her teaching. She's a goof ball and makes Biology really fun. The material might seem challenging, but Rene genuinely cares about her students doing well. If you do the ASQs and Mastering Biology you will be golden.

Renee is a really cool professor. She loves what she teaches and that makes you want to love it too. Her class is very difficult, not because of her but because of the amount of material learned in such a short time span. Expect 8-12hrs a week of studying. I would take this class again from her rather than anyone else! Hard class, great professor.

Renee is a nice person but she is very disorganized and all over the place with her lectures. You have to learn by yourself by doing the problem sets. I feel like I really learned nothing, just how to do meaningless problems to complete the tests.  I would not recommend taking this class from her and she refuses to curve anything.

Great teacher! Loves biology so makes lectures easier to listen too. Definitely NOT an easy class for slackers. She provides a lot of different ways to learn info but you definitely have to spend 8-12 hours a week on this class. Overall a worth while class. I learned a ton! DO THE ASQS! Also do mastering biology cause it helps with the basics.

Your success in this class will be determined pretty much only by how much you study the ASQs. This is not a joke. You have to do them. The ASQs are basically the same as the exams. Also it's not really Renee's fault that biology is hard, and I think she does a really good job with such a huge class that covers so much material.

Professor Dawson was very passionate about the subject but focused on the wrong things in lecture. When she did focus on the right things she breezed over some difficult stuff.  Genetics is a hard topic so I think she did well enough. Her exams were right out of her problem sets, so that was helpful, but still fairly difficult.

Professor Dawson is good. But I think the class is difficult and it did required a lot of study. Professor is good doesn't mean you don't need to study. Most of the exam question are from the study guide so be sure you go over it before the test. I think the homework is a little bit too much.

ONE OF THE BEST PROFESSORS AT THE UNIVERSITY!!!  The class is difficult, but dedication and hard work will get you and easy A.  This class really prepares you for the other Biology courses you may need to take, especially the study habits if you take the time to do the ASQs.  Awesome professor

I think she made this class a lot harder than she needed to. Exams are all fill in the blank. She requires TONS of study time. As if you don't have any other school work to do. Do the ASQs and you'll do okay. Also attend class and use the clicker.

This course is challenging but if you do the ASQs, read the book, and ask questions it'll be alright. Renee is super nice and always available to help but make sure to take advantage of the TAs too. Do the study questions and the extra credit (I promise it'll help you with studying and understanding material) and you'll do fine.

This class was very difficult. I thought that for being an entry level Bio class it would not be too tough. I was wrong. If you really want to do well in her class you can, but need to work for it. I attended all the lectures and still did not understand the tests because a lot of the test material was not covered in class.

The absolute hardest class I have taken in my entire college career.  It's taught like it's an upper division science class. She is an enthusiastic teacher but does not explain the concepts very well at all. The tests are the worst. If I you have to take BIO1210 as a requirement for another major, I wouldn't suggest this.

If you want to do good in the class you have to study on your own. She is very knowledgable but she does not how to properly explain the hard concepts. Keep doing the ASQs for studying because almost all questions on exams are from them. Chemistry is not a prerequisite but it would help if you took it before Bio. Good Luck ;)

Did fine in the class, but to be honest Im confused what people are saying because she is not a good teacher. The only time I actually understood the concepts was from going to discussions where the TAs actually explained it.

As long as you attend class and do the ASQ's you will do fine in the class. She gives you every tool you need to succeed. Good teacher. It does require quite a bit of studying though. I would recommend this class to whoever actually wants to learn more about biology

If you are looking for an easy class go elsewhere. She challenges you and really makes sure you know the material. DO THE ASQ's!!!!! Focus all studying on the ASQ and you will be fine. Go to study sessions to! When she says you want to study 12 hours a week she isnt kidding!

I hated this class. I felt that she was out to trick me and that's all she wanted to do. Her powerpoints and textbook were completely useless if you don't do the ASQ's you are definitely not going to get a good grade I would never recommend this course or professor to anyone
Renee was super fun to learn from, as long as you complete the ASQ and masteringbiology you will be able to know what is on the tests. Also attend some TA discussions

While her tests are tricky, actually understanding the material is key. Just memorizing formulas and the ASQ's help, but really try talking them out. She is able to make this class interesting! Don't be discouraged by how much studying you will need to do each week. If you take physiology after, you will be VERY glad that you understand biology.

Study the ASQ's. Her curriculum seems fine but you get to the tests and it is pretty confusing. I studied so much that when she asked an ambiguous question on a test, I wasn't sure which concept she was referring to and it really messed up my grade. Study a bunch however and you should do okay. Once again, ASQ's all the way!
Very interested in the subject. Tests were hard and you really had to know the stuff. She tries to trick you on the tests.

Renee is a very dedicated professor.  After every test I would go to her office hours and we would go over the things I got wrong.  She loves what she does and it shows in lecture. I took the night class and was impressed that she kept her peppiness.  Take this class from her and study the ASQs!!!! Can't stress that enough!

Renee is one cool woman. Her passion for biology is evident throughout the course and she is always inviting questions during lectures. Yes, this course is challenging. You will study at least 8-12 hours per week if you want to succeed. The ASQs are your recipe for success and the TA sessions were also helpful. This course taught me how to study!

I took Bio 1210 from her and thought this class would be interesting and similar to that one, but this class was super boring and pointless. She would keep getting distracted on different topis. Her tests are impossible and you never have enough time to take them. I would not recommend this class.

Renee is a great teacher. She really cares about the subject and teaches in an easy to understand manner. I never left class feeling confused. But if you want a good grade in the class you have to do the ASQ's and mastering biology. All of her test questions come from those but she flips them around so don't just memorize the material verbatim.

Renee is an awesome teacher.  She really cares about the subject and teaches at an easy to understand level.  I never left class feeling confused.
