However, if you want a good grade in this class it is crucial that you complete the ASQ's and online mastering biology.  All of her questions come from those two sources.  I would highly reccommend her!

Do not take this class. She is ridiculously hard! This is a general biology class and she is teaching it as it were a 4000 level class. Most say do the ASQ's and you're ok, but that won't help cause she is going to switch up a lot of stuff on the test to confuse you. She is a nice person, but teaches a little intense for a general class.

Renee is awesome. I have had a lot of professors at the U and none are as good as she is. To be clear however, her classes are NOT EASY so if you are looking for an easy A take your course from someone else. But if you want to really learn and understand things in class and actually REMEMBER what you learned down the road.. she is your woman lol
Very Helpful and listens to feedback from students to make sure she is teaching clearly. very open to class discussion and very helpful.

People say she's hard but just do ASQ and it's super easy. Enough bonus points assignments too. I ended up with a 98% thanks to those bonus points. Her exam and quiz questions are pretty much exactly her ASQ's questions but she flips them.I think she's too nice and lets people ask too many questions. 3 busy work assignments though.
Renee is a great teacher. She is very knowledgeable about the subject and makes it interesting. The ASQ's help a TON and really give a good idea of what will be on the tests and quizzes.

Dawson is an awesome teacher that knows she's teaching to a group of 100 bored, tired students, and tries her best to make the topic interesting and engaging. The class is no doubt difficult, but she is very clear about what will and will not be on the exams. If you ditch class and try to learn from the book, you will not get a good grade.

Renee is very fun to listen to as she lectures because you can tell she really loves Biology and wants you to learn.  The class is easy in the beginning, but then seriously ramps up.  You have 3 exams (plus a final), 4 quizzes, 4 articles, a project and online homework you have to do.  If you do not study, you will NOT do well in this class.
This class is not an easy one. It's do-able as long as you do your ASQ's. Renee is a great professor and she makes sure you understand the concepts.

Dawson is a great professor. She's genuinely enthusiastic about biology AND teaching. Her course starts our fairly easy but definitely gets tougher, but she makes sure you actually understand the concepts. Although most of her homework is busy work, it's easy, the tough homework is what really helps. She's also a fairly fun lecturer.

She is a great teacher. If you pay attention in class and do the ASQ's then you will definitely get a good grade. This class takes effort. You can't just memorize you need to know the stuff forwards and backwards. You will learn alot. Take the time!
This class was ridiculously hard. Her tests cover some insanely small details in the book and there really weren't any simple questions.

Dawson has ruined me! I used to love bio and now thinking about it makes me want to cry! I study for over an hour every day and I have failed 2/4 tests so far. I do the asq's twice each and there is just too much material. She adds much, much more detail than there is in the text. I will be ecstatic if I get a C-
Shes an easy teacher. Do ASQ and you win.

Renee is an amazing professor! She is a charismatic lecturer, she made Human Genetics an enjoyable subject and a joy to learn. The work load is a little intensive, and the quizzes and exams are hard, but if you attend every lecture and discussion (a little studying helps too) you will be sure to pass.

Dawson was the best professor I ever had. I found the TA discussions to be one of the most helpful aspects of this class. The MOST helpful aspect by far were the ASQ's. Do the ASQ's and actually understand what you are doing and you will get an A. Attend class, read prior to, do the homework, do the ASQ,s, attend TA discussions and you're golden.

Renee is an excellent professor. As others have mentioned, the class requires effort. Go to class. Read the textbook. Four different T.A. led study groups were organized throughout the week. Renee's enthusiasm helped me enjoy the subject of biology. Take her class. Don't be lazy.

She was very disorganized with little focus on test materials. She loved teaching history of genetics. A lot of statistic in this class which she barely shows you how to do.Extremely disorganized,she uses her T.A.'s to determine how hard the test should be based off of how quick they can finish her test.Horrible Teacher but one of your only options

Incredible instructor (bio-1210)Sets all students up for success. Oustanding website-everything you need - no guessing what is expected. The text book is excellent-top notch. Follow her syllabus,do all required, come to class-you'll be successful.The TA,David S.was also positive, smart and helpful-free group help sessions.Top class for any major!!!

Perfect course for Pre-Med, Pre-Dent students. Renee worked to ensure that we would understand future biology/chemistry classes. She was respectful and kind. She also usually gave a 24 hour grace period after homework was due. Her tests were insanely difficult, but doable if you completed the Assigned Study Questions (ASQs)
Very passionate about the subject.  It is by far the hardest class I have taken at the U.  Dawson is a good teacher, but the tests are beyond hard.

If you are a Pre-med/ pre-dental, this is the course for your. Dr. Dawson is an amazing professor that teaches you how to handle tricky questions on standard exams. Her in class exams are very comprehensive, but as long as you have done the study guides and have participates in class lectures you should get a reasonable grade I highly recommend Dr. Dawson!
she is awsome!!! very inteligent

Hard class but Renee is a great teacher. She keeps things interesting but it is imperative that you attend her classes or you can fall behind quite quickly. She covers a lot of material so if you have a laptop I suggest you use it to take notes seeing as how most people can type faster than they can write.

Renee is the funnest most excited to teach her subject teacher I've ever had.  She made you love biology whether or not you already did or even wanted to.  Yeah her tests were difficult, but I got a 94, 90, 97, 83 (final) on them.  DO THE ASQ'S!!! Her test questions come from those!  If you don't want to work hard in bio, don't take her class.

Renee is one of the most intelligent professors that I have encountered here at the U. She is a very approachable person and is always available to help you (I was pleasantly surprised at how quickly she managed get back to me via email). She's a fun lady, but the classwork can be deceptively hard. Do your work! The ASQ's are ridiculously helpful.

She is an awesome professor! If you need help, she actually puts in the effort to sincerely help you to do well and explain what it is you may be doing wrong and how to fix your mistakes! She will prepare you for other upper division bio classes. Didn't like her exams (some multiple choice) but if you do your part you'll ace it, no doubt! love her!
She is a great teacher! Genetics is somewhat challenging as a subject, but she makes it so much easier than it could be. If you can, for sure take her!
great teacher
So awesome- take genetics from her!
She was awesome.  She loves the topics she teaches so it makes class fun and interesting.  All of her exams come from her lectures so it's really straightforward.

She pushes her students to really understand what is being taught, and did so very effectively for me.  You won't want to miss lectures. The class was taught in a very interesting way, and made me love biology!  It's very possible to get an A if you follow the directions that she gives! An awesome class and professor!

Great teacher. She wants you to succeed and is entertaining. The class is hard and takes a lot of work, but she provides plenty of help and extra credit. I had not had Biology since 9th grade and got an A in this class. Go to class, read slides (posted online), go to discussion, do Assigned Study Questions, do extra credit, and you will do well.

I felt like she really wanted the class to succeed.  She took a lot of time answering all of my questions until I understood.  She has homework that is not required, but her tests are identical to the homework.  Do the homework, get an easy 'A' on the quizes and exams.
I pretty like her. she is wonderful professor. genius! I almost fotgot what I learned at high school. but her teaching is so wonderful.I like her, best professor!
she is very helpful. I still remember what she taught. if you want to learn sth. take her class. you should follow her step. dont lost yourself.
very good and interesting. really funny too. class is actually interesting to listen to.

Extremely tough tests, rushes through chapters so fast that nothing covered in class in depth (but tests expect depth of knowledge), expects a lot of previous Bio knowledge despite no pre-req.  Way too hard for entry level. Not recommended.

A great professor for both Bio intro and Genetics.  She loves genetics, Mendal and punnett squares.  So don't expect to get much about other parts of biology such as diversity and ecology.  Her tests are hard, but if you do the Assigned study Questions you should pull +80 and higher if you do extra studying on your own  Her TAs are really good too.
Rushes through the material, I took AP bio in high school and I am completely lost in her lectures. She gets off on a tangent and is fairly boring. I wouldn't recommend her.

Way to hard for an entry class. Gets stuck on one subject then rushes through the rest of her lecture. I want to go into nursing but I'm just looking to pass this class so I can retake it from another teacher. Exams and quizzes are extremely difficult. The class averages are usually very low and are usually not even passing scores.

Extremely erratic teacher. I use to enjoy biology, to the point that it was a considered major. She ruined all interest I ever had in the subject. I have never felt "lost" in a class before and have always done very well in school. This class was an absolute joke. Interested in biology, and want to keep it that way? Take it from another professor!
Extremely hard, lectures were fast and confusing, tests were difficult, some aspects felt like she was teaching to middle schoolers (censored slides). I would not recommend this class to anyone
There is a lot of work in this class.  The tests can be hard, but she makes up for it with some easy points and an easy final.

She is a GREAT teacher! She is alot better than the other teacher. When taking her class go to every one!! The study questions ARE THE  QUESTIONS ON THE QUIZ!!! It comes in handy to get a tutor from the tutoring center, and attend study groups.

She is very helpful and enthusiastic. She is a bit erratic but tries really hard to make sure you understand the information. She gives you many different resources to explain the information and the videos she suggests are short and really help give you a better understanding. Extra credit and clicker Q's are easy. I definitely recommend her!

Her teaching habits make understanding the material very difficult. She works fast and expects student to know what she is talking about. To pass this class you must put countless hours and you'll still get confused on tests. If you want an 'A', plan on not having a life and hiring a private tutor. She does NOT prepare you well for the tests at all

She helps you buffer your grade.  If you don't get an A in this class you didn't do anything.  The clicker she uses costs a little but is a huge help, and grade buffer.  The Extra Credit she gives isn't all that hard.  And the online resources she has are a great addition to her class. She loves what she does and it reflects in the students.

This teacher was AWESOME! Never been to better lectures. She is enthusiastic and genuine. Very eager to help and teach. Discussions are a must, but great class! Definitely would recommend taking this class before genetics (BIOL 2030)

This Professor has a frantic, fast paced teaching style which is sometimes annoying. The exams were very difficult and I did not get well prepared for them from the assignments and study guides. You must have a tutor to get a decent grade.

Can't imagine staying awake for this class?  Take it from Renee!  I was surprised at the amounts of energy she would put into her lectures every day.  She gives students endless amounts of resources to use, and is always willing to answer a question/sit down and explain things.  Takes clicker quizes daily, so you might want to go to class.

Dr. D is the shiznit.  We need more passionate/fun Educators in our school systems so that we, the students, become interested in being a part of the class instead of just cramming and sitting at lectures feeling uninterested and bored-

Dawson is a really excellent professor.  She is always open to questions and helping students, and is really clear in lecture.  She obviously wants every student to succeed, so if you read your textbook and go to class you can get an A for sure.
If u r so into biology, take the class from her. you will see bunch of information even thou it is basic course! her tests are so comprehensive and memorizing and sometimes tricks

She's an awesome teacher and hilarious! her notes are online and her tests are alright. The only thing I hated were the ranking questions and teh fact that there are multiple answers to Multiple choice questions. Read everything and do the study questions and you'll ace it!

although this is not an easy class, Dr. Dawson was very fair in her grading.  She supplied practice exams and quizzes and made expectations very clear.  She wants her students to do well and is very helpful. Great professor!

you must attend her class. she does a clicker which is worth one test every day.  She is a lovely person and if you do her practice exams and reviews that she posts online you will do great in her class.
She understands the dificulty of the material and teaches quickly but very clearly. She can laugh and make fun of herself and tries to make the class entertaining and educational.
No Comments
I really appreciate that she loves what she teaches, it makes her fun to listen to. However, she goes off on tangents that aren't necessary and it confuses us as to whats important and whats not.
She's very enthusiastic about the subject which is nice but she rambles a lot. Her test aren't too bad. She's a fair grader. Overall, not bad.

I really enjoyed Scott. He taught me so much about drawing architecture, and he was extremely easy to talk to when I needed help. Although at the start the workload seemed a bit intense once we started the assignments were really fun and he was a really fair grader.

My experience with Scott was during a semester-long study abroad. He taught the communications/architectural sketching class. I believe this was the first class Scott had taught at a university, so it obviously had some rough patches, but Scott is one of the most talented Architects/Artists I've ever met and has a lot to offer.

Scott is very nice at first but his professionalism falls away quickly. He's immature and can be difficult to learn from. By the end of the semester, he was incredibly difficult to work with and VERY rude. However, it's hard to doubt the talent that he has with architecture. Learning how to draft sketch and watercolor were valuable skills learned.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I participated in a 90-day study-abroad course with daily interactions with Scott. The learning environment felt tense and uncomfortable. Feedback and critical discussion were not encouraged, and teaching relied heavily on affirmation rather than dialogue. This dynamic limited open learning. I caution students considering taking any of his courses.

This has to be the worst instructor I have ever seen, been with, or been taught by. He taught us elementary drafting, which was useful in architecture. His anger tantrums, unhelpful explanations, and lack of help and professionalism are my reasoning of this. His class is overall an easy A if you put in the work, but please avoid him at all cost
Professor Scallheim was very professional. Although he was a tough grader. I learned alot from his course.
Professor.Schallheim was great to learn from he gives great feadback
ere is lots of homework but its not that bad.
He was caring and patient and gave a very thorough explanation for everything.
he was great and very thorough

This class was a nightmare. It needs to be completely restructured and re-designed. He is a very nice man. This was the first year of this class, so hopefully, things get better. But be ready to grab some coffee. Also, the tests are extremely easy. You just have to pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Although I did learn a fair amount in the class and the professor is a very nice guy, I could have learned a lot more if I had taken it from another professor. Although I would recommend this class, I would not recommend this professor. It's difficult to follow his lessons and there is a lot of group and individual papers.

Overall, great person. Less great professor. Weekly labs were outdated. We were told to contact TAs for help on labs, but the TAs were not helpful. I was often left to figure it out. Lectures were mundane, and for an IS professor he struggles with IS. Didn't realize none of us could see his screen until day 3. BUT he is very kind and cares.

Uses extremely old lectures on outdated software; I don't think any of the class material is his own. If I weren't already tech-savvy, I would be so cooked. So I can't imagine how difficult this would be for other students. Initial directions on assignments are extremely unclear, and he has to send multiple announcements with extra instructions.

The material was difficult, but the Professor was very generous with extensions. I usually went to class, but it was easy to keep up when I didn't. When you have a question about an assignment he will always send you to the TAs so be prepared for that, overall a good guy.

This course has a lot of homework, but Mr. Srinivasan made it easier. He gave plenty of time and many extensions on assignments. If you have to take this class, I would recommend you take it with Sankar. Attendance was not required, but he did give some extra credit for showing up some days. Overall, not a great course, but the teacher was a W.

I'm not sure why Professor Sankar has received some negative ratings, but I tend to be particular about my professors. After checking RateMyProfessors, I was a bit hesitant due to the reviews. However, my experience in his course has been quite positive. He is responsive to emails and truly cares about his students' success.

Professor Srinivasan is very caring and wants his students to do well. He replies to his emails quickly and his assignments aren't too difficult. He also curves the grades at the end of the semester. As long as you do the assignments and watch the lectures, it is relatively easy to get an A.

He is a good professor, but his lectures are quite outdated. The exams were a little difficult, but overall, it wasn't too bad of a course. I enjoyed taking it online. I never watched a lecture video and still did well in the class. It really isn't a hard class to pass, and he seems like a reasonable guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Sankar is the man. He is lenient with grading and deadlines , and he is more than willing to work with you.

May Allah Bless Professor Sankar ameen. He has been good help to me this entire semester and I appreciate leniency this semester towards our grades. Even though he gave a good chunk of homework, it was actually enjoyable because its technology and good for those who like tech. This man and Manu Goyal are my two fav indian professors atm.

Sankar is the most caring professor. He sends emails often about class related stuff to make sure everyone is up to date and doing okay. He even goes out of his way to check up on you and classmates during the group project and will give you any accommodations you need. He's the nice professor everyone wishes they had, truly.

The online IS4410 class reuses the same material every semester and has done that since like 2020, but the professor is super helpful and very forgiving with deadlines, late work, etc. Super nice guy, not sure how he is in person but would 100% take an online class with him again.

sankar was very boring, most of his lectures were outdated and reused info from 2016. he repeated himself so much, dragged out lectures longer than they needed to be. the lab sessions taught by syd, a different professor, were more helpful than him. he also ignored my emails while i was sick w covid and caused me to fail. good class, bad teacher

It is pretty easy if you pay attention. Thankfully he now records his own lectures. Sankar wants students in this class to succeed and tries to help students a lot so they can do well on the exam. Just use the study guide and make sure you know how to do the practice problems to be prepared for the exam and you should be fine.

I am about 2/3 of the way through the semester and I am not sure he has done anything other than send a few emails. It is Summer 23, and our lecture slides are still from 2018 talking about tech that isn't even a thing anymore. 

Luckily I am a tech person with prior experience with a lot of this, but I could see this class being hard if not.

Sankar barely teaches this course to begin with and just reuses videos from other professors from 2016.  Nothing is updated and you are constantly having to figure out the new updates of the software taught since the videos are from so long ago.  The discussion posts are lengthy and there isn't much direction.  Best of luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Don't know why he has bad reviews, he honestly wants students to succeed and is accessible and accommodating outside of class. His exams are pretty hard though.

Sankar really wants the students in his class to succeed, and I think he tries his best to make sure everything makes sense. The questions he writes for quizzes can be difficult, and I don't think attendance should have been made 5% of your letter grade.

This class was miserable to say the least. He would repeat himself for 40mins at the beginning of each lecture and never got through all the content. Basically, I ended up teaching myself, which wasn't horrible... but when I had any type of concern, he never answered my emails. I had to go to the lab sessions taught by a Syd to learn anything.

Prof fails to write fair test questions (multiple correct answers, or none at all, on MC & T/F) which affects your grade. All lectures in the course were made & presented by a different prof - not sure what Sankar actually does. The group project is a pain, the TA's don't grade well. Positives: resposive via email, has clear grading criteria.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Messed up grading my final and my grade dropped from a 92 to an 87. This wouldn't be a problem if he just read the 3 to 5 emails I sent him regarding this issue. The class was pretty easy but he was a pretty bad teacher. Wouldn't take a class taught by him ever again.

Sankar is really well versed in statistics and information systems. Unfortunately he isn't the easiest to understand and this can be a problem when the material is challenging to begin with. He seems like a really nice guy but given how difficult the subject is, I'd rather have taken it with someone else.

Sankar is a good professor and is very understanding of his students and their experience using the software in class (Excel). None of the homework or tests have been particularly difficult. I received a good grade and never went to class, you can learn through the textbook and the practice quizzes. BTW, his canvas page is very disorganized.

I really loved Professor Sankar, he understands the level most of the students in this course are at and caters to that. He provides reasoning and an explanation for the Excel formulas. Its easy to tell that he is very intelligent and that he wants to share his knowledge with his students. He also really wants his students to succeed. 10/10

Sankar is a nice guy and means well, but 90% of the classes I attended, he rambled about how he hates canvas for one half and the other half is covering an excel that is accessible at home and will be a homework assignment due at the end of the week. Class is super easy though, he's very picky on packsack responses so just make sure their detailed.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Srinivasan is a good professor in my opinion. He makes his class easy enough for students and he deeply wants students to succeed in his class. His lectures aren't required and are only intended to give you more/extra perspective on the content. His canvas page is very unorganized and hard to navigate, but that's the only issue. Easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Sankar's lectures are super boring and you leave feeling like you learned nothing. There are videos for every assignment so just watch those instead of going to class and you will do fine as long as you follow the video. The tests are super easy and are taken anywhere with all answers on quizlet. Easy but boring class.

I am at the end of Sankar's BCOR 2020 class. What is really annoying is he has video lectures you are supposed to watch outside of class before class and then he doesn't lecture in class. In class, we do excel together which can be helpful but is slightly annoying that he doesn't actually lecture.

I transferred from another university and was SHOCKED at how disorganized Shankar was from day one. The canvas page was a MESS and a pain to sift through. Lectures are a joke because we hardly go through material found on the homeworks. He talks in circles and his accent makes it hard to follow along sometimes

Sankar from what I experienced is a very nice person but the lectures are quite hard to understand. I have found that not showing up to class is not the worst thing in the world. The Homeworks are pretty well explained through videos that he posts with the assignment.

Easy class, Sankar also does his best in lectures to make sure all students understand what he us working on. However class is slow and a drag and his accent does make it a bit difficult to understand. Also has random assignments that don't relate to class like discussions and lots of homework from the online textbook-- meaning you have to buy it.

This professor was very solid. His lectures are there to provide a bit more in-depth detail to the subjects, but overall not required. The videos and assignments that are provided do plenty to help teach you what you need to learn. He is very responsive and provides great feedback.

Taking BCOR2020 with Sankar was very easy. There were many opportunities for extra credit to bring your grade up. As long as you watch the lectures and do the assignments, you will do fine in his class. His accent was a little difficult to understand, so his lectures were a bit boring. He was very understanding of students. A solid professor.

It is extremely difficult to follow the course flow because Sankar constantly posts class announcements that are 500+ words long. He talks in circles and constantly states how easy the course is when in reality it is not. I would recommend NOT taking this course. Sankar is smart but that does not translate to being a good teacher.

Really, really lenient and laid back. Almost to a fault. The take-home tests became too easy that you felt like you haven't learned much. He cares a lot about his students and their success, however, and for that, I would take his class again.
He is very nice and truly cares, but the tests dont relate to most of the material learned and are very very hard (despite being open book)
Awesome teacher and guy.

This professor is completely unorganized. He teaches us things that we learned in middle school. We have been learning how to calculate the mean of a number set for an hour and 20 minutes. If . you take his class you will frequently hear him say "makes sense?" or "does it make sense?" even when nobody responds. Waste of time.

Sankar is nice; however, he is VERY unorganized and all over the place. We were very behind on the material as an honors class, which was embarrassing. He is an easy grader, flexible, and a pushover. The lectures are dry and do not help. The labs were easy, but random so attend class. The tests are hard, so just study the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: At the end of the semester, I felt completely blindsided by my grade. I had always participated in class, completed my homework well, and generally did well on the tests. Up until the last day grades were submitted, I had an A. Out of nowhere, my grade was deflated by several percentage points. Lectures were fine but tests did not reflect lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Sankar is a very nice person, but not the greatest professor. Homework and tests do not reflect the in-class lectures. Even with prior Java experience? I found myself spending hours upon hours teaching myself different concepts to complete the homework. I found the class to be unorganized and the tests to be difficult. Love him as a person, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Sankar is a very caring professor, he truly wants his students to succeed. But he is extremely unorganized and constantly falls behind. We were over a month behind on the curriculum and the homeworks didn't follow along well with the class. He constantly tells you not to worry, you'll do fine, and that is not the case.

Dr. Srinivasan is an incredibly knowledgeable and caring professor. His lectures mainly involve doing in-class participation exercises while he explains the logic behind the code(rather than tons of homework). The tests are easy if you take time to understand the logic of Java and practice programming in class and on your own.

I did the hybrid course where the in-person class was with a TA, who was wonderful. But Prof. Schurig assigned so many unnecessary readings, and half the time the movies we were assigned weren't relevant to the week's topic. Eventually, I skipped out on all the readings and online lectures because it got to a point where it was just ridiculous.

I didn't personally have Prof. Schurig, but one of her TAs. It was very harsh. She graded super harshly and the feedback she gave wasn't very helpful. At the end of the semester my grade dropped immediately and there wasn't anything I could do. She was good in her lectures but I was insanely disappointed after working hard all semester.

Professor Schurigs class was 4 hours long in which she talked for 2 hours about nothing. The readings given were irrelevant and were never brought up in the lectures. After showing the movies that barely associated with the weeks themes, she'd try to get people to discuss it but had fostered a bad community so nobody talked. Do not take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She gives good feedback and fair explanations about the class content. Its a lot of reading, make sure to actually read and not just skim the articles as they come up in the tests. Her emails are helpful to understand the material before diving into it. Theres clear rubrics for everything, if you read them youll do good.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: WORST professor I've ever had. She grades everything arbitrarily, and gives no feedback on anything. She had us turn in a 10 page paper rough draft, didn't even read them, and then had us do peer reviews instead of giving us feedback herself. Disrespectful to her students and their work, and put graded course feedback questions on the final exam.

As long as you put work into everything, you'll do well. The only really difficult parts of this class are the papers. She's a hard grader when it comes to those. But if you read the instructions thoroughly and her feedback on previous work, you'll do fine.

-Gives good feedback -Get ready to read -Lots of homework -Clear grading criteria -Caring -Lecture Heavy. This was a very enjoyable class for it was fun and you have to work for your grade. I would recommend taking this class to everyone, especially for movie fanatics who love expressing their opinions about scenes and movies!

This class was kind of rough for a general. There are two papers throughout the term that are graded hard. The tests are tough, but you can get a good score on them if you watch the films and read the readings every week. The assignments are fairly easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Paper grading seemed somewhat arbitrary, tests were very hard, and very little feedback was given from the professor to her students. Papers were given only score grades, no comments on what was done rightwrong or why points were taken away. Wouldn't recommend to anyone but film majors. And even then, maybe go with a different professor.
If you aren't interested in becoming a film major, then I'd skip taking this class. Her exams can be tricky.

Took her online Intro to Film class. It was pretty easy. There are quite a few reading assignments, at least one or two a week, but I didn't actually read them and still did fine on the exam. She responds to messages pretty quickly and helpfully.

This class was interesting and tests/assignments weren't especially difficult, but there is A LOT of reading. She is a bit difficult to get ahold of. I would recommend this class if you can make the time commitment and care a lot about political science.

Professor Seelig is the absolute worst professor I have ever had. She is way too intense for an intro-level class. It is very apparent she does not care about the success of her students. I learned nothing from this class, it was a colossal waste of time. She refused to provide any leniency or understanding. DO NOT HAVE HER AS A PROFESSOR.

Her class is overwhelmingly strict with no leniency whatsoever. I had reached out to her on a Friday morning due to an unexpected emergency before an assignment was due on Sunday. She didn't respond until 9 pm on a Tuesday stating she had a two-business-day rule which was not mentioned in her syllabus. She was extremely unprofessional.

Taking this class was a drag. Quizzes were long and boring. The final quiz is a different format from the rest and she disables your ability to look at previous questions only on the final. Lots of papers, and only one that I was interested to write. Grades these meticulously as well, even though this is conducted as an intro class. DON'T TAKE!

Worst class I have ever taken. I would much rather take all my chemistry classes over again then this one. Do not take this class if you want to maintain any sanity. Too much reading, impossible quizzes that take hours to take. Unclear and confusing instructions on every assignment. Not to mention she is extremely condescending and unhelpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I ended up dropping this class because it started to take over my 5000 level classes. Unrealistic amount of work is given & her quizzes are way too detailed & tries to make you write a whole essay each time at the end of the quizzes & makes you read a chapter each week (at least 40 pages). This class is the equivalent of taking 2-3 classes. BEWARE!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She assigns a lot more than any other class I've had level 200 and below.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I don't know what class the previous commenter took but man I wish I had taken THAT class. This was the WORST class I have EVER taken. She is incredibly condescending and self-righteous. Even the person I interviewed for one of the papers for this class said this professor was full of herself, & she doesn't even know her! DO NOT TAKE.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Seelig is one of the BEST professors I have ever taken a class from. She encourages students to learn and then form their own opinions, cares about their success, and will help any student to get the grade they want to. She also had many amazing guest speakers throughout the semester that were incredible. I HIGHLY recommend her class.

Professor Schaefer is probably the best professor I've ever had. Very clear and knowledgable about the course. He's also very entertaining and makes class fun. If you actually understand the coursework you'll do well on the exams.

Great in class lectures, I like the online module videos as well. Funny and knowledgeable professor! Lots of studying is required for tests. Some of the concepts can be quite confusing, so I would recommend going to Scott's/TA's office hours. Group assignments will be frustrating if your group isn't very good. I didn't like my group very much so.

While the course can be difficult at times, Schaefer makes the course interesting and comprehensible. There's a moderate amount of homework, but it takes 20 minutes at most. The group homework is super helpful, but that depends on your group tbh. Attending lectures is the best way to understand the material.

This class is very difficult, but Dr. Schaefer is an excellent professor who makes lectures engaging and the material easier to understand. There are quizzes at the beginning of every and a fair amount of group homework and if your group sucks, then you are kind of on your own.

First off, don't be mislead QAMO 2011 is much harder than QAMO 2010 even if you are good at calc. However, if you're up for the challenge this professor is amazing. He lectures very well and helps you really understand the material. Only downside of the class is that almost all HW is in groups (and my group sucked) but its not too hard.

complete lack of organization of the class, few practice materials, and absence from his own office hours without notice. His lectures are pretty good but he always runs out of time. This class isnt like other economics classes where there are a lot of resources online to learn the concepts.

Prof. Schaefer is fantastic. He teaches clearly, and is clearly excited about the topics he is teaching. He also loves teaching undergraduate students, even though he should probably be teaching the graduate and executive courses instead. Game Theory is a fantastic course, and the content in the class is something that is very helpful.

Fav teacher from semester, made me really consider QAMO. Pray you have a good hw group with similar availability or weekly assignments get tough. Made class interesting and I felt prepared for exams with a few hours studying/doing study guide. If you show up and watch lecture videos you will be fine. don't put your heart into prep assignments them.

Professor Schaefer is amazing at teaching the QAMO material. He is so unbelievably educated and he can present his knowledge in a way that everyone can understand. This class was not my biggest work load and I never stressed about it because he gave you all the information to be sucessful.

Scott is an amazing professor; his lectures are always engaging and things are explained well. There are a few quirks - there's probably going to be a mistake in the slides every class - but Scott does a good job overall. He also helps students out and provides them with resources like office hours or free lunch for their success.

I absolutely love Scott! He is an amazing professor. He is funny, caring, and extremely smart. He thinks about things in such complex and smart ways yet explains things in an easy-to-grasp manner. I would recommend taking any course taught by Scott.
Learned the most from him. If you are a QAMO major take every class from this guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Great professor

Professor Schaefer is easily the best professor I've ever had. He is very careful to make sure all his students know all of the concepts and exactly what is expected. Very easy going and personable, but always very professional. If you get the chance to take a class from him, you should 100% take the opportunity.

Scott was an amazing professor. I still go back to his lecture notes after 5 years of taking the course. He taught us using practical business examples from his Roadside MBA venture. He used case studies to bolster the points of the practical examples that he would teach in class. He is one of the best Econ professor in the country.

Definitely one of the best professors I had. 
I loved his lectures and how he did not use any textbook, but just his notes, which were great!
If you will end up taking his class, he will explain why he uses no textbooks.

Scott is amazing. You watch videos/read articles, turn in a short pre-lecture assignment, then attend class and get straight-fire wisdom bestowed upon you. Weekly assignments, ~3 exams, required participation. Easily my favorite course I've ever taken. The work load may sound like a lot, but it's worth it!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Scott was an awesome professor, one of the best I've had. He is very knowledgeable and is great at explaining concepts and giving examples. He is also more than willing to help you outside of class. His expectations are clear and easy to meet if you are willing to put in some work. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Scott is easily the best teacher in the QAMO program. Class time is mostly used for group exercises and discussion based on prerecorded lectures. Tests are difficult, I recommend completing all homework and practice tests without help from notes as exams are closed-book. If you show up prepared, you'll have a great experience in this class.
Very organized, taught the content well!

Great professor who cares for his students. Focuses on making sure concepts stick with students and not overly concerned with grades. Ensures everyone in class gets involved which I think is a bonus because it made for fun discussions.

He is one of the best professors I have ever had. He really cares about helping his students learn the material and he is head of QAMO so developing a good relationship with him in this class will help later. You will learn a lot from this class. Show up to class and do the homework and you will get an A.

Scott is one of the best professors I've met. His classes are very interesting, fun and organized. His assignments and exams are related to his lectures. Whenever I had questions, he took the time to explain it. He's very patient and understanding. If you're good at math, it's an easy class. Participation required. No textbook required.

Professor Schaefer is an amazing professor. He really cares about his students and is available if you need help. He really wants you to succeed in his class. You need to show up to class to get the material. The work you do in class will be on the test. I would take almost any class that he teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He was wonderful.
Lectures are excellent, but usually abstract. The assignments put the lectures to practice. Scott is entertaining. My only complaint is having attendance as 25% of the grade in QAMO 3010.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The contrast between his lectures and the homework is day and night
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Wonderful professor. Lectures are interesting and applicable. He is a very reasonable grader because he wants you to understand and apply the concepts. If you put in effort to make sure you truly understand the concepts, you will do well. He is very accessible to answer questions quickly.

Scott is just a master on the subjects he teaches. Classes are very entertaining and heavy on content. But he makes sure to post his own notes online. You will get some interesting and useful knowledge form his classes. Scott is also a great person to talk outside of the classroom.
Great professor who really knows his stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Schaefer is one of the best teachers at the business school. He cares deeply about the subject and the success of his students. He is super helpful outside of class and will do everything he can to clarify his content. This class is difficult material but he grades fairly and on a nice curve. 10/10 recommend taking a class from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Schaefer is great.  His explanations are clear, he is obviously passionate about the subject, and he is always available to give extra help.  I would absolutely recommend taking a class from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Economics is simplified and applied to real life situations. All the math is thoroughly explained and simplified, and the way he teaches engages you and requires you to think logically and deeply. If you want to do well then participate and think on the topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Scott Schaefer is one of my favorite business professors that I've had at the U. He uses intriguing, real-life examples to explain his content and his lectures are both informative and interesting. His dry sense of humor is pretty funny. He is very available via office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Scott was an awesome professor! Classes are structured the same way each week with 3 lecture days and a homework assignment due every friday that only takes about an hour. Make sure to check the assignments with peers and if you fall behind on the material catch up fast! overall a great teacher who knows what hes talking about
Lectures are long but interesting. He is very good at explaining what he is teaching and why it matters. He is also very patient with those who are having a hard time.

One of my favorite professors.  More than willing to help students with the material, which can be difficult.  Very knowledgeable professor who brings in professionals and shows us the connection.  He also shows the connection between economics and other areas of business.  If you have a chance to take a class by him DO NOT HESITATE!!  SIGN UP!!

Microeconomics was a tough class for me. If you didn't read or go to class, it was really hard to keep up with the material. He is a very smart professor and knows what he's doing, but it's difficult to follow along, so really pay attention.
Totally unresponsive outside of class.
Great econ professor and keeps your interest - esp. for those non-Econ majors out there - super helpful!!
He really knows the material.  Extremely valuable class.
Just one word: BRILLIANT! I'm not kidding. One of the last true economists at the DESB. Hat's off to you prof!!!
Teacher knows his stuff.  See his blog:  http://utah-economist.blogspot.com/   Enjoyed his class!!

A brilliant professor by all standards he keeps his audience interested throughout. The only flip side is that his final is very tough. And the reason is that although u understand everybit of what he teaches in the class its hard to retain it long enough coz there is not much description to the notes he gives...
No Comments
Excitable, but keeps the subject interesting.  Overall, a good instructor.
Sean the G.O.A.T. for many reasons, a true hero for anyone who wants to ace Calculus 2!
Sean Groathouse more like Sean GOAThouse
Good lecturer. Easy class. Allows notes sheet on exams. Very straightforward expectations of what you will be tested on. Not an unreasonable amount of homework.
I would die for Sean Groathouse. Build him a statue immediately.

Sean was an amazing professor for MATH 1311. He truly cared so much about every student and knew what he was talking about. I wish that other professors put this much work into a course. TAKE MATH FROM HIM. Thank you Sean!!

Sean is one of the best professors I've ever had. He's very flexible and will take as much time as needed to go over hard topics in and outside of class. His grading is pretty lenient; he'll give partial credit on test questions. All of our lectures were also on Zoom, so you could tune in if you were sick or out of town. TAKE MATH WITH SEAN!!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Sean is the best math professor I've had at the University of Utah (along with Victoria Kala). His lectures are easy to follow, he explains things clearly, and he's extremely nice. He had very reasonable expectations for Foundations of Analysis I during the Summer 25 semester. I also liked how he followed the textbook while teaching this class.

Professor Groathouse was incredible this semester and perfect for Foundations. Lectures were incredible and he had realistic expectations of class participation (Tuesday and Friday had attendance points, but he provided ways to make them up). I took the class during the summer semester and Zoom recordings of class were life-saving. Love this guy!

Calc II is a hard class, but I can't imagine taking this course from anyone else. Not only does he know the material inside and out, but he knows HOW TO TEACH IT. I went to his office hours multiple times a week and he could explain a topic in multiple ways to make sure that it clicked for me. He won't just give you an A, but he makes it attainable
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is just awesome. Before taking the class I looked him up on rate my prof and saw he had a 5/5 and couldn't believe it, but now I do. Everyone in our class LOVES him, he is so caring, great at explaining the material, has challenging but manageable tests and makes his class interact

I've had to take Calc II three times and it didn't take the first two times but Sean completely changed the way that I look at math. I'm so much more confident in my abilities and I actually understand what is going on in class. I will be done with math after this class but I'm so glad I got to finish it off with Sean's class!
One of the most caring professors I've met. He understands what it's like to be a student and wants to help everyone understand. Easily accessible outside of his lectures. I love Sean.
Amazing lectures. Really wants you to learn the material. Homework is way harder than the tests and quizes. If you got the homework down you are good.
He's a great professor, makes it easy to learn the content. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is the best professor I have seriously ever had. An absolute gem of a person with fantastic teaching skill. He treats you like a person and not like someone less than him. He is very knowledgeable, and is phenomenal at answering questions. He teaches at a great pace isn't too fast or too slow and is very good at keeping the information concise.

Groathouse is the best teacher EVER!! HE INSPIRED ME TO LOVE MATH! HE is so nice and willing to work with you! if you are nervous about taking math, take it from groathouse and you will be fine. He will make math not scary or intimidating and easy to understand. And if you have questions he will help. He is on your side and wants you to succeed!

I LOVED taking linear algebra from Sean! It has been my favorite math class so far. He does a great job teaching the material. I would love to take Probability 5010 and statistics from him! If you can take ANY class from him DO IT!

Best professor I've ever had here at the U. He is so kind and accommodating, and really knows his stuff. His lectures run smoothly and he offers an online zoom link and also records the lectures. There are "weekly quizzes" but you can use your notes and he can come around and check your work.

I took Calc 3 with Prof. Sean last semester and he's possibly the best math professor I'll ever have. His lectures are well-organized and succinct. He deeply cares about his class, and wants everyone to truly understand the material. Sometimes stayed after class for nearly an hour to explain lecture/homework topics. He also provided guided notes.
He's goated. It's basically in the name
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Sean Groathouse is an amazing professor who cares about his students. He took the time to make sure each concept was understood and his exams were very straightforward.

I was walking down the street one day when I saw Sean casually solving the Riemann Hypothesis using the spectral theorem on a napkin. If you don't understand his lectures, it's not because they're unclear—it's because your brain isn't ready for this level of enlightenment. 10/10 Groated

Between annotated notes (that are actually coherent and easy to follow), practice exams, all the exam review sessions, and asking our opinion on logistical decisions. It was clear that he cared about us succeeding. I had a class from 6-7:30pm and I would do it again just to be in his class.

There's a reason he's called Sean "The G.O.A.T." Groathouse. Sean is a fantastic professor who makes difficult concepts easy to understand. He always answers questions in ways that delve into the underlying concepts, and makes sure that you understand the material beyond just a surface level. Probably the nicest professor I've had, We love Sean!

I took linear algebra and applied from statistics from Sean over the summer. You can tell he has a deep understanding of the material without oversharing and confusing his students. He makes it clear of what is expected and the steps to achieve them. Exam = comprehensive review & cheatsheet. Honestly the best professor I have ever had.
Sean amazingly teaches linear algebra. His lectures and notes are the best.

Sean is so caring and understanding of his students. You can really tell that he wants to make sure everyone is truly learning the concepts and does well in the class. Seriously, he is probably one of the most chill math teachers I've ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: lecture were very easy to follow and he was always available to help.

Math has never been my best subject and I was worried about taking this class freshman year, however Sean made math enjoyable.  He truly cares about the success of his students, anytime anyone was confused he quickly cleared up any confusion perfectly.  After 2 years at the U, Sean has been the best professor I've had!  1000000% recommend.

I never took a calculus class before but Sean made everything easy to understand and follow! he would always answer questions in class and if you didn't want to ask during class he would be accessible after class or during office hours. If you can't meet with him during normal office hours please reach out to him!
Does an amazing job at breaking down complicated material. Really cares about the topic and students' success.

By far the best math teacher I've ever had. Sean explained calculus in a way that was easy to follow and understandable. His tests were always fair, he was easily accessible outside of class, and he genuinely cared about you learning the material. Highly recommend taking his class.

He is an my best math teacher to date. Explains things super clear and always stops to make sure everybody is able to follow along. Every question i've taken a question to him has been answered and explained super well. He's very patient and there are no wrong questions or answers. A very reasonable professor and made taking calc not as horrible.
He was a great teacher. He was always open to answering questions and it was easy to get in touch with in. I would recommend him.

Sean is probably one of the best math teachers I've ever had. His style of teaching is simple and efficient. There hasn't been one concept that has just flown over my head. He's also a nice guy. He's really understanding and helpful when students are confused. I'd strongly recommend Sean.

Sean is awesome, had him for Calculus I and now I'm lucky enough to have him again for 5010. Sean provided zoom sessions for lecture this semester which was awesome because it was recorded, and I really enjoyed listening to them @ 2x, saved me so much time. He gave two review sessions for midterms and finals that followed what the tests where like.
Great professor! If you have or had struggles with math, this is the guy to help you out. Keep up on the homework. He is always willing to take time to work out the problems with you.

Sean is really good! He prepares students well for tests and also does review sessions before and sometimes immediately before the midterms and final. Generous partial credit is given on exams and the exam questions are very easy if you understand the material correctly. No trick questions or unnecessarily long computations. Homework is fine too.
Sean is the best! He cares about his students and always takes the time to investigate interesting tangents.

Attendance is not mandatory and he uploads all the lectures and notes. He provides the best lecture note in my short college math life. His lecture note has all the essential definitions, theorems, and good examples. Exams are similar to the homework questions and his study guide. I feel this class is way easier to get an A than elective classes.

Truly a great teacher! Always so prepared with a good and thorough lesson plan. He responds really well to questions, and he asks for our "questions or thoughts" after almost every step :) He is super available outside of class! His tests are very straightforward.
He is a really great teacher and really cares about his students learning. I would highly recommend taking any of his classes!

I know too many math professors that could overcomplicate a probability 5010 class. Thankfully, Prof. Groathouse is not one of them. Every lecture was engaging and I can easily say no concept was left imprecisely explained. This is even more exceptional considering that he taught the whole class over Zoom. This man is arguably best math prof. @ U.

Best professor I've ever taken any class from. Made Calc 2 easy. Starts each class by writing his name and cell phone number on the board. Says to text him with any questions on homework or otherwise. Amazing professor! Sends out lots of communications via Canvas to keep everyone updated on details. Homework wasn't too heavy. Sean is great!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: All material throughly explained and disseminated online. If days were missed, Sean understood without question and would stop class to PERSONALLY hand out missed notes from previous day(s). 3+ reviews before EVERY exam (though not needed if you attend class). Expectations and tested materials communicated (NOT HIDDEN). TAKE LINEAR FROM SEAN.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I transferred into Sean's class halfway through the semester because my original teacher was awful. Sean welcomed me without hesitation, even though his class was full. He helped me catch up quickly, then I did well from that point forward. He is amazing at explaining abstract concepts. My only regret is not transferring to his class sooner.

He is the best professor I have ever had! The class was way hard but he was always there willing to take extra time to help me understand things better. He is very approachable and easy to talk to! He posted his cell on the board and said to text him with any questions. I reached out many times and he responded quickly with great help! Love him!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Sean has got to be one of the best math teachers Ive ever had. He cares about his students and is willing to do whatever he can to help them succeed. Sean has an amazing understanding of the material that allows him to teach complex concepts very simply. 1080 is a grind with a heavy workload, but Sean understands this and makes it very doable.

My biggest regret about taking his class is that all other math teachers will now seem terrible by comparison. I challenge you to find a more caring, sociable, knowledgeable math professor because i assure you one does not exist. I gave him a 3 on difficulty simply because math 1080 is a tough course, but you will not have it easier anywhere else.

One of the best teachers I've had, ever. He gives you every opportunity in the world to pass, good lectures, and encourages you to contact him if you have any questions (went as far as to give us a phone number) and understands when things get in the way. Just get ready for a lot of homework and make sure and pay attention. 10/10 stars or whatever

Amazing professor! He really cares about helping students succeed and is willing to do everything he can to help each individual person. He understands conflicts outside of class and is willing to allow you to make up missed quizzes or turn in late homework. I would HIGHLY suggest taking a class from this professor!
Very nice and caring instructor

This guy is seriously one of the best professors Ive ever had. He would give you the shirt off of his back if you needed it. His lectures are also really good too because he has a way of breaking things down to make them as simple as possible.
Dr Shepherd was a great teacher for my online history class. She responded to emails quickly and made sure to send announcements out to keep us in the loop. I would take a class from her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Shepherd is an amazing professor; she assigns TAs to every student who can help them wherever needed and responds promptly to messages (ensure you message her through Canvas). The class is not that difficult if you do the readings, watch the videos, and take advantage of the study guides and quizzes to study for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took the online HIST 1700 course and was instantly hit with hour-long lectures, sometimes multiple per module. She tends to draw out her words and have long pauses, so I suggest watching most of them at 1.25x–1.5x speed. Other than that, there's nothing wrong; she responded quickly and politely to my questions.
Great teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was a nightmare. I have taken organic chem 1 and 2 and I had a harder time in this class and got a worse grade then both of those. THis class is terribkle I do not recomend. and the teacher grades so horribly and so much busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I actually took her 4000 level Vietnam war class. I thought the reading was fantastic. Dr Shepherd was much more knowledgeable than I assumed for a non-tenured professor. Reading the other reviewers it seems like they want slides and pictures more than reading and critical thinking. I appreciate that I I got my money and time's worth out of it.

I didn't like mandatory attendance and lectures were a bit boring and very very very heavy of information + not engaging + slides weren't available. 
However! The class is super easy and study resources are great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was not bad, but her lectures were very long and did not involve the students, and at times she would move very fast with her slides. Overall, I think she was a pretty good teacher, and her class was not hard at all if you take good notes and remember to turn in your weekly homework.

She was a very nice professor and worked with me when I had conflicts with showing up for class/turning in work, however her lectures are very long and don't involve a lot of talking from students. Tests are fairly easy I would say the hardest part is the writing but even then not too hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Stormy Shepherd is non-communicative and extremely strict. The course was difficult enough, and then she DRONES on and on with LONG AI lectures that she tries to speak conversationally but are clearly written by robots with no conversational skills so the lectures are INCREDIBLY difficult to interpret while listening to. This class was a nightmare.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Stormy Sheppherd is very sweet, personable, and passionate about her niche. However, the lectures are typically long and information heavy. As long as you follow her citation format, the class is pretty easy. I'm a history major who was taking her 3000 class on Vietnam, not 1700.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Going to lecture every day is required if you want all of the notes. She gives 4 essays that were pretty short and lots of easy online quizzes. This class was great overall and not too hard.
Dropped her class before the first lecture ended, she's that bad. Best decision I've ever made. Take Brandon Clark instead.

Dr. Stormy Shepherd is a great history professor. The Vietnam War class is a must take for all history majors. As an upper division history class, don't expect to just slide by. Most of the grade comes from essays with high expectations, which should be expected from this level. She gives good feedback, answers questions and will help you improve.

This was the most unenjoyable class I've ever taken, and I was only in it for a week and a half. There were so many assignments, lectures were unorganized, she doesn't post slides (you can't take pictures of slides or record lectures), grading is very harsh. DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HER!!!!
I dropped her class halfway through the first lecture. She's that bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: My main takeaway from this class wasn't history, it was how to write using Chicago style citations. That seems to be the most important part of this class, aside from taking decent notes from the lectures. Pretty standard lectures for a history class, and not the most engaging, but she was fine at communicating her expectations, overall.
I wrote more papers in this class than I have in any English class. Nice lady but difficult and time-consuming coursework.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class was fairly easy, very quiz and essay heavy. Definitely not a difficult class, just time consuming. As long as you take good lecture notes, you should be fine! Dr. Shepherd is great about replying and answering questions as well. I would recommend going ahead especially on weeks where you have to write papers.

First of all, who uses Chicago Style! Her lectures are long and boring, she doesn't upload powerpoint slides either. She also places heavy emphasis on essay formatting, even said she'd give any essay without proper Chicago Style footnotes and citations a grade of zero. It's a lot of busy work and I don't recommend her.

The lectures were over an hour long of just sitting and listening to her talk what sounded like straight out of a book. It was boring and the tests that went along with every chapter/lecture were almost nothing like what we learned from the actual book or lecture. She has us do many papers which made the class feel more like an English class.

This is supposed to be a history class, but it ended up being an English class. the lectures were long and boring, with very vague descriptions about assignment details. She is a very tough grader and does not provide any feedback. Overall, this was a very frustrating class to take.

Has very vague instructions for essays then grades them very strictly. Her lectures are long and boring, sounds like she's reading straight out of a textbook. Her midterms and final exams are hell on earth and can really mess up a good grade
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Shepherd was very nice but her teaching style was not my favorite. Lectures were incredibly boring and it felt like she was just reading the textbook word for word. She doesn't post notes or anything online so you really do have to be in class in order to do well on the midterm and final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She was awesome! Clearly very knowledgable on the subject. It was hard not being allowed to access the notes outside of class. Though her class was really fun and she even gave me an extension on the final paper after I explained how there was some miscommunication on the due date.

It's pretty easy to get a good grade, and this professor is very nice. However, the Midterm and Final Exam are both decently long essays (6-10 pages) which you have to use a lot of the material from the lectures. She grades the essays very tough. She also doesn't post the PowerPoints online so you have to take notes in lectures for the essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I love Chuck! He is so sweet and makes his lectures interesting and applicable to the real world. Lots of assignments but completely doable. Made the class enjoyable, which I didn't think was possible for an IS class.

If Prof. Sharp taught all of my classes I would have a 4.0 GPA. He is so engaging and makes class fun. Most of the lectures I actually gained useful information. There is quite a bit of assignments but they aren't too bad. Take his class!

Chuck is the goat, cares about his students, and is actually passionate about what he teaches. Lots of good advice that goes beyond the course content. Never thought I would enjoy an IS class. Highly recommend.
Fantastic Professor, it really seemed like Chuck cared about every one of his students, I enjoyed my time with him and plan on taking more classes with him later down the line.

Chuck is probably the best professor for this class. This is a tough class as it is but he makes it interesting. Although, he doesn't teach much of what you need for exams in class because its hybrid. Exam material is all from out of class assignments and lectures which made it hard to study as you never felt like you will know anything.

He gives very good, clear lectures, and he's always happy. You can tell he really understands the material. It's very easy to do well in his class. The homework assignments are fun/interesting too. This is my last semester as a math major, and Anurag is one of the top 3 math professors I've had at the University of Utah. I recommend taking him.
Super chill

Overall a good professor and was willing to explain things if needed. If you show your work on the quizzes he will give extra points even if you get the question wrong. Quizzes every week but the three lowest scores are dropped.
I had a hard time with this class, but this professor was really trying his best to help me get through it. Very well respected.

This man is a ray of sunshine. He always came to class with a smile. He absolutely prioritizes students and their learning. His classes were easy to follow and he was always willing to answer questions. The only thing that I disliked about the course was its weighting, with performance dependent on finals/quizes (final very heavily weighted).

I did struggle in this class for sure, but he was very accessible and open to meeting outside class times that worked with my schedule. There were weekly quizzes, but gave 3 drops. Definitely cares that you understand the material and always very happy in class.
Great Professor. Average on the midterm was a 91%. Homework was optional.

He started out this class by saying this is supposed to be enjoyable and to not worry about our grades because we will be fine. Graded 40% on homework, 30% on Exam 1, and 30% on Exam 2 (which was a take-home). Learned a lot and his lectures were really enjoyable, he was lenient but fair. Would take another class with him again!

Exams are weighted heavy. The only things graded are quizzes that are once a week and the 3 exams. Neither is too hard as long as you know the material and put in the slightest effort. The professor was very sweet, however, he just did not teach in a way I could learn. So I learned from the videos he posted that went over the same material.

He was really understanding and I felt that he really cared about his students success. He moved pretty fast but takes the time to explain his steps if we asked him a question. His quizzes and tests were pretty hard so if you didnt study it was kind of hard but he dropped the lowest 4 quizzes. I would take another class from him!

Such a challenging class. He was very nice, but his explanation of math was not my style. I had to drop out because I missed too many days when we had quizzes. There were quizzes every week and you could not retake them.
Singh is the best teacher ever! He really cares about his students and will take the time to explain the problems. His office hours are super useful and I HIGHLY recommend going to them.
one of the best profs ive had. inspired me to switch majors from art history to math. thank you dr. singh!

Anurag is the sweetest man! He is a very generous grader and is very helpful in office hours. My only complaint is his lectures can be a bit boring but the class was online so it's kinda expected. His homeworks can be tricky but for the most part they reflect the lectures. He also asked how we wanted the test to be formatted which was nice!

Everyday of lecture felt like we were solving different riddles. The class lectures felt light. However when we started taking the tests, he covered everything on the tests in class, but supplemental examples from the book were needed for understanding. Beware he has a slight accent, but his handwriting is good and he is a friendly and nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Very well-learned and intelligent. Great lectures, lenient homework, and allows notecards on tests. I learned a lot.

Very easy grader. Lectures were good. He always has a big cheeky smile on his face. He seemed to care that the students enjoyed the class and learned the material, which is somewhat rare.  If you get a chance to take a class from Anurag, definitely do it.

Definitely one of the easiest math classes I've ever taken. There's optional homework online for practice and then a quiz each week on the chapters discussed between each quiz. Your lowest quiz gets dropped, and then there are just two exams and one final. Professor Singh is very accommodating and wants all of his students to succeed!

It is unfortunately rare to find personable and caring professors in Mathematics.  Prof Singh is an exception to this standard and a phenomenal teacher.  He truly cared whether we understood the material and tried hard to present the material in an accessible manner.  I don't really like math but would take another class if it were taught by him.
A-M-A-X-I-N-G
Not very helpful. Graded harshly and sometimes the grading felt a bit random. Took this Spring 2024 so I don't know if anything has changed.

Unreasonable and arbitrary grading methods. It's as if she expects you to be a professional and penalizes you for student work despite improving. Although, over time this has admittedly gotten better. Overall, low sense of flexibility for a student's artistic individuality and gives highly discouraging feedback. Will not be taking her courses again

I do not enjoy accounting by any means, but Silvers was great and taught in a way that is easy to apply and understand.  You want to come to class prepared and have already watched the lecture for that week. Would highly recommend him.
One of my favorite professors, lectures were awesome and he makes sure that every student knows the material he's teaching. Wants you to succeed.

His class was great so far. A lot of practice classes to work on problems that would probably on the exam. He also provided practice exam that 80% identical to the real exam. I would take his class again if I had a chance
Goat professor. Makes lectures interesting and really cares about breaking down difficult topics into more understandable content.

Professor Silvers was a caring professor and always willing to explain topics as many times as necessary. Definitely a content heavy course, make sure to study for the exams because they are pretty hard.

One of, if not the best, professors I have had so far, he is engaging and cares about his students' learning. One of those professors who is there for love of the game and to teach, not for the paycheck.

He just wasn't a good professor. Every class he would always tell us how bad we are gonna do on exams and that we aren't going to understand anything. The whole class was always confused and I had to go to a different section to understand stuff.

He was good teacher, the only thing is he moved fast through the problems but will explain in detail if you ask. Exams were as expected, you need to study for sure. He also posted review exams which were helpful.

Professor Silvers is honestly and amazing professor. I am not majoring in accounting but found his class extremely interesting and he genuinely cares about the class and students. Class could have had more structure but that's up to the accounting department not him. I highly recommend him, he is also super funny. Way better than Shannon....
