POLS 5322 is a crucial class to take if you're interested at all in the environment; just be prepared for lots of dense readings & writing assignments on the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Benney is one of the most amazing professors I have ever had! I was always so engaged in her lectures and learned so much from this POLS 5322 course. This was a challenging class for me, but Prof. Benney's teaching made it worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Bus 3850 RISE OF CAPITALISM was a interesting and fun class. Teacher was awesome and would highly recommend.

You have to work hard in this course. This is not an easy introductory class, you have to put a lot of effort in to do well. The course is only graded on 3 exams which can make or break your grade quickly. The best thing to do to prepare is to read and re-read the chapters you are tested on and use the online sources. Very effective professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Her lectures are mostly just summarizing the textbook, but that just means you don't have to read hundreds of pages. The lectures were still fun because we would go off on tangents and have a little bit of conversation in class, which is exactly what a political science class should entail. She had no work just a couple of tests and participation.
my best friend and I took her class and both left unsattisfied ... I know it is not just me. Being frank, I cannot recommend this professor to other university student ...

I cannot believe the U of U has professors like Benney. Horrible professor, lectures what is on the textbook (I am sure I can read the textbook), just the worst teacher I have had so far. Stay away from her class,,,

Lectures were essentially just her going over the readings and giving a few examples of how they apply outside of the textbook. Attendance in mandatory, but the best thing for doing well on the tests was the textbook. Her TA was really bad, couldn't read his writing and when I asked for clarification he looked at me like I was some kind of idiot.

She is very knowledgeable, but this is a 2100 class, meant for freshman, and it is ridicilously hard. I imagine she is good with upper division courses. A lot of reading, a lot of details, and not attending class will kill your grade.
Avoid her. The worst teacher at the U.

Professor Benney is a great professor, she explains a lot in the lectures so you get out of every lecture understanding everything. If you have any questions or need help she is very helpful. Her classes are not an easy A, you have to do the reading, writing assignments are in this class no tests, but she encourages you to write well.
I liked this class and Professor Benney. Be sure you have the time to read both the textbook AND THE READER. Those are the most important things you can do to get a good grade.

Benney's lectures are very long and detailed, and attendance is always taken for a grade.  However, not much of the class content is on one of the three very difficult exams.  The test content mostly comes from textbooks and required readings, which are also very long and detailed.  She is super knowledgable but a tough grader.
Avoid her like the plague.

i learned a lot but it was a tough class. Two textbooks, you better read both for the tests, and she only graded on the tests and a group project so there aren't any buffer points. Study study study she hates slackers.

Hardest class i have ever taken & i am a senior. She expects you to read these readers that are about 25-45 pages. Each test covers about 15 readers, if you don't read them you won't pass. She expects students to already know everything about IR when this is a lower level class. she takes attendance and 50% of the test is written. DO NOT TAKE HER.

Hardest class I've ever taken, and its a lower level class! She definitely knows her stuff, but I think she expects too much out of her students on tests.  Its endless amounts of studying and reading.  To put it into perspective the class average for her tests was a 69% and she would say how most of the class failed the test.

Great Professor, I took another class from her after this one, and it was great! That being said, this is not an easy A class, you have to read, do your work, study and attend class, you will do great!  Also, if you talk to her she will do her best to guide you to do better, and work on things to make you do better.  She is fair, and teaches good!!
Incredible teacher. Tests are not that difficult, and if you study you should be fine.

The first exam was kind of a mess, but once Professor Sanchez's expectations were tempered the course went a lot more smoothly. I got a D or lower on 3 out of 4 exams but because of the way the test correction system works I still got an A in the class. Very light workload, just be prepared to study.

The beginning of the semester was definitely rough, as it was taught through Zoom right until the first exam. Things did improve over time, and by the end, I found myself actually enjoying the course. Don't delay taking a class to avoid this professor. I promise he's not THAT bad. A word of advice, though, attend office hours!

This was his first semester to teach and it was a REALLY rough start for everyone. Most students were failing for most of the semester, despite their best efforts to learn the content. Later on, I think he got a little better, but it was still a very stressful class and I know that I have some large gaps from what I was supposed to learn.

For those who want to get into the ECE program at the U, DON'T TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. He is extremely rude and thinks lowly of everyone. Most have dropped out of this class because of insane weight of exams and the hostile and unforgiving learning environment. Approaching him about a question will lead him to degrading you and to "just learn it".

Most people dropped his class half way through the simester. After most tests when the class average was around 50-60%, he would yell at us saying "Just understand. Just dont get confused. You just do x and it works." Most people who had a 3.9+ average gpa had a C or below. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lecture style is just to have you watch some other professors video before class then go over problems during. I had to teach myself all the material in class from YouTube and khan academy. He is not lenient at all, I took a test online and was a minute late in submitting it so I emailed it to him but since I was late he gave me a zero.

Professor Manning was a great teacher. I didn't understand the math the best. He seemed to waltz over the topics quite fast. When it came to asking questions I didn't know where to start because I didn't understand any of it. He does write-ups which can receive extra credit. I suggest reading the chapter before class in order to grasp it better.
Best math teacher I've ever had

Thomas Manning was one of the best Math Teachers I have ever met in my whole life. Expect a lot of homework and tough practice exams. Yet the exams are easy, straightforward, forward, and simple. He is a fair grader, and you can feel that he really likes math and wants people to feel the same. I really enjoyed taking both Calc 1 and 2 with him.

Professor Manning is the kindest professor I have ever had. He is very understanding and considerate about his students. As someone who finds calculus difficult, he is amazing at teaching it, and making sure we understand the content. He is willing to go back and review past math concepts, and overall he is just so nice!!! 10/10 recommend ^_^

Professor Manning was a great calc teacher. He explained concepts in different ways, and was always willing to go back fill any gaps in math. There were practice exams before each exam that nicely showed what information should be studied. He graded fairly but kindly. Each test had some sort of take home section where you'd create your own problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Manning is an outstanding professor, my favorite professor I've had at the U. He cares for his students and focuses his class on each student's success. He moves quickly through material, so don't miss class. Although, attendance is not mandatory. Test reviews are a great reflection of actual tests (all tests have extra credit opportunities).

I took Math 1210 & 1220 with Professor Manning. He makes sure that his students understands what he's describing and will back up as far as you need if you ask a question about a problem. He always tells some funny, random story during class, but he still gets through all the class material. He gives practice tests that are similar to the test.

The basics: he's hilarious, caring, flexible. He gives you every chance to ask questions and do well on tests. His class is easy, but you will also leave understanding the concepts, not just an easy A (although a high percentage of students got A's in my class). His grading scheme is forgiving and homework isn't bad. Highly recommend.

Great dude; every lecture will have a 5 min tangent or life story for sure. Fair amount of homework, I showed up half the time and managed to get an A (he's receptive to emailing assignments and posts class notes online). Exams are exact copies of the practice tests he gives out save a few minor switch ups. Overall great course, very educational.

Super intersting guy, total nerd, and fantastic math teacher. By far my favorite math professor at the U. He was very articulate with his lectures and helped conceptualize topics for students. Decent amount of homework but nothing too crazy. He gave out a review packet that was a mirror image of each test so tests were a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Thomas Manning gives good reviews and is very funny in his lectures. He goes through topics very quick. He sometimes skips steps because he figures you should know what he did. If you don't pay close attention you might as well drop the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

By far worst teacher Ive ever had

reviews.comment: One of the most unorganized unclear teachers I've ever had in all of my scholastic experience. If you can avoid this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I followed the instructions in the syllabus to try to download the book. The ISBN she provided in the Syllabus was incorrect. She had no answer and referred me to the textbook rep. I was delayed in the getting the book because of this, she said she would reopen the assignments for me. Never responded when I asked. Online Canvas was a mess. AVOID

Professor Brown is among the best professors I've had. The feedback she gives is constructive and she shows genuine interest in the long-term success of her students. I was pleased with the organization of the course from day one; she did not throw any curve balls and communicating what was expected. Also, Prof. Brown is very accessible.

-Gives good feedback -Respected -Get ready to read -Inspirational -Clear grading criteria -Hilarious -Caring -Group projects -Lecture Heavy She is a professor I will definitely remember, for she made part of my college experience very enjoyable. I would recommend the whole world to take her class!

PICK THE OTHER PROFESSOR!! Assignment due dates are never clear. This class reminds me of a high school class. It's very small and you feel like you do not need to be there 90% of the time. Boring, long lectures that lead to nothing. My main Gripe is that Teri still has no idea how Canvas works. She doesn't put assignments or due dates up.

Teri is amazing. Prepare to do a lot of argumentative writing about controversial issues. She cancels class a few times a semester so that's always nice. She's really forgiving about missing class if you email her in advance. She makes you print EVERYTHING. So put some money on your Ucard or buy a printer. Overall a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Teri was always well prepared with clear expectations and guidelines. She was eager to help us succeed with multiple examples online, and willingness to meet with students after hours. She was caring of each student, and cares about individual success. I learned a lot about professional writing and communication in this course. Great class!

Terri would go from being a cool teacher to awful in seconds during class. This class is all speeches and the grading is unclear with poor feedback. DO THE READINGS. She will quiz you in class on small details of them and if you don't do well on them you will lose a lot of points on your final grade. She grades everyone the same in the B range.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Avoid this teacher at all cost! If you enjoy receiving confusing instructions, unclear feedback, and ridiculous grading. Then this is the teacher for you! reviews.comment: Doesn't give feedback that makes sense and treats you like 2 year olds. She will give you an F for a small thing that needs work and mark everything else as fine. When you ask why, she will cite the one thing that could be worked on, such as tone, or a certain sentence, and doesn't tell you to work on it but gives an F. Take someone else.

reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She is very nice and goes over the material well. She is a tough grader, but you can usually get some points back if you talk to her about it. You are required to go to class and are graded on attendance. Have to do presentations in front of class. Textbook is online and comes with an access code. You can get an A, but you have to work for it.
Teri is a very nice professor. Because I was taking her class in a small classroom, she cared all of us very much. Her teaching style is very fresh and detailed. I recommend you to take her class.

You never know where she is going to take points from. I'd often get scores on papers or projects back and then when I'd ask her why I'd missed points, she wouldn't have a clear answer. For example, I lost ten points on attendance even though I showed up to class more often than her. She's very disorganized and often didn't show up to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Teri Brown is my favorite professor! She is tough and makes you work for your grade, but you walk away with so much more knowledge.  It's a lot of public speaking, so if you're not comfortable with that she helps you overcome it without feeling stupid.  She genuinely cares about the success of her students.  I would HIGHLY recommend this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Teri Brown is an excellent professor for writing. While it is annoying that she takes attendance, it is necessary to attend. She teaches you how to write in a more academic manner, which has been helpful. She assigns homework ever night, but it's not hard or time consuming. She is always willing to help and very understanding. So glad I had her!

Professor Brown really cares about her students and loves the subject. She is always willing to meet with students and responds to emails very quickly. Textbook is inexpensive and is needed for a few quizzes she will do on assigned reading through out the semester.

Teri is a great teacher, but she is also hard. 3 speeches. Writing and Grammar tests. 4 pop quizzes on the reading, drops lowest one. Her grading can be confusing.  She has you work with classmates, so you are close with everyone. Not hard work, just a lot of it. Stay on top of it. I actually learned stuff. I loved the class. Hard, but worth it!

Teri is a good professor, but she is pretty strict when it comes to grading. There are 3 presentations - a group, an interview, and a shark tank pitch. You are video taped for them, but it isn't intimidating. If you practice your presentations then you'll do fine. Then just stay on top of the work - she will give quizzes on readings sometimes.

Teri is the quintessential masochistic type of person that has decided to alleviate her need to cause humiliation and pain through her job as a university professor. I didn't understand that "challenging" meant bandaging a washed-up intellectual's ego. Class content is useful, but look to a different faculty member if you have the choice.

Teri is a great professor who knows her stuff! She wants to make sure everyone is progressing at a good pace, so she does pop quizzes on the readings. You will learn a ton from her class, and will leave the class better than when you came.

Teri is an amazing teacher. It is a very time consuming class but if you stay on top of the assignments and go to class you will love it. She was very approachable and gave great feedback. I loved the class and would love to take another one of her classes.

This class was a TON of work and time. It was really beneficial, but try to take it during a semester when you won't have a lot of homework from other classes. Teri's instructions can sometimes be confusing, but she's always willing to elaborate or to look at your papers when you need it.

I wouldn't recommend this professor. She gives vague instructions and often contradicts herself in lectures. When grading, she focuses more on simple conventions rather than the content. She doesn't spend any time preparing material for class, in fact, the material she does provide is not her own. If she doesn't take the time, why should students?

Professor was inconsistent in grading. Taught (said) one thing but did another. This was a half semester course. She said she would have grades posted within a week or two. End of the semester and still hasn't posted anything. Overall I felt she was hypocritical in much of her teaching.

Horrible professor. Class is mandatory and the lectures are ridiculously boring and pointless. She is not engaged with students at all, and simply expects you to know what to do for the hw after she gives confusing and unclear directions, which change frequently. Their is absolutely nothing positive to learn or gain from taking her courses.
Great class and awesome professor. Be ready to work, lots of reading and little assignments. She is a tough grader, but really wants to help students succeed.
Teri is an excellent professor and wants to make sure that her students succeed in this course. Be warned, this class is extremely demanding and will take a lot of your time but you will learn a ton!

Teri is a nice person but her class is unnecessarily demanding for what it's worth as far as graduation goes.  She assigns a ton of work each day, maintains strict deadlines and the FIJI Water project is a waste of time.  You also end up doing a presentation, so you might as well take the alternative to this class which is Management 3810.

Professor is smart and teaches a lot but BEWARE, the amount of writing/reading/assignments is heavy, I took this class during summer and I literally had an anxiety attack. The problem is compounded by the fact she is a tough grader and expects a lot. On a good note you will learn a lot, my writing has improved drastically due to this class.

Terri is an amazing writing teacher. Her class is not easy due to a lot of homework and other writing material but is worth the amount of homework that she gives since it does help you understand better the material and the material you learn will be useful in the real world. Always there willing to help.
excellent! very helpful, required class attendance but i learned a lot from this class. Amazing teacher i would retake her class. a lot of work but worth it.
Teri is very helpful.  She makes time to meet or talk with any student who needs help.  Class is well organized and final project is done in pieces so you don't procrastinate.

Teri is very helpful.  There's a lot of busy work that is a bit tedious.  The final project is spread out over several weeks.  She requires sections be turned in and peer reviewed, so it makes finishing the paper a lot easier.  Good class.

A super chill teacher and a great lecturer. Really cares about economics and pushes all of his students to pursue it in their studies. A total of 8 assignments is graded in this class; however, the essays (3) are graded easily, and the quizzes (5) are not very challenging with attention and a small amount of studying. Interesting and fun class.
Excellent US Economics History Professor
US of Inequality was a great class to be introduced to various forms of inequality and their effects on the US economy.

I was hesitant to take this class but it has been the best decision. I loved this class and the content, I learned so much and want to keep learning! Prof. Maloney is wonderful and very helpful, funny, and really cares. This class is challenging because it is mostly 3 tests that were difficult but if you prepare well and go to class they are great!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a good guy, I had some issues trying to contact him about a test beforehand and he seemed confused, but overall I would take him again, but not ECON.
Very straightforward and easy to understand professor, course is content heavy.

You learn a lot in his class. He is down to earth and easy to talk to. You write papers, watch lectures, read papers. Overall I learned a lot. And professor Maloney is a very fair grader too. He's great. Take classes from him 100%
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Extremely disinterested, doesnt explain concepts well. Had him as a professor fully over Zoom, so maybe having him in person for class could possibly be less bad?
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Maloney makes Econ fun and understandable. He's always available for questions and if you ask him about the problem sets he'll all but give the answer to you. Brilliant man and very kind.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Maloney is very knowledgeable and he tried to make a class that's typically one of the most difficult ECON classes in the department into a class that's much more manageable. Class consisted of lectures, easy weekly, based-on-completion homework, three problem sets before each exam, and a policy analysis paper. Would recommend a study group.

Very good professor. He was always willing to talk about ideas and questions I was having. I took history of u.s. Economics with him. It did lean more towards the history labor economics. I was hoping for an in depth look at economic policy, recessions, what causes the economy to grow or slow. Those things were in there but they took the back seat to the labor side for sure. Overall I would highly recommend him.
I took various classes from Professor Maloney because he was such a good professor.  His classes require work, but he is fair and explains things very clearly.

I took a class from Tom in 1995 for my undergrad in economics.  Since then, I have graduated from a top law school, and also earned a masters degree in health care administration along the way.  Of all the professors I've ever had, I would have to say Tom is the best.  If you get a chance to take one of his classes, do it.
No Comments
Tom is a solid, fairly young academic.  He is really friendly and easy to work with.  He also takes the time to clearly explain questions.  I highly recommend doing research with him.

This class was very helpful when learning spanish because the professor understands how to teach in an effective way that isn't overbearing. He is also very generous grader and understanding. I highly recommend taking him if you have any spanish classes.

This professor's lectures were very engaging and I liked them, though I wish they were available on canvas after. In general, Prof. Cannon did well at teaching the material needed for quizzes and oral exams. 
But, he was hard to contact after class and the canvas could have been organized much better to make due dates clear without the calendar.

Tim is a great instructor, good vibes and pretty chill as long as you make an effort. Overall great class, but definitely difficult. MindTap assignments can be excessive at points but are (unfortunately) useful in furthering your understanding of the language and course :/. Workload does get insane at the end of the semester.

I really loved taking spanish with Tim, he was really nice. I was super sick and missed an exam and he let me make it up. It's a lot of work but necessary to actually improve in a foreign language. So be prepared for a lot of work. Exams are oral, and there's a bunch of quizzes. Homework 3 nights a week at least too, but not super hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Tim is a good teacher and makes sure everyone understands before moving on. However, there is so much workload. Near the end of the semester, we had projects and quizzes in each class. It was very easy to feel overwhelmed especially when you had to be more focused on harder classes. There were assignments on canvas and Mindtap which was confusing.

Tim is not a bad professor, but there is so much homework that it is easy to get overwhelmed. There are three groups projects but two of them are due the week before finals so make sure you have the time to finish everything before you have to study.

Tim is a good professor who explains things well, the hybrid part of the course is time-consuming and boring but is valuable to your learning. This class is challenging and fast-paced but very rewarding. Tim does a good job making himself accessible if extra help is needed and is willing to work with students.
Tim is a great professor, I learned a lot from him this semester. The class requires a lot of work but if you go to class, participate and do you homework, you will be fine.

Professor cannon is AMAZING! Yes, there was a ton of homework but it shouldn't be too hard if you learn to apply yourself. Attendance is mandatory which wasn't the best because if you missed a day, you would be behind by a lot. The attendance policy did help me though since I've struggled with that in the past.

Prof.Tim Cannon is super great! He always has co-teachers who speak fluent Spanish. He is a reasonable grader if you come to class and complete your work!This is a four-credit class, which calls for 8 hours of homework a week, but it was never that much for me.there is an online section that is homework heavy, due three times a week, but its easy.

He's a very good professor, and I learned a lot from his class. 
An important thing to know about his classes is that attendance is not only mandatory, but extremely important if you want to do well. Also expect lots of studying and near-daily homework. 
His classes take commitment, but it will be worth your time.
Very patient when it comes to correcting mistakes both in class and on assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Cannon's class is not difficult, but he is a bad teacher and honestly a weird, creepy dude. The homework is very time-consuming, but not too difficult. The oral exams aren't bad either, just depends on who you are assigned to do it with. Make sure to buy his textbook from the store because it basically is a study guide to the many quizzes

I took this class this semester as a hybrid course. The amount of homework was honestly INSANE, but I usually could get it done within an hour. The in-person portion of the class is not challenging and was an easy way to start my morning. We had a quiz like every two weeks and they were easy. We also had two oral exams, but again not too hard.

I LOVED this class. There is a lot of homework, but hello it's college and you're learning a langue so there is bound to be a little more practice. I totally failed like 10 of them and still passed with an A! there is NO reason you shouldn't do well with him. He grades fair and is ALWAYS willing to help. Show up and put work in and you will pass...

Bad communicator-- most of the time he just didn't respond to my emails at all. There is an ABUNDANCE of busy online work. More than I've EVER had even for actual online courses. Links to the work are often broken, so you can't do well on assignments. Very poorly organized online work. He's alright in person, but don't take hybrid courses from him.

Tim is overall an excellent professor. He is helpful when you ask questions and willing to work with you if you participate, and his teaching is easy to follow. Be prepared for a HUGE amount of online homework (if you do hybrid), two oral exams, a project, and quizzes. If you show up to class and do the homework, you should pass easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Such a good professor. He teaches the material well, allows the class to be very student-focused with a lot of speaking practice- which I think can be hard for professors who like to stroke their own ego. The homework helps you solidify knowledge as well, while making interesting connections. Very very well done class with an amazing professor.

Professor Tim was such an amazing professor!! This class was so fun and informative and I learned so much about Spanish and lots of Spanish speaking countries. I loved coming to class everyday and I felt like the environment was perfect for learning a language. Homework wasn't overwhelming and Tim was really understanding. Gracias Tim!!!

I took 1010 and 1020 from Tim and I was not disappointed. He is a great teacher and very thorough in his efforts to make sure you understand the language as much as possible. Mindtap was long but an important part of language learning and Tim can help. Don't take this class if you want to slack off and not participate/do hw, you won't pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Tim cannon is not that great. The homework is a joke. There is a lot of it, but it can also pretty much just be skipped. I got by ok by not doing a lot of the homework. He doesn't teach very well. The projects do suck but they are not uncalled for. The Mindtap homework is what makes this class bad. It also doesn't help so I would not worry about it

The homework would take everyone hours to do. The TA did everything. Miss >2 classes and you drop half a grade for each one. Makes you move around and switch partners. Has no interest in talking to students. Doesn't really teach in class. Expects you to learn everything from MindTap. Points get taken off for bad grammar that was never taught.

I love learning spanish and Tim is great but... The hybrid part sucks. I will never take a hybrid class through cengage again. Mindtap is a joke and doesn't help you learn. Sometimes it takes a ridiculous amount of time to finish mindtap and then you have assignments from Tim on top of that. It's worth trying to get into a non hybrid class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Tim is one of the top teachers at the university. He knows what he is doing and cares about his students. The people who arent happy in his class are the people I never wanted to work with as partners because they never prepared or did the work. It isnt easy learning a language. Tim was always willing to help. All you have to do it ask. :)

Tim is a great teacher, but this class is way to hard for an intro level course. Don't take if you work while also going to school. Assignments are not added in MindTap until sometimes the same day they are due, mid-week. He does not plan ahead at all, so neither can the student! The online projects and group videos are confusing, not helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Half of the stuff on mindtap makes about as much sense as a stroke patient trying to explain quantum theory. The other half of the stuff is basically just going to make you feel like a three-year-old that needs to be told over and over again what a thing is. If this class didn't use mindtap I would totally recommend it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I have to take four semesters of spanish for my degree and after taking this BEGINNING level spanish class I'm really questioning what I will do. This is the hardest class I have taken in my three years of college. Tim is a great professor but the course material for this class gets really confusing and frustrating. This class is way too fast pace.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Honestly, I believe that if Tim taught the whole class it would be way better, but instead, it is a hybrid class with extraordinarily difficult to understand and trouble-filled online questions that really will require that you use an online dictionary. Words that you've never heard before will be in some of the questions and it will be angering.
Does not know hot balance online homework at all. Assignments are not clear and it is a terribly constructed hybrid class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Profesor Tim has been my favorite teacher so far at the U. Class is always about actively learning and practicing with others and homework was extremely easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved this class! I love Spanish, so Tim only made learning it better. He is so chill, and an easy grader. He understands what's realistic when it comes to learning a language. The work is never hard, but there is a lot and it can be time consuming. A lot of little and repetitive assignments, but nothing too bad. Gracias Tim!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Tim is the best!! He is genuinely concerned about how well you do in class and is very helpful if you are struggling with a particular concept. He explains the material exceptionally well and with enthusiasm! You can tell he is passionate about what he is teaching; I would recommend him to anyone!

I have really enjoy taking Tim's Spanish class. You have to work but as he says learning a language isn't easy. He is willing to help you outside of class. He is a true gentleman, smart, thoughtful and easy on the eyes. :)

Tim is an awesome guy! He is passionate about what he teaches and inspires his students to participate and learn about the culture. He incorporates personal experiences and relatable content into all his lessons. He is extremely approachable and always there for advice and help. There's a lot of homework, so stay on top of the online component!

He's passionate about his students learning Spanish and he's a great professor, BUT do not take this class as a hybrid. The class is already test and project heavy but adding the virtual days adds about three hours of work a day and thats not including the homework for the class. It's not manageable as a hybrid class in a 18 credit schedule.

I took Tim's class for 1010 and 1020. Like everyone else has said, there's a lot of homework. But if you actually do it, you will do well on quizzes/tests, and will leave the class with WAY more knowledge than when you came in.  Overall: fun class, great teacher, and yes, lots of homework.
Really a lot of homework, this class will take up a lot of time outside of class and will be difficult if you have a full schedule. He is a nice dude, but expects a lot of work to be done.

Great professor! He really helps you to understand the material in a way that you will remember. There is a lot of homework and assignments, but if you go to class and do all the homework you will pass even if you don't do that well on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Tim Cannon is the best professor I've ever had at a University. He truly wants people to succeed and he teaches the material in a way that makes sense and isn't overwhelming.
This class is really hard if you dont study. He sticks to the subject and doesnt spend time talking about his personal life. Study and show up for class and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I took Span 1010 and 1020 from Tim, and loved the classes so much I actually decided to do the Study Abroad Program, which he also leads, in Spain. Tim instilled in me a love for Spanish, and his own love for the language and culture really can be felt in his classes. He makes you WANT to learn the language. Wish he taught even more classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: Tim is the absolute best.  Seriously, there is no one else you should take SPAN 1010 & 1020 from.  He is clear, smart, knowledgeable and very helpful.  He is ALWAYS there to help in class or in office hours & will respond to emails in a matter of hours.  He is excellent! I'm sad I wont be able to take 2010 & higher from him because he's that good!!
I love Tim

I am taking another class from Tim. After the first week I am reminded how excellent he is at what he does. Take his class he is smart, student centered, friendly (I wish he would get even more friendly), and a good professor.  He can be a little mysterious at time, but I like that.  Highly recommended! Take his class.

Tim is a really nice guy. He's clear and helpful, but always professional and doesn't seem to be to interested in getting close to students or having causal chats but he is fair and kind. Lots of busy work online but the class is pretty easy as he helps you prepare for tests and quizzes. I really liked him and would take him again.

Tim is a wonderful professor! He is very understanding & always willing to help. His class is very interesting, and I love when he teaches. He makes sure you understand the material, and know what to expect with quizzes and tests. If you put in the effort to do the work you will easily survive this class! His voice is beautiful as well as is face!

Take a class from Tim.  You will learn something (you do still have to actually work).  I like how Tim teaches and runs his class.  He is friendly and approachable especially during his office hours.  He is one of the best Spanish teachers I have ever had.

Tim is a very devoted teacher. Every day in lecture I am reminded of how crystal-clear his lectures are. He has been the greatest mentor and guide for me since I have taken on the task to learn Spanish. Basically he's top notch.

The hybrid course is a lot of homework because of the "virtual days" you will need your text for online activities if nothing else, but it's the same as for 1010. Tim is a good instructor, but you need to take the initiative to learn the material on your own sometimes, and then he will review it in class later.
Tim is awesome. He is very helpful and a very smart guy. He knows a ton of facts outside of the language as well as with the language. He really knows his stuff.

Good teacher overall.  I kind of got screwed because I had a sucky TA that taught half of the class.  The class had a lot of group work and group projects.  Alot of the homework was online, and there was alot of it. As for the teacher, he did a great job at explaining the language rules and actually teaching it.
Tim is awesome. Super nice guy and he really wants you to succeed. As long as you keep up with the homework (and understand it) you'll do fine in his class.
Tim is a great professor and really loves the language.  I highly recommend taking a class or two from him.

Cannon is a real good guy. Not too hard but yeah, you have to do a lot of independent reading and lots of busy work online. He honestly wants you to do well so he'll try to help you out the best he can.

If you have a hard time with completely self-motivated learning then don't take this class.  Tim Cannon is a decent teacher but he doesn't really teach..and he literally tells you that.  You have to independently go online and learn for yourself because he does not lecture.  He's a pretty nice guy but a little intimidating.  Minimal personality.
very helpful and always willing to help with compositions.  Keeps class interesting with lost of speaking activities.  Good teacher.
amazing 5 star teacher

I've never had a worse experience in a class. Nothing would ever be graded, and you just see your grade change at the very last second (im talking 11:59 pm deadline day)... He would rather sit there and respond to emails than actually teach or grade. If you have an option, do not take a class from Vawdrey, you (and your grade) will regret it.

He is one of the worst teachers I've ever had. He doesn't grade anything on time so you're stuck wondering what your grade is until the last second. He also doesn't answer questions & expects you to know everything & gets annoyed when you do ask. He is super passive aggressive and he sounds like he really does not enjoy teaching. Do not take him.

reviews.comment: i hate him :(((((
Never take a class by this teacher

Todd is extremely smart but expects a lot of his students while giving very little to no feedback or help. He was condescending & unhelpful whenever students were stuck or asked for assistance. His lectures were all over the place and hard to follow making it impossible to learn anything. I felt like I had to teach myself everything out of the text
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Todd was absolutely HORRIBLE. He said that if we needed math help to find someone else or go through math help resources. He read everything straight from the textbook and graded so harshly most of the class was failing. With hard work and reaching out to many people our class got him removed and we got a new professor.

I feel like Todd Vawdrey is really smart but can't teach very well. It didn't help that when I took his class there were no TAs. The final exam score average was a 52.7% however as seen through my exam score and other students in class the curve was around a 20-25% increase (depending on the student). Overall, I learned a lot but was very difficult
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His class was very test heavy, those who failed the first couple of tests were doomed for the rest of the class. It was to the point that many people had to drop the class after the second test and only about half the class showed up for the final test because they gave up. Also, he would assign hw and after it was due he would teach the subject.

The SOLE reason why I passed with an A is that I took Calculus 1 literally last semester so it's very fresh in my mind. He doesn't teach. He puts up lecture videos from another professor, which are ridiculously long. Further, the tests are worth a lot of your grade and the 30-40 problems that are due each week are at best stressful.

Avoid! T he U's math department has a database of lectures videos, which is all he would put up for this course. And would correlate to a few problems per assignment at best. I spent my term at the tutoring center and patrickjmt's YouTube channel and I dedicate my solid B to his channel. If there is literally anyone else, I would chose them

I don't want to start off by saying that 75% of your grade is based on 3 exams... but it really sets the tone of his class. Not to mention that the professor does not even provide his own lectures. The lectures are recordings from a different professor that do not coincide with weekly online or written homework. 6+ weeks of ungraded assignments..

Unreliable & Unhelpful instructor who lacks empathy for his students. He is unresponsive to emails. I mean, it's an online class. What is his role if he can't answer the questions of students in emails or answer any discussions at all? You really can't have a worse instructor than this anywhere. Please think 100x before you take any class with him.

The homework load was insane, the video lectures (while pre-recorded) were only the week of (usually on Monday with 30 problems due Wednesday) and usually the videos were 2-3 hours long. The remote exam set up is very stressful (broken into 3 parts and you have to show/scan your work after each timed part). Also terrible at responding to emails.

This is hardest class ever and ever I've taken. Professor didn't teach anything and you will see all lectures from past. I saw some students complained about homework assignments because it was too much however he ignored it or want to talk directly into his office. Lastly this is online class but he always made take exam in testing center.

Does not teach anything, videos were done by another professor, does not upload videos to explain how homework was done until 1 week prior the test. The test? The heaviest test ever, like the standard raised to someone who has completed a math degree. A lot students agree too much hw on the discussion, he told to email him directly and solve nothin
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He "teaches" an online class. Apparently his full time job is a high school teacher, so the lectures he puts out are done by another professor at the university. he doesn't really teach. you're teaching yourself calc. Homework load is insane. if you're taking a full load, good luck. avoid this guy if you can. very hard to get a hold of him, also.

Tom was a very chill guy; however, his lectures were quite boring and very easy to tune out during, as he would just read off the slides, which were all the information you could find from the assigned textbook of the class. I did learn a lot of new concepts in this class, and overall, it was a very chill and easy class.

Chill guy but not an effective teacher. He isn't very involved with his teaching and just reads off slides during lecture so it is extremely boring and easy to tune out. Did not learn a whole lot the semester which sucks because I spend thousands of dollars on  on a class that is supposed to be extremely helpful towards my career :'(
Very boring lectures and very little going on in the class besides a group project that is due at the end of the semester. Class content is a little interesting but would not recommend.

Prof Cova was very boring. Be ready to load up on caffeine for his class. He was very monotone, yet the information he taught was interesting. I would recommend this class because he was very easy grader, and was not tough at all. Graded on attendance so go to every one for those easy points.

Monotone voice. Lectures were repetitive. He just read of the slides most of the time and if not he was just talking about relevant current events or reading news and research articles word for word. It was really hard to stay engaged. I probably could've done the final assignment without ever coming to class.

Tom is super passionate about his work/subject and can really have a good time during class students stay involved. He spends a lot of time talking about current events, which is always engaging. Assignments were super easy, took maybe 30-40 minutes max and in-class participation was only required once the whole semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a very monotone lecturer. At times this makes it hard to connect to the material. But Cova is also very passionate with the concepts he teaches. If you try to connect with the material he will notice and the class can be interesting. There are assignments and quizzes every few weeks, and a large group project for the final.

Cova means well but his execution of teaching is not full-hearted. It is clear he is very knowledgeable and is ready to share that knowledge but the method of which he delivers and teaches is monotone and hard to keep with.

This class was interesting but the professor has a monotone voice, so beware. Participation does not matter but you should go to learn what will be on the quizzes. There are only a few assignments and they correspond to lecture slides/ special guest.

Professor Cova was alright. He just read everything off of the slides, which made the class boring. There was a BCP project that you have to do at the end of the semester, but there isn't a clear rubric of what exactly he is looking for. This led to a lot of confusion in our group. The class is great, but I would take someone else if possible
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tom himself is not a bad professor, just dry. Very much reads verbatim off the prepared slides. The only issue was the TA for this course, the submissions of assignments with clear instructions on what was to be submitted lead to being marked down because non-listed items were not included. It was a battle with the TA to get the correct grade.
This class was extremely easy if you know how to use the program Python... No tests in this class just labs that are due once a week with a quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Cova is a fine professor. He seems very knowledgeable, just comes off a bit boring and disinterested at times. I found it difficult to pay attention sometimes,  even though he can also be funny on occasion. His class was very easy, and I got an "A", though it was painful to sit through some of the lectures.
Tom is an excellent instructor. His classes are not easy, but you can make the grade if you give the effort. Go meet with him in office hours and get to know him. He is very friendly and helpful.
Good class. I really like the topic and what i learned.  I suffered through many power points but was glad i took it over all.
Tony is a great professor. I took the 6-9pm class which was rough but his lectures are very engaging! would recommend!

It was an absolute pleasure having Professor Tony Passey for MKTG 6310. His lectures were truly a highlight of the MBA program – engaging, insightful, and genuinely awesome! What stood out most was his ability to take complex marketing concepts and explain them in a way that just clicked.

I took the 6-9 class and it was manageable because he was engaging. The lectures are clear, so as long as you show up to class, you'll do fine on the weekly quizzes and exams. There is a fair bit of group work, but you can choose your own group. To get full participation points you have to answer a lot of questions, or talk to him outside of class.

This class is based fully on building a brand with a group that you get to choose at the beginning of the year. I usually am not a fan of group work, but it was very manageable, and I enjoyed this class. He has great lectures and real-life advice and cares about his students. Overall, a fun class that I highly recommend taking!

Funny and engaging lectures.  I wish every professor put this level of effort into their lectures.  The assignments are not too hard but there is a lot of group work so get a good group. 

I learned a lot that I could immediately apply in my job.

I wish Prof. Passey would've been more communicative and had given more feedback. This class is group-work heavy, but you can choose your groups. So I would only recommend this class if you take it with friends/partner with students who will pull their weight, and if you plan on being in class every week, no exceptions.

Professor Passey is a dynamic and engaging instructor in the field of digital marketing. His lectures are not only informative but also captivating. His teaching style involves a perfect blend of real-world examples, case studies, and interactive discussions that keep the class actively involved and eager to learn. His enthusiasm is contagious.
Professor is a good person who clearly knows what he's talking about. Lectures can be kind of boring but that's life. He rarely makes you stay for the entire class.

I took MKTG 2310 and the class was super easy. Weekly reading quizzes of definitions that come out of the textbook or from class. Mid-term and final exams were easy and not hard. Lectures were interesting and engaging. Most of the work is in groups so choose a good group. Overall, he's a good professor.

Tony is a great guy and seems to have a lot of real-world experience. However, there was no structure to this class. We randomly went from one project to another without ever finishing the first one and projects didn't have very clear outlines. I don't feel like I learned as much from this class as I could have had there been more organization.

This class changed my life.  I decided to change my career to marketing after taking this course.  We worked on real projects and learned very applicable marketing tactics.  I didn't know there was so much data and analytics involved in marketing before taking this course.  I will be taking all the courses offered by Professor Passey.
Really good class and has a great professor, however, make sure that you pick a good group for the midterm and final because that it basically the only grade you get.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I don't understand how Tony is still allowed to teach MBA students. The in-class lectures were rarely ever relevant to the course content and revolved mostly around his professional history (mostly name dropping important people), so attending class was frustrating because it felt like a total waste of time. Tony should be audited by the DESB.

This was an online class in the MBA program regarding digital marketing. The videos were very good and the teacher was very knowledgeable on the subject. I found the quizzes to really help establish the knowledge gained from the text. This was a very well organized and well structured class.

Based on some of the other reviews it sounds like the class has changed, probably due to covid. There are video lectures every week to watch and there is a live session with the professor which I guess will change in the fall. He cares about how his students are learning. Great experience in this class and have decided to pursue digital marketing.

Tony is cool, and he is really knowledgeable about digital marketing. He is a little all over the place with his lectures and assignments, and he shows up late most days (it's clear this isn't his main job). He has three required textbooks and insists that you read them all to pass the class, but he'll typically give the answers before quizzes.

Tony is a good professor who approaches his teaching from a real-life perspective. Our homework worked at creating a marketing campaign for a local company. reviews.comment: Tony's lecture are full of humor and current information. The assignments given are a true representation of what is being learned about in class as well as in the textbooks. There is quite a bit of reading, but it is all applicable and useful - if you are going to be in a marketing position, purchasing the books is advisable.
Tony is awesome and funny! Tons of hands-on projects that gives a lot of experience.

Great class with clear expectations. If you read and follow the syllabus, you'll do well. The material builds on itself, so staying on track matters. Students who struggle often ignore guidelines or fall behind. I think she set expectations and expected us to follow the syllabus to get a good grade.

I've been in contact with Prof Tsuya post class and she has been an excellent resource for me as I am starting my career. She's helped me network and introduced me to people in my field. Very grateful

TL;DR: Don't believe the "reads off slides" reviews; she uses them as a backdrop for deep-dives into real-world case studies. As an older student, I find her style refreshing. She's fair, patient, and stays late to help. If you put your phone away and engage, you'll realize the "difficulty" others complain about is just a lack of effort. 5/5 stars.

Actually IS 3060- but one of the most frustrating professors I have ever had. Her organization of the class makes no sense, creates so much extra work for herself and us, and she barely explains any concepts beyond reading off the slides for her lectures. If you have the chance, take any other professor for the course.

I really liked Lindsey's teaching, I felt that the course material/assignments were straightforward. Homework was not difficult in my opinion. She's pretty good at replying to emails and she cares a lot about students having integrity and doing well in the course. Was canvas images issue during the mid term but I think that was out of her control.

Her ta grades the hw extremely strictly

Despite this she makes many mistakes herself

She is very bad at canvas

she messed up the midterm images

Pretty unprofessional tbh

The class is easy but she seems like she never really knows what's going on. She messes up on explaining basic concepts, messes up the quiz formats which leads to chaotic classes, etc. She talks about her Air bnbs a lot, seems like she's more focused on that than stastics/teaching.
Teacher was good. She took a lot of time to stay after class and go over questions and talk with the students. There was group project. t/he course in general is a lot of work

This class was challenging, but it was clear that she genuinely cared about the students. She was always available and responded faster than any other teacher I have had. The content she had to teach was challenging, and I am sure it was difficult to make it enjoyable. She was always available to meet if needed.
i got a 89.99 and she said she'd get fired if she rounded my grade up 0.01%. like girl be so fr.
Professor Tsai basically just reads out of the book for lectures and doesn't actually teach yet creates the hardest exams. His course was basically just reading the textbook.

Professor Tsai is definitely a very kind and smart professor. If you are ever stuck with something, he definitely does a great job explaining it until you understand it. However, it can be tough to understand some things from his instruction, especially if you are unable to stay on track with what he goes over.

This professor does not care at all about his students. He doesn't want his students to be successful. His teaching style is him lecturing and if you don't understand he will refer you the textbook and say you need study more. In our zoom classes he disabled the chat and muted everyone so we couldn't ask any questions in real time.

I was struggling before we went online, but now it's impossible. When we had classes in person you could just copy what he was doing on excel and be fine (don't miss a class though, you'll be screwed) but now that we're online there is less instruction, and it makes it harder to understand what we're leaning. I'll pass, but I didn't learn.

reviews.comment: Just show up to class and follow his lesson. Make sure you get your group organized from the start, they will help you pass this class and learn. I think Weiyu was an awesome guy but fails to engage you.

His advice to me was, "maybe switch your major" His lectures don't make a ton of sense and none of his resources make sense without him actually being there. Discouraged me from even pursuing the OSC major.

reviews.comment: He is a really good professor. If you do the work, pay attention, and dont skip class you will be fine. He teaches everything you will need to know. There are no secrets in this class. Just be a good student and you will do well

This is one of those classes that makes you wonder why you are paying so much to learn nothing. Tsai is a teacher who just talks instead of teaches. If you go to class and do the examples in class you'll be fine. Tests are difficult even with a help sheet, but he lets you earn back half credit on all assignments and tests.

He's a great professor! His class is pretty clear-cut. He does example problems in class, assigns homework (half the time it's optional) that sets you up for the exam, and he allows a cheat sheet for the exams. They are pretty tough, but if you go to class, he is always willing to explain more or answer questions. He made this class easy.

He is a best one. His class meets with all basic things in textbook. Also, he often have a review exam with clear solution before real exam.  Open book, note and feel free during exam & quiz. In addition, he try to help any student that do not understand course material. I love him!

He's a very poor teacher.  The tests have nothing to do with what is taught in class.  He does review questions for tests that don't help at all.  Everything is done online.  He's difficult to understand and is an overall poor teacher.
Not bad, but the class wasn't very useful in my mind.
Not bad.  Easy going.  Difficult to understand.

Very kind, and very emotional. Passionate lecturer with excellent content. Grading criteria is confusing to say the least; however, lots of opportunities for extra credit if you know how to do it! The first 2 weeks are the hardest. Just stick with it; she's testing your patience and passion, it's worth it.

reviews.comment: Engaging lectures and workload is actually pretty light. Attendance is graded but also necessary for success. She grades fairly and unbiased so just try

She was an amazing teacher! The class is challenging, but it is so much fun to learn! Definitely recommend this class for anyone who wants to learn and will put the time and effort into their assignments and notes. Quick Disclaimer! Only written notes will be allowed in this class!
She was the best. This class wasn't for my major, but it was worth my time.

reviews.comment: she's awesome.

The class was easy enough and Theresa is fine. I had a few interactions with her that I really did not appreciate and felt she brushed off my concerns and any issues I was having with the class due to concerns arising in my personal life. Her assignments were easy and graded fairly lenient with extra credit being given out for well done essays.
Theresa Martinez is everything. I would recommend her classes to anyone, even if you are not a sociology major. I love her so much.

Theresa is such an amazing person and her classes are such a welcoming space while also being very detailed and informative. Lecture slides themselves are barebones but she goes over and adds so much detail just talking to the class. Not a sociology major, but I would absolutely take more of her classes if I wasnt't graduating.

Theresa is wonderful and the real deal. The structure of her class is strict (no laptops or electronic devices, don't be late, talk over her, etc.), but it creates a great community. This class is so important and should be required!!! Attend every class - that's the majority of your grade.

Dr. Martinez is an excellent, eccentric professor. Classes should not be skipped since she grades on attendance and there are notes to be taken every class. However, the few assignments you get are manageable, and the multiple-choice tests (there is an option to do an essay if you want to) are online with open notes. I enjoyed this class a lot.

I enjoyed this class. The professor mainly focused on media involving youth and mentioned it would be her last year teaching it. I've taken about four classes with her, and all were interesting. Be aware that she only allows handwritten notes on paper or iPad—no laptops. She heavily focuses on notes, and attendance is crucial, worth 200 points.

She explains the content well, but she tends to be condescending and she treats her students like children. She also tends to belittle students for small things like being a few minutes late to class or asking "dumb" questions. On the other hand, she's always there to help those in difficult situations, and clearly cares for her students.

One of my favorite professors ever - I considered switching majors just so I could have a reason to take more classes with Theresa. Inequality through Music and Film was such an incredible class. Not too much reading, a short weekly writing assignment, and you have to take notes by hand during lectures which is what I usually do so I didn't mind.

Theresa's awesome! I really enjoyed taking her Rock & Roll Sociology class! She's funny, makes her lectures very interesting, and is super caring towards students. Attendance is mandatory and the workload with exams is very manageable for an A if you do well on them. If you love rock music, this class is worth taking from this amazing professor.

I do not recommend anyone take this class. What little course content there is outdated, she assigns readings we never discuss in class. She spends entire class periods playing sections of movies, we're lucky to get one actual lecture of content in a two week period. She is dismissive, rude, and picks on students that look tired or disengaged.

She's great! Super funny and really cares about students. She had lots of wisdom I've loved hearing about. A little bit of a stickler about some things but it's in your best interest. Totally take one of her classes.

Best professor ever! If you have the chance, take every class she teaches. She's incredibly knowledgeable and accepting of everyone. Attendance is required and a significant part of your grade, but her lectures are 100% worth it. She's very energetic and passionate about teaching.

Professor Martinez's lectures are engaging and entertaining. Attendance is mandatory, but worth it - she makes the material easy to grasp. Using unstuck ai alongside the textbook helped me ace the tests. An easy A if you stay on top of the work.

Gives narcissistic mother that provides just enough approval to keep you hopeful then gets inexplicably angry about things that don't matter. Yells at her students like children. She's probably guarded bc of frat boy disrespect but she doesn't discriminate with occasional humiliation of all students. Her commentary lacks nuance+ she supports cops?

reviews.comment: It should be a requirement to take a class from her. She is the best professor I have had at the U. On Day one she had memorized the names of everyone in our huge class. The workload is very doable. Notes must be handwritten and phones/laptops are prohibited. As long as you put effort into your work and show up to class, you will be fine.

Easily the best professor I've had so far. Lectures were super funny and engaging. She memorizes everyone's name before the semester to maximize every student's connection to the class. She was great at teaching and getting everyone engaged. I loved everything about this class and this professor. Highly recommend her.
Love her lots, she's such a passionate teacher and truly cares. She changes her students for the better!

Theresa memorized all her students names on the first day. She is an incredibly passionate teacher and if you take notes during class you're bound to excel. Attendance is a huge part of the grade, but her tests are very easy and she throws out extra credit like candy. She truly cares about every student and loves teaching. You'll never be bored!

First day of class Theresa had all names memorized. Her lectures are amazing and she cusses like a sailor, her assignments and tests are extremely easy if you attend class & take notes. She very often grants extra credit on both. Attendance is 200 points, each test is worth 100 so make sure to attend class. Incredibly nice teacher who really cares.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Passionate about her work & students, long but invigorating readings, incredible lectures, and overall just an amazing person. Attendance is mandatory and a large part of your grade, exams are easy if you apply yourself. Good grader, often gives extra credit if you turn things in early. 100% take her class!

reviews.comment: Everyday you need to sign roll (200 pts). Cool teacher, she memorized everyone's names and loves feedback from students. There are pop quizzes if no one participates. Lenient grader, I didn't spend much time on this class at all. There are textbook readings that I barely read, but I still got 90+ on the 3 exams. Utilize the extra credit!

Theresa is the best professor I have had at the U thus far. I have taken both her upper division classes as well as Soc1010 and it is evident that she both cares for her students as people and wants them to succeed. She does not put up with disruptions and has clear class expectations. Attending lectures are required but they are always engaging!

She somehow makes everyone feel recognized during classes even in lectures of 200+ people. Somehow she had everyone's names memorized by the first few class periods. There isn't too much homework (2-3hr per week) and attendance is heavily emphasized. Don't skip class and there is a lot of extra credit given by going the extra mile on assignments.

Such a fun class. Lots of fun and entertains lectures. Attendance is required. No phones usage and notes have to be written not typed. If you attend the class and take notes you will easily pass the tests. Easy grader on the essay assignments.

Overall, I really did like this professor. She remembered the names of everyone in the class, around 100-150 students if I had to make a guess. Attendance is heavily weighted in this class, and it would be difficult to not make an A or an A- if you continuously show up to class. There are assignments weekly, taking about 1-2 hours to complete each.

I honestly can't say enough good things about Professor Martinez! She taught the course material in a way that was easy to understand. She is so passionate about what she teaches; I learned so much that I didn't know before. She always made class so fun and entertaining; I didn't ever want to miss class! I would hands down recommend her!

She is very funny, understanding and kind to her students. Lots of great stories that will keep the whole class entertained the whole period. Her class describes topics that are sensitive to some people. Best thing about the class is that its easy and she is such an entertaining teacher. It covers very political topics,so try not to get offended :p

Theresa is an amazing professor. She is well-articulated and ensures everyone understands the concepts. Since lectures are emotionally heavy, Theresa does her best to elevate them. She truly loves her students, and she ensures empathy is always present. No electronics are allowed, but the class is more interesting and engaging without them.

Her class has expanded my worldview to better understand and empathize with so many different groups of people. She is funny, caring, and SO genuine. It isn't difficult to see how much she cares about her students. Lots of stories, super interesting lectures. Assignments are straightforward and offer extra credit for those who go above and beyond

This class has been by far one of my most favorite at the U! I couldn't imagine taking it with any other professor. Professor Martinez is one of a kind, well respected, and cares about each and every one of her students. Do yourself a favor and take one of her classes!

Professor Martinez's lectures were always very informative, but not in a boring way, and she engages with the class a lot and always made it fun. However, she doesn't allow notes to be taken electronically, which for someone who studies better with electronic notes for various reasons, wasn't ideal.
Great professor, with super interesting lectures. The class was fun and the tests were super easy and open note. If you go to class pretty consistently and take notes, it's basically a guaranteed A.

Theresa is an incredible professor. Her lectures are engaging and interesting, and as long as you show up to class and take notes, you will easily leave with an A. The only assignments are two essays and she gives tons of extra credit. It's obvious she cares about her students and wants you to succeed. I highly recommend taking her class.

Theresa is an amazing professor. She truly cares about her students and people in general. I highly recommend this class, it is the best class I have ever taken and it changed my outlook on so many things about the world. The coursework is very manageable and she grades easily on essays.

She is the best professor I've had! I enjoyed and looked forward to every class. Tests were easy and as long as you attend class, you're golden. I would recommend anyone and everyone take a class from her!
She was very inspiring and caring. She had almost no homework and graded very easily. She cares about her work and students and it shows in her lectures.

Everyone loves Professor Martinez! She is that one relatable professor who will swear and tell stories in class, but you still learn. She is passionate, knowledgeable, and there for you. 3 multiple choice open note online exams (or you can pick an essay if you want), two essays. Extra credit is given out often. Overall awesome class!
Theresa is an amazing teacher, I enjoyed her class. ATTENDANCE is mandatory only because it is graded. Her lectures are interesting most times.

She is sooooo amazing. This class was hard for me because I hate writing, but it was worth it. She is an INCREDIBLE professor and is so helpful. lectures are always interesting so DON'T skip. Plus she grades attendance. Lots of reading and writing but if you stay on top of it and do the work it's not terrible. Worth it to get her as your professor.

If you keep up with the work, you will have a great time.

My favorite professor at the University of Utah. I've taken 2 of her courses, Inequality through Music and Film and Deviant Behavior. She does cuss and can show R-rated material, but if she shows it at any point she will warn you well ahead of time and help you avoid it. She memorized everyone's names by the 2nd lecture. She's to reach and talk to.

One of my favorite classes and professors ever. The materials can be really heavy, but she does a great job covering them!

Love, love, love Theresa. She is an amazing and very inspirational woman and idk how anyone could ever say anything bad about her. She is truly what makes any class you take from her what it is. Lots of people love her but she . Loves to victimize herself

This class was hilarious despite covering topics such as serial killers, genocide, etc. Theresa is a great, down to earth professor who has the best stories to tell. If this class fulfills a requirement for you, just take it.

Prof. Martinez is AMAZING! There isn't a textbook for the class but there are a lot of pdf readings to do and homework is entirely writing assignments. reviews.comment: Theresa is the best professor I have ever had. She really cares about the class material and her students, and she makes the class such a safe environment for talking about difficult topics and personal experiences. She really cares that her students succeed both in class and in life, and is not only an amazing professor but an amazing person.

I loved her! She is so sweet and responds to quickly to emails. Class is so fun and easy. Discussion posts every week that you get full credit just for doing. 3 exam or essay exam options with 2 essays. She offers so much extra credit so there is no way you won't get an A even if u do bad on exams. Such a great professor and class, don't get book.
Theresa is such a great professor! Easy A and you will love her class!!

Loved lecture, hated the vagueness TLDR: superb lecturer, extremely poor feedback.

Attendance is not mandatory but you will want to go to every single one of her lectures. (It's the best part of my day no lie) She is the most caring professor I have had. I feel like I can express my opinions openly in class. I want to take another one of her classes for my SOC minor. Theresa if you're reading this we love you. <3 -Fall 20' Class

There are not enough words to describe how amazing of a professor Theresa is. She has such a big heart and truly cares about her students. In this class there were lots of assignments but she gives extra credit if you do well.
You have a paper due every week, but seriously they are super quick and easy nothing to stress about. she cares about you and your life. this class was so fun I wish I could take more like it.
I love Theresa and the class. So good. Too good.

I learned a lot in this class but more than that, it helped me grow as a person. The connection that Theresa had with the students, including myself, immediately caused me to be more interested and engaged with the class. She had every student's name memorized and that made each student feel cared for.

Theresa is incredible! She memorized everyones name (200+ students) by the first day of class and her lectures are always engaging and passionate. There are weekly reading assignments which are easy and the exams are open note essays. The content is emotionally challenging but soooo worth it!

this was a great class! in the beginning i wasn't looking forward to writing a paper (2 pages) every week but they turned out to be quite easy to write. Attendance is graded but if you do good on the essays (not hard to do) then feel free to skip every now and then. She is very passionate and lectures are never boring, take this class!

Attendance is graded. Lectures are amazing so it makes you want to go. Lectures are clear and take notes because tests are at home and open note. reviews.comment: I NEVER write these, but Theresa is the exception. Theresa is hands down the best professor I have ever had. reviews.comment: Amazing teacher, would take again.

I'm a Computer Science major who came into this general elective class with low expectations, and she completely blew me away. She is so amazing, and such a great professor that it made me sad that I can't take any more classes with her. Take her!

Theresa Martinez is out right the BEST professor I have ever had. TAKE THIS CLASS. I dont know who I would be today without this class. She taught me so much about life and myself. My entire mindset has changed for the better.

Professor Martinez is an amazing professor! She loves what she teaches and (tries) to remember everyone's name. It is important to go to class and write down notes because your grade is based on 4 exams (They are to be taken at home and are open-note).
