I took Professor Tim Tribone for Calculus 1 at the University of Utah, and he was nothing short of a great teacher. Take Tim!

highly recommend!

This professor should never have been trusted as a teacher. He is a terrible choice. Take anyone else for this class.

Tuttle is the man, I took photojournalism with him and loved it so much I signed up for another one of his classes. Great person and has a lot of amazing photographic insight. Take any of his classes and you wont regret getting to know him!

Great intro photography class. Was able to use my iPhone camera for most assignments, with a couple exceptions. Weekly photographs, nothing too hard at all. Very broad range to choose from, can really shoot anything you want. Some quizzes, not hard. Great online class!
This class was helpful in learning about the use of cameras, as well as editing photos.  Professor is pretty easy going, which was really nice for a summer class.  Overall great experience.

This class is successful in being fun and creative and still teaches you a lot. Typical week is some readings on a particular photography subject, a photograph applying those concepts, and a short quiz that you get multiple attempts on. All assignments are open so you can work ahead if so desire.

He is very enthusiastic and his lectures were quite enjoyable. Though his instructions were not very clearhelpful (we were never even given a grading rubric), he did provide very helpful feedback after each assignment. Prof. Tuttle's class was fantastic. Roger is a fantastic professor. This was an online section of his class, but he's really able to do more online in terms of teaching and interaction than most are able to do in-class. One of the best professors I have ever had. He really does care about his students and gets to know you. He cares about you actually learning, not just regurgitating information. We need more teachers like Roger Tuttle.

She uses AI but says that no other student should use AI. She puts no effort into making any of the slides, homework or tests because she said that AI did it all for her. Its a coding class that she refuses to teach coding for and makes you learn it out of class using a random site.

I am taking her IS4487 class right now. I was terrified to take her cause I saw some bad reviews but I think she is great! I'm awful at coding and IS but she makes the class very manageable and is very accessible outside of class. She emphasizes that she is always available to help! She grades generously as she understands the topics are complex.
Accuses students of cheating with no evidence.

This professor was one of the most awful I have ever taken a class with. She would accuse you of doing things without actual evidence and would do her best to get you to the edge with her constant accusations. Also, when it comes to group projects, she gives credibility to the crowds and not individuals, so make sure you are cool with your group.
I would strongly advise other students to avoid taking a class with this professor.

Vandana is an unpleasant professor to work with, she's very condescending, insensitive, and accusatory without solid evidence. She won't get a proctor for her exams, instead, she just accuses everyone of cheating semester over semester. It feels like a cry from her for attention at this point. I wish I took the course from someone else.

Don't let the awful reviews scare you. V is a good professor with clear lectures and grading criteria. Her lectures are very long and heavy but watch them on 2x speed and you'll be fine. The group project is a LOT of work but she gives 2 opportunities to meet with the TA and get feedback so you can get a great score.

Vandana was a great professor for a hard topic. It's not a subject that is easily taught in ten weeks so it's obviously not going to be a breeze to get through, but she makes it fairly easy. Each module has a homework assignment relating to the previous week lecture. The fours hours was tough but she was really nice.
Did not like this professor at all. Her content was all over the place and it was not clear what she expected from us. Would not take another class from her again.
Worst class I took in my entire time at the U. Do yourself a favor and avoid this professor. Disrespectful, under-qualified, self obsessed, narcissist.
Skip this class at all costs, the professor will treat you like garbage.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Vandhana Ramachandran is a very bad professor. She is overly critical of students' work and gives absolutely no room for any mistakes. Her assignment and test questions are very poorly written and confusing due to her lack of English, yet she will criticize students who ask her to please explain herself. She has a severe lack of self-awareness.

Her lectures are not helpful. She will not give you the necessary skill set to complete assignments, instead she states that "the internet is the most up-to -date for data information" and "spending hours on assignments and getting frustrated is part of learning". She does not teach to her expectations on homework. Prepare to spend hours online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The course is difficult because she doesnt teach the concepts we need to know to do well on the assignments and theres no clarity in her instructions. Grading is incredibly subjective; the rubric for grading (if there is oneoftentimes there isnt) includes things that werent asked for. Lectures were a waste of time; just read WSJ tech section
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Hannah is extremely hard to learn from. Her feedback is vague and purposefully unhelpful. She is often unprepared which falls on the students to pick up the slack. She does not grade anything the entire semester and your grade is a mystery until the very last second. She is disorganized and sets unrealistic deadlines. Do not take a class from her.
Hannah is a great instructor. She gives great feedback and wants you to succeed. If you want to do well, be ready to put in a lot of hard work.

She does not take students as individuals.  She is very disrespectful to students and on numerous occasions laughed at students and mocked them.  She created such a hostile environment at school that many of the students in the class did not feel comfortable being in class when she was there.  Avoid taking any classes at all costs.

Asked what to study for a test and he said the old ones posted under another professor. Study those and the test he gives out is NOTHING like it. Payed attention in class and he still put problems I have never seen before. I have been a straight A student my whole life in honors and am struggling in his class.

Do not take him. He reuses a course from a previous professor but doesn't even teach. He doesn't give any formulas and just reads off the powerpoint. Allowed to bring a formula sheet which DOESNT help because we ARENT GIVEN formulas. Not a lot of ways to get points in the class besides three exams and homework. Taking Phys2 in summer to avoid him.

Michael is a great professor, he's really knowledgeable about physics and really tries to help his students understand the topic. The tests are hard, but he helps students prep for them well in class.

Prof. Vershinin is incredibly good at connecting material in interesting ways and providing background history to set up the context of the physics. The lectures are framed in an exploratory fashion -- he asks the class a lot of hypothetical questions that lead to bizarre physical scenarios. I have no idea why he's poorly rated.

Professor V is by the most inspiring instructor for math I've had.  He taught the class at a high level and gave us many extra credit tasks through the semester.  He was extremely kind and was always willing to help in office hours.  There were students that were very unprepared for the class, and some were even disruptive. Highly recommend!

Probably the worst math professor I've ever had. His lectures left everyone lost, and he had no idea how to simplify something for a student to understand. He wrote on a chalk board during class and never uploaded notes to canvas. This class was a waste of my time, and you're better off teaching yourself the content outside of class. Awful teacher

Never responded to emails, was frequently late posting content, half of the lectures were recorded by a different professor, and his accent is thick enough that i found watching khan academy videos more effective than the actual pre-recorded lectures. Exams are not much like homework and are graded much more stringently than he leads you to believe

I am frustrated with this professor. They don't seem to speak English well and haven't replied to any messages on Canvas. I would suggest avoiding this professor if possible. I hope this guys will be fired soon

Truly the worst professor I have had the displeasure of having in my 4 years here at the U. Raghav lacks basic compassion, manners, and teaching ability. He took several days to respond to emails and was extremely rude in his responses. Raghav also questioned my legally mandated accommodations. Could not recommend avoiding him more.

He is not accessible outside of class and gives practice exams that are absolutely nothing like the actual exam. He also does the bare minimum when it comes to helping his students. Take literally anyone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was a cool professor, just make sure that you go to classes, might have to do a presentation but it was pretty light.

Doctor V cares about her students (or maybe she just liked my class). She has an Indian accent but is quite easy to understand. She can also go on tangents or tell stories if the class sparks it. She makes me laugh. This quest class is new, so we were the guinea pigs.  Some of the assignments felt like busywork, but not too bad.

This class was very group project heavy. Well over half of the homework assignments were group projects, but she was very helpful when you needed help. She's very funny and encourages class participation. My only complaint was the amount of reading: you were expected to read several pages from different scholarly articles before each class.
Horrible professor. You can't understand what she is saying and can't read her handwriting.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. V is an amazing person and is super passionate about the material taught in class. Class was way more engaging and interesting than reading the material. However, the majority of your grade in the class is group projects and you have to hope and pray that you get a good group.

Knowledge professor who is very passionate about the material and class. I wouldn't say the class is particularly easy (lectures are mandatory) but if you put in the effort, you should get an A no problem. There's a few group projects, a final presentation, and a few small exams. Homework is moderate (maybe ~1-2 hours a week).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: lectures were required, but they mostly felt like wastes of time. most of what i learned was outside of class. shes a nice person, but sometimes class felt pointless. group projects are pretty much the entirety of your grade, and you only get one group for the whole semester and can't really change it so hope that you get competent group members
My favorite professor. She cares and really gets her students thinking. She wants what's best for her students and is always willing to help outside of class. Take if you can!

In person lectures felt useless. Its just an ungraded discussion on the readings/online lecture. 4 absences before your grade tanks. This section heavily focuses on working with a team she assigns you, so pray that you get a team that knows what they're doing because your grade is pretty much just those team memos. Nice person. Not so great prof.

There is a lot of homework in the class, but the community you develop with your classmates seems worth it. There's a semester-long research project, which is very time demanding. The class discussions are super interesting and usually gets everyone involved. This course makes you really think outside of the box. Fun professor and fun classmates.

It is hard to come by a professor that cares about their students as much as she does. I like how she asks her students for feedback throughout the semester and actually listens to it! I know that I can be honest with her, which creates a unique instructor-student relationship. The class is discussion-heavy and you have a semester group project.

This class was a massive disappointment from what I hoped to get out of it. Veeraghanta IS a caring professor, but the lack of organization made the class miserable. Virtually all assignment deadlines were never updated from previous semesters/incorrect, and most feedback we received ranged from unhelpful to entirely uninterpretable.

DO NOT TAKE 1501 FROM HER. She isn't even an engineer, she's a humanities professor. Half of the semester was several very large group projects that make up the majority of grade and she grades like a tough writing professor. I did not get what I wanted to from this class. And last but not least she cheated me from my earned extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr V is super nice. She really cares about her students! Only issue is she rambles a lot during lecture to the point everyone's lost. On top of that, her assignment instructions are extremely confusing and her feedback on assignments is often not legible or helpful. She would just write question marks on assignments. How is that helpful??

One of the most fun professors to ever have. Kind and always open about what going on with class. Most of the time we would only do discussion and get readings that would relate to the topic of what is going in class. Near the end, there is always a group project. You will get a good grade if you put effort and participation in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: The first half is a lot of reading and in-class lectures which sometimes can get sidetracked, but Dr. V is a passionate teacher and wants to have students learn and grow rather than teach to a test. The second half is an intense research project, tons of work, but is graded pretty fairly. She cares about kids a ton and reaches out.

She wants to see you succeed and she gives you material that will help you be successful. She won't give you a free ride. But I'd you pay attention you be fine. Not many tests but lots of writing and reading. Still the best teacher I've had

Absolutely fabulous! Her passion for the topics covered in class really shine through, and her unique perspective is inspiring. If you put in genuine effort, you can succeed in her class, and if you don't, you're missing out on what this course has to offer.

She is a great professor that has some very interesting articles and lectures you read throughout the semester. For LEAP 1501: Weekly homework for the first half of the semester which is fairly easy and then the second half is a huge group project that makes up around 60% of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: 1st half of the course was very easy and slow. 2nd half of the course was group project heavy and very reading and content heavy. Professor does a good job with lectures and offers lots of chances to help improve grades in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is a very good teacher. Will help you with anything. But expects a lot from you. Make sure to always check your email and the modules in canvas. She like to keep you on your toes. Overall a very caring and supportive teacher. She really helps you get connected
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Absolutely the worst professor I've ever had the displeasure of working with. Arrogant, ignorant and most importantly, not even an engineer. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: First half of the class is very simple and involves reading about historical engineering disasters and their implications. Expect weekly homework where you respond to questions about the disasters. Midterm is easy if you read. Last half is a ton of group work, be prepared to research. She grades easy as long as you put in effort.
reviews.rating_tags: SO MANY PAPERS--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Show up to class ready to learn and participate and you should be fine. Overall she's a nice teacher that enjoys teaching, which can be clearly seen through her lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very good professor but very strict with grading. Not many points given so each point counts and she gives you an opportunity to earn an extra 5 points for the semester. Make sure you show up because lectures are key to the midterms.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She was a really great teacher and I had a good time in her class. She does require a lot of group projects and they were fairly difficult and graded a little tougher than normal, but overall a good class.
The best teacher at U of U!

The professor was great overall but you have to try and push yourself.  Group projects are really important to passing the class because it's really going to hurt your grade if you don't put enough effort into your teams.  Sometimes the professor rambles a bit too much, but it kind of shows how she loves what she does.

Amazing teacher! Really interesting if you actually decide to think. Likes participation, doesn't require a textbook, assigns articles each week though, easy enough if you read them. A couple hours of reading a week, proly less. Great class, required for my major.  You do have to pt effort in, though. But no real studying. Very funny in her own way

Although there is a lot of work in this class, I felt that Dr. V. Was interesting and helpful. She did tend to talk too much but she knows her stuff and loves what she does. She is a very nice person.
I wish this class was not required for my major. Excessive homework, handouts and instructions were very jumbled and unclear. She LOVES to ramble on and on in lectures.

Great teacher, fun, interesting, smart... also a little excessive work load. I would strongly recommend you take this course from another instructor due to the fact the class should have been much easier but she purposely overloaded the work schedule.
This professor is my fav.
One of the best professors I ever had
class not worth it

The class requires much more work than it's worth.  If you can find another class that fulfills both Humanities and Ethics, I'd recommend taking that class if the topic interests you.  If you don't like working in teams don't take this class.

EXCELLENT TEACHER, EASY CLASS BUT ALOT OF READING-5/6 NOVELS PER SEMESTER. EASY A IF YOU SHOW UP AND READ
Veera is a man who is full of knowledge and only wants to share that wisdom with his students in the way that means the most to him.

The actual nicest professor I've ever had. Class was always entertaining and Veera cares about you doing moves correctly, so they can apply outside of class. Great prof for if you need an extra class!
He always makes class fun and is always very fun to talk to.

I was terrified after reading the reviews, but Prof. Vergobbi turned out to be amazing. He's kind, always willing to help, and actually made things make sense. His passion shows, and I genuinely looked forward to class. So glad I didn't let the reviews scare me off!

Dr. Vergobbi is not the easiest professor. You will have to work, read, and participate in this class. That being said, this was the most useful and rewarding class I have had the privilege of taking at the University of Utah. In a monotonous four-year career of professors letting students slide by, Dr. V was a breath of fresh air. He really cares.

Vergobi is the worst professor at the University of Utah. He continually singled me out in front of the entire class because I didn't agree with his BS liberal agenda. I quite literally did not learn a single things in his comm law or freedom of expression class. Wast of time and money. Honestly pretty disappointing that Utah still employs him.

I took Dr.V's Freedom of Speech class. Dr.V made me rethink my college experience in the best way possible. He is a professor that cares is passionate, & is invested- even after a lifelong career in teaching. I was challenged to think in other ways. He was the best professor I ever had, wish I could have taken more of his classes before graduation.

I don't recommend this professor whatsoever. His course is disorganized, and the workload is unreasonable. He randomly screams during lectures and expects his students to be lawyers. If the U offers any other professor for Mass Comm Law, I highly recommend you take their course instead.

Don't let people scare you out of taking his classes. He is INCREDIBLE and I learned SO much! The first class I actually cared to actively participate in rather then feeling like I had to. I highly recommend Dr. V. He's a really nice guy and just wants his students to succeed. Just stay on top of things and get to class and you'll do great!!

I was terrified to take a class from Dr.V because I had heard he was hard, but don't be afraid of him. Seriously by far the most incredible and passionate professor I have EVER had! Just make sure to make his classes ( I took both Ethics and Law in the same semester) your top priorities- don't miss class and stay on top of readings & you'll be good

Vergobi is an obnoxious teacher that makes you jump through all sorts of ridiculous hoops throughout his course. Pushes lectures onto students through group projects. 8 lectures are completely taught by students. I'm paying him to teach, it'd be nice if he would do that. If there was another teacher teaching these classes I'd recommend any of them.

reviews.comment: This class became online due to covid which had pros and cons. Pros - we could use notes on tests. Cons - lectures had no PowerPoints so it was easy to get lost if you didn't read the complete chapter thoroughly. It is a lot of info to memorize and read. He expects participation during class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. V is the best professor at the U! This class is hard, so expect that. Form a study group in the beginning and split up the work, thats the best way to do well and to pass. Dr. V knows what he is talking about and wants you to succeed. His lectures were interesting and sometimes hilarious. Best MassCommLaw prof by far!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I get this is his first time teaching online, but having no slides made this really difficult for me. He acts like we knew the topics before coming in to the class. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hes easily the best professor Ive ever had. His method of teaching keeps you engaged and makes his concepts easy to learn. Take him if you can! He gives you all the tools to succeed.

One of the best professors I've ever had, truly cares about you learning the material. Grading is a little hard to follow, it's mostly based on tests, attendance, and participation. He's a little eccentric, but he has a method to his madness. You will need to read and come to class every day prepared and ready to participate. The tests are hard!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Vergobbi is one of most eccentric professors at the U and his knowledge of the material is thorough and enlightening. Miss more than 5 classes and you fail, no quizzes or test, three short papers. Overall great class with a fun but tough teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: This class was awesome! I truly learned so much. Although, there was a lot of work. Each class you had to turn in a paper from the assigned reading (usually 15-20 pgs). reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: He is an intense teacher but is very fun and surprising! He wants us to succeed. He is very loud. You need to show up on time and be prepared or it will be very hard to pass. He is available for consultation. Cares more that you understand the material than actually getting the specifics down of each case. Very understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Vergobbi is the best professor I have ever had. He knows the material is hard so he doesn't go out of his way to make it harder. The class itself is tough but if you read and do your case questions you will be fine! Anything that is not on the test review is not on the test!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Best professor I've ever had. His classes are hard and he definitely makes you work for it, but he sets your up for success. I've taken 3 classes with him and I want to take more
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Do not miss class. After 5 absences he automatically fails you because a lot of important things happen during class. It is a long class about two hours. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Vergobbi is an awesome professor! This class is hard and you have to be involved in class and study a lot outside of it, but it's also very fun and entertaining. Make sure that you take good notes in class, bring your book each time and stay involved. He really sets you up to pass by being very clear about what is expected so listen to him!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was probably the most challenging class I've ever taken, but also the most rewarding. He expects a lot from his students, so make sure you actually READ each chapter and do the study guides. FORM A STUDY GROUP EARLY. This makes life SO MUCH EASIER!

Has that "you are in my class so absences, tardiness and cellphones will not be tolerated" importance about himself. Makes you sign a CONTRACT that you will fail after 4 absences. harsh grader - even marked me down for "grammatical errors" that were in fact NOT errors but he is an idiot who does not understand his first language.  Demanding. Awful.

You just have to keep up on the reading and case problems. I highly recommend getting a study group together so you can divide and conquer. Staying on track and going to class are key to passing this course.

Dr V is hands down the hardest but BEST professor I've had at the U. He challenges his students, he wants them to think beyond their comfort zones and he makes you achieve a scholastic level you never thought yourself capable of. This is the second course I've taken from him and it was totally worth it.

This class is the most rewarding class I've taken at the U of U. Dr. Vergobbi is engaging, entertaining, and wants you to succeed. Most importantly, he teaches you how to THINK. Make a study group on day one. From his "Batman Utility-Belt Syndrome" to his life dream to be a forest ranger, this is one professor you'll be grateful for in the future.

Mass Comm Law with Vergobbi is the most useful college class I've taken.  You will learn a lot.  Dr. V is the BEST professor I have had at the U, hands down.  He is hilarious and really engages the class.  The class requires effort, but an A is very possible if you put in the time. Take his classes.

Most interesting professor i have ever had. He was very difficult but the hard work was rewarded by the knowledge gained. He was able to keep class interesting and very possible to get the A or grade you want as long as you put in work. Going to take as many classes as possible from him.

Vergobbi's class is hard. But why are you going to college, anyway? Don't you want a challenge? I always heard other students talking about how easy their mass comm law classes were. But why is that a good thing? Vergobbi will interest you and challenge you. I didn't want to take the class, but it became my favorite!
Super interesting class and fun teacher. He demands a lot though. Keep up with the reading and you will be fine.

Hard class, only in that the material is challenging. Exams are difficult, but if you read and attend lectures, it's pretty easy to do well. Professor is lively and makes class entertaining and engaging. If you are prepared to work and want to learn, this is the guy!

Took his class Freedom of Expression five years ago. I cried- literally - when I got my first paper back. But I worked my behind off the rest of the semester. No professor has ever expected that much from me. He got me ready for grad school, however, and he is one of the best instructors out there. But DO NOT expect to skate by.

Vergobbi is BY FAR the best professor I have had at the U so far. He is extremely helpful and really wants you to do well in his class. He keeps class entertaining with his crazy personality, and make the material a lot of fun! I would recommend him to any student and wouldn't take this class from any other professor!
mostly self taught
Hard.  Hard. Hard.  If you don't have a lot of time, then avoid this instructor at all costs.  That said, he is a great teacher and his classes are extremely good.

SO hard!  He is a great teacher and you will learn a lot, but know beforehand that it will be extremely hard, you are required to be in class everyday (because he WILL learn your name and take roll and you lose points if you don't come...a LOT of points).  I wish I'd known this beforehand....

Great teacher! Makes you come to class, keeps you interested. Actually learns everyone's name!! Knows his material inside and out. Would highly recommend to anyone in the comm program that you try to get Mass Media Law from him.

one of the best prof at uri, highly recommended as the class is extremely easy due to exam being exactly the same as hw, prof also make alot of resources available online so going to class is not a requirement( but I highly recommend you still go however as the class is fun and Pete actually care about students)
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Wants his students to succeed. The work was clear and useful. I actually kind of like econ now. Very clear to understand if you pay attention.
I had pete for ECN at URI and I loved him. He's a nice guy and his class isn't that hard, though he is hard to understand sometimes. Personally, I think he is the best ECN teacher you could get.

Loved this course. I usually hate math but professor Vechsuruck explained things in an understandable way, even though he has a thick accent. He drops the worst exam score and lets you have a cheat sheet. I would definitely recommend.

"Pete" was a very nice guy and great at letting you know what he's looking for. All exam questions are taken from the weekly quizzes, and one of three exams is dropped. It was easy to pass the class without religiously attending class.

He is a great teacher for economics classes. I had him for both Intermediate Micro (4010) and Math for Econ (3620). He has a thick accent but does a great job of explaining difficult concepts. He is a very fair person and is very approachable for any questions you have. I would highly recommend him for 4010.

Started off slow which was concerning, but sped up after a few weeks of creating a very solid base. Explains things well and gives students multiple opportunities to practice problems alone, in groups, and up on the white board. Very much encourages going to office hours. Maybe the sweetest professor I've had, cares about students beyond the class.

Folks be prepared, if you have no choice but to take math with Vera, strap yourself in... The accent won't bother you at first but trust me, it makes every concept feel way more abstract than it already is. Notes? TAKE THEM. TAKE PHOTOS ON YOUR PHONE because she flies through the material in class so quick that if you sneeze, you'll miss the slide
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: It is very hard to understand her, I knew a lot of the materiel before but when she explained it I had no idea what i was talking about. She also skips steps and would go through each section really fast.

It's extremely hard to understand her and if you're not the best at math, her notes and shown-work are hard to follow. Unless you already understand the homework 100% before you take notes on it, go to class.

There is a clear language barrier and that is hard but Vera clearly loves math and is a brilliant person. She follows right from notes though and there is a 1-2 question quiz EVERY week. It's either an easy A or an easy flunk depending on who you are. She's an easy grader and nice... but not the best teacher in a subject that is already challenging
Vera is such a good teacher she post all the notes online and the book is really clear to just do all the homework and study for the test and you should be okay

this class comes with a 2 hr/week internship, which no one bothers to tell you about. Vedrana cares and she's extremely available. She is a great resource.
She really wants the students to be successful
Most pointless class I've ever taken.
She is the best piano teacher the University of Utah  has to offer.
Dr. Subotic is a great prof. Very helpful, clear, and intelligent!
If you want to work hard and learn a lot, if you want to learn excellent musicianship, try Vedrana.
Excellent
No Comments
