reviews.comment: Professor Zagal is an entertaining professor but homework assignments lacked consistent structure, and instructions for assignments were ambiguous while grading criteria was strict and wouldnt be provided prior to completing the assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The Class was pretty interesting, and Jose is a great professor when it comes to lecturing. He does grade very brutally however, be sure to know at least what the readings are about for class and the exams. Also, be sure to grammar/spellcheck your papers because he will show no mercy. The class is much more forgiving online than in person.

I've seen rough ratings for Prof. Zagal for other EAE courses, but for 2100 he was great. The course isn't easy by any means, but he is pretty generous w/ dropping stuff. The lectures/discussions were excellent and the feedback is direct and helpful. Only issue I had is that I was not a fan of how his grading method interacted w/ Canvas.
He's a really fun person and super passionate about EAE. 10/10 would recommend.
Try to avoid his classes if you are EAE games major.

reviews.comment: Biggest issue I had with this class was the workload. There was a reading or two per week but they were often up to 30 pages. His lectures try to be fun but lack a little, and I wished that this class had actually talked about ethics in games instead of just ethics in general with the occasional game mentioned. Nice guy, assignments kind of tough.

This is a class to help you improve your thinking skills. I spend an extra 4-6 hours out of each class to study philosophy-related knowledge independently. They are not all about ethical studies. The benefit is that the narrative knowledge and aesthetics-related needed in game studies can also be learned incidentally.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Ethics in Videogames is not a good class to take if you are a Philosophy major. Is just one of those "ethics" courses engineering students have to take -- not sure why it's listed under Philosophy. Grading scheme was clear, but the questions on the midterm and final were unclear and weirdly specific. Nice-ish guy, but definitely not worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The class was not hard just the requirements were not clear therefore leading to unclear grades. The entire semester I based my grade based off of Canvas to only find out he adds criteria at the end that he does not specify how he is grading and I ended up missing 8 points somewhere. Other than that he's ok.

For Social Justice Facilitation - Kilo is a fantastic professor and person, I always looked forward to class and felt extremely safe around Kilo and the environment he and my classmates built. I learned so much about how to talk about hard issues with groups of people and the skills I learned will no doubt help me throughout life. Be ready to talk!

I took Gender and Nature in '22 and to this day, am still embarrased to have it on my  transcripts. I signed up for this class hoping to learn more about Gender and Nature, throughout time. I was  mistaken as instead we did performative things like writing land acknowledgements. This class convinced me to move to a hard science degree from ENVST.

Kilo is an amazing professor, He pushed me so much and changed my perspective on so many things. He's very caring and understanding, and really wants everyone in class to do their best and live up to their potential. Highly recommend.

My time in this class was cut short because of COVID-19, but it was a fantastic class. Kilo is a really amazing person and cares deeply about his students and this subject. I will say that he doesn't do much teaching himself in this course, and rather gives students the resources to educate each other, and this format really works.

Kilo seems like a nice person, but was not very understanding when it came to personal matter. He taught based on subject and what the text says and doesn't consider emotional and personal trauma about the subject. He was not very understanding with medical and mental health excuses. He also has issues opening up and considering different views.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Kilo is my favorite professor I've had at the U so far. He's so knowledgable, insightful and wise. He really challenges you to grow as a student and as a human. I learned so much in his class! If I could I would take a class from him every semester.

He cares about the topic and wants you to as well, which isn't hard because all the content is extremely relevant. I'm taking another class from him just because loved the class so much, I always left class feeling motivated and inspired. It being a discussion based class was an incredible way to learn from others, and I would highly recommend it.

Kilo is one of my favorite professors at the University of Utah. He knows what he's talking about, and really cares about his students. Most of the time, his classes are primarily student led and uses more of a pedagogical approach as opposed to lectures. This means that you won't do well here if you don't like to participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The students taking this class lead this class. Prof. Kilo pushed students outside of there comfort zone and accepted failure as a step towards success. In taking this class you will move peace indicators up. (Warning: you will have to public speak)

Kilo is the embodiment of Peace and Conflict Studies. He's kind, caring and a real example of educational excellency. I learned a lot from him and would take him again in a heart beat. His lack of judgment makes him perfect for his line of work. He focuses on Student led lectures and the readings are necessary to understand key concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: For my first review on rate my professor I felt very compelled to give Rachel a 5. She creates a great learning environment, and her weekly readings are always interesting and helpful. She gives incredible, in-depth feedback and always makes herself available outside of class. We also have great weekly class discussions and writing exercises.

Zavecz is seriously one of the greatest professors I've had so far at the U. She is incredibly caring, gives the most thorough feedback on every assignment and cares about each student. I absolutely loved this class and had fun with each of the readings, the workshop and the final project. Overall a great class

Rachel was very nice, and this class was fun. The first half of the semester was reading and discussion, and the last half was straight workshop. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but it is always respectful to come to workshop. This class was chill, and the main assignments were to read and write in discussion posts.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was a really cool class  good balance of reading, writing, and bookmaking. Zavecz is super nice, flexible when it comes to personal issues, and adjusted the course load as the semester went on so it wasn't overwhelming. She looks for effort and completion rather than grading on strict requirements, for both reading and writing assignments.

reviews.comment: Best professor I had in the math department.  Really worked hard to help me understand the course.
Amazing teacher, sad that he let the u
His course was easy, he gave a lot of high grades, but I don't feel that I learned much.

I had Mark for calculus II.  He is an amazing instructor.  He makes sure everyone knows that material and doesn't leave it to you to teach yourself.  His tests were fair and included material from his homework so I always felt very prepared.

Zajac's exams are very easy, if you do his assignments and understand the problems you'll do well. He often reviews the algebra ad nauseum rather the pure calculus, which gets boring. He tends to close his eyes while lecturing so if you're really shy it may be hard to ask questions, but he highly encourages them so it's your responsibility to ask.

The professor is good enough. His grading policy is harsh. His late policy is minus 10-20% in one week with no credit after. He's not understanding of travel or sickness other than with a doctor's note. He will not round grades. I have a 79.92%; he will not round to 80% because it would be unfair to others. He is the typical 100-level prof.

reviews.comment: Instructor has a thick accent which makes it hard to understand what he is saying in the video. Will not give any grace to bumping grades (was less than one percent away from an A- and would help.) Responds quickly to email but quizzes are difficult and worth 40% of the grade.
Responded quickly and was always happy to answer questions. Occasionally he will say the wrong word in lectures. Hard quizzes.

This man should not be allowed to teach. He does not know how to answer questions. He has a very strong accent that makes him difficult to understand. Also, he never said anything about deducting points for late work, but 2 weeks after semester ended he took points away for all late work. Completely destroyed my grade. No grace for grade changing.

Knowledgeable, but puts in zero effort. Assignments have typos, bad code, and missing files. Weekly quizzes ask unreasonable questions for being closed book. I'd have failed nearly every one if it weren't that just showing up and taking the quiz earns you like 20%. Lackluster lecturer and difficult to understand, mostly because he talks so quietly.

reviews.comment: I do not understand the negative reviews - I really enjoyed the course and learned a lot. Yes, it was not easy and required a lot of independence. Some materials could have been more thoroughly prepared. But over all, I learned a lot and the professor seemed very competent.

This professor is a joke. He does everything in his power to do the least amount of work possible. Refusing to even proofread the projects for mistakes. He expects you to constantly monitor the piazza chats that he only sometimes answers for the mistakes that he made so as to not spend hours unable to figure out that you've done nothing incorrect.

reviews.comment: The professor knows very well about what he's teaching. However, he is very hard to reach out to and does not care about the students. reviews.comment: Your grade comes from 2 midterms, one final, weekly group quizzes and a group project. I am not particularly good at testing, but I did ok in this class. He was happy to answer questions and stay after class.

reviews.comment: He's a great professor. Homework is optional but helpful and there are weekly quizzes that are fair. He's very helpful and teaches clearly.

Leif has been one of my favorite professors. He is extremely helpful and will answer any questions you have. His lessons are well prepared and he knows what he is talking about. He is pretty funny, too.

Leif is really awesome! He is kind of awkward, but a great teacher. He is very clear and goes over multiple ways to solve one problem to make sure everyone understands. There is homework every night, but it isn't due until Friday and then there is a quiz on everything from that week. He has a website that he put

This professor is amazing! He teaches so clearly and in a way where non math minds can understand. All tests and quizzes were very clear and had good materials to prepare for them. Way awesome professor.

He taught word-for-word out of the textbook which made his lectures difficult to understand, not to mention how quickly he moves. I had to completely rely on the math lab to understand what he had taught. On a positive note, he is willing to meet with you in his office during or outside of his office hours and does not grade too harshly.
He was not very helpful and just wrote from the textbook for class notes while not allowing us to even follow along from it. He gave lots of homework and painfully confusing tests.

He was very unclear and only used the textbooks for class notes so there wasn't really anything else to be used to study for the class. Over half the class was failing and he refused to give extra credit because he already gave an extra 5 point problem on a test that didn't help in the slightest. Loads of homework and painfully confusing tests.

Horrible class. He writes notes straight out of the textbook all period long rather than go over homework or explain questions in his own words. Weekly homework worth 100 points. Quiet young guy. If you struggle the slightest bit with math and are unable to TEACH YOURSELF, I recommend NOT taking this course. Three midterms, a final and two quizzes.

The class material is not difficult to understand. My main issue was her tests, she used the most frustrating wording! It's like she used a thesaurus for every other word. It seemed like she was trying to trick the class. Luckily she grades on a curve so that seemed to be relief. Also she gives weekly clicker points, so attendance is important

Professor Zick wasn't great, but not terrible. The class was boring, but had some good information here and there. Not too difficult, there isn't a lot of homework. The tests were ok, make sure you go over the study guides.

I knew nothing about finance nor economics when I took this class, but I earned an A.  Come to class everyday because lectures are not posted and write down more than what is on the slides and you will do well.  Copy the problems she does in class word for word because they match the ones on the problem sets.

Family economic issues is the course I took. Challenging class. Tests are fairly hard, but curved. No textbook, only online readings. And you have to go to class to get the notes. They are not posted online and no other option to obtain them (even if you are 10 mins late). She encourages questions but is not friendly in answering them.

No textbook, just readings from online. She does not post notes, you just have to take your own notes and use them for the test (in that way, attendance is mandatory, but she does not take attendance). No extra credit. SUPER hard tests. Nice lady, but not a student-friendly teacher.
I loved this class! He made everything so easy to understand. He was willing to work with the students if he needed to and kept things interesting!!
Great professor!
Outstanding professor. Really good at teaching this subject and it is very nice not to have to purchase a textbook for this class.

Unnecessarily difficult course. He takes attendance at random and it's part of the final grade, not extra credit. Grading for written assignments was very subjective, even if you follow the instructions completely. Shared his liberal/socialist political views excessively and did not seem to respect others' views. I don't recommend taking his class.

This class was one of the hardest I've ever taken, but the most rewarding. Dr Zimmer is AMAZING, he only wants the best of the students that put forth the effort. AMAZING! I LOVED HIM! BRILLIANT MAN! Take his class!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
A funny guy, made the class information.  He's understanding and provides a decent amount of time for work, so it's pretty easy in all.

His class was very trying and hard, but extremly interesting and a lot of fun. He took time to answer questions if you ever had any, and he only wanted the best for his students. I'd recommend him highly!
Great Math Teacher, Best teacher I have  ever had , he is good with helping all students achieve. Takes time with all questions I would take his class again

He did a really good job of explaining the tougher materials in class. If you go to class, and do the homework you will do fine. He is really down to Earth and will go out of his way to help you. He is just a cool cat.

Took  Math 1010 from him at SLCC, would not have passed if it weren't for him.  He's very willing to help.  He can get going too fast at times, but he will always go back and make sure you understand.  He's a cool guy.

Kyle is a great instructor!  He can take complex subjects, and explains them in easy-to-understand language.  He spends A LOT of time and resources into helping his students.  His grading is fair, but his tests can be difficult.  He was a little bit flaky when showing up to lectures, though, which was frustrating.  I recommend this class!

Kyle is super awesome and he's so helpful! If you have any questions he will definitely help you out. He'll show you multiple ways to work out a problem. The tests are a little tough, but as long as you're willing to work for your grade you should be fine. And he's also hot, so that's a plus!

He's very willing to engage and spend a lot time with you for help. During class he can be a bit confusing. He seems to get a little tongue-tied with stuff at times but is very receptive to feedback. Assignments online are time consuming but helpful. His tests were weird--2 matched the stuff we did and the other 2 were a little iffy but he curves.

Make sure you go to class otherwise you will have trouble with everything going on. He's a great teacher and will help you if your having trouble. Does a lot of tutoring! so make sure you go to that if your having trouble. Some test are a bit hard but if you study, you'll be fine.

He's a good teacher his tests are difficult, but it's not specific to him, it's more of just the subject. He explains things 3 different ways. open to feedback and student involvement. He hates cheaters with a passion.
The classwork was easy, but she took months to grade anything and give feedback. She was very difficult to get ahold of to ask about grades or improvement in classwork.
Couldn't be easier. Don't expect any type of help/communication though, not that you'd need it.

Zuzanna is an extremely talented photographer. Although she can take some time to get back to you she does give helpful feedback. It is a great class to take for non photography majors, because you learn a great deal about the art of photography. I would recommend taking it from her!

I took her online photography class and she was the WORST! Zuzanna took at least 1-2 months to grade each assingment, she never gave feedback, would NEVER respond to emails. Unprofessional!!!! She should not teach online courses where the main source of communication is emailing.

Very easy class, since you can re-submit the assignments as many times as you want. She is a pro in photography, so don't worry if you don't understand what she is saying in class. As long as you know what to do in your assignments you will do fine in the class.

I took her digital photography online course last summer semester and she did a horrible job. She was very unprofessional. It took her 4 weeks to get back to us on our grades! And weeks and weeks in between. She kept pushing back due dates and it became clear that she did not care about the class and did not invest any time in it at all.

It's clear Zuzanna knows a lot, but she struggled with conveying that to the class. She hardly ever responds to emails, cancels class last minute (which would be fine if we didn't have to make up for it during finals week), and seemed confused as to what she wanted to teach. I think with more organization she could be great, but as of now she's not

Zuzanna Audette was very unprofessional. I took her online class this summer (13') and she didn't grade our photo assignments for weeks. A month later she graded our assignments in bulk and kept delaying due dates and apologizing about the "delayed grading." I felt like I wasn't being taught by a real professor! I was underwhelmed and unimpressed!

NM digital photography was the easiest/best class I have taken. we were allowed to resubmit assignments till we got the grade we wanted (except the final portfolio.) You may want to take notes on what types of photos different photographers use and understand how F-stop aperture and ISO work together. I highly recommend!fun to see everyone's photos

I wasnt too excited to take an art class but she made it pretty fun. The assignments are easy and she's very helpful. I learned a lot about my camera. If you want an easy going class I'd take it from her.

I took Zuzanna's online digital photography class and was very unimpressed with her as a professor.  It took her WEEKS if not months to get our grades back to us, and consequently she just kept pushing due dates back (past when finals were over).  She never responded to emails which is imperative when taking an online class.  I was very unimpressed
Zuzanna is awesome! I had no idea how to use a camera and she personally showed me what to do. My photographs have dramatically improved. I look forward to taking more classes from her.
Awesome photographer, great professor. A little rude in her critiques, but there's no doubt she knows what she's talking about.

I think she is amazing.. My love for photography has grown even more.. I had her last semester as well and she is very helpful and easy to understand. She expects the best from her students and I believe that helps us all strive to be the better versions of ourselves.

Zuzanna is a great teacher!  Really knows the subject well and is very willing to help.  I didn't want to take any art classes, but I'm really glad I took this one.  I'm going to buy myself a better camera after this.

Pretty cool teacher.  I thought I knew a good deal about digital photography before I took the class but within the first few weeks I learned more about camera function and techniques than I had known about before.  The class gives you a chance to do things that, at least in my experience, I would not get the chance to do.  Awesome instructor.
No Comments

If you are interested in getting into photography, you'll like Audette and her class. She is always willing to help you with you photographs and withe questions you might have about your camera. She grades fair and the assignments are easy but you get what you put in. I really liked the class.

While he was teaching, all he did was writing out algebra step, not explaining a single thing. Co teach with Bei Wang Phillips and im sick of both. They like copy and paste from each other for every steps in lecture, without actually teaching students what they really need to understand. Professors like this should not teach anyone.

This class is advertised as "beginner course" but it/he was helpless in teaching beginners. TA's were okay, but had interesting teaching styles I couldn't follow, lectures were lots of rambling and felt like I wasn't actually learning anything. Homework was way too hard. If you have no programming experience, pray! Lots of YouTube/outside studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is the most uncaring Professor I've ever had (Especially during this pandemic event). I have problems with my internet, and he did not accept quizzes that I uploaded since it was late (even though I was waiting for the upload bar to finish but the time for the submission was already done.) Note for u guys: DON'T EVER TAKE HIS CLASS.

Worst lecturer I have ever had. Co-taught with Phillips, and both were horrendous. Not to mention that tough lecture material was given as "take home work" and in order to get taught that material you would have to attend office hours. Very pathetic in my opinion. Not to mention the example problems are taken straight from the book. VERY lazy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: It is clear that the professor does not care about the students or the class in general and repeatedly takes the easy way for himself. Would redirect all questions to TAs even if you asked him in person. He teaches the course like you have prior knowledge of computing. If you do not have experience, expect to spend about 50+ hrs weekly on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Comp 1010 is called as programming for all, and was listed as an intro/beginner level class. This was not the case as it seems that if you don't have background you will heavily struggle to keep up. This "beginner" level class by has 50-60 hours of homework a week, which is absurd for an intro class.
Great professor, tends to get a little distracted by student questions, but that's only because he wants everyone to understand everything.

Dr. Rakamaric is a good lecturer and he cares very much that you understand all the material. If you attend class you will do well on your homework and in turn you will understand everything you need to do well on the exams. Also, if you have time to put in some extra work he offers a bit of extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at the U. Takes his time to respond to ALL questions (which can lead to going off a tangent), researches and gives feedback on questions he didn't have answers for. Intelligent, funny, easy-going, understanding!, great charisma.

Zvonimir explains the topics as good as anyone can and doesn't give overly demanding homework assignments but you have to work very hard and know the material well. I didn't like the exams because the problems on the exams had several problem styles that were only covered once in class or once in the homework. He's the best teacher for this course.

Zvonimir is very funnyentertaining in lecture. Tests (quizzes) are weighted heavily but easy enough if you've done the homework. Chances are you've seen most of the material in other classes especially if you decide to take this late in the major. Zvonimir sometimes gets a little off topic, but it makes the class interesting.
Dylan is a super instructor. His pre-class notes are clear, concise and funny! His lectures are also engaging. He is definitely one of the better math professors at the U.

Such a good professor. He literally reads the book for you and posts the notes online. His tests are more than fair in that they are set up for you to get everything right. Best math professor I've had so far at the U.

Prof Zwick is very easy going. Knows his material very well. He is always available during his office hours and whenever you drop by his office, he is very willing to help. We used to have quizzes every friday and they were very easy. Exams vey also very easy. He welcomes questions in class as well. I would highly recommend this prof
